My heart is full of trouble. Please bring me out of my troubles.
Look at my pain and my trouble. Forgive all my sins.
Look at how many enemies I have. They hate me with cruel hate.
Keep me safe and save me. Do not let me be embarrassed, because I trust in You.
May goodness and honesty keep me safe, because I trust in You.
Save Israel, O God, from all its troubles.
Judge me, O the LORD, because I have lived in an honest way. I trusted in the LORD and did not turn away.
Test me, O the LORD, and try me. Look deep into my heart and mind.
Your love is always in front of me, and I have lived by Your truth.
I have not sat with people who lie, and I do not go with people who pretend to be good.
I hate groups of bad people. I will not sit with evil people.
I wash my hands to show I am clean. I walk around Your altar, O the LORD.
I speak out with thanks. I tell all the amazing things You do.
O the LORD, I love Your house. It is where You live and where Your glory is.
Do not take me away with people who do wrong. Do not take my life with people who hurt others.
They use their hands for bad plans. Their right hands are full of money to cheat.
But I will live in an honest way. Save me and be kind to me.
My feet stand on flat ground. In the big group I will praise the the LORD.
The LORD is my light and the One who saves me. Who should I be afraid of? The LORD is the safe place in my life. Who can scare me?
Bad people came close to hurt me. My enemies and foes tripped and fell.
Even if an army camps against me, I will not be afraid. Even if war comes against me, I will still trust in the LORD.
One thing I ask of the LORD. This is what I want: to live in the LORD's home all my days. I want to see how good the LORD is. I want to look around in His holy place.
On a bad day, He will hide me in His safe place. He will keep me safe under His tent. He will lift me up on a rock.
Now I will stand tall above my enemies all around. In His tent I will give happy sacrifices. I will sing and make music to the LORD.
Hear me, the LORD, when I call. Be kind to me and answer me.
My heart says, "Look for the face of the LORD." I will look for Your face, the LORD.
Do not hide Your face from me. Do not push away Your servant in anger. You have helped me. Do not leave me or forget me, God who saves me.
Even if my father and mother leave me, The LORD will take me in.
Teach me Your way, the LORD. Lead me on a safe, straight path because of my enemies.
Do not let my enemies take me. Liars have stood up against me. They breathe out harm.
I believe I will see the goodness of the LORD in this life.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong and take heart. Wait for the LORD.
I call to You, the LORD. Do not be quiet to me, my Rock. If You do not answer, I will be like people who go down to the grave.
Hear my cry for help when I lift my hands to Your holy place.
Do not drag me away with bad people, with people who do wrong. They say nice things to their friends, but their hearts are full of bad plans.
Give them what they deserve for their bad deeds. Pay them back for the wrong they have done.
They do not care about what the LORD does or about His great works. So He will tear them down, and they will not be built again.
Praise the LORD! He heard my cry for help.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusts in Him, and He helps me. So my heart is glad, and I will sing to thank Him.
The LORD gives strength to His people. He keeps His chosen one safe.
Save Your people and bless the people You chose. Be their shepherd and carry them forever.
A song of David. Give to the LORD, you mighty beings. Give to the LORD glory and strength.
Give to the LORD the glory His name deserves. Worship the LORD in His holy beauty.
The LORD's voice is over the waters. The God of glory thunders. The LORD is over many waters.
The LORD's voice is strong. The LORD's voice is grand.
The LORD's voice breaks the cedar trees. Yes, the LORD breaks the cedar trees of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon jump like a calf. He makes Sirion jump like a young wild ox.
The LORD's voice shakes the desert. The LORD shakes the desert of Kadesh.
The LORD's voice twists the oak trees. It strips the woods bare. In His temple all cry, "Glory!"
The LORD sits as King over the flood. The LORD sits as King forever.
The LORD gives strength to His people. The LORD blesses His people with peace.
I will praise You, the LORD, because You lifted me up. You did not let my enemies laugh at me.
the LORD my God, I called to You, and You healed me.
the LORD, You brought me back from death. You kept me alive so I would not go down to the grave.
Sing to the LORD, all you who love Him. Give thanks to His holy name.
For His anger lasts only a short time, but His kindness lasts all our lives. We may cry at night, but joy comes in the morning.
When things were going well, I said, "I will never fall."
the LORD, by Your kindness You made me strong like a mountain. Then You looked away, and I was scared.
I called to You, the LORD. I begged You for mercy.
What good would it do if I died? Would dust praise You? Would it tell Your truth?
Hear me, the LORD, and be kind to me. the LORD, please help me.
You turned my sadness into dancing. You took off my sad clothes and dressed me with joy.
Now I will sing and praise You. I will not be quiet. the LORD my God, I will thank You forever.
For the music leader. A song of David. In you, the LORD, I run for safety. Please don't let me be ashamed forever. Save me because You do what is right.
Listen to me quickly. Come rescue me soon. Be my strong rock. Be my safe fort. Save me.
You are my rock and my fort. Lead me and guide me because of who You are.
Keep me out of the trap they hid for me. You are my safe place.
I give You my life. You saved me, the LORD. You are the true God.
I hate people who trust in empty lies. But I trust in the LORD.
I will be glad and happy because of Your love. You saw my trouble. You knew I was hurting.
You did not let my enemy catch me. You put my feet in a big, open place.
Be kind to me, the LORD. I am in trouble. My eyes hurt from crying. I am sad in my heart and body.
My life is full of pain. My years are full of groaning. My strength is gone because of my sin. My bones are weak.
All my enemies make fun of me. My neighbors are scared of me. My friends run away when they see me. People on the street avoid me.
People forgot me like I am dead. I feel like a broken pot.
I hear many people whispering, "Danger is all around!" They plan together against me. They want to kill me.
But I trust in you, the LORD. I say, "You are my God."
My whole life is in Your hands. Save me from my enemies. Save me from those who chase me.
Smile on me, Your servant. Save me because of Your love.
The LORD, do not let me be ashamed. I called to You. Let the bad people be ashamed. Let them be quiet in the grave.
Stop their lying mouths. They speak proud and mean words against good people.
How great is Your goodness! You keep it for people who respect You. You give it to them where everyone can see, to those who hide in You.
You hide them in Your safe place. You keep them safe from people's evil plans. You keep them safe in Your home from mean words.
Praise the LORD! He did a great thing for me. He showed me His love when I was in a city under attack.
I was scared and said, "You have forgotten me!" But You heard my cry for help. You listened when I called.
Love the LORD, all His faithful people! The LORD keeps those who are true. But He pays back proud people in full.
Be strong. Take heart, all you who hope in the LORD.
Happy is the person whose wrongs are forgiven. Happy is the person whose sins are covered.
Happy is the person whose wrongdoing the the LORD does not count against him, and who has no lies in his heart.
When I kept quiet, my bones felt weak. I groaned all day.
Day and night, Your hand was heavy on me. My strength dried up like it does in summer heat.
Then I told You about my sin. I did not hide my wrongdoing. I said, "I will confess my wrongs to the the LORD." And You took away my guilt.
So let every faithful person pray to You while You can be found. When big floods come, they will not reach him.
You are my safe place. You keep me safe from trouble. You surround me with songs of rescue.
"I will teach you and show you the way to go. I will give you advice, and I will watch over you.
Do not be like a horse or a mule that has no sense. They must be led with a bit and bridle, or they will not come close to you."
Many troubles come to people who do wrong, but faithful love surrounds the person who trusts in the the LORD.
Be glad in the the LORD and rejoice, you who do right. Shout for joy, all you with honest hearts.
Sing with joy to the LORD, you good people. It is right for honest people to praise Him.
Praise the LORD with a harp. Sing to Him with a harp that has ten strings.
Sing a new song to Him. Play well and shout with joy.
The the LORD's words are right. He does all His work with care.
He loves what is right and fair. The earth is full of the LORD's kind love.
The the LORD spoke, and the heavens were made. All the stars were made by the breath of His mouth.
He gathers the sea water into a big pile. He stores the deep water.
Let all the earth fear the the LORD. Let all the people in the world be amazed by Him.
He spoke, and it happened. He gave a command, and it stood firm.
The the LORD stops the plans of countries. He ruins the plans of people.
The the LORD's plan lasts forever. The plans in His heart last for all time.
Happy is the nation whose God is the the LORD. Happy are the people He chose to be His own.
The the LORD looks down from heaven. He sees all people.
From where He lives, He looks at all who live on earth.
He made their hearts. He sees all the things they do.
No king is saved by a big army. No strong fighter escapes by his great strength.
A horse cannot save anyone. Even with its great strength, it cannot save.
The the LORD watches over those who fear Him. He watches those who trust His kind love.
He saves them from death. He keeps them alive when there is no food.
We wait for the the LORD. He is our help and our protector.
Our hearts are glad in Him, because we trust His special name.
May Your kind love rest on us, O the LORD, as we put our hope in You.
I will praise the LORD at all times. His praise will always be on my lips.
I am proud of the LORD. Let people who are hurting hear and be happy.
Praise the LORD with me. Let us tell how great His name is together.
I looked for the LORD, and He answered me. He saved me from all my fears.
People who look to Him shine with joy. Their faces will not look ashamed.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him. He saved him from all his troubles.
The angel of the LORD stays near those who respect Him, and he saves them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. The man who trusts in Him is happy.
Respect the LORD, you His people, for those who respect Him do not lack anything.
Even young lions may go hungry, but those who look for the LORD will not lack any good thing.
"Come, my children, listen to me. I will teach you to respect the LORD.
Who wants to live and see good days?
Keep your tongue from evil. Keep your lips from lies.
Turn from evil and do good. Look for peace and go after it."
The eyes of the LORD are on good people. His ears listen to their cries.
The LORD is against people who do evil. He will make people forget them on the earth.
Good people cry out, and the LORD hears them. He saves them from all their troubles.
The LORD is near to people who are sad and hurting. He saves those who are sorry and humble.
Good people may have many troubles, but the LORD saves them from all of them.
He guards all their bones. Not one of them is broken.
Evil will destroy bad people. Those who hate good people will be punished.
The LORD saves people who serve Him. No one who trusts in Him will be punished.
The LORD, fight the people who fight me. Stand against the people who attack me.
Pick up your shield and small shield. Get up and help me.
Lift your spear and throw it at the people chasing me. Say to me, "I will save you."
Make the people who want to kill me feel ashamed. Make the people who plan bad things for me turn back and feel confused.
Make them like dust in the wind. Let the angel of the the LORD push them away.
Make their road dark and slippery. Let the angel of the the LORD chase them.
They hid a net for me for no reason. They dug a hole for me for no reason.
Let trouble come on them by surprise. Let the net they hid catch them. Let them fall into the hole and be ruined.
Then my soul will be happy in the the LORD. I will be glad because He saves me.
All my bones will say, "the the LORD, who is like You? You save poor people from those who are too strong for them. You save poor and needy people from those who rob them."
Mean people stand up and lie about me. They ask me things I do not know.
They pay me back with bad for good. They hurt my heart.
But when they were sick, I wore rough clothes. I made myself humble with not eating. My prayers were not answered.
I walked sadly like I did for a friend or brother. I bowed down in sadness like I lost my mother.
But when I fell, they were happy and came together. People I did not know attacked me. They said bad things about me all the time.
Like mean people at a party, they grit their teeth at me.
How long, O Lord, will You look on? Save my soul from their attacks. Save my life from these lions.
Then I will thank You in the big group. I will praise You among many people.
Do not let my enemies brag about me for no reason. Do not let those who hate me wink for no reason.
They do not talk about peace. They make tricks against quiet people in the land.
They open their mouths wide against me and say, "Aha, aha! We saw it!"
O the the LORD, You have seen. Do not be quiet. O Lord, do not stay far from me.
Wake up and stand up for my side. Stand up for my case, my God and my Lord.
Judge me by Your right ways, O the the LORD my God. Do not let them brag about me.
Do not let them say in their hearts, "Aha, we have swallowed him up!" Do not let them say, "We have eaten him up!"
Let the people who are happy about my trouble feel ashamed together. Let the people who put themselves above me be covered with shame.
Let the people who want what is right shout for joy and be glad. Let them always say, "Great is the the LORD, who is happy with His servant."
Then my tongue will say Your right ways and Your praise all day long.
For the music leader. A song by David. David served the LORD. A thought came to my heart about bad people's sin: "They do not fear God."
He thinks he is too good. He does not see his sin or hate it.
His words are mean and full of lies. He stopped being wise and good.
Even in bed he plans bad things. He walks a bad road. He does not say no to evil.
The LORD, Your kind love reaches the sky. Your truth reaches the clouds.
Your goodness is like God's tall mountains. Your fair choices are like the deep ocean. The LORD, You keep people and animals safe.
How special Your kind love is, God! People find safety in the shadow of Your wings.
They eat the good things in Your house. You give them water from Your river of joy.
You are the source of life. In Your light, we see clearly.
Keep showing Your kind love to people who know You. Show Your right way to people with honest hearts.
Do not let proud people step on me. Do not let bad people push me away.
There the bad people fall. They are thrown down and cannot get up.
Do not get mad at bad people. Do not wish you were like those who do wrong.
They fade fast, like grass. They dry up like green plants.
Trust in the LORD and do good. Live in the land and be faithful.
Enjoy the LORD, and He will give you what your heart wants.
Give your way to the LORD. Trust Him, and He will do it.
He will make your good shine like the morning sun. He will make what is right shine like noon.
Be still before the LORD and wait for Him. Do not get upset when bad people do well. Do not worry about people who make bad plans.
Stop being angry. Let go of rage. Do not get upset. It leads to evil.
Bad people will be cut off. But people who hope in the LORD will get the land.
In a little while, the bad person will be gone. You may look for him, but he will not be there.
But gentle people will get the land. They will enjoy peace and plenty.
Bad people plan harm against good people. They grind their teeth at them.
But the Lord laughs at them, because He sees their day is coming.
Bad people pull out swords and bend bows. They want to hurt poor and needy people. They want to kill people who do right.
But their swords will stab their own hearts. Their bows will break.
A little that a good person has is better than the riches of many bad people.
The arms of bad people will be broken. But the LORD holds up good people.
The LORD knows the days of good people. Their land will last forever.
In hard times they will not be ashamed. In days with no food, they will have enough.
Bad people will die. The LORD's enemies will fade like grass. They will be gone like smoke.
Bad people borrow and do not pay back. Good people are kind and give.
People the LORD blesses will get the land. People He curses will be cut off.
The LORD makes a person's steps steady. He is glad in the way that person goes.
If he falls, he will not be thrown down. The LORD holds his hand.
I was young, and now I am old. I have never seen good people left alone. I have never seen their children begging for bread.
They are always kind and lending. Their children are a blessing.
Turn from evil and do good. Then you will live in the land forever.
The LORD loves what is right. He will not leave His faithful people. They are kept safe forever. But the children of bad people will be cut off.
Good people will get the land. They will live there forever.
A good person's mouth speaks wisdom. his tongue speaks what is right.
God's law is in his heart. his steps will not slip.
Bad people watch good people. They want to kill them.
But the LORD will not leave good people in their power. He will not let them be found guilty when they are judged.
Wait for the LORD. Keep His way. He will lift you up to get the land. You will see bad people cut off.
I saw a bad, scary person. he grew strong like a tree with deep roots.
But he passed away and was gone. I looked for him, but I could not find him.
Look at good people. See people who do right. People of peace have a good future.
But rebels will be destroyed together. The future of bad people will be cut off.
Good people are saved by the LORD. He is their strong place in trouble.
The LORD helps them and frees them. He saves them from bad people, because they trust in Him.
The LORD, do not punish me in Your anger. Do not correct me when You are very angry.
Your arrows hit me deep. Your hand presses down on me.
My body is not well because of Your anger. My bones hurt because of my sin.
My sins are too many to count. They are a heavy load I cannot carry.
My sores smell bad and are rotting because of my foolish choices.
I am bent over and brought low. I am sad all day long.
My back burns with pain. My body is not well.
I feel numb and crushed. I groan because my heart is hurting.
Lord, You know all I want. You hear my groans.
My heart beats fast. My strength is gone. Even the light in my eyes is fading.
My friends stand far away because I am sick. My family stands far away too.
People who want to kill me set traps. People who want to hurt me say mean things. They lie all day long.
But I am like a deaf man. I do not hear. I am like a man who cannot speak. I do not open my mouth.
I am like a man who cannot hear. My mouth has no answer.
I put my hope in You, the LORD. You will answer me, Lord my God.
I said, "Do not let them be happy over me. They make fun of me when I fall."
I am ready to fall. My pain is always with me.
Yes, I admit my sin. I am worried because of my sin.
Many enemies are strong. Many people hate me for no reason.
They do evil back when I do good. They speak against me because I try to do good.
Do not leave me, the LORD. Do not stay far from me, my God.
Hurry and help me, Lord. You are my Savior.
I said I will watch my ways. I will not sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth shut with a muzzle. I will do this while bad people are near.
I was quiet and said nothing. I did not even say good things. But my sadness got worse.
My heart got hot inside me. When I thought about it, a fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue.
The LORD, show me when my life will end. Show me how long I will live. Help me know how short my life is.
Look, You made my life only a few inches long. My whole life is like nothing to You. Yes, every person is like a breath. Selah.
Yes, people walk around like shadows. They worry for nothing. They gather things, but they do not know who will get them.
And now, Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in You.
Save me from all my wrongs. Do not make me a joke to foolish people.
I am quiet. I do not open my mouth, because You did it.
Take away Your sickness from me. I am worn out by the hit of Your hand.
You teach people with warnings when they do wrong. You melt away what they love, like a moth eats cloth. Yes, every person is like a breath. Selah.
Listen to my prayer, the LORD. Hear my cry. Do not stay quiet when I cry. I am a stranger with You. I live here for a short time, like all my fathers did.
Look away from me, so I can smile, before I leave and am gone.
I waited and waited for the LORD. He leaned down to me and heard my cry for help.
He pulled me out of a deep, muddy pit. He set my feet on a rock and made my steps firm.
He gave me a new song to sing. It praises our God. Many people will see it and respect God, and they will trust the LORD.
Happy is the person who trusts the LORD. That person does not follow proud people or believe lies.
The LORD, my God, You have done many wonderful things. You have great plans for us. No one is like You. If I tried to tell all of them, there would be too many to count.
You did not want gifts or offerings. Instead, You made me able to listen. You did not ask for burned gifts or gifts for sin.
Then I said, "Here I am. I have come. It is written about me in the book.
I want to do what You want, my God. Your rules are in my heart."
I tell people what is right when many people are together. I do not keep my mouth shut. You, the LORD, know this.
I have not kept Your goodness a secret in my heart. I have told people about Your faithfulness and Your help. I have not hidden Your love and Your truth from the crowd.
The LORD, do not keep Your mercy from me. Let Your love and truth always protect me.
Troubles are all around me. I cannot count them. My sins have caught up with me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs on my head. My heart feels weak.
The LORD, please save me. Hurry and help me, the LORD.
Let the people who try to kill me be ashamed and confused. Let the people who want to hurt me turn back and feel ashamed.
Let the people who say, "Aha! Aha!" be ruined because of their shame.
Let everyone who looks for You be happy and glad in You. Let those who love Your saving help always say, "The LORD is great!"
But I am poor and need help. Please think of me, Lord. You are my helper and my rescuer. My God, do not wait.
For the music leader. A psalm of David. Happy is the person who cares for poor people. The LORD saves him when trouble comes.
The LORD watches over him and keeps him alive. He is happy in the land. Do not let his enemies get what they want.
The LORD helps him when he is sick in bed. You make him well again when he is sick.
I said, “The LORD, have mercy on me. Heal me, because I have sinned against You.”
My enemies say bad things about me. They ask, “When will he die? When will people forget his name?”
When someone comes to see me, he says false things. He keeps bad thoughts in his heart. Then he goes out and spreads them.
All who hate me whisper together against me. They plan to hurt me.
They say, “A terrible sickness has hit him. He will never get up again.”
Even my close friend, whom I trusted, who ate with me, has turned against me.
But You, the LORD, have mercy on me and raise me up, so I can pay them back.
This is how I know You are happy with me: my enemy does not win over me.
You hold me up because I have done right. You let me stand before You forever.
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, from now and forever. Amen and amen.
A deer longs for streams of water. Just like that, my soul longs for You, God.
My soul is thirsty for God, for the living God. When can I go and see God?
I have cried so much day and night. People ask me all day, “Where is your God?”
I remember these things, and I tell God how I feel. I used to walk with the crowd to God’s house. We sang happy songs and gave thanks. Many people were there for the feast.
Why are you sad, my soul? Why are you upset inside me? Hope in God. I will praise Him again. He saves me. He is my God.
My God, I am sad deep inside. So I remember You, even here by the Jordan River and Mount Hermon, near Mount Mizar.
One trouble calls to another. I hear Your waterfalls roar. Your waves wash over me again and again.
By day the the LORD shows His kind love. At night His song is with me. I pray to the God who gives me life.
I say to God, my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk around sad while my enemy hurts me?”
My enemies make fun of me. They hurt me deep inside. They say all day, “Where is your God?”
Why are you sad, my soul? Why are you upset inside me? Hope in God. I will praise Him again. He saves me. He is my God.
Stand up for me, God. Fight my case against people who do not follow You. Save me from liars and people who do wrong.
You are my strong God. Why did You turn away from me? Why must I walk sad, pushed down by my enemy?
Send Your light and Your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and Your home.
Then I will go to God's altar. I will go to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with a harp, O God, my God.
Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you upset inside me? Put your hope in God. I will still praise Him. He is the One who saves me and my God.
We heard it ourselves, God. Our fathers told us what You did long ago.
You pushed out other nations by Your power and planted Your people there. You crushed other groups and sent them away.
They did not take the land by their own power. Their own strength did not save them. It was Your power and Your strength and Your favor, because You were pleased with them.
You are my King, God. Please give help to Jacob.
With Your help we will push back our enemies. In Your name we will walk over those who fight us.
I will not trust my bow. My sword will not save me.
You saved us from our enemies. You made those who hate us feel ashamed.
We praise God all day long. We will thank Your name forever.
But now You have pushed us away and put us to shame. You do not go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from our enemies. Those who hate us take our things.
You let us be like sheep for food. You scattered us among the nations.
You sold Your people for almost nothing. You did not get much money for us.
You made us a shame to our neighbors. People all around us laugh at us and make fun of us.
You made us a bad example to other nations. People everywhere shake their heads at us.
All day long I feel ashamed. Shame covers me.
I hear people tease and say bad things. I see the enemy and the one who wants to hurt us.
All this happened to us, but we did not forget You. We did not lie about Your promise.
Our hearts did not turn away. Our steps did not wander from Your path.
Yet You crushed us in a place of wild animals. You covered us with deep darkness.
If we forgot the name of our God, or prayed to another god,
would not God find out? He knows the secrets of our hearts.
But for Your sake we are killed all day long. People count us like sheep to be killed.
Wake up, Lord! Why do You sleep? Get up! Do not leave us forever.
Why do You hide Your face? Why do You forget our trouble and our hard times?
We are pushed down to the dust. Our bodies stick to the ground.
Get up and help us. Save us because of Your love.
My heart is full of a good thought. I say my words to the king. My tongue is like the pen of a good writer.
You are the best looking of men. Kind words pour from your lips. So God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword to your side, mighty hero. Show your glory and greatness.
Ride out in victory with your greatness. Fight for truth, kindness, and what is right. Let your right hand do great things.
Your arrows hit the hearts of the king's enemies. The nations fall under you.
Your throne, God, lasts forever and ever. Justice is the power of Your kingdom.
You have loved what is right and hated what is wrong. So God, your God, has poured oil of joy on you more than on your friends.
All your clothes smell sweet with myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Music from the palace makes you glad.
Princesses stand among your honored women. The queen stands at your right hand in gold from Ophir.
Listen, daughter. Think and listen well. Forget your people and your father's house.
The king will want your beauty. Bow down to him, because he is your lord.
The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift. Rich men will ask for your favor.
The princess is very beautiful in her room. Her dress is sewn with gold.
She is led to the king in colorful clothes. Her young friends are brought to you.
They are led in with joy and gladness. They go into the king's palace.
Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You will make them leaders in all the land.
I will keep your name alive in every generation. So the nations will praise you forever and ever.
God is our safe place and our strength. He is always ready to help when trouble comes.
So we will not be afraid, even if the earth changes and mountains fall into the sea.
Even if the sea roars and foams and the mountains shake. Selah.
A river has streams that make God's city glad. It is the holy place where the Most High lives.
God is in that city, so it will not fall. God will help it in the morning.
Nations are loud and kingdoms fall. God speaks, and the earth melts.
The LORD of Hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our strong place. Selah.
Come and see what the LORD has done. He has brought ruin on the earth.
He stops wars all over the earth. He breaks bows and cuts spears. He burns shields in fire.
"Be calm and know that I am God. I will be honored among the nations. I will be honored on the earth."
The LORD of Hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our strong place. Selah.
Clap your hands, all you people. Shout to God with a happy shout.
The LORD Most High is awesome. He is the great King over all the earth.
He makes other nations obey us. He puts them under our feet.
He chose the land we get. It is the best part of Jacob's land, and He loves it.
God went up with a shout. The LORD went up with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing to God. Sing to God. Sing to our King. Sing to God.
God is King of all the earth. Sing a wise song to Him.
God rules over the nations. God sits on His holy throne.
The leaders of the nations came together. They are the people of the God of Abraham. The rulers of the earth belong to God. He is raised up very high.
A song. A psalm for the sons of Korah. The LORD is great. People should praise Him very much in the city of our God. It is His holy mountain.
It is beautiful and high. It makes all the earth happy. It is like the mountains in the far north. It is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
God is in its strong towers. He has shown that He is a safe place.
Look! The kings came together. They all marched by together.
They saw it and were amazed. They ran away in fear.
They shook with fear there. Pain hit them like a woman having a baby.
You broke the ships from Tarshish with an east wind.
We heard about these things, and now we have seen them in the city of the LORD of heaven's armies, in the city of our God. God will keep it strong forever. Selah.
In Your temple, O God, we think about Your kind love.
Like Your name, O God, Your praise reaches all over the world. You always do what is right.
Mount Zion is glad. The people of Judah are happy because you judge fairly.
Walk around Zion. Count its towers.
Look closely at its walls. Look at its strong towers. Then you can tell the next group of people.
This God is our God forever. He will lead us even after we die.
Hear this, all people. Listen, everyone in the world.
Rich and poor, high and low, all listen together.
My mouth will speak wise things. My heart will share good thoughts.
I will listen to a wise saying. I will play my harp and explain my puzzle.
Why should I be afraid on bad days, when my sins catch up with me?
Some people trust in their money. They brag about how rich they are.
No one can buy back a brother's life. No one can pay God to save him.
It costs too much to save a life. No one can pay it.
So he cannot live forever. He cannot stay out of the grave.
We see that wise people die. Foolish people die too. They leave their money to others.
They think their houses will last forever. They name lands after themselves.
But even a respected person will not last. He is like an animal that dies.
This is how foolish people live. But later people agree with their words.
They are like sheep led to the grave. Death is their shepherd. Good people will rule over them in the morning. Their bodies will rot in the grave, far from their fancy homes.
But God will buy back my life from the grave. He will take me with Him.
Do not be afraid when a person gets rich. Do not worry when his home gets nicer.
When he dies, he takes nothing with him. His wealth does not follow him.
While he lives, he praises himself. People praise you when you do well for yourself.
He will go where his fathers went. He will never see light again.
A person may be honored, but if he does not understand, he is like an animal that dies.
A song by Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and calls the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
From Zion, so beautiful, God shines out.
Our God comes and will not stay quiet. Fire burns in front of Him. A big storm blows all around Him.
He calls to the sky above and to the earth. He will judge His people.
"Bring My faithful people to Me. They made a promise to Me with an offering."
The sky says He is right. God Himself is the judge. Selah.
"Listen, My people, and I will speak. Israel, I will speak against you. I am God, your God.
I am not scolding you for your offerings. I always see your burnt offerings.
I do not need a bull from your house or goats from your pens.
Every wild animal in the forest is Mine. The cattle on a thousand hills are Mine.
I know every bird in the mountains. The animals in the fields are Mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, because the whole world is Mine, and all that is in it.
Do I eat the meat of bulls? Do I drink the blood of goats?
Bring a thank offering to God. Keep your promises to the Most High.
Call on Me when you are in trouble. I will save you, and you will honor Me."
But God says to the wicked, "What right do you have to talk about My laws? Why do you take My promise with your lips?
You hate My teaching and throw My words behind you.
When you see a thief, you join him. You take part with people who cheat in marriage.
You use your mouth for bad things. You tie your tongue to lies.
You sit and speak against your brother. You tell lies about your own mother's son.
You did these things, and I kept quiet. You thought I was like you. But I will correct you and show you your wrongs."
"Now think about this, you who forget God, or I will tear you apart, and no one will save you.
The one who gives a thank offering honors Me. I will show how God saves to the one who lives right."

For the music leader. A psalm of David. Nathan the prophet came to David after David had sinned with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God. Be kind to me because of Your faithful love. You have so much mercy. Wipe away my wrongs.
Wash me clean from my wrongs. Make me pure from my sin.
I know my wrongs. My sin is always in front of me.
I sinned against You alone. I did what is bad in Your eyes. So You are right when You speak. You are fair when You judge.
I was born sinful. I have done wrong since my mother was pregnant with me.
You want truth deep inside me. You teach me wisdom in my secret heart.
Clean me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear joy and gladness again. Let the bones You broke be happy again.
Turn Your face away from my sins. Wipe away all my wrongs.
Make a clean heart in me, God. Give me a new and steady spirit.
Do not throw me away from Your presence. Do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
Give me back the joy of Your saving me. Give me a willing spirit to help me stand.
Then I will teach wrongdoers Your ways. Sinners will come back to You.
Save me from the guilt of killing, God. You are the God who saves me. Then I will sing about how good and right You are.
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will tell Your praise.
You do not want sacrifices, or I would give them. You do not want burnt offerings.
The sacrifice God wants is a broken spirit. A broken and sorry heart, God, You will not turn away.
Be kind to Zion. Build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Then You will be pleased with good sacrifices and whole burnt offerings. Then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
Why do you brag about doing bad, strong man? God's love lasts all day.
Your tongue plans trouble. It is like a sharp razor. You trick people.
You love what is bad more than what is good. You love lies more than truth.
You love words that hurt people. Your tongue tricks people.
But God will bring you down forever. He will snatch you and pull you from your tent. He will pull you up by the roots from the land of the living.
Good people will see it and be afraid. They will laugh at him and say,
"Look at the man who did not make God his safe place. He trusted his many riches. He made himself strong with his bad ways."
But I am like a green olive tree in God's house. I trust in God's love forever and ever.
I will praise You forever, because You did this. I will wait for Your name, because it is good, with Your faithful people.
The fool says to himself, “There is no God.” They are bad. They do bad things. No one does good.
God looks down from heaven at people. He wants to see if anyone understands and looks for God.
They all turned away. Together, they became bad. No one does good. Not even one.
Will those who do wrong never learn? They hurt my people as if it were nothing. They do not pray to God.
There they are, very afraid, even though there was nothing to fear. God scattered the bones of those who attacked His people. He put them to shame, because He rejected them.
I wish Israel’s help would come from Zion! When God brings His people home again, Jacob will be glad. Israel will be happy.

This song is for the music leader. Use stringed instruments. David wrote it to teach. The Ziphites went to Saul and said, "Is David not hiding with us?" Save me, O God, by Your name. Judge me by Your power.
Hear my prayer, O God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
Strangers have turned against me. Mean men want to kill me. They do not care about God.
God is my helper. The Lord keeps me alive.
He will send trouble back to my enemies. In Your truth, destroy them.
I will freely give You an offering. I will praise Your name, O the LORD, because it is good.
He has saved me from all trouble. My eyes have seen my enemies fall.
God, please listen to my prayer. Do not hide from me when I ask for help.
Pay attention to me and answer me. I am upset, and I groan.
I hear my enemy. Wicked people hurt me. They bring trouble on me, and they hate me in anger.
My heart pounds in me. I am scared I might die.
I am afraid and I shake. A deep fear covers me.
I said, “I wish I had wings like a dove. Then I would fly away and rest.
I would go far away. I would stay in the desert. Selah.
I would hurry to a safe place away from the wild wind and storm.”
Lord, mix up their words. I see hurting and fighting in the city.
Day and night they walk around its walls. Trouble and evil are inside it.
The city is full of trouble. Lies and cheating are in its streets.
If an enemy made fun of me, I could take it. If someone who hates me came against me, I could hide from him.
But it is you, a man like me. You are my friend, my close friend.
We used to enjoy being together. We walked with the crowd to God's house.
Let death grab them. Let them go down alive to the grave. Evil is in their homes and hearts.
But I will call on God, and the LORD will save me.
Morning, noon, and night, I will complain and cry out, and He will hear me.
He saved my life and gave me peace from those who fought me, because many were against me.
God will hear and bring them down. He has been king forever. They do not change, and they do not fear God. Selah.
My friend has turned against his friends. He broke his promise.
His words are smooth like butter, but he wants war in his heart. His words are soft like oil, but they are like sharp swords.
Give your worries to the LORD. He will take care of you. He will never let good people fall.
But You, God, will bring them down to a deep pit. People who hurt others and lie will not live long. But I will trust in You.
God, be kind to me. People hunt me down. They attack me all day.
My enemies hunt me all day. Many proud people attack me.
When I am afraid, I will trust in You.
I praise God's word. I trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?
All day they twist my words. They plan to hurt me.
They team up and hide. They watch my steps. They wait to take my life.
Will they get away with their sin? God, in Your anger, bring down the nations.
You count my steps as I wander. Put my tears in Your bottle. Are they not in Your book?
Then my enemies will turn back when I call. I know this: God is for me.
I praise God's word. I praise the LORD's word.
I trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?
God, I have promised things to You. I will give You thanks.
You saved my life from death. You kept my feet from falling. Now I can walk before God in the light of life.
Be kind to me, God. Be kind to me. I run to You for safety. I will hide in Your care until the trouble is gone.
I cry out to God Most High, to God who helps me.
He sends help from heaven and saves me. He stops the people who chase me. God sends His love and His truth.
I am among dangerous men. They are like hungry beasts. Their teeth are like sharp spears and arrows. Their words cut like swords.
Be praised, O God, above the sky. Let Your greatness be seen over the whole earth.
They set a trap for my feet. I was weak and sad. They dug a hole in my path, but they fell into it themselves.
My heart is strong, O God. My heart is strong. I will sing and make music.
Wake up, my heart! Wake up, music! I will wake up at dawn to praise You.
I will praise You, Lord, where all nations can hear. I will sing about You among all people.
Your love is so big it reaches the sky. Your truth reaches the clouds.
Be praised, O God, above the sky. Let Your greatness be seen over the whole earth.
For the music leader. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A song of David. Do you really say what is right, you leaders? Do you judge people fairly, you people?
No, in your hearts you plan bad things. Your hands are full of violence on the earth.
Bad people turn away from God from the time they are born. They have always told lies.
Their poison is like a snake's poison. They are like a deaf cobra that will not listen.
It will not listen to snake charmers, even if the snake charmer is very good.
O God, break the teeth in their mouths. O the LORD, pull out the fangs of those young lions.
May they melt away like water that runs off. When He shoots His arrows, may they be useless.
They are like a snail that melts away. They are like a baby born dead that never sees the sun.
Before your pots feel the heat of thorn bushes, whether green or dry, He will sweep them away like a storm.
Good people will be glad when they see God punish bad people. They will wash their feet in the blood of bad people.
Then people will say, "Surely good people get a reward. Surely God judges the earth."
Save me from my enemies, my God. Keep me safe from people who stand against me.
Save me from people who do wrong. Save me from killers.
They hide and wait to hurt me. Mean men plan against me, but I did nothing wrong. I did not sin, the LORD.
They run to get ready, but I did nothing wrong. Wake up and help me. Look!
You are the LORD God of all armies. You are the God of Israel. Wake up and punish all people. Do not be kind to bad people who turn away from You. Selah
They come back in the evening. They growl like dogs. They walk around the city.
See what they say with their mouths. Their words cut like swords. They think no one hears them.
But You, the LORD, laugh at them. You make fun of all people.
You are my strength. I will watch for You, because God is my safe place.
My God is full of kind love. He will come to help me. God will let me see my enemies lose.
Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Send them away with Your power, and make them fall, O Lord, our shield.
Their mouths sin, and their words are bad. Let them be caught in their pride. They speak curses and lies.
Be angry and wipe them out. Wipe them out, so everyone on earth will know that God rules over Jacob. Selah
They come back in the evening. They growl like dogs. They walk around the city.
They look for food. They growl if they are not full.
But I will sing about Your strength. In the morning I will tell about Your kind love. You have been my safe place. You help me when I am in trouble.
You are my strength, so I will sing to You. God is my safe place. God is the one who loves me with kind love.
You turned away from us, God. You broke us. You were angry. Please bring us back.
You shook the land and tore it open. Fix its cracks, because it is shaking.
You made Your people see hard times. You gave us wine that makes us wobble.
You gave a flag to people who fear You, so they can lift it up because of truth. Selah.
Answer us and save us by Your right hand, so the people You love may be saved.
God has spoken from His holy place: "I will win. I will divide Shechem. I will measure the Valley of Succoth.
"Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine. Ephraim is the helmet on My head. Judah is My ruler's stick.
"Moab is My washbasin. I will throw My sandal on Edom. I will shout with joy over Philistia."
Who will take me to the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You not turned away from us, God? Will You not go with our armies?
Give us help against our enemies, because help from people is worth nothing.
With God we will be brave, and He will crush our enemies.
Hear my cry, O God. Listen to my prayer.
I call to You from far away. When I feel weak inside, lead me to a safe place higher than I am.
You have been my safe place. You are like a strong tower against my enemies.
I want to live in Your house forever. I want to hide under Your loving care.
You, O God, have heard my promises. You gave me the same gift You give to people who honor Your name.
Please let the king live many more years. Let his life last for many years to come.
Let him rule with God forever. Send Your kind love and truth to keep him safe.
Then I will always sing to praise Your name. I will keep my promises every day.
I wait quietly for God alone. He saves me.
He alone is my rock. He saves me. He is my safe place. I will not be shaken.
How long will you attack one man? Will all of you knock him down? He is like a wall about to fall, like a fence ready to break.
They plan to bring him down from his high place. They love lies. They say good things with their mouths, but they curse him in their hearts. Selah
I tell myself to rest in God alone. I hope in Him.
He alone is my rock. He saves me. He is my safe place. I will not be shaken.
God saves me and gives me honor. He is my strong rock. I am safe in Him.
Trust in Him at all times, people. Pour out your hearts to Him. God is our safe place. Selah
People are like a puff of air. Even important people are a lie. On a scale, they are too light. They weigh less than a puff of air.
Do not trust in money you took by force. Do not hope in stolen things. Even if your money grows, do not set your heart on it.
God has said one thing. I have heard two things. Power belongs to God.
And that You, Lord, are kind. You will give each person what he deserves.
God, You are my God. I look for You with all my heart. I am thirsty for You. My body is weak for You. It is like a dry, tired land with no water.
So I saw You in the holy place. I saw Your power and Your glory.
Your kind love is better than life. My lips will praise You.
So I will bless You while I live. I will lift my hands in Your name.
I will be as full as after a big feast. My mouth will praise You with happy lips.
When I am in bed, I remember You. I think about You at night.
You have helped me. I will be happy in the shadow of Your wings.
I hold tight to You. Your right hand holds me up.
But the people who want to kill me will go deep into the ground.
They will be killed by swords. Wild animals will eat them.
But the king will be glad in God. Everyone who makes a promise in His name will praise Him. People who lie will stop talking.
God, please hear my voice when I pray to You. Keep me safe from my enemies.
Hide me from the secret plans of bad people. Hide me from the noisy crowd of people who do wrong.
They make their tongues sharp like swords. They aim bitter words like arrows.
From hiding places, they shoot at good people. They shoot fast and do not fear.
They help each other do bad things. They plan traps in secret. They say, “Who will see us?”
They look for ways to do wrong. They search hard. No one can see their hidden thoughts.
But God will shoot an arrow at them. They will be hurt all at once.
Their own words will turn against them. Everyone who sees them will run away.
Then all people will be afraid. They will tell what God did. They will think carefully about His work.
Good people will be happy in the the LORD. They will trust in Him. All honest people will praise Him.
People in Zion wait to praise You, God. They will keep their promise to You.
You hear prayer. Everyone will come to You.
My wrongs are too much for me, but You forgive our sins.
Happy are the people You choose and bring near to live in Your courts. We are full of the good things in Your house. Your holy temple is wonderful.
You answer us with amazing and good works. You are the God who saves us. People everywhere hope in You, even far across the seas.
You made the mountains with Your power. You are full of strength.
You calm the loud seas and their waves. You calm the noise of the nations.
People far away are amazed by Your signs. Morning and evening shout for joy because of You.
You visit the earth and water it. You make it very rich. Your streams are full of water. You get the grain ready, and You get the earth ready.
You water its rows. You smooth its bumps. You soften it with rain. You help its plants grow.
You fill the year with good things. Everywhere You go has more than enough.
The wild fields are full. The hills are full of joy.
Meadows are full of sheep. Valleys are covered with grain. They shout and sing for joy.
Shout with joy to God, all you people of the earth!
Sing about the glory of His name. Make His praise wonderful.
Say to God, "Your works are amazing! Because You are so strong, Your enemies will bow to You."
All the earth will bow down to You and sing to You. They will sing about Your name. Selah.
Come and see what God has done. He does amazing things for people.
He turned the sea into dry land. They walked across the river. We were happy in Him there.
He rules the world forever with His power. His eyes watch the nations. Don't let stubborn people lift themselves up. Selah.
Praise our God, you nations. Let people hear His praise.
He keeps us alive. He does not let our feet slip.
For You, God, have tested us. You made us pure like silver.
You brought us into a trap. You put a heavy load on our backs.
You let enemies walk all over us. We went through fire and water, but You brought us to a place with plenty.
I will come to Your house with burnt offerings. I will keep the promises I made to You.
My lips promised. My mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
I will bring You burnt offerings of fat animals, with the smoke of rams. I will offer bulls and goats. Selah.
Come and listen, all you who fear God. I will tell you what He did for me.
I cried out to Him with my mouth. Praise was on my tongue.
If I had sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
But God has listened. He has heard my prayer.
Praise God, who has not turned away my prayer or His faithful love from me.
For the music leader. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be kind to us and bless us. May His face shine on us. Selah.
Then people everywhere will know Your way. They will know how You save people among all nations.
May all people praise You, O God. May all people praise You.
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy. You judge people fairly. You lead the nations on earth. Selah.
May all people praise You, O God. May all people praise You.
The earth has given its crops. God, our God, will bless us.
God will bless us. May people all over the world respect Him.
God stands up. His enemies scatter. The people who hate Him run away.
Smoke blows away. Wax melts near fire. In the same way, bad people are destroyed when God is near.
Good people are happy. They cheer before God. They are glad and happy.
Sing to God. Sing about His name. Praise the One who rides on the clouds. His name is the LORD. Be happy before Him.
God is a father to children with no parents. He stands up for women whose husbands have died. He lives in His holy home.
God gives lonely people a home. He leads prisoners out with happy songs. But people who fight Him live in a dry, empty land.
God, when You went out ahead of Your people and walked through the empty land, the earth shook.
The sky poured rain because of You. This happened at Mount Sinai, before the God of Israel.
You sent plenty of rain. You made Your land strong when it was tired.
Your people lived there. God, in Your kindness, You gave food to poor people.
The Lord gave the command. Many women told the good news.
Kings and their armies ran away. The woman at home shared the treasure.
Even when God's people rest among sheep pens, they shine like a dove with silver wings and gold feathers.
When God Most High scattered the kings, snow fell on Mount Zalmon.
God's mountain is Mount Bashan. It has many high peaks.
Why are you jealous, you high mountains? This is the mountain God chose for His home. The LORD will live there forever.
God has thousands and thousands of chariots. The Lord is with them in His holy place, at Mount Sinai.
You went up high. You took prisoners. You received gifts from people, even from those who fought You, so the LORD God could live there.
Praise the Lord. He carries our load every day. He is the God who saves us.
Our God saves us. The Lord helps us escape death.
God will crush the heads of His enemies. He will punish the one who keeps doing wrong.
The Lord said, "I will bring them back from Bashan. I will bring them back from the bottom of the sea."
God's people will walk in the blood of their enemies, and their dogs will get a share.
People saw Your march, God. They saw You, my God and King, march into Your holy place.
Singers walked in front. Musicians followed. Young women played tambourines in the middle.
Praise God with the big group. Praise the LORD, people of Israel.
There is Benjamin, the youngest tribe, leading them. There are leaders from Judah, Zebulun, and Naphtali.
God has given strength to His people. God, make strong what You have done for us.
Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings will bring gifts to You.
Stop the wild animal in the reeds. Stop the crowd of strong bulls with their young. They love silver. Scatter the people who love war.
Leaders will come from Egypt. The people of Cush will quickly raise their hands to God.
Sing to God, all kingdoms of the earth. Sing praises to the Lord.
Praise the One who rides on the highest heavens, the heavens that have been there since long ago. Listen, He speaks with a strong voice.
Give praise to God for His strength. His glory is over Israel. His strength is in the sky.
God is amazing in His holy place. The God of Israel gives strength and power to His people. Praise God.
Save me, God! The water is up to my neck.
I sank in deep mud. I can't find a place to stand. I went into deep water, and the flood swept over me.
I am tired from calling out. My throat is dry. My eyes are tired as I wait for my God.
My enemies hate me for no reason. They are more than the hairs on my head. The people who want to destroy me are strong. My enemies tell lies. They make me pay for things I did not take.
God, You know my foolish ways. My sins are not hidden from You.
Lord, the LORD of all armies, do not let the people who hope in You be ashamed because of me. God of Israel, do not let those who look for You be put to shame because of me.
I carry shame for You. Shame covers my face.
I am like a stranger to my brothers. I am like a foreigner to my mother's sons.
My love for Your house eats me up inside. The mean words of people who hate You fall on me.
I cried and did not eat. People made fun of me for it.
I wore rough sackcloth. People used me as a joke.
People at the city gate talk about me. Drunk people sing about me.
But my prayer is to You, the LORD. At the right time, answer me with Your great love. God, answer me with Your true help.
Save me from the mud. Do not let me sink. Save me from my enemies and from deep water.
Do not let the flood sweep over me. Do not let the deep water swallow me. Do not let the well close its mouth over me.
Answer me, the LORD, because Your love is good. Turn to me because You are very kind.
Do not hide Your face from me, Your servant. Answer me fast, because I am in trouble.
Come close and save my life. Buy me back because of my enemies.
You know my shame and my disgrace. All my enemies are in front of You.
Shame broke my heart. I am sick. I looked for someone to feel sorry for me, but no one did. I looked for someone to comfort me, but I found none.
They gave me bitter food. They gave me vinegar to drink when I was thirsty.
Let their table be a trap. Let their peace be a snare.
Let their eyes grow dark so they cannot see. Make their legs shake all the time.
Pour out Your anger on them. Let Your hot anger catch them.
Let their homes be empty. Let no one live in their tents.
They hurt the one You already hit. They talk about the pain of the ones You wounded.
Add their guilt to their guilt. Do not let them share in Your right way.
Wipe their names from the book of life. Do not write their names with good people.
But I am poor and in pain. God, lift me up with Your help.
I will praise God's name with a song. I will make Him great with thanks.
This will please the LORD more than a big bull with horns.
The humble will see and be glad. You who look for God, let your hearts live.
The LORD hears those in need. He does not turn away from His people in chains.
Let heaven and earth praise Him. Let the seas and all that moves in them praise Him.
God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah. People will live there and own it.
The children of His servants will get it. People who love His name will live there.
God, save me! The LORD, hurry to help me.
Let the people who want to kill me feel ashamed and confused. Let those who want to hurt me turn back and feel ashamed.
Let the people who say, “Ha! Ha!” turn back because they feel ashamed.
Let all who look for You be happy and glad in You. Let those who love Your saving help always say, “God is great!”
But I am poor and need help. God, hurry to me! You are my help and the One who saves me. The LORD, do not wait.
I put my trust in You, the LORD. Please never let me be ashamed.
Because You do what is right, save me and rescue me. Listen to me and help me.
Be my safe rock that I can always go to. You have said You will save me. You are my rock and my strong safe place.
My God, save me from bad people. Save me from those who are mean and cruel.
You are my hope, Lord. You are the LORD I trust since I was young.
I have leaned on You since I was born. You brought me into the world. I always praise You.
Many people look at me in surprise. But You are my strong safe place.
My mouth is full of praise for You. I talk about Your greatness all day.
Do not throw me away when I am old. Do not leave me when my strength is gone.
My enemies talk about me. The people who want to hurt me plan together.
They say, “God has left him. Chase him and grab him. No one can save him.”
God, do not stay far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
Let the people who accuse me be put to shame. Let them be ruined. Cover them with shame and disgrace, because they want to hurt me.
But I will always hope in You. I will praise You more and more.
My mouth will tell about Your right ways. It will tell about the ways You save people all day long. I cannot count them all.
I will come with the great things the Lord, the LORD, has done. I will remember that You alone do what is right.
God, You have taught me since I was young. I still tell about Your wonderful works.
Even when I am old and gray, God, do not leave me. Let me tell Your strength to the next generation. Let me tell Your power to everyone who comes after.
Your goodness reaches up to the sky, God. You have done great things. No one is like You, God.
You have let me go through many hard times. But You will make me live again. You will lift me up from the grave.
You will make me great again. You will comfort me again.
I will praise You with a harp, my God, because You are faithful. I will sing to You with music. You are the Holy One of Israel.
My lips will shout for joy as I sing to You. My whole self will sing, because You saved me.
My tongue will talk about Your right help all day. The people who tried to hurt me are ashamed and confused.
God, give the king Your fair rules. Give Your good and right ways to the king’s son.
May he judge Your people in a right way. May he judge Your hurting people fairly.
May the mountains bring peace to the people. May the hills bring good and fair ways.
May he help the people who are hurt. May he save the children of poor people. May he stop the ones who hurt others.
May people honor You while the sun shines. May they honor You while the moon shines, for all time.
May he be like rain on new grass. May he be like showers that water the earth.
While he rules, may good people grow strong. May peace fill the land for all time.
May he rule from sea to sea. May he rule from the river to the ends of the earth.
May the desert people bow to him. May his enemies fall down and give up.
May kings from faraway lands bring gifts. May the kings of Sheba and Seba bring their gifts.
May all kings bow to him. May all nations serve him.
He will save the poor who cry for help. He will help those who hurt and have no one to help them.
He will care for the poor and needy. He will save their lives.
He will rescue them from harm and wrong. He sees their lives as very precious.
May he live a long time. May gold from Sheba be given to him. May people always pray for him and bless him all day.
May there be lots of grain in the land. May it grow on the tops of mountains. May its fruit grow like the trees in Lebanon. May it grow like grass in a field.
May his name last forever. May it grow as long as the sun shines. May all nations be blessed because of him. May they call him blessed.
Praise the LORD God, the God of Israel. He alone does amazing things.
Praise His glorious name forever. May all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.
This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
This song is by Asaph. For sure, God is good to Israel. He is good to people with clean hearts.
But I almost slipped. My feet almost gave way.
I was jealous of proud people. I saw bad people doing well.
They do not hurt when they die. Their bodies are strong.
They do not have the troubles other people have. They are not hit with sickness like others.
So pride is like a necklace for them. They wear hurt and mean acts like clothes.
Their eyes bulge from fat. Their hearts dream up bad things.
They laugh and say mean things. From their high place they speak with pride. They plan to hurt people.
They talk like they own heaven. Their words go all over the earth.
So their people turn to them. They drink up all they can.
They say, "How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?"
Look, these are bad people. They are always at ease. They get more and more money.
I kept my heart clean for nothing. I washed my hands to show I did no wrong.
All day I was hurt. Every morning I was told I was wrong.
If I had talked like that, I would have turned against Your children.
I tried to understand this. It was too hard for me.
Then I went into God's holy place. There I saw what would happen to them at the end.
You put them on slippery ground. You make them fall down.
In a moment they are destroyed. Fear sweeps them away.
They are like a dream when someone wakes up. When You get up, Lord, You will think they are nothing.
My heart was sad. My feelings were hurt.
I was foolish and did not know. I was like a wild animal with You.
But I am always with You. You hold my right hand.
You lead me with Your advice. After that, You will take me to glory.
Who do I have in heaven but You? Nothing on earth makes me happy like You.
My body and my heart may fail. But God is the strength of my heart. He is my share forever.
People far from You will die. You destroy all who are not true to You.
But it is good for me to be near God. I have made the LORD my safe place. I will tell about all the things You have done.
God, why did You leave us for so long? Why is Your anger like smoke over the sheep You take care of?
Please remember Your people. You bought them long ago. You saved the family You chose. You live on Mount Zion.
Please come and look at the ruins. The enemy has broken everything in Your holy place.
Your enemies shouted in Your meeting place. They put up their flags as signs.
They looked like men with axes, cutting trees in the woods.
They smashed the carved wood with hammers and axes.
They burned Your holy place to the ground. They ruined the place where Your name is.
They said in their hearts, “Let’s destroy them all!” They burned every place where God is worshiped in the land.
We do not see any signs from You. There are no prophets now. No one knows how long this will last.
How long, God, will the enemy make fun of You? Will the enemy insult Your name forever?
Why do You stop helping us? Why do You keep Your power hidden?
God, You have been my King since long ago. You save people all over the earth.
You split the sea by Your power. You broke the heads of sea monsters in the water.
You crushed the head of the big sea monster, Leviathan. You gave it as food to the people in the desert.
You split open springs and streams. You dried up strong rivers.
The day is Yours, and the night is Yours too. You made the sun and the moon.
You set all the borders of the earth. You made summer and winter.
Remember this, the LORD: The enemy insults You. Foolish people make fun of Your name.
Do not let Your helpless people be killed. Do not forget Your poor people forever.
Look at Your promise. The dark places of the earth are full of mean people.
Do not let the hurt people go back ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise Your name.
Stand up, God, and fight for us. Remember how foolish people insult You all day.
Do not forget the voice of Your enemies. The noise of those who rise against You never stops.
We give thanks to You, God; we give thanks, for You are near to us. People tell about Your amazing works.
"When I choose the right time, I will judge fairly.
The earth and everyone in it may shake, but I keep its pillars steady.
I told proud people, 'Stop bragging,' and I told bad people, 'Do not show off your power.'
Do not act proud. Do not speak like you are better than others."
Being lifted up does not come from the east or the west. It does not come from the desert either.
God is the judge. He brings one person down and lifts another up.
The LORD holds a cup. It is full of wine mixed with spices. He pours it out, and all the bad people of the earth drink it to the last drop.
But I will tell of this forever. I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
"I will take away all the power of bad people, but good people will be lifted up."
God is known in Judah. His name is great in Israel.
His tent is in Salem. His home is in Zion.
There He broke the arrows. He broke the shield and sword. He stopped the war.
You shine with light. You are greater than the mountains.
Brave men lost what they had. They fell asleep. The soldiers could not lift their hands.
When You told them to stop, God of Jacob, the horses and war carts lay still.
You alone are to be feared. Who can stand before You when You are angry?
From heaven You judged. The land was afraid and became quiet.
God stood up to judge. He came to save all the poor and hurting people in the land.
Even when people are angry, it can bring praise to You. You hold back the rest of their anger.
Make promises to the LORD, your God, and keep them. Let all the nearby lands bring gifts to the One we fear.
He breaks the spirit of rulers. The kings of the earth fear Him.
I cried out to God. I cried to God, and He heard me.
When I was in trouble, I looked for the Lord. At night I reached out my hand, and it did not get tired. My heart would not be comforted.
I thought about God and groaned. I was sad, and my spirit grew weak. Selah.
You kept my eyes open. I was too upset to speak.
I thought about the old days, the years long ago.
At night I remembered my song. I thought in my heart, and my spirit searched.
Will the Lord leave me forever? Will He never be kind again?
Has His kind love gone away forever? Has His promise ended for all time?
Has God forgotten to be kind? Has He stopped caring for me because He is angry? Selah.
Then I said, "This is my sadness: the Most High God's power has changed."
I will remember what the LORD has done. Yes, I will remember Your wonderful works from long ago.
I will think about all Your work. I will talk about what You have done.
Your way, God, is holy. Who is a great God like our God?
You are the God who does amazing things. You showed Your power to people everywhere.
You rescued Your people with Your power—the children of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
The water saw You, God. The water saw You and shook. Even the deep water trembled. Selah.
The clouds poured down water. The sky thundered. Your lightning flashed everywhere.
Your thunder rolled in the storm. Your lightning lit up the world. The earth shook and trembled.
Your way was in the sea. Your path was through the deep water, but no one saw Your footprints.
You led Your people like sheep. You used Moses and Aaron to guide them.
Listen, my people. Hear my teaching. Turn your ears to my words.
I will open my mouth and tell a story. I will share old secrets.
We heard these things. We know them. Our fathers told them to us.
We will not hide them from their children. We will tell the next group of kids about the great things the LORD has done. We will tell about His power and His wonders.
He made a rule for Jacob's family. He gave a law to Israel. He told our fathers to teach it to their children.
Then the next group would know it. Even kids not born yet would learn it. They would grow up and tell their own children.
Then they could trust God. They would not forget what God did. They would keep His commands.
They would not be like their fathers. Their fathers were stubborn and would not obey. Their hearts were not true to God. Their spirits were not faithful to Him.
The men of Ephraim had bows, but they turned back on the day of battle.
They did not keep God's agreement. They would not follow His law.
They forgot what He had done. They forgot the wonders He showed them.
God did amazing things where their fathers could see. He did them in Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.
He split the sea and led them through it. He made the water stand like a wall.
He led them with a cloud in the day. He led them with fire all night.
He broke rocks in the desert. He gave them plenty to drink, like water from the deep sea.
He made streams come from the rock. The water flowed down like rivers.
But they sinned even more against God. They fought against the Most High in the dry land.
They tested God in their hearts. They asked for food they wanted.
They spoke against God. They said, "Can God set a table in the desert?
He hit the rock, and water poured out. Streams rushed by. Can He also give bread? Can He get meat for His people?"
So the LORD heard them. He was very angry. Fire burned against Jacob. His anger rose against Israel.
They did not believe in God. They did not trust His power to save.
But He told the clouds above to open. He opened the doors of heaven.
He rained bread on them to eat. He gave them grain from heaven.
People ate the food of angels. He sent them food until they were full.
He made the east wind blow in the sky. By His power He led the south wind.
He rained meat on them like dust. He rained birds like sand by the sea.
He let them fall in the middle of the camp. They fell all around their tents.
The people ate and were very full. He gave them what they wanted.
But they were not done wanting. The food was still in their mouths.
Then God's anger rose against them. He killed their strongest men. He brought down the young men of Israel.
Even after all this, they still sinned. They did not believe Him, even with His wonders.
So He made their days end like a breath. Their years ended in fear.
When He killed some of them, the others looked for Him. They turned back and searched for God.
They remembered that God was their rock. The Most High God was the one who saved them.
But they only praised Him with their mouths. With their tongues they lied to Him.
Their hearts were not true to Him. They were not faithful to His agreement.
But God was kind. He forgave their sin. He did not destroy them. He held back His anger many times. He did not let all His wrath come out.
He remembered that they were only people. They were like wind that passes and does not come back.
How often they fought against Him in the desert! How often they made Him sad in the dry land!
They tested God again and again. They made the Holy One of Israel angry.
They did not remember His power. They did not remember the day He saved them from their enemy.
They did not remember the signs He did in Egypt. They did not remember His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
He turned their rivers into blood. They could not drink from their streams.
He sent flies that ate them. He sent frogs that ruined them.
He gave their crops to the locust. He gave the fruit of their work to the grasshopper.
He killed their vines with hail. He killed their fig trees with frost.
He gave their animals to the hail. He gave their flocks to lightning.
He sent His burning anger on them. He sent wrath, trouble, and distress. He sent angels to hurt them.
He made a path for His anger. He did not spare them from death. He gave their lives to sickness.
He struck all the firstborn in Egypt. He struck the first sons in the tents of Ham.
Then He led His people out like sheep. He guided them in the desert like a flock.
He led them safely. They were not afraid. The sea covered their enemies.
He brought them to His holy place. He brought them to the mountain His right hand won.
He drove out nations in front of them. He gave them land to live in. He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
But they tested God the Most High. They fought against Him. They did not keep His rules.
They turned back and were not faithful, like their fathers. They were like a bow that does not shoot straight.
They made Him angry with their hilltop altars. They made Him jealous with their idols.
God heard this and was very angry. He turned away from Israel.
He left His home at Shiloh. That was the tent where He lived among people.
He let His power be taken away. He let His glory fall into the enemy's hand.
He gave His people to the sword. He let His anger fall on His own people.
Fire ate their young men. Their young women did not sing happy songs.
Their priests fell by the sword. Their widows did not cry.
Then the Lord woke up, like a man waking from sleep. He was like a strong man shouting after wine.
He beat back His enemies. He put them to shame forever.
He turned away from the tent of Joseph. He did not choose the tribe of Ephraim.
He chose the tribe of Judah. He chose Mount Zion, which He loves.
He built His holy place high like the heavens. He made it strong like the earth He set forever.
He chose David, His servant. He took him from the sheep pens.
He brought him from caring for mother sheep. He brought him to lead Jacob, His people. He brought him to lead Israel, His own land.
David led them with a true heart. He guided them with skillful hands.
A song by Asaph. God, other nations came into Your land. They made Your holy place dirty. They turned Jerusalem into a pile of rocks.
They gave the dead bodies of Your servants to the birds. They gave the flesh of Your faithful people to wild animals.
They poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem. No one was there to bury them.
We became a shame to our neighbors. People all around us laughed at us and made fun of us.
How long, the LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
Pour out Your anger on the nations that do not know You. Pour it on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name.
For they destroyed Your people Israel and ruined their homes.
Do not blame us for sins of long ago. Let Your kindness come to us soon, because we are very weak.
Help us, God who saves us, so Your name will be honored. Save us and forgive our sins to show how great You are.
Why do the nations ask, 'Where is their God?' Let the nations see You punish those who killed Your servants, right before our eyes.
Let the cries of people in prison come to You. By Your great power, keep alive those who are about to die.
Pay back our neighbors seven times for the insults they threw at You, Lord.
Then we, Your people, the sheep You care for, will thank You forever. We will tell of Your praise from one family to the next.
Listen, Shepherd of Israel. You lead Joseph like a flock. You sit among the angels. Show Your power.
Shine before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Wake up Your power. Come and save us.
Bring us back to You, God. Show us Your favor, and save us.
How long will You be angry, the LORD God Almighty? Will You be angry at Your people's prayers?
You gave them tears for food. You made them drink tears.
You made us a joke to our neighbors. Our enemies make fun of us.
Bring us back, God Almighty. Show us Your favor, and save us.
You brought a grapevine from Egypt. You chased out nations and planted it.
You cleared the ground. It grew roots and filled the land.
The mountains were covered by its shade. The big cedar trees were covered by its branches.
Its branches reached the sea. Its new shoots reached the river.
Why did You break down its fence? Now everyone who passes by picks its grapes.
Wild pigs from the forest tear it up. Wild animals eat it.
