Come back to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Take care of this vine.
Take care of the root Your right hand planted. Take care of the son You raised up for Yourself.
It is cut down and burned with fire. Your people die when You are angry.
Help the man at Your right hand. Help the son of man You raised up for Yourself.
Then we will not turn away from You. Give us life, and we will call on Your name.
Bring us back, the LORD God Almighty. Show us Your favor, and save us.
Sing out loud to God. He is our strength. Shout to the God of Jacob.
Start the song. Play the tambourine. Play the sweet harp.
Blow the trumpet on the new moon. Blow it on the full moon. Blow it on our feast day.
This is a rule for Israel. It is a law from the God of Jacob.
He made this rule for Joseph. Joseph went out from Egypt. I heard a voice I did not know:
"I took the heavy load from his shoulders. His hands were free from the baskets.
You called to Me when you were in trouble. I saved you. I answered you from a hidden thundercloud. I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
"Hear Me, My people. I will warn you. Israel, if you would listen to Me!
Do not have any strange god among you. Do not bow down to a god from another land.
I am the LORD your God. I brought you out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
But My people did not listen to My voice. Israel did not want Me.
So I let them go their own way. They followed their own plans.
If only My people would listen to Me! Israel would walk in My ways.
I would quickly beat down their enemies. I would turn My hand against their enemies.
Those who hate the LORD would bow low before Him. Their trouble would last forever.
I would feed them the best wheat. I would fill you with honey from the rock."
God stands in the meeting of gods. He judges them.
“How long will you judge in a wrong way and be nice to bad people? Selah.
Help the weak and kids with no dad. Do right for the poor and those who hurt.
Save the weak and needy. Get them away from bad people.”
They know nothing. They do not understand. They walk in the dark. The whole earth shakes.
I said, “You are gods. You are all sons of the Most High.”
But you will die like people. You will fall like leaders.”
Get up, O God. Judge the earth, because all the nations are Your.
God, do not be silent. Do not be quiet. Do not rest.
Look! Your enemies are making noise. The people who hate You are proud.
They make secret plans against Your people. They plot against the ones You keep safe.
They say, "Come, let us wipe them out as a nation. Let no one remember Israel's name again."
They agree together. They make a pact against You.
They are the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites.
They are Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia and the people of Tyre.
Assyria has joined them too. They help the people of Lot.
Do to them what You did to Midian, to Sisera, and to Jabin at the Kishon River.
They were destroyed at Endor. They became like dirt on the ground.
Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeeb. Make all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna.
They said, "Let us take God's fields for ourselves."
Make them like a rolling weed, my God. Make them like dust blown by the wind.
Like fire burning a forest, like a flame setting hills on fire,
chase them with Your storm and scare them with Your strong wind.
Fill their faces with shame, so they will look for Your name, the LORD.
Let them be ashamed and scared forever. Let them be disgraced and die.
Then they will know that You alone are the LORD, the Most High over all the earth.
For the music leader. A song for Korah's sons. How lovely is Your home, the LORD of Heaven's Armies!
I want to be in the LORD's special place so much that I feel weak. My heart and body cry out for the living God.
Even a small bird has found a home. A swallow has a nest for her babies near the place where people worship You, the LORD of Heaven's Armies. You are my King and my God.
Happy are the people who live in Your house. They always praise You.
Happy is the person who gets strength from You. That person wants to travel to Your house.
When people walk through the dry Valley of Tears, they make it a place with springs. The first rain fills it with pools.
They get stronger and stronger until they meet God in Zion.
The LORD God of Heaven's Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.
Look at our protector, O God. Look kindly at Your chosen king.
One day in Your special place is better than a thousand days anywhere else. I would rather stand at the door of my God's house than live in the tents of bad people.
The LORD God is like the sun and a shield. The LORD gives help and honor. He does not keep any good thing from people who do right.
The LORD of Heaven's Armies, happy is the person who trusts in You.
The LORD, You were good to Your land. You made things good again for Jacob's family.
You took away Your people's sin. You covered all their wrongs. Selah.
You let go of Your anger. You stopped being mad.
God, our Savior, please bring us back again. Please stop being mad at us.
Will You be mad at us forever? Will Your anger last for all time?
Won't You make us live again? Then Your people will be happy with You.
The LORD, show us Your kind love. Give us Your help.
I will listen to what God the the LORD says. He promises peace to His people and to those who follow Him. They must not go back to doing foolish things.
His help is near to those who respect Him. Then His glory will stay in our land.
Love and truth come together. Right and peace become friends.
Truth will grow from the ground. Right will come from heaven.
The LORD will give good things. Our land will grow good food.
Right will walk ahead of Him. It will make a path for His feet.
Please listen to me, O the LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and in need.
Protect my life, for I am faithful to You. Save me, Your servant, who trusts in You, my God.
Be kind to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
Make my heart happy, for to You, O Lord, I give my whole heart.
For You, O Lord, are good and ready to forgive. You are full of faithful love for all who call on You.
Listen to my prayer, O the LORD, and hear my cry for help.
When I am in trouble, I call on You, because You answer me.
No god is like You, O Lord, and no one does what You do.
All the nations You made will come and bow down to You, O Lord, and they will honor Your name.
For You are great and do amazing things. You alone are God.
Teach me how to live, O the LORD, so I can follow Your truth. Give me a heart that is fully Yours, so I may respect Your name.
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will honor Your name forever.
For Your faithful love for me is great. You have saved me from the grave.
Proud people attack me, O God. A group of mean people wants to kill me. They do not care about You.
But You, O Lord, are kind and caring. You are not quick to get angry. You are full of faithful love and truth.
Please look at me and be kind to me. Give Your strength to me, Your servant, and save the son of Your servant woman.
Show me a sign of Your goodness, so my enemies see it and feel ashamed. This is because You, O the LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
This is a song by the sons of Korah. God's city rests on holy mountains.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion. He loves them more than all the homes of Jacob.
People say wonderful things about you, city of God. Selah
I will name Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me. Look! Philistia, Tyre, and Cush— "This one was born there."
People will say about Zion, "This one and that one were born in her." The Most High Himself will make her strong.
The LORD will write in the book of the nations, "This one was born there." Selah
Singers and dancers will say, "All my joy comes from you."
O the LORD, God who saves me, I call to You day and night.
Let my prayer come to You. Please turn Your ear to my cry.
I have had all the trouble I can take. I feel like I am near the grave.
People count me with those going down to the grave. I am weak and helpless.
I am left among the dead, like people killed in battle who lie in graves. You do not remember them anymore. They are beyond Your help.
You put me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in deep water.
Your anger weighs on me. All Your waves crash over me.
You have taken my friends far away. You made me something they hate. I am trapped and cannot escape.
My eyes are weak from sadness. I call to You every day, O the LORD. I hold out my hands to You.
Can You do miracles for dead people? Can those who have died rise and praise You?
Will anyone speak of Your love in the grave? Will anyone speak of Your faithfulness in the place of ruin?
Will Your miracles be known in the dark? Will Your goodness be known in the land where people are forgotten?
But I cry to You, O the LORD. In the morning my prayer comes to You.
O the LORD, why do You turn away from me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
I have been in pain and near death since I was young. I have suffered Your terrors. I feel hopeless.
Your burning anger has come over me. Your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like water all day. They close in on me from all sides.
You have taken my friend and neighbor far away. Darkness is my closest friend.
I will sing about the LORD's love forever. With my mouth I will tell all people how You keep Your promises.
I have said, "Love lasts forever. You show in the sky that You keep Your promises."
You said, "I made a promise to My chosen one. I swore to David, My servant.
I will make your family last forever. I will build your throne for all time." Selah
The sky praises Your wonders, O the LORD. It praises how You keep Your promises where holy ones meet.
Who in the sky can be like the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
God is feared where holy ones meet. He is awesome to all around Him.
O the LORD God of armies, who is like You? The LORD is mighty, and how You keep Your promises is all around You.
You rule the wild sea. When its waves rise, You calm them.
You crushed the sea monster Rahab like a dead body. You scattered Your enemies with Your strong arm.
The sky is Yours. The earth is Yours too. You made the world and all that is in it.
You made the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
Your arm is strong. Your hand is mighty. Your right hand is lifted high.
Doing right and being fair hold up Your throne. Love and truth go before You.
Happy are the people who know the joyful shout. They walk, O the LORD, in the light of Your face.
They are happy in Your name all day. Your goodness lifts them up.
You are their strength and glory. Your favor makes us strong.
Our shield belongs to the LORD. Our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.
Long ago You spoke in a vision to Your faithful people. You said, "I gave help to a strong man. I lifted up a young man from the people.
I found My servant David. I poured holy oil on him.
My hand will hold him. My arm will make him strong.
No enemy will trick him. No bad man will hurt him.
I will beat down his enemies before him. I will strike those who hate him.
I will keep My promises and love him. His power will grow because of My name.
I will put his hand over the sea. His right hand will rule the rivers."
"He will call to Me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the Rock who saves me.'
I will make him My firstborn son. He will be the greatest king on earth.
I will keep My love for him forever. My promise to him will stand.
I will make his family last forever. His throne will last as long as the sky."
"If his sons leave My law and do not follow My rules,
if they break My laws and do not keep My commands,
then I will punish their wrong with a rod. I will hit them for their sins.
But I will not take My love from him. I will not stop being true.
I will not break My promise. I will not change what I said.
Once I swore by My holy name, I will not lie to David.
His family will last forever. His throne will stand before Me like the sun.
It will last like the moon, a faithful witness in the sky." Selah
But You have turned away and hated. You are angry with Your chosen king.
You have broken Your promise to Your servant. You threw his crown in the dust.
You broke down all his walls. You made his forts fall.
All who pass by rob him. He is a shame to his neighbors.
You lifted up his enemies' hands. You made all his foes glad.
You turned his sword back. You did not help him in war.
You ended his glory. You threw his throne to the ground.
You cut short his young days. You covered him with shame. Selah
How long, O the LORD? Will You hide forever? Will Your anger burn like fire?
Remember how short my life is. Why did You make all people for nothing?
What man can live and not see death? Can he save his life from the grave? Selah
O Lord, where is Your old love? You swore to David that You would be true.
Remember, O Lord, how Your servants are shamed. I carry in my heart the shame from all nations.
Your enemies have mocked You, O the LORD. They mocked Your chosen king.
Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.
Lord, You have been our home in every time.
Before the mountains were born, before You made the earth and the world, You are God from forever to forever.
You turn people back to dust and say, "Return, people."
For in Your eyes, a thousand years are like yesterday that is gone, or like a few hours in the night.
You sweep people away in their sleep. They are like grass that grows in the morning.
In the morning it blooms and grows. By evening it dries up and dies.
We are used up by Your anger. We are scared by Your great anger.
You put our sins in front of You. Even our secret sins are in Your sight.
All our days pass under Your anger. Our years end like a sigh.
Most people live to be seventy. Some live to eighty if they are strong. But even those years are full of trouble and sadness. Life passes quickly, and we are gone.
Who knows how strong Your anger is? It is as great as the honor You deserve.
So teach us to count our days, so we can have wise hearts.
Return, O the LORD! How long? Have pity on Your servants.
Fill us with Your love in the morning, so we can sing and be glad all our days.
Make us glad for as many days as You made us sad, for as many years as we saw trouble.
Let Your work be seen by Your servants, and Your glory by their children.
May the Lord our God show us favor. Make the work of our hands last. Yes, make our work last.
The person who stays in the safe place of the Most High rests in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say to the LORD, "You are my safe place and my strong fort. You are my God, and I trust in You."
He will save you from the trap of a bird catcher and from terrible sickness.
He will cover you with His feathers. You will be safe under His wings. His truth is your shield and your armor.
You will not be afraid of the fear of the night or of the arrow that flies by day.
You will not fear sickness that walks in the dark or ruin that strikes at noon.
A thousand may fall beside you, and ten thousand at your right side, but it will not come near you.
You will only look with your eyes and see what happens to bad people.
This is because you made the LORD your safe home. You made the Most High your safe place.
No bad thing will happen to you. No sickness will come near your tent.
He will tell His angels to watch over you in all your ways.
They will lift you up in their hands so your foot does not hit a stone.
You will walk on lions and snakes. You will step on young lions and serpents.
"Because he loves Me, I will save him. Because he knows My name, I will keep him safe.
When he calls to Me, I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will rescue him and honor him.
I will give him a long life and make him happy. I will show him how I save."
It is good to thank the LORD. It is good to sing to Your name, O Most High.
It is good to tell of Your love in the morning. It is good to tell of Your care at night.
We praise You with a ten-string harp, a lyre, and soft music.
For You, the LORD, made me happy by what You did. I will sing for joy at the work of Your hands.
How great are Your works, the LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
A foolish person does not know this. A silly person does not understand it.
Bad people grow fast like grass. All who do wrong seem strong for a time. But they will be destroyed forever.
But You, the LORD, are high forever.
See, Your enemies, the LORD. See, Your enemies will die. All who do wrong will be scattered.
You have made me strong like a powerful ox. You have poured fresh oil on me.
My eyes have seen my enemies fall. My ears have heard the cry of those who rise against me.
Good people will grow like a palm tree. They will grow strong like a cedar in Lebanon.
They are planted in the house of the LORD. They grow in the yards of our God.
They will still bear fruit in old age. They will stay fresh and green.
They will show that the LORD is fair. He is my rock, and He does no wrong.
The LORD rules. He wears great power. The world stands firm. It will not shake.
Your throne has been firm since long ago. You live forever.
The rivers rise up, O the LORD. They lift their voices. Their waves crash.
The LORD in heaven is stronger than loud waters and crashing waves.
Your promises are very true. Your house is holy and beautiful, O the LORD. It will last forever.
The LORD, God who pays back wrong, show yourself!
Stand up, Judge of the whole world. Give proud people what they deserve.
How long, the LORD, will bad people keep winning? How long will they cheer?
They say proud and mean things. All who do wrong brag.
They hurt your people, the LORD. They trouble the ones who belong to you.
They kill widows and strangers. They murder children with no parents.
They say, "The LORD does not see us. The God of Jacob does not notice."
Listen, you silly people! You fools, when will you get smart?
The One who made ears, can't He hear? The One who made eyes, can't He see?
The One who trains nations, won't He correct them? The One who teaches people what to know—the LORD—knows what people think.
The LORD knows what people think. Their thoughts are like a puff of air.
Happy is the person the LORD corrects and teaches from His law.
He gets rest from hard days until the wicked are caught.
The LORD will not leave His people. He will not give up the ones who belong to Him.
Fairness will come back to good people. Everyone with a right heart will follow it.
Who will stand up for me against bad people? Who will help me against those who do wrong?
If the LORD had not helped me, I would soon be in the quiet grave.
When I thought, "I am falling," your faithful love, the LORD, held me up.
When I have many worries, your comfort cheers me up.
Can bad rulers be your friends? They make unfair laws.
They gang up against good people. They say innocent people should die.
But the LORD is my safe place. My God is the rock I hide behind.
He will make their wrong come back on them. He will wipe them out for their evil. The LORD our God will destroy them.
Come, let us sing to the LORD. Let us shout to the Rock who saves us.
Let us come to Him with thanks. Let us sing happy songs to Him.
The LORD is a great God. He is a great King over all gods.
He holds the deep places of the earth. The tall mountains are His too.
The sea is His, because He made it. His hands made the dry land.
Come, let us bow down and worship. Let us kneel before the LORD, our Maker.
He is our God. We are His people. We are like sheep He cares for. Today, if you hear His voice,
“Do not be stubborn like the people at Meribah. Do not be stubborn like that day at Massah in the desert.
Your fathers tested and tried Me there, even though they saw what I did.
“For forty years I was angry with those people. I said, ‘They are people whose hearts always go the wrong way. They do not know how I want them to live.’
So I made a strong promise in My anger: ‘They will never come into the place of rest I promised.’”
Sing a new song to the LORD. All the earth, sing to the LORD.
Sing to the LORD. Praise His name. Tell everyone about His saving power each day.
Tell the nations about His glory. Tell all people about His amazing works.
The LORD is very great. People should praise Him. He is to be feared more than all other gods.
All the gods of other people are just pretend gods. But the LORD made the heavens.
He is full of honor and greatness. His holy place has strength and beauty.
All families of the nations, give the LORD glory and strength.
Give the LORD the honor His name deserves. Bring a gift and come to His temple.
Worship the LORD in holy beauty. All the earth, shake with fear before Him.
Tell the nations, "The LORD rules! The world is set in place. It will not be moved. He will judge all people fairly."
Let the sky be glad. Let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and everything in it.
Let the fields be happy, and all that is in them. Then all the trees in the forest will sing for joy
before the LORD, because He is coming. He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with what is right. He will judge the people with His faithfulness.
The LORD rules. Let the earth be happy. Let the faraway islands be glad.
Clouds and thick darkness are around Him. Right and fair hold up His throne.
Fire goes before Him. It burns His enemies all around.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees it and shakes.
The mountains melt like wax before the the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
The sky shows His right ways. All people see His glory.
People who worship statues are put to shame. Those who brag about fake gods are put to shame. All gods, worship Him.
Zion hears and is glad. The people of Judah are glad because of Your fair rules, O the LORD.
For You, the the LORD, are highest over all the earth. You are lifted up far above all gods.
You who love the the LORD, hate what is bad. He keeps His people safe. He saves them from bad people.
Light is planted for good people. Joy is planted for those with honest hearts.
You who do right, be glad in the the LORD. Thank His holy name.
Sing a new song to the the LORD, because He has done amazing things. His strong and holy power won the victory.
The LORD has shown His saving power. He has shown His right and good ways to all the nations.
He remembered His kind love and His faithfulness to Israel's family. Everyone on earth has seen how our God saves.
Shout to the the LORD, all the earth! Break out in song and praise Him.
Praise the the LORD with the harp. Sing with music and songs.
Play trumpets and the ram's horn. Shout for joy before the the LORD, the King.
Let the sea roar, and everything in it. Let the world and all who live in it shout.
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing together for joy.
They sing before the the LORD, because He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly, and He will judge all people with what is right.
The LORD rules. Let the nations shake. He sits above the angels. Let the earth shake.
The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all nations.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name. He is holy.
The King is strong. He loves justice. You made things fair. You did what is right and fair for Israel.
Lift up the LORD our God. Bow down at His footstool. He is holy.
Moses and Aaron were His priests. Samuel was one of those who called on His name. They called to the LORD, and He answered them.
He spoke to them in a cloud pillar. They kept His rules and the law He gave them.
The LORD our God, You answered them. You forgave them, but You punished their wrongs.
Lift up the LORD our God and bow down at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
Shout with joy to the the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the the LORD with joy. Come before Him with happy songs.
Know that the the LORD is God. He made us. We did not make ourselves. We are His people. We are sheep in His care.
Come into His gates with thanks. Come into His yards with praise. Thank Him. Bless His name.
For the the LORD is good. His love never ends. He keeps His promises forever.
I will sing about the LORD’s kindness and fairness. To You, the LORD, I will sing praise.
I will think about the right way to live. When will You come to me? I will live with a clean heart in my house.
I will not look at worthless things. I hate the bad things people do when they turn away from God. That will not stick to me.
A bad heart will stay far from me. I will not take part in evil.
I will destroy anyone who talks bad about a neighbor in secret. I cannot stand proud people who look down on others.
I look for loyal people in the land. They can live with me. The one who lives the right way will help me.
No one who tricks others can live in my house. No one who tells lies will stay before me.
Every morning I will destroy all the bad people in the land. I will remove all who do wrong from the city of the LORD.
Hear my prayer, the LORD. Let my cry reach You.
Do not hide Your face from me when I am in trouble. Turn Your ear to me. Answer me fast when I call.
My days pass like smoke. My bones feel like they burn.
My heart feels struck down like grass that dries up. I forget to eat my bread.
Because I groan so loud, my bones cling to my skin.
I am like a bird alone in the desert, like an owl in empty places.
I cannot sleep. I am like a lonely bird on a roof.
My enemies make fun of me all day. People who tease me use my name to curse.
I eat ashes like bread. My tears mix with my drink.
This is because of Your anger. You lifted me up and threw me down.
My days are like a shadow at evening. I dry up like grass.
But You, the LORD, sit on Your throne forever. People will remember You for all time.
You will get up and show love to Zion. It is time to be kind to her. The set time has come.
Your servants love her stones. They feel sorry for her dust.
Nations will fear the LORD's name. All kings on earth will fear Your glory.
The LORD builds up Zion. He shows His glory there.
He listens to the prayer of the poor. He does not turn away their prayer.
Write this for people who come later. Then people not yet born can praise the LORD.
The LORD looked down from His holy place in heaven. He looked at the earth.
He heard the groans of prisoners. He set free those who were about to die.
Then they will tell the LORD's name in Zion. They will praise Him in Jerusalem.
Peoples and kingdoms will come together to serve the LORD.
He made me weak along the way. He cut my days short.
I say, "My God, do not take me away in the middle of my life. Your years last for all time."
Long ago You made the earth. The heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will pass away, but You will stay. They will wear out like clothes. You will change them like a robe, and they will pass away.
But You are the same. Your years never end.
The children of Your servants will live there. Their children will be safe with You.
Praise the LORD, my soul. With all my heart, praise His holy name.
Praise the LORD, my soul. Do not forget all the good things He has done.
He forgives all your sins. He heals all your sickness.
He saves your life from death. He crowns you with love and mercy.
He fills you with good things. Your youth comes back like an eagle's.
The LORD does what is right and fair for all who are treated badly.
He showed His ways to Moses. He showed His great works to the people of Israel.
The LORD is kind and full of grace. He is slow to anger. He has much love.
He will not argue forever. He will not stay angry forever.
He has not treated us as our sins deserve. He has not paid us back for our wrongs.
His love for those who respect Him is as high as the sky above the earth.
He has moved our sins far away from us, as far as east is from west.
A father is kind to his children. In the same way, the LORD is kind to those who respect Him.
He knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
People live a short time. They grow like grass. They bloom like a flower in a field.
The wind blows over it, and it is gone. Its place does not remember it.
But the LORD's love lasts forever and ever for those who respect Him. His goodness lasts for their children and grandchildren.
It is for those who keep His agreement and remember to obey His rules.
The LORD set up His throne in heaven. His kingdom rules over all.
Praise the LORD, all His angels. They are strong and do what He says. They listen to His words.
Praise the LORD, all His armies. His servants do what He wants.
Praise the LORD, all the things He has made, in every place He rules. Praise the LORD, my soul.
Bless the the LORD, O my soul. O the LORD my God, You are very great. You wear glory and honor.
He wraps Himself in light like a cloak. He spreads out the sky like a tent.
He builds His rooms above the water. He makes the clouds His chariot. He walks on the wind.
He makes the wind His helpers. He makes fire His workers.
He set the earth on strong supports. It will never be moved.
You covered the earth with water like a blanket. The water stood over the mountains.
When You spoke sharply, the water ran away. When You thundered, it hurried off.
The mountains rose up. The valleys sank down to the place You made for them.
You set a line they cannot pass. They will never cover the earth again.
He sends springs into the valleys. They flow between the mountains.
They give water to all wild animals. Wild donkeys drink and are not thirsty.
Birds build nests near them. They sing in the trees.
He waters the mountains from above. The earth is full of good things You make.
He makes grass grow for the cows. He makes plants for people to grow. Then people can get food from the earth.
Wine makes people happy. Oil makes faces shine. Bread keeps people strong.
The LORD's trees get plenty of water. He planted the tall cedar trees in Lebanon.
Birds build nests in them. The stork makes her home in the pine trees.
High mountains are for wild goats. Cliffs are safe places for small rock animals.
He made the moon to show the times. The sun knows when to go down.
You bring darkness, and night comes. Then all the forest animals come out.
Young lions roar for food. They look to God for what they eat.
The sun rises, and they go back. They lie down in their caves.
People go out to work. They work until evening.
O the LORD, You have made so many things! You made them all with wisdom. The earth is full of what You make.
The sea is big and wide. It is full of life, more than we can count. There are big and small animals.
Ships sail there. You made the big sea creature to play in it.
All living things look to You. You give them food at the right time.
When You give it, they pick it up. When You open Your hand, they have all the good they need.
When You hide Your face, they are scared. When You take away their breath, they die and go back to dust.
When You send Your Spirit, they are made. You make the earth new again.
May the the LORD's glory last forever. May the the LORD be happy with what He made.
He looks at the earth, and it shakes. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
I will sing to the the LORD all my life. I will praise my God as long as I live.
May my thoughts please Him. I will be glad in the the LORD.
May sinners be gone from the earth. May bad people be no more. Bless the the LORD, O my soul. Praise the the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD. Call on His name. Tell people in other lands what He has done.
Sing to Him. Sing His praise. Tell about all His wonderful works.
Praise His holy name. Let those who look for the LORD be glad.
Look for the LORD and His strength. Look for His face always.
Remember the wonderful things He did. Remember His miracles and the words He spoke.
You are the children of Abraham, God's servant. You are the sons of Jacob, His chosen people.
He is the LORD our God. He rules all the earth.
He remembers His promise forever. He gave His word for a thousand families.
He made a promise to Abraham. He made a promise to Isaac.
He made it strong for Jacob. He made it last for Israel forever.
He said, "I will give you the land of Canaan. It will be your own land."
They were few in number. They were strangers in that land.
They traveled from nation to nation. They went from one kingdom to another.
He did not let anyone hurt them. He told kings to leave them alone.
He said, "Do not touch My chosen ones. Do not hurt My prophets."
He called for hunger in the land. He took away their food.
He sent a man ahead of them. It was Joseph, sold as a slave.
They hurt his feet with chains. They put iron chains on him.
He stayed there until the right time. The LORD's word tested him.
The king sent for him and set him free. The ruler of the people let him go.
He made Joseph the boss of his house. He put him over all he owned.
Joseph could teach the leaders what to do. He could teach the old men wisdom.
Then Israel came to Egypt. Jacob lived in Egypt.
The LORD made His people grow in number. He made them stronger than their enemies.
Their enemies' hearts turned to hate His people. They made secret plans against His servants.
He sent Moses, His servant. He sent Aaron, whom He chose.
They did His miracles among them. They did wonders in Egypt.
He sent darkness, and it got dark. They had not obeyed His words.
He turned their water into blood. He killed their fish.
Frogs filled their land. They were even in the kings' rooms.
He spoke, and flies came. Tiny bugs came all over their land.
He gave them hail instead of rain. Lightning flashed through their land.
He hit their grape plants and fig trees. He broke the trees in their land.
He spoke, and locusts came. Young locusts came without number.
They ate every plant in the land. They ate the food from the soil.
He hit the oldest child in every home. He took the first and best of their strength.
He brought Israel out with silver and gold. None of His people fell.
Egypt was glad when they left. The people of Israel had scared them.
He spread a cloud to cover them. He gave fire to light the night.
They asked, and He brought quail. He fed them with bread from heaven.
He opened a rock, and water poured out. It flowed like a river in the dry land.
He remembered His holy promise. He remembered His promise to Abraham, His servant.
He brought out His people with joy. He brought out His chosen ones with songs.
He gave them the lands of other nations. They took what other people had worked for.
He did this so they would keep His rules and obey His laws. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, because He is good. His love lasts forever.
Who can tell all the great things the LORD has done? Who can say all the good things about Him?
Happy are those who do what is right and fair all the time.
Remember me, the LORD, when You show kindness to Your people. Help me when You save them.
Let me see the good things You give to the people You chose. Let me be glad with the joy of Your nation. Let me praise You with Your people.
We sinned like our fathers did. We did wrong and did bad things.
Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your great works. They did not remember how much You loved them. They turned against You at the Red Sea.
But He saved them so people would know His name. He showed His great power.
He spoke to the Red Sea, and it dried up. He led them through the deep water like it was dry ground.
He saved them from their enemies. He set them free from those who hated them.
The water covered their enemies. Not one of them was left.
Then they believed His words. They sang His praise.
But they soon forgot what He had done. They did not wait for His plan.
They wanted bad things in the desert. They tested God in the dry land.
He gave them what they asked for. But He sent a sickness that made them weak.
In the camp they were jealous of Moses and of Aaron, the holy man of the LORD.
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan. It covered the group of Abiram.
Fire burned among their group. Flames burned up the wicked people.
At Horeb they made a calf. They bowed down to a metal statue.
They traded their glorious God for a statue of an ox that eats grass.
They forgot God, their Savior, who did great things in Egypt.
He did wonderful things in Egypt. He did scary things at the Red Sea.
So He said He would destroy them. But Moses, His chosen servant, stood before Him and turned His anger away, so He would not destroy them.
They did not want the good land. They did not trust His word.
They complained in their tents. They did not listen to the LORD's voice.
So He raised His hand against them. He said He would make them fall in the desert.
He would scatter their children among the nations. He would spread them out in other lands.
They joined themselves to Baal of Peor. They ate food offered to dead idols.
They made Him angry with what they did. So a sickness broke out among them.
Then Phinehas stood up and did what was right. The sickness stopped.
God counted this as something good. People will remember it forever.
They made Him angry at the waters of Meribah. Moses got in trouble because of them.
They upset him so much that he spoke without thinking.
They did not destroy the nations, like the LORD told them to.
They mixed with the nations and learned their ways.
They served their idols, and the idols trapped them.
They sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons.
They spilled the blood of innocent children. They sacrificed them to the idols of Canaan. The land was made dirty by all that blood.
They became unclean by what they did. They were unfaithful in what they did.
So the LORD was angry with His people. He turned away from His own people.
He let other nations rule over them. Their enemies were in charge of them.
Their enemies crushed them. They were beaten down under their power.
He saved them many times. But they kept turning against Him. They became weak because of their sin.
He saw their trouble. He heard their cry.
He remembered His promise to them. He felt sorry for them because His love is so great.
He made the people who took them away feel sorry for them.
Save us, the LORD our God. Bring us back from the nations. Then we will thank You for Your holy name. We will praise You.
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, forever and ever. Let all the people say, 'Amen!' Praise the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, because He is good. His love never ends.
The people the LORD saved should say so. He saved them from their enemies.
He brought them back from many lands. He brought them from the east and the west, from the north and the south.
Some people wandered in the desert. They could not find a city to live in.
They were hungry and thirsty. They were very tired and weak.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.
He led them on a straight path. He took them to a city where they could live.
Let them thank the LORD for His love. Let them thank Him for the wonderful things He did for people.
He gives water to thirsty people. He fills hungry people with good food.
Some people sat in the dark. They were prisoners in chains.
They did not obey God's words. They did not listen to the Most High.
So God made them work hard. They fell down, and no one helped them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.
He brought them out of the dark. He freed them from their chains.
Let them thank the LORD for His love. Let them thank Him for the wonderful things He did for people.
He broke the bronze gates. He cut the iron bars.
Some people were foolish. Their sins made them sick.
They did not want to eat. They were close to death.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.
He sent His word and healed them. He saved them from dying.
Let them thank the LORD for His love. Let them thank Him for the wonderful things He did for people.
Let them bring gifts to thank the LORD. Let them tell others what He did, and be happy.
Some people went to sea in boats. They worked on the big water.
They saw what the LORD did. They saw His wonders in the deep sea.
He told the wind to blow hard. The waves grew high.
The boats went up high and down low. The sailors were very scared.
They stumbled like drunk people. They forgot what to do.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.
He made the storm quiet. The waves became still.
They were happy when the water was calm. He brought them to the place they wanted.
Let them thank the LORD for His love. Let them thank Him for the wonderful things He did for people.
Let them praise the LORD with the people. Let them praise Him with the leaders.
He can make rivers dry. He can make springs dry up.
He can make good land dry and salty, because the people there do bad things.
He can make a desert into a lake. He can make dry land into springs.
He lets hungry people live there. They make a city to live in.
They plant crops and grape vines. They get a big harvest.
He blesses them, and they grow in number. Their animals do not go away.
But later they become fewer and sad. Hard times and sorrow bring them down.
He puts shame on proud leaders. He makes them wander in empty places with no road.
But He lifts poor people out of trouble. He makes their families grow like flocks of sheep.
Good people see this and are glad. People who do wrong stop talking.
Who is wise? Think about these things. Then people will understand the LORD's love.
This is a song and psalm of David. My heart is ready, God. I will sing and make music with all my heart.
Wake up, my heart! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up early.
I will thank You among the countries, O the LORD. I will sing praises to You among the people.
For Your kind love is great above the sky. Your truth reaches to the clouds.
Be lifted up, God, above the sky. Let Your glory be above all the earth.
Save with Your right hand and answer me, so Your loved ones can be saved.
God has spoken from His holy place: “I will win. I will share Shechem and measure the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine. Ephraim is the helmet for My head. Judah is My ruler’s stick.
Moab is My washbowl. Edom is under My foot. Over Philistia I shout in victory.”
Who will take me to the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You turned away from us, God? Will You not go out with our armies?
Give us help against the enemy, for help from people is no good.
With God we will do great things, and He will step on our enemies.
God, You are the one I praise. Please do not stay quiet.
Bad people with tricky mouths speak against me. They tell lies about me.
They surround me with mean words and fight me for no reason.
I loved them, but they accuse me. I keep praying to You.
They pay me back with bad for good, and hate for love.
Put a bad man over my enemy. Let someone accuse him at his right side.
When he is judged, let him be guilty. Let his prayer be a sin.
Let his days be few. Let someone else take his job.
Let his children lose their father. Let his wife become a widow.
Let his children wander and beg. Let them look for food from ruined homes.
Let money collectors take all he has. Let strangers steal what he worked for.
Let no one be kind to him. Let no one feel sorry for his children who have no father.
Let his family line end. Let their name be erased from the next generation.
Let the LORD remember the wrongs of his fathers. Do not erase his mother's sin.
Let these wrongs stay before the LORD always, so He can erase their memory from the earth.
He did not remember to be kind. He chased poor and needy people and those with broken hearts to kill them.
He loved to curse others. Let curses come to him. He did not want blessing. Let blessing stay far from him.
He wore curses like clothes. They soaked into him like water, into his bones like oil.
Let curses cover him like clothes. Let them be the belt he always wears.
This is how the LORD will pay back my accusers, those who speak evil against me.
But You, O Lord, the LORD, help me to honor Your name. Because Your faithful love is good, save me.
I am poor and needy. My heart is hurt inside me.
I fade away like a shadow in the evening. I am brushed away like a grasshopper.
My knees are weak because I have not eaten. My body has grown thin.
I am a joke to them. When they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, the LORD my God. Save me because of Your faithful love.
Let them know that Your hand did this. You, the LORD, did it.
They may curse, but You bless. They stand up, but they are put to shame. I, Your servant, will be glad.
Let those who accuse me be covered with shame. Let them wear their shame like a coat.
With my mouth I will thank the LORD very much. I will praise Him among many people.
He stands at the right side of the one in need to save him from those who judge him.
The LORD said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your power.”
The LORD will send your strong power from Zion. Rule even when your enemies are around you.
Your people will gladly help you when you are strong. They will be holy and bright like the morning dew. You have young helpers like dew drops.
The LORD made a promise and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever, like Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings when He is angry.
He will judge the nations. He will pile up the dead. He will crush the leaders of the whole earth.
He will drink from a stream beside the road. Then He will lift His head in victory.
Praise the LORD! I will thank the LORD with all my heart. I will do this with good people who follow God, in our meeting.
The LORD does great things. People who love His works study them.
His work is beautiful and great. He always does what is right, and that lasts forever.
He made people remember His miracles. The LORD is kind and caring.
He gives food to those who respect Him. He remembers His promise forever.
He showed His people how strong His works are. He gave them the lands of other nations.
His hands made things that are true and fair. All His rules can be trusted.
They stand strong forever. They are made with truth and what is right.
He sent help to His people. He made His promise last forever. His name is holy and wonderful.
Respecting the LORD is the start of wisdom. Everyone who follows His rules learns good sense. His praise lasts forever!
Praise the the LORD! Happy is the person who respects the the LORD and loves His rules.
His children will be strong in the land. Good people will be blessed.
His home has money and good things. His good deeds last forever.
Light shines in the dark for good people. They are kind, caring, and fair.
Good things come to the person who is kind and shares. He does his work in a fair way.
He will not be shaken. People will remember the good person forever.
He will not be afraid of bad news. His heart is strong because he trusts the the LORD.
His heart is safe. He will not be afraid until he sees his enemies fall.
He gives to poor people. His good deeds last forever. People will honor him.

even the dark is not dark to You. The night shines like day, because dark and light are the same to You.
You made my inner self. You put me together in my mother's womb.
I praise You because You made me in an amazing way. Your works are amazing, and I know it well.
My body was not hidden from You when I was made in secret. You made me deep in the earth.
Your eyes saw me before I was formed. All my days were written in Your book before even one of them happened.
God, Your thoughts are so special to me! There are so many of them!
If I tried to count them, they would be more than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with You.
God, I wish You would kill the bad people! Get away from me, you killers!
They say bad things about You. Your enemies use Your name in a wrong way.
The LORD, I hate those who hate You. I hate those who fight against You.
I hate them completely. I call them my enemies.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know what worries me.
See if I am doing wrong, and lead me on the right path forever.
The LORD, save me from bad people. Keep me safe from men who hurt others.
They think up bad things in their hearts. They stir up fights all day long.
They make their tongues sharp like snakes. Snake poison is under their lips.
The LORD, keep me safe from the hands of bad people. Protect me from men who hurt others. They plan to make me trip and fall.
Proud people hid a trap for me. They spread ropes like a net by my path. They set traps for me.
I said to the the LORD, "You are my God. The LORD, listen to my cry for help."
O the LORD, my Lord, You are strong. You save me. You keep my head safe in battle.
O the LORD, do not give bad people what they want. Do not let their plans work, or they will brag.
May trouble cover the heads of those around me. Their own words bring them trouble.
May hot coals fall on them. May they be thrown into fire, into deep mud, and never get up.
Do not let a person who tells lies be safe in the land. May trouble hunt down the man who hurts others.
I know the the LORD will help poor people get justice. He will stand up for those in need.
Surely good people will praise Your name. Honest people will live with You.
O the LORD, I call to You. Hurry and help me! Listen to my voice when I call to You.
Let my prayer be like sweet smoke before You. Let my hands lifted up be like the evening offering.
O the LORD, put a guard on my mouth. Keep watch over my lips.
Do not let my heart want bad things. Do not let me do wrong with people who do wrong. Do not let me eat their tasty food.
Let a good person correct me. That is kind. Let him scold me. It will be like a blessing on my head. I will not say no. I still pray against their bad deeds.
Their leaders will fall off the cliff. They will hear my words, and they will like them.
Our bones are scattered at the grave like dirt that has been dug up.
But my eyes look to You, O the LORD God. I trust in You. Do not take my life away.
Keep me from the traps they set for me. Keep me from the traps of people who do wrong.
Let bad people fall into their own nets while I get away safe.
I cry out loud to the the LORD. I beg the the LORD to help me.
I tell the the LORD all my worries. I tell Him how much trouble I am in.
I feel weak inside, but You know where I go. People hide traps where I walk.
Look to my right and see. No one knows me. I have nowhere to run. No one cares about my life.
I cry to You, the LORD. I say, "You are my safe place. You are my hope in this life."
Listen to my cry, because I am very weak. Save me from the people chasing me. They are stronger than I am.
Get me out of this prison, so I can thank You. Good people will be around me, because You will be good to me.
O the LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for help. Answer me because You are faithful and right.
Do not judge Your servant, because no one is right before You.
My enemy chases me. He has crushed my life to the ground. He has made me live in dark places like people who died long ago.
My spirit is weak inside me. My heart is worried inside me.
I remember the days long ago. I think about all Your works. I think about what Your hands have made.
I hold out my hands to You. My soul is thirsty for You like dry land. Selah.
Answer me fast, O the LORD. My spirit is weak. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who go down to the grave.
Let me hear Your kindness in the morning, because I trust in You. Show me the way I should go, because I give myself to You.
Save me from my enemies, O the LORD. I come to You for safety.
Teach me to do Your will, because You are my God. Let Your good Spirit lead me on flat ground.
Because of Your name, O the LORD, keep me alive. In Your right ways, bring me out of trouble.
In Your kindness, defeat my enemies. Destroy all who hurt me, because I am Your servant.
Praise the LORD my Rock. He trains my hands for war. He trains my fingers for battle.
He is kind to me. He is my safe place and my strong tower. He saves me. He is my shield, and I trust in Him. He puts nations under me.
The LORD, what is a person that You know him? What is a human being that You think about him?
People are like a breath. Their days pass like a shadow.
The LORD, bend Your sky and come down. Touch the mountains so they smoke.
Send lightning and scatter them. Shoot Your arrows and make them run away.
Reach down from heaven and save me. Pull me from deep water. Save me from strangers.
They say things that are not true. They do not keep their promises.
God, I will sing a new song to You. I will play music to You on a harp with ten strings.
He gives kings the win. He saves His servant David from the sword that kills.
Save me and pull me from strangers. They say things that are not true. They do not keep their promises.
May our sons grow strong like plants when they are young. May our daughters be like beautiful pillars in a palace.
May our barns be full with all kinds of food. May our sheep have thousands and thousands of babies in our fields.
May our oxen carry heavy loads. May our walls stay strong. May no one be taken away. May our streets be quiet.
Happy are the people who have these things. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
I will lift You up, my God and King. I will praise Your name forever and ever.
Every day I will praise You. I will praise Your name forever and ever.
The LORD is great. People should praise Him very much. No one can understand how great He is.
One group of people will tell the next group about Your works. They will tell about Your strong acts.
They will talk about how great and beautiful You are. I will think about Your amazing works.
They will tell how strong Your amazing deeds are. I will tell about Your greatness.
They will share the memory of Your great kindness. They will sing with joy about Your good ways.
The LORD is kind and caring. He is slow to get angry. His love is very big.
The LORD is good to everyone. He is kind to everything He made.
Everything You made will thank You, the LORD. Your faithful people will praise You.
They will tell about how great Your kingdom is. They will talk about Your power.
They will help people know Your strong acts and how great Your kingdom is.
Your kingdom lasts forever. Your rule lasts for all time.
The LORD holds up everyone who falls. He lifts up everyone who is bent down.
All eyes look to You. You give them food at the right time.
You open Your hand. You give every living thing all it needs.
The LORD is right in everything He does. He is kind in all His work.
The LORD is close to everyone who calls on Him. He is close to all who call on Him and mean it.
He gives those who respect Him what they need. He hears their cry and saves them.
The LORD keeps safe all who love Him. But He will destroy all evil people.
My mouth will speak praise to the LORD. Let all people bless His holy name forever and ever.
Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, O my soul!
I will praise the LORD as long as I live. I will sing to my God while I have life.
Do not put your trust in leaders. Do not trust in people who cannot save you.
When his breath leaves him, he goes back to the dust. On that day, his plans are gone.
Happy is the person whose help is the God of Jacob. His hope is in the LORD his God.
He made heaven and earth. He made the sea and everything in it. He is faithful forever.
He does what is right for people who are treated badly. He gives food to hungry people. The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD helps blind people see. The LORD lifts up people who are bent down. The LORD loves people who do right.
The LORD watches over people from other lands. He helps children with no father and women with no husband. He turns the plans of bad people upside down.
The LORD will rule forever. Your God, O Zion, will rule for all time. Praise the LORD!
Praise the the LORD! It is good to sing praise to our God. It feels nice and right to praise Him.
The LORD builds Jerusalem. He brings Israel's people home.
He heals people with broken hearts. He bandages their hurts.
He counts all the stars. He calls each one by name.
Our Lord is great. He is very strong. No one can measure how smart He is.
The LORD helps humble people. He brings down people who do wrong.
Sing to the LORD and thank Him. Play music to our God with a harp.
He covers the sky with clouds. He sends rain to the earth. He makes grass grow on the hills.
He feeds the animals. He feeds young ravens when they call for food.
He is not pleased by a horse's strength or a person's speed.
The LORD is happy with people who respect Him and wait for His kind love.
Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
He makes the bars on your gates strong. He blesses your children inside you.
He gives peace inside your land. He fills you with the best wheat.
He sends His command to the earth. His word moves fast.
He gives snow like wool. He scatters frost like ashes.
He throws down hail like small rocks. Who can stand up to His cold?
He sends His word and melts the ice. He sends His wind, and the water flows.
He tells His word to Jacob. He gives His rules and decisions to Israel.
He has not done this for any other nation. They do not know His rules. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD from heaven! Praise Him in the highest places!
Praise Him, all His angels! Praise Him, all His armies in heaven!
Praise Him, sun and moon! Praise Him, all shining stars!
Praise Him, highest heavens! Praise Him, waters above the sky!
Let them praise the name of the LORD, because He spoke, and they were made.
He put them in place to last forever. He made a rule that will not be broken.
Praise the LORD from the earth! Praise Him, big sea animals and deep ocean places!
Praise Him, fire and hail, snow and clouds, and strong winds that do what He says!
Praise Him, mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedar trees!
Praise Him, wild animals and all farm animals, small things that crawl and birds that fly!
Praise Him, kings of the earth and all nations, leaders and all judges of the earth!
Praise Him, young men and young women, old people and young people too!
Let them praise the name of the LORD, because only His name is great. His greatness is above earth and heaven.
He gave His people strength. He is praised by all His faithful people. They are the children of Israel, people close to Him. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Sing a new song to the LORD. Sing His praise with God's people.
Let Israel be happy with its Maker. Let the people of Zion be glad with their King.
Let them praise His name with dancing. Let them sing to Him with tambourines and harps.
The LORD is happy with His people. He saves humble people.
Let God's people be glad and proud. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
Let God's people sing loud praises to God. Let them hold a sharp sword in their hands.
They will punish the nations. They will punish all the peoples.
They will tie up their kings with chains. They will bind their leaders with iron chains.
They will do the punishment that was written down. This is an honor for all God's people. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD. Praise God in His holy place. Praise Him in the strong sky.
Praise Him for His mighty acts. Praise Him for how great He is.
Praise Him with a trumpet. Praise Him with a harp and a lyre.
Praise Him with a tambourine and dancing. Praise Him with strings and a flute.
Praise Him with loud cymbals. Praise Him with crashing cymbals.
Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.
These are the wise sayings of Solomon. He was David's son. He was the king of Israel.
They help people know what is wise. They help people learn good lessons.
They help people learn to be fair and do right.
They give good sense to people who are not wise yet. They give young people knowledge and good plans.
A wise person listens and learns more. A person with understanding finds good advice.
These sayings help people understand short wise sayings. They help people understand what wise people say. They help people figure out hard questions.
Honoring the LORD is where knowing starts. But fools hate wisdom and good lessons.
My son, listen to your father's teaching. Do not forget your mother's words.
They will be like a pretty crown on your head. They will be like a necklace around your neck.
My son, if sinners try to get you to do wrong, do not agree.
They may say, "Come with us. Let us hide and hurt someone. Let us attack a person who has done nothing wrong.
We will make them disappear like death. We will take them down whole, like people falling into a deep hole.
We will find many valuable things. We will fill our homes with stolen goods.
Share your money with us. We will all share one money bag."
My son, do not walk in their way. Keep your feet away from their path.
Their feet run to do bad things. They hurry to hurt people.
It is useless to spread a net where a bird can see it.
But these people set traps for their own lives.
This is what happens to people who chase money the wrong way. It costs them their lives.
Wisdom shouts in the street. She raises her voice in the town squares.
She calls out where crowds gather. She speaks at the city gates. She says,
"How long will you people who are easily fooled love being fooled? How long will you who make fun of others enjoy it? How long will you fools hate learning?
Turn back when I warn you. Then I will pour out My Spirit on you. I will make my words known to you."
"I called, but you refused to listen. I reached out my hand, but no one cared.
You ignored all my advice. You did not want me to correct you.
So I will laugh when trouble comes to you. I will make fun of you when you are afraid.
When fear comes like a storm and trouble comes like a strong wind, when hard times and pain come on you, I will laugh."
"Then they will call to me, but I will not answer. They will look for me, but they will not find me.
This is because they hated knowledge. They did not choose to respect the LORD.
They did not want my advice. They laughed at all my warnings.
So they will get what their choices deserve. They will be full of their own bad plans.
People who are easily fooled can die because they turn away. Fools are destroyed by their own comfort.
But the person who listens to me will live in safety. That person will be calm and not afraid of trouble."
My son, if you listen to my words and keep my commands with you,
listen to wisdom and work hard to understand.
Yes, if you ask for good sense and ask for understanding,
and if you look for it like silver and search for it like hidden treasure,
then you will understand deep respect for the LORD, and you will find out about God.
For the LORD gives wisdom. From His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
He keeps good things for honest people. He is a shield for people who live without blame.
He guards the path of fair people. He protects the way of His loyal people.
Then you will understand what is right and fair and good, every good way.
Wisdom will come into your heart, and knowing things will make you happy.
Good sense will protect you, and understanding will keep you safe.
Wisdom will save you from the ways of bad men, from men who say twisted things.
These men left the right path to walk in dark ways.
They like to do wrong, and they are glad to do evil.
Their paths are crooked, and they are tricky in their ways.
Wisdom will save you from the woman who is not true to her husband, from the smooth words of a stranger.
She left the husband she married when young. She forgot the promise she made to her God.
Her house leads to death, and her paths go to the place of the dead.
No one who goes to her comes back, or finds the way to life.
So you will walk in the ways of good people and stay on the paths of people who do right.
Honest people will live in the land, and people without blame will stay there.
But bad people will be removed from the land, and people who are not loyal will be pulled out of it.
My son, do not forget my teaching. Keep my rules in your heart.
They will help you live a long and peaceful life.
Do not let kindness and truth leave you. Keep them with you always. Remember them in your heart.
Then God and people will like you. They will see you as wise.
Trust the LORD with all your heart. Do not depend on your own ideas.
In everything you do, turn to Him. He will guide your steps.
Do not think you are wise. Fear the LORD. Stay away from evil.
This will bring health to your body. It will refresh your bones.
Honor the LORD with your wealth. Give Him the first part of all you make.
Then your barns will be full. Your wine jars will overflow.
My son, do not say no to the LORD's teaching. Do not hate it when He corrects you.
The LORD corrects those He loves. A father is pleased with his son.
A person who finds wisdom is happy. A person who gets understanding is happy.
Wisdom is worth more than silver. It is worth more than gold.
Wisdom is worth more than jewels. Nothing you want is as good as wisdom.
Wisdom gives long life. She gives riches and honor.
Her ways feel good. All her paths bring peace.
She is like a tree that gives life to those who hold on to her. Those who keep her are happy.
The LORD made the earth with wisdom. He set up the heavens with understanding.
By His knowledge the deep waters split open. The clouds dropped dew.
My son, do not take your eyes off these things. Keep good sense and wise plans.
They will give life to your soul. They will be like a beautiful necklace.
Then you will walk safely. Your foot will not trip.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Your sleep will be peaceful.
Do not be afraid of sudden danger. Do not fear trouble that hits bad people.
The LORD will be your safe place. He will keep you from getting trapped.
Do not keep good from people who should have it. Help them when you can.
Do not say to your neighbor, 'Go, and come back, and tomorrow I will give it,' when you have it now.
Do not plan evil against your neighbor. He lives safely beside you.
Do not argue with someone for no reason. Do not fight if he has not hurt you.
Do not envy a cruel person. Do not follow his ways.
The LORD hates a crooked person. But He is a friend to good people.
The LORD's curse is on the house of bad people. But He blesses the home of good people.
He laughs at people who make fun of others. But He is kind to humble people.
Wise people will get honor. Foolish people will get shame.
Listen, my sons, to a father's teaching. Pay attention and gain understanding.
I give you good teaching. Don't leave my law.
For I was a son to my father. I was young and the only child my mother had.
He taught me. He said, "Hold my words close to your heart. Keep my commands and live."
Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget my words. Don't turn away from what I say.
Don't leave wisdom, and she will guard you. Love her, and she will keep you.
Wisdom is the first thing to get. Get wisdom, and with all you get, get understanding.
Value her, and she will lift you up. Hold her close, and she will honor you.
She will put a pretty crown on your head. She will give you a crown of beauty.
Listen, my son, and take my words. Then you will live many years.
I taught you the way of wisdom. I led you on straight paths.
When you walk, nothing will get in your way. If you run, you won't fall.
Hold on to teaching. Don't let go. Keep it, for it is your life.
Don't go on the path of bad people. Don't walk in the way of evil people.
Stay away from it. Don't pass by it. Turn away from it and keep going.
They can't sleep unless they do bad things. They lose sleep unless they make someone fall.
They eat the bread of badness and drink the wine of hurting others.
But the path of good people is like the light of morning. It gets brighter and brighter until full day.
The way of bad people is like deep darkness. They don't know what makes them fall.
My son, listen to my words. Turn your ear to what I say.
Don't let them leave your sight. Keep them in your heart.
They are life to those who find them. They bring health to the whole body.
Guard your heart more than anything else, for life comes from it.
Take bad talk out of your mouth. Stay far from lies and bad words.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Look right at what is in front of you.
Make the path for your feet level. Then all your ways will be firm.
Don't turn right or left. Keep your foot away from bad.
My son, listen to my wise words. Turn your ear to what I understand.
Then you can make good choices. Your lips can keep wise words.
A woman who is not your wife may speak sweet words. Her talk may be smooth like oil.
But in the end she is bitter like a bad herb. She is sharp like a sword with two edges.
Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead to the grave.
She does not think about the path of life. She does not know her ways are not steady.
So now, my sons, listen to me. Do not turn away from what I say.
Keep your way far from her. Do not go near the door of her house.
Then you will not give your strength to others. You will not give your years to a cruel person.
Strangers will not eat up your wealth. Your hard work will not fill a stranger's house.
At the end of your life, when your body is worn out, you will groan.
You will say, "How I hated being taught! My heart did not like correction!
I did not listen to my teachers. I did not turn my ear to my guides.
I almost ruined my life in front of everyone."
Drink water from your own well. Drink fresh water from your own spring.
Why should your water flow in the streets? Why should your streams flow in the public squares?
They are for you alone. Do not share them with strangers.
May your spring be blessed. Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
She is like a loving deer. She is like a graceful young deer. Let her love fill you always. Let her love hold you forever.
My son, why would you be drawn to a woman who is not your wife? Why would you hug a stranger?
The LORD sees the way a man lives. He watches all his paths.
A bad man's wrong acts catch him. His sins hold him tight.
He will die because he would not learn. His great foolishness leads him the wrong way.
My son, if you promise to pay for your neighbor, or shake hands to back a stranger's debt,
you are trapped by your own words. You are caught by what you said.
Do this now, my son, to get free. You have fallen into your neighbor's hands. Go and humble yourself. Ask your neighbor to let you go.
Do not let your eyes sleep. Do not let your eyelids rest.
Get free like a deer from a hunter's hand. Get free like a bird from the hand of a bird catcher.
Go to the ant, you lazy person. Watch what it does. Learn from it and be wise.
It has no boss, no leader, and no ruler.
But it stores food in summer. It gathers food at harvest time.
How long will you lie there, you lazy person? When will you get up from your sleep?
A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of your hands to sleep,
and poverty will come to you like a robber. You will not have enough, like a man with a weapon.
A bad man is a troublemaker. He walks with twisted words.
He winks with his eyes. He taps his feet. He points with his fingers.
He has tricks in his heart. He always plans bad things. He stirs up fights.
So his trouble will come on him fast. In a moment he will be broken, and no one can fix him.
There are six things the LORD hates. There are seven things He hates.
He hates proud eyes. He hates a lying tongue. He hates hands that kill people who did no wrong.
He hates a heart that makes bad plans. He hates feet that run fast to do bad things.
He hates a false witness who lies. He hates a person who stirs up fights between brothers.
My son, keep your father's rules. Do not leave your mother's teaching.
Tie them to your heart always. Wear them around your neck.
When you walk, they will guide you. When you sleep, they will watch over you. When you wake up, they will talk to you.
The rules are like a lamp. The teaching is like a light. The hard words that correct you show the way to life.
They will keep you from the bad woman. They will keep you from the smooth words of a woman you do not know.
Do not want her beauty in your heart. Do not let her eyes catch you.
A bad woman can be bought for a piece of bread. But a married woman hunts for a man's life.
Can a man carry fire in his lap and not burn his clothes?
Can a man walk on hot coals and not burn his feet?
So is the man who goes to his neighbor's wife. No one who touches her will go free.
People do not hate a thief who steals because he is hungry.
But if he is caught, he must pay back seven times. He must give all the money in his house.
A man who sleeps with another man's wife has no sense. He hurts his own life.
He will get hurt and shame. His shame will never go away.
A husband is very jealous. He will not be kind on the day he gets even.
He will not take any money to let it go. He will not be happy even if someone gives him a big gift.
My son, remember my words. Keep my rules with you.
Keep my rules and live. Guard my teaching like your own eyes.
Tie them on your fingers. Write them on your heart.
Say to wisdom, “You are like a sister to me.” Call good sense your close friend.
Wisdom and good sense will keep you safe from a woman who is not your wife. They will keep you from a woman from far away who uses sweet words to trick you.
I looked out the window of my house. I looked through the bars.
I saw some young men who did not think. I noticed a young man among the boys. He had no sense.
He walked down the street near her corner. He took the road to her house.
He went when it was getting dark, in the evening. It was the middle of a very dark night.
Then a woman came to meet him. She was dressed like a woman who sells love, and her heart was tricky.
She is loud and will not listen. She does not stay at home.
She walks the streets and town squares. She waits at every corner to trap someone.
She grabbed him and kissed him. She looked bold and said to him: “
I made my peace offerings today. I paid what I promised to God.
So I came out to meet you. I looked for you, and I found you.
I put nice covers on my bed. They are covers made of fine cloth from Egypt.
I put perfume on my bed: myrrh, aloe, and cinnamon.
Come, let us enjoy love until morning. Let us be happy together.
My husband is not at home. He went on a long trip.
He took a bag of money with him. He will come home when the moon is full.”
With her many words, she led him away. With her smooth talk, she made him go with her.
He followed her right away, like an ox going to be killed. He was like a deer stepping into a trap.
He kept going until an arrow hit his liver. He was like a bird rushing into a trap. He did not know it would cost him his life.
Now listen to me, my sons. Pay attention to my words.
Do not let your heart turn to her ways. Do not wander on her paths.
She has hurt many people. She has killed strong men.
Her house leads down to the grave. It leads to the rooms of death.
Does wisdom call out? Does understanding raise her voice?
She stands on high places, by the road, where paths cross.
She stands by the city gates and calls out at the doors.
“I call to you, people. I speak to everyone.
People who are simple, learn to be smart. People who are foolish, learn to think.
Listen, for I speak good and wise things. My words are right.
My mouth speaks truth. I hate wrong words.
All my words are good. None are crooked or twisted.
They are clear to those who understand. They are right to those who seek knowledge.
“Take my teaching, not silver. Choose knowledge over gold.
Wisdom is better than jewels. Nothing anyone wants can match it.
I am Wisdom. I live with good sense. I find knowledge and wise plans.
“To fear the the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, bragging, bad ways, and twisted words.
I have good advice and wise plans. I have understanding and strength.
“Kings rule by me. Leaders make fair laws by me.
Princes rule by me. All leaders judge fairly by me.
I love those who love me. Those who look for me find me.
“Riches and honor are with me. So are lasting wealth and right living.
My fruit is better than gold. What I give is better than silver.
I walk on the path of right living. I stay on the road of fairness.
I give wealth to those who love me. I fill their storage rooms.
“The LORD made me first, before He began His work long ago.
I was set up from long ago, before the earth began.
When there were no deep oceans, I was born. When there were no springs of water,
before the mountains were set in place, before the hills were born,
before He made the earth and its fields, or the dust of the world.
“When He set the sky in place, I was there. He drew a circle on the deep sea.
He made the clouds strong above. He made the deep springs strong.
He set a limit for the sea, so the waters would not cross it. He laid the earth's foundations.
I was beside Him like a skilled worker. I was His joy day by day. I rejoiced before Him always.
I rejoiced in His world where people live. My delight was with people.
“Now, children, listen to me. Happy are those who keep my ways.
Listen to teaching and be wise. Do not ignore it.
Happy is the one who listens to me, who waits at my doors every day, who keeps my doorways.
“For whoever finds me finds life. He gets favor from the the LORD.
But whoever sins against me hurts himself. All who hate me love death.”
Wisdom built her house. She cut seven pillars.
She prepared her meat. She mixed her wine. She also set her table.
She sent out her helpers. They called from the high places in the town.
She said, "Whoever is simple, come in here!" She said this to the one who needs understanding.
"Come and eat my bread. Drink the wine I mixed.
Leave your simple ways and live. Walk in the way of understanding."

Do not eat the food of a person who is stingy, and do not want his fancy food.
What he really thinks is who he is. He says, "Eat and drink," but he does not really want you to.
You will throw up the food you ate, and your kind words will be wasted.
Do not talk to a foolish person, because he will make fun of your wise words.
Do not move an old boundary stone, and do not take land from orphans.
Their Redeemer is strong. He will stand up for them against you.
Give your heart to teaching, and listen with your ears to wise words.
Do not refuse to discipline a child. If you punish him with a stick, he will not die.
Punish him, and you will save his life.
My son, if you are wise, I will be very happy.
I will be glad deep inside when you say what is right.
Do not be jealous of sinners. Always be eager to honor the the LORD.
You have a good future, and your hope will not be taken away.
Listen, my son, be wise, and keep your mind on the right path.
Do not be with people who drink too much wine or eat too much food.
People who drink too much and eat too much become poor, and sleepiness makes them wear old clothes.
Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not look down on your mother when she is old.
Buy the truth and do not sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
The father of a good man is very happy. A man who has a wise son is glad.
May your father and mother be happy! May the woman who gave birth to you be joyful!
My son, give me your full attention, and keep your eyes on my ways.
A prostitute is a deep hole, and a woman who cheats is a narrow well.
She waits like a robber and leads many men to be unfaithful.
Who has trouble? Who has sadness? Who has fights? Who has complaints? Who has bruises for no reason? Who has red eyes?
People who stay too long over wine, who go to taste mixed wine.
Do not stare at wine when it is red, when it shines in the cup, when it goes down easily!
In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a poison snake.
You will see strange things, and your mind will think confusing thoughts.
