“Bring your case to court,” says the LORD. “Bring your strong points,” says the King of Jacob.
“Let them come forward and tell us what will happen. Let them tell the old things, what they are, so we can think about them and know how they end. Or let them tell us what is coming.
Tell the things to come, so we know you are gods. Do good or bad, so we can be shocked and afraid together.
See, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. Anyone who chooses you is disgusting.”
“I raised up one from the north, and he has come. From where the sun rises, he calls on My name. He walks on rulers like mud, like a clay worker steps on clay.
Who told this from the start, so we could know? Who told it long ago, so we could say, ‘He is right’? No one told it. No one said it. No one heard your words.”
“I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look, here they are!’ I gave Jerusalem someone with good news.
When I look, there is no one. Among these, there is no helper who can answer when I ask.
See, they are all a lie. Their works are nothing. Their statues are like wind and nothing.”
Here is My servant. I will hold him up. He is My chosen one. I am happy with him. I put My Spirit on him. He will bring fair rules to the nations.
He will not shout or yell. People will not hear his voice in the streets.
He will not snap a weak, bent reed. He will not put out a small, smoking flame. He will bring true, fair rules.
He will not get tired or give up. He will do this until fair rules are set on earth. Faraway lands will wait for his teaching.
This is what God, the LORD, says: He made the sky and spread it out. He made the earth and all that grows on it. He gives breath to the people on it. He gives life to those who walk on it.
"I, the LORD, called you to do what is right. I held your hand. I kept you safe. I made you a promise for the people. You will be a light for the nations.
You will help blind people see. You will free people from prison. You will bring people out of dark cells.
"I am the LORD. That is My name. I will not give My glory to another. I will not give My praise to idols.
Look, the old things have happened. Now I tell you new things before they grow."
Sing a new song to the LORD. Sing His praise from the ends of the earth. You who go down to the sea and all that is in it, sing. You who live on faraway islands, sing too.
Let the dry places and their towns sing. Let the people of Kedar sing. Let the people who live on rocks shout for joy. Let them call out from the tops of mountains.
Let them give glory to the LORD. Let them tell His praise in the faraway lands.
The LORD will go out like a strong man. He will stir up His anger like a warrior. He will shout and cry out. He will win over His enemies.
"I have been quiet for a long time. I kept still and held Myself back. Now I will cry out like a woman giving birth. I will gasp and pant.
I will dry up mountains and hills. I will make all their plants dry up. I will turn rivers into dry land. I will dry up the ponds.

I will lead blind people on a road they do not know. I will guide them on paths they have not walked. I will turn darkness into light for them. I will make rough places smooth. I will do these things. I will not leave them."
But people who trust in idols will be turned back and put to shame. They say to metal statues, "You are our gods."
"Listen, you who are deaf. Look, you who are blind, so you can see.
Who is blind like My servant? Who is deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one who belongs to Me? Who is blind like the servant of the LORD?
You have seen many things, but you do not keep them. Your ears are open, but you do not listen."
The LORD wanted to show His right way. He wanted His law to be great and honored.
But these people have been robbed and ruined. All of them are trapped in holes and hidden in prisons. They are taken away, and no one saves them. No one says, "Bring them back."
Who among you will listen to this? Who will pay attention and hear for the future?
Who gave Jacob to be robbed? Who gave Israel to the robbers? Was it not the LORD, the One we sinned against? They did not want to walk in His ways. They did not listen to His law.
So He poured out His angry wrath on them. War came all around them. It burned them, but they did not know it. It set them on fire, but they did not think about it.
But now the the LORD says this: "I made you, Jacob. I shaped you, Israel. Do not be afraid. I have saved you. I called you by your name. You are Mine.
"When you go through water, I will be with you. When you cross rivers, they will not sweep you away. When you walk through fire, you will not burn. The flames will not hurt you.
"I am the LORD, your God. I am the Holy One of Israel. I am the One who saves you. I gave Egypt to pay for you. I gave Cush and Seba in your place.
"You are special to Me. You are honored. I love you. I will give people in your place. I will give nations to save your life."
"Do not be afraid. I am with you. I will bring your children from the east. I will gather you from the west.
"I will say to the north, 'Give them up!' I will say to the south, 'Do not hold them back!' Bring My sons from far away. Bring My daughters from the ends of the earth.
"I made everyone who is called by My name. I made them for My glory. I shaped them. I made them."
"Bring out the people who are blind, even though they have eyes. Bring out the deaf, even though they have ears.

"All the nations come together. The peoples gather. Who among them can tell us this? Who can make us hear what will happen next? Let them bring people who saw it to prove they are right. Or let them listen and say, 'It is true.'

"You are My witnesses," says the LORD, "and My servant, whom I chose. I chose you so you can know Me and trust Me. Then you can understand that I am the One. No god was made before Me. No god will come after Me.
"I am the LORD. I am the only One who saves. There is no one else.
"I told you what would happen. I saved you. I made you hear it. No strange god was among you. So you are My witnesses," says the LORD, "and I am God.
"Even from the start, I am the One. No one can take you out of My hand. I act, and no one can stop it."

The The LORD says this: "I am the One who saves you. I am the Holy One of Israel. For your sake, I will send to Babylon. I will bring them down. They will run away, even the Chaldeans, in their ships.
"I am the LORD. I am your Holy One. I made Israel. I am your King.
"I make a way in the sea. I make a path in deep water.
"I bring out chariots and horses. I bring out armies and strong men. They lie down together. They will not get up. They are put out, like a lamp."
"Do not remember the old things. Do not think about things from long ago.
"Look, I am doing something new. It is starting now. Can you see it? I will make a road in the desert. I will make rivers in dry land.
"The wild animals will praise Me. Even the jackals and ostriches will praise Me. I give water in the desert. I make rivers in dry land. I do this to give drink to My people, the ones I chose.
"The people I made for Myself will tell about My praise."
"But you did not call to Me, Jacob. You grew tired of Me, Israel.
"You did not bring Me sheep to burn for Me. You did not honor Me with your gifts. I did not make you work hard with grain offerings. I did not tire you out with incense.
"You did not buy sweet cane for Me with money. You did not make Me happy with the fat from your gifts. Instead, you made Me work hard with your sins. You tired Me out with your wrongs.
"I am the One who wipes out your wrongs. I do it for My own sake. I will not remember your sins.
"Remind Me. Let us talk it over. Tell your side, so you can be right.
"Your first father sinned. The people who spoke for you turned against Me.
"So I will let the holy leaders be put to shame. I will let Jacob be destroyed. I will let Israel be shamed."
The LORD says, “Now listen, Jacob, My servant. Israel, I chose you.
I made you and formed you in your mother’s womb. I will help you. Do not be afraid, Jacob, My servant. Jeshurun, I chose you.
I will pour water on thirsty land. I will pour streams on dry ground. I will pour My Spirit on your children. I will send My blessing on your family.
They will grow like grass. They will grow like willow trees by streams.
One will say, ‘I belong to the the LORD.’ Another will call himself Jacob. Another will write on his hand, ‘I belong to the the LORD,’ and take the name Israel.”
The LORD, the King and Savior of Israel, the the LORD who rules everything, says, “I am the first. I am the last. There is no God but Me.
Who is like Me? Let him speak and show it. Let him tell Me, since I chose the people long ago. Let them tell what will happen next.
Do not be afraid. Do not be scared. Have I not told you since long ago? I told you. You are My witnesses. Is there any God but Me? There is no Rock. I know of none.”
All who make a carved idol make something empty. Their favorite things do not help. Their witnesses do not see or know. So they will be ashamed.
Who made a god? Who poured a metal idol that helps no one?
Look, all who join them will be ashamed. The workers are only people. They all gather and stand together. They are afraid. They are ashamed together.
The blacksmith works with tongs in the coals. He shapes it with hammers. He works hard with his strong arm. He gets hungry and weak. He drinks no water. He gets tired.
The woodworker stretches a line. He marks it with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it with a compass. He makes it look like a man. He makes it look nice, to put in a house.
He cuts down cedar trees. He takes cypress and oak. He picks strong trees from the forest. He plants a pine tree. The rain makes it grow.
The wood is used to burn. A man takes some and warms himself. He lights a fire and bakes bread. He also makes a god and worships it. He makes a carved idol and bows to it.
He burns half of it in the fire. He cooks meat on the other half. He eats and is full. He warms himself and says, ‘Ah, I am warm. I see the fire.’
He makes the rest into a god, his carved idol. He bows to it and worships it. He prays to it and says, ‘Save me, for you are my god.’
They do not know or understand. Their eyes are covered so they cannot see. Their hearts are covered so they cannot understand.

No one thinks about it. No one has knowledge or sense to say, ‘I burned half of it in the fire. I baked bread on its coals. I roasted meat and ate it. Should I make the rest into something hated? Should I bow to a piece of wood?’
He feeds on ashes. A tricked heart leads him the wrong way. He cannot save himself. He cannot say, ‘There is a lie in my right hand.’
“Remember these things, Jacob. You are My servant, Israel. I made you. You are My servant. Israel, I will not forget you.
I wiped out your wrongs like a cloud. I wiped out your sins like fog. Come back to Me, for I saved you.”
Sing, heavens, because the the LORD has done it. Shout, deep parts of the earth. Break into song, mountains, forests, and every tree. The The LORD saved Jacob and shows His glory in Israel.
The LORD, your Savior, who formed you in your mother’s womb, says, “I am the the LORD. I made everything. I alone stretched out the heavens. Who spread out the earth with Me?

I stop the signs of false prophets. I make fortune-tellers look foolish. I turn wise men back. I make their knowledge look silly. “I keep the word of My servant. I do what My messengers say. I say to Jerusalem, ‘You will be lived in.’ I say to the cities of Judah, ‘You will be rebuilt.’ I will raise up her broken places.
I say to the deep sea, ‘Be dry.’ I will dry up your rivers.
I say to Cyrus, ‘You are My shepherd.’ He will do all I want. I say to Jerusalem, ‘You will be rebuilt.’ I say to the temple, ‘You will be started again.’”
The LORD says this to Cyrus, the man He chose to lead: "I hold your right hand. I will help you beat nations. I will take power from kings. I will open doors for you. Gates will not stay shut.
I will go in front of you. I will make rough places flat. I will break bronze doors. I will cut iron bars."
"I will give you treasures hidden in dark places. I will give you secret riches. Then you will know I am the LORD, the God of Israel. I call you by name.
I do this for Jacob, who serves Me, and for Israel, My chosen people. I call you by name. I give you a special name. But you do not know Me."
"I am the LORD. There is no other God. I will give you strength, even though you do not know Me.
Then people from sunrise to sunset will know there is no one but Me. I am the LORD. There is no other.
I make light. I make darkness. I bring peace. I bring trouble. I, the LORD, do all these things."
"Rain down, heavens. Let the skies pour down what is right. Let the earth open up. Let saving help grow. Let what is right grow too. I, the LORD, made this."
It is bad for a man who fights his Maker. He is like a clay pot among other pots. Will clay ask the potter what he is making? Will the thing made say he has no hands?
It is bad for one who says to his father, "What did you make?" or to his mother, "What did you bring into the world?"
The LORD, the Holy One of Israel, who made Israel, says this: "Ask Me about what will happen. Will you tell Me what to do with My children? Will you tell Me what to do with the work of My hands?
I made the earth. I made people on it. My hands spread out the skies. I told all the stars to be there.

I will raise Cyrus to do what is right. I will make his path straight. He will build My city again. He will let My people go free. He will not ask for money or pay. This is what the LORD of Armies says."

The LORD says this: "Egypt's goods and Cush's goods, and the tall Sabeans, will come to you. They will be yours. They will walk behind you. They will come in chains. They will bow down to you. They will say that God is with you and there is no other God."
Truly, You are a God who hides Himself. You are the God of Israel. You save people.
They will all be ashamed. The men who make false gods will leave together in shame.
But Israel will be saved by the LORD forever. You will never be ashamed.
The LORD says this: "He made the heavens. He is God. He made the earth. He set it in place. He did not make it empty. He made it for people to live in. I am the LORD. There is no other.
I did not speak in secret in a dark land. I did not tell Jacob's people, 'Look for Me for nothing.' I, the LORD, speak truth. I say what is right.
"Come together. Come near, you who ran away from the nations. They do not know anything. They carry wooden gods. They pray to a god that cannot save.

Speak up. Make your case. Let them talk together. Who said this long ago? Who told it from the start? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me. I am a good God who saves. There is no one else.
"Turn to Me and be saved, all the world. I am God. There is no other.
I made a promise by Myself. Truth came from My mouth. My word will not change. Every knee will bow to Me. Every tongue will promise to Me.
They will say that only in the LORD are right ways and strength. All who get angry at Him will come to Him and be ashamed.
All Israel's children will be made right in the LORD. They will praise Him."
Bel falls down. Nebo bends over. Their statues are carried by animals. The things you carry are a heavy load for tired animals.
They bend down together. They cannot save the load. They are taken away as prisoners.
Listen to Me, family of Jacob. All of you who are left from Israel. I have carried you since you were born.
Even when you are old, I will not change. I will hold you up when your hair turns gray. I made you, and I will carry you. I will care for you and save you.
Who can you compare Me to? Who is equal to Me? Who is like Me?
They pour gold from a bag. They weigh silver. They pay a worker to make a god. Then they bow down and worship it.
They lift it on their shoulders and carry it. They put it in a place, and it stays there. It does not move. If someone calls to it, it does not answer. It cannot save him from trouble.
Remember this and be ashamed. Think about it, you who do wrong.
Remember the things from long ago. I am God. There is no other God. There is no one like Me.
I tell the end from the start. I tell what will happen before it comes. I say, "My plan will stand. I will do all I want to do."
I call a bird of prey from the east. I call a man from far away to do My plan. I have spoken, and I will make it happen. I have planned it, and I will do it.
Listen to Me, you who are stubborn. You are far from doing right.
I bring My right way near. It is not far away. My help will not be late. I will give help in Zion and My glory to Israel.
Go down and sit in the dust, young woman of Babylon. Sit on the ground with no throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. People will not call you gentle and soft anymore.
Get the millstones and grind flour. Take off your veil. Lift your skirt. Show your legs. Walk through the rivers.
People will see your naked body and your shame. I will punish you. I will not spare anyone."
Our Redeemer—the the LORD of Hosts is His name—the Holy One of Israel. "
Sit quietly and go into the dark, daughter of the Chaldeans. People will not call you the queen of kingdoms anymore.
I was angry with My people. I let them be hurt. I gave them to you. You showed them no mercy. You put a very heavy load on the old people.
You said you would be queen forever. But you did not think about these things. You did not remember what would happen to you.
Now listen to this, you who love comfort and sit safely. You say in your heart that you are the only one. You say you will not be a widow and will not lose your children.
These two things will come to you in one moment, in one day. You will lose your children, and you will become a widow. They will come on you fully, even with all your magic and strong spells.
You trusted in your bad ways. You said no one sees you. Your wisdom and knowledge led you the wrong way. You said in your heart that you are the only one.
But trouble will come on you. You will not know how to make it go away. Disaster will fall on you. You cannot pay for it. Ruin will come on you suddenly, and you will not know it.
Stand by your spells and all your magic. You worked hard at them since you were young. Maybe they will help you. Maybe they will scare people.
You are tired from all your plans. Let those people stand up and save you. They study the sky and the stars. They tell what will happen each new moon.
Look, they are like dry grass. Fire burns them up. They cannot save themselves from the fire. There is no coal to warm them, no fire to sit by.
That is what they are to you. You worked with them. They traded with you since you were young. Each one goes his own way. No one can save you."
Listen, people of Jacob. They are called Israel. They come from Judah's family. They promise by the LORD's name. But they do not really honor the God of Israel. They do not do what is right.
They call their city holy. They say they trust the God of Israel. The LORD of heaven's armies is His name.
I told people about things long ago before they happened. I spoke them. Then I did them quickly, and they came true.
I knew you are stubborn. Your neck is stiff. Your head is hard like metal.
So I told you ahead of time. I wanted you to know before it happened. Then you could not say, "My false god did this. My statue told it to happen."
You heard this. Look at all of it. And you people, won't you tell? From now on I will tell you new things. They are secret things you did not know.
These things are new now. They were not known before. You never heard them before today. So you cannot say, "I already knew."
You did not listen. You did not know. Your ears have been closed since long ago. I knew you would turn away. You have rebelled since birth. People even call you a rebel.
For the sake of My name, I will wait before showing My anger. For My praise, I will hold back for you. I will not destroy you.
See, I have tested you in fire, like metal. But it was not silver. I chose you in hard times.
I will do this for My sake. I will do it for My sake. My name should not be dishonored. I will not give My glory to anyone else.
Listen to Me, Jacob. Listen, Israel, whom I called. I am the One. I am first. I am last too.
My hand made the earth. My right hand spread out the sky. When I call them, they stand together.
Gather together, all of you, and listen. Who among them said these things would happen? The LORD loves him. He will do what the LORD wants in Babylon. His power will be against the Chaldeans.
I, yes I, have spoken. I called him. I brought him here. He will succeed in what he does.
Come close to Me and listen. I have not spoken in secret from the start. Since it began, I have been there. Now the Lord the LORD has sent Me, and His Spirit.
This is what the LORD says, your Savior, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God. I teach you what is good for you. I lead you on the way you should go.
If only you had listened to My commands! Then your peace would flow like a river. Your goodness would be like ocean waves.
Your children would be many, like sand. Your family would be like grains of sand too. Their name would not be wiped out. They would not be destroyed by Me."
Leave Babylon! Run away from the Chaldeans! Shout with joy. Tell everyone. Send this news to the ends of the earth: "The LORD has saved His servant Jacob!"
They did not get thirsty. He led them through dry places. He made water flow from a rock. He split the rock, and water came out.
"There is no peace for bad people," says the LORD.
Listen to you islands. Pay attention, you people far away. The LORD called Me before I was born. He named Me while I was still in My mother’s womb.
He made My mouth like a sharp sword. He hid Me in the shadow of His hand. He made Me like a polished arrow. He hid Me in His quiver.
Then He said to Me, “You are My servant, Israel. I will show My glory through You.”
But I said, “I worked for nothing. I used up My strength for no good. But the LORD will make things right for Me. My God will reward Me.”
Now the LORD speaks. He made Me in My mother’s womb to be His servant. He sent Me to bring Jacob back to Him. He sent Me to gather Israel to Him. I am honored by the LORD. My God makes Me strong.

He says, “It is not enough for You to be My servant. You will not just bring back the tribes of Jacob. You will not just bring back the people of Israel who are kept safe. I will make You a light for the nations. My saving help will reach the ends of the earth.”

This is what the LORD says. He sets His people free. He is the Holy One of Israel. He speaks to the one people hated. He speaks to the one people turned away. He speaks to the servant of rulers. Kings will see You and stand up. Leaders will bow down to You. This will happen because of the LORD. He is faithful. He is the Holy One of Israel. He chose You.

This is what the LORD says: “I will answer You when the time is right. I will help You on the day I save You. I will keep You safe. I will make You a promise for the people. You will build up the land again. You will give back the empty places.
You will tell the prisoners, ‘Come out.’ You will tell those in the dark, ‘Be free.’ They will eat along the roads. They will find food on every hill.
They will not be hungry. They will not be thirsty. The hot sun will not hurt them. The one who loves them will lead them. He will guide them to springs of water.
I will make all My mountains into roads. My highways will be lifted up.
Look! Some will come from far away. Some will come from the north. Some will come from the west. Some will come from the land of Sinim.”
Sing, you heavens! Be glad, you earth! Burst into song, you mountains! The LORD comforts His people. He is kind to those who hurt.
But Zion said, “The LORD left me. The Lord forgot me.”
The LORD says, “Can a mother forget her baby? Can she stop loving the child she bore? Even if she forgets, I will not forget you.
Look, I wrote your name on My hands. Your walls are always before Me.
Your children hurry back. The people who broke you and ruined you will leave you. “
Look up and see. All your children gather and come to you. As surely as I live,” says the LORD, “you will wear them like pretty jewels. You will put them on like a bride.
You were ruined and empty. Your land was destroyed. But now your land is too small for your people. The people who ate you up will be far away.
The children born while you were sad will say, ‘This place is too small for us. Give us more room.’

Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who had these children for me? I lost my children. I was alone. I was sent away. Who raised these children? I was left by myself. Where did these children come from?’”

This is what the Lord the LORD says: “I will lift My hand to the nations. I will raise My flag for the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms. They will carry your daughters on their shoulders.

Kings will take care of you. Their queens will feed you like mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground. They will lick dust from your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD. Those who wait for Me will not be ashamed.”
Can a strong man’s stolen things be taken back? Can prisoners be saved from a cruel man?
But this is what the LORD says: “Yes, prisoners will be taken from strong men. Stolen things will be saved from cruel men. I will fight those who fight you. I will save your children.
I will make your enemies eat their own flesh. They will be drunk on their own blood, like wine. Then everyone will know that I, the LORD, save you. I set you free. I am the strong God of Jacob.”

This is what the LORD says: "Where is the divorce paper for your mother? I did not send her away without a reason. Or did I sell you to pay a debt? No. You were sold because of your sins. Your mother was sent away because of your wrongs.

Why was no one here when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Am I not strong enough to save you? Do I have no power to help? Look, I can dry up the sea with a word. I can turn rivers into dry land. The fish die and rot because there is no water.
I can cover the sky with darkness. I can put black cloth over it."
The Lord the LORD gave Me words to teach. He taught Me how to help tired people with a word. Each morning He wakes Me. He opens My ear to listen like a student.
The Lord the LORD opened My ear. I did not say no. I did not turn back.
I let people hit My back. I let them pull hair from My face. I did not hide My face from shame and spit.
But the Lord the LORD helps Me. So I am not ashamed. So I set My face like a hard rock. I know I will not be put to shame.
The One who says I am right is near. Who can argue with Me? Let us stand together. Who can take Me to court? Let him come near.
Look, the Lord the LORD helps Me. Who can say I am guilty? Look, all My enemies will wear out like old clothes. Moths will eat them.
Who among you fears the LORD and listens to His servant? If you walk in the dark with no light, trust in the name of the LORD. Lean on your God.
Look, all of you start fires and light torches. Walk in the light of your fire. Walk by the torches you made. But this is what you get from Me: you will lie down in pain.
Listen to Me, you who want to do right. You look for the the LORD. Look at the rock you were cut from. Look at the stone pit you were dug from.
Look at Abraham, your father. Look at Sarah, who gave birth to you. I called him when he was just one man. Then I blessed him and gave him many children.

The LORD will comfort Zion. He will fix all her broken places. He will make her dry land like Eden. He will make her desert like the the LORD's garden. People will find joy and gladness there. They will sing songs of thanks.
Listen to Me, My people. Pay attention to Me, My nation. My teaching will come from Me. My right way will be a light for all people. I will do it soon.
My right way is near. My help has already gone out. My arms will judge the people. The far islands wait for Me. They hope in My strong arm.

Look up at the sky. Look down at the earth. The sky will fade like smoke. The earth will wear out like old clothes. The people on it will die. But My help will last forever. My right way will never fail.
Listen to Me, you who know what is right. You people have My teaching in your hearts. Don't fear people's mean words. Don't be crushed by their insults.
Moths will eat them up like clothes. Worms will eat them like wool. But My right way will last forever. My help will last for all time.
Wake up! Wake up! Put on strength, arm of the the LORD! Wake up like in the old days, long ago. Was it not You who cut the sea monster Rahab into pieces? Was it not You who killed the dragon?
Was it not You who dried up the sea? Was it not You who made a road in the deep water so saved people could cross?
The people the the LORD saved will come back. They will enter Zion singing. They will have joy that lasts forever. Gladness and joy will catch up to them. Sadness and sighing will run away.
"I, yes I, am the One who comforts you. Why are you afraid of people who die? Why are you afraid of people who fade like grass?"

"You have forgotten the the LORD, your Maker. He stretched out the sky and laid the earth's foundations. You are scared all day because of angry, mean people, as if they will destroy you. But where is their anger now?"
"The prisoner will soon be free. He will not die in the dark hole. He will not run out of bread.
"I am the the LORD, your God. I stir up the sea so its waves roar. The LORD of Heaven's Armies is My name.
"I put My words in your mouth. I cover you with the shadow of My hand. I made the sky and the earth. I say to Zion, 'You are My people.'"
Wake up! Wake up! Stand up, Jerusalem. You drank from the the LORD's hand. You drank the cup of His anger. You drank every drop of the cup that makes people stumble.
Of all the sons she raised, none leads her. Of all the sons she grew up, none holds her hand.
Two troubles have hit you. Who will feel sorry for you? Ruin and destruction, hunger and war. Who will comfort you?
Your sons are weak. They lie at the head of every street, like animals caught in a net. They are full of the the LORD's anger. Your God has spoken strongly against them.
So listen to this, you who are hurt and dizzy, but not from wine.
This is what your Lord, the the LORD, says: "See, I have taken the cup that makes people stumble from your hand. From that cup, the cup of My anger, you will never drink again.
"I will put it in the hands of the people who hurt you. They told you to bow down so they could walk over you. You let them walk all over you, like dirt on the ground."
Wake up, wake up! Put on your strength, O Zion! Put on your beautiful clothes, O Jerusalem, the holy city. People who are not part of God's people and are not clean will not come in to you anymore.
Shake off your dust. Get up and sit on your throne, O Jerusalem. Take off the chains around your neck, O captive people of Zion.
For this is what the LORD says: "You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be set free."
For this is what the Lord the LORD says: "At first My people went down to Egypt to live; then Assyria hurt them."
"And now what do I have here?" says the LORD. "My people were taken away for nothing, and those who rule them laugh at Me," says the LORD. "And all day long people say bad things about My name.
So My people will know My name. So on that day they will know that I am the one who speaks. Here I am."
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who tell of peace, who bring good news of good things, who tell of being saved! They say to Zion, "Your God is king!"
Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices. Together they sing for joy. For everyone will see with their own eyes when the LORD comes back to Zion.
Burst out in joy and sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has set Jerusalem free.
The LORD has shown His holy power to all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see how our God saves.
Go away, go away! Come out from there! Do not touch anything unclean! Come out from her! Clean yourselves, you who carry the things of the LORD.
For you will not leave in a hurry, and you will not run away. For the LORD will go in front of you, and the God of Israel will guard your back.
Look! My Servant will do well. He will be raised up and lifted high. He will be very great.
Just as many people were shocked at You, His face was hurt more than any man's, and His looks were worse than other people.
So He will make many nations clean, and kings will close their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they were not told, and they will understand what they did not hear.
Who believed our news? Who saw the LORD's power?
He grew up like a young plant. He was like a root in dry ground. He had no beauty to make us look at Him. We did not want Him.
People did not like Him. They turned away from Him. He was a man full of pain. He knew sickness. People hid their faces from Him. We thought He was not worth much.
But He took our sickness. He carried our pain. We thought God was punishing Him.
He was hurt for our wrongs. He was crushed for our sins. He took our punishment so we could have peace. His cuts healed us.
We all went the wrong way, like sheep. Each of us went his own way. The LORD put all our sin on Him.
He was treated badly and hurt, but He did not say a word. He was led like a sheep to be killed. He was like a sheep that is quiet when its wool is cut. He did not open His mouth.
He was taken away by force and judged unfairly. Who cared about His people? He was taken from the living. He was hurt for the sins of My people.
They put Him in a grave with bad people. But He was with a rich man when He died. He had not done wrong. He had not lied.
The LORD wanted to crush Him and let Him suffer. If He gives His life for sin, He will see His children. He will live a long time. The LORD's plan will win.
He will see the hard work of His life and be satisfied. Because He knows what is right, My Servant will make many people right. He will carry their sins.

So I will give Him a great place with many people. He will share the good things He wins. He poured out His life to death. He was counted with bad people. He carried the sin of many. He asks God to forgive them.
"Sing, you woman with no children. Shout for joy! You never gave birth. But you will have more children than a married woman," says the LORD.
"Make your tent bigger. Stretch out the curtains of your home. Do not hold back. Make your ropes long, and make your tent stakes strong.
You will spread out to the right and to the left. Your children will take over other nations. They will live in empty cities.
"Do not be afraid. You will not be put to shame. Do not be scared. You will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of when you were young. You will not remember the shame of being a widow.
"Your Maker is your husband. The LORD of Armies is His name. The Holy One of Israel saves you. He is called the God of the whole earth.
The LORD called you back, like a wife left alone and sad in spirit, like a young wife who was sent away," says your God.
"For a short time I left you, but with great kindness I will bring you back.
In anger I turned away from you for a moment, but with love that lasts forever I will be kind to you," says the LORD, your Savior.
"To Me, this is like the days of Noah. I promised that Noah's flood would never cover the earth again. In the same way, I promise I will not be angry with you or scold you.
Even if the mountains move and the hills shake, My love for you will not leave. My promise of peace will not be broken," says the LORD, who is kind to you.
"You are a city hurt by storms and with no comfort. But I will build you with pretty stones. I will set your base with sapphires.
I will make your towers shine like red jewels. I will make your gates from sparkling stones. All your walls will be made of precious stones.
"All your children will be taught by the LORD. They will have great peace.
You will stand firm in what is right. You will be far from those who hurt you, so you will not be afraid. You will be far from fear, and it will not come near you.
"If anyone fights against you, it is not from Me. Whoever fights you will fall in front of you.
Look, I made the worker who blows on the coals to make weapons. I also made the one who destroys to ruin things.
"No weapon made against you will succeed. You will prove wrong every voice that accuses you. This is what the LORD's servants receive. I am the one who makes them right," declares the LORD.
“Come, all you who are thirsty! Come to the water. And you who have no money, come buy food and eat. Come buy wine and milk. You do not need money.
Why spend money on food that is not real bread? Why work so hard for things that do not fill you? Listen to Me. Eat good food. Let your soul be happy with plenty.
Listen to Me. Come to Me. Hear Me, and your soul will live. I will make a lasting promise with you. It is the kind love I promised David.
I made him a witness to the nations. He is a leader and commander for them.
You will call people you do not know. Nations that do not know you will run to you. This is because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel. He has made you great.”
Look for the LORD while He can be found. Call to Him while He is near.
Bad people should leave their bad ways. People with wrong thoughts should stop them. They should come back to the LORD. He will be kind to them. Come back to our God. He will forgive much.
“For My thoughts are not like your thoughts. Your ways are not like My ways,” says the LORD.
“For the sky is higher than the earth. In the same way, My ways are higher than your ways. My thoughts are higher than your thoughts.
Rain and snow come down from the sky. They do not go back up until they water the earth. They help plants grow. They give seed to the farmer and bread to the eater.
In the same way, My word goes out from My mouth. It will not come back empty. It will do what I want. It will succeed in what I sent it to do.
You will go out with joy. You will be led out in peace. The mountains and hills will sing before you. All the trees in the field will clap their hands.
Thorn bushes will become cypress trees. Weedy bushes will become myrtle trees. This will bring honor to the LORD. It will be a lasting sign that will not be cut off.”
This is what the LORD says: "Keep what is right and do what is fair. My saving help is coming soon. My right way will soon be seen."
Happy is the person who does this. Happy is the one who holds on to it. He keeps the Sabbath day and does not ruin it. He keeps his hands from doing bad.
A person from another land who joins the LORD must not say, "The LORD will keep me out of His people." A man who cannot have children must not say, "I can never have children."
This is what the LORD says to the men who cannot have children: "If you keep My Sabbath days, choose what pleases Me, and hold on to My agreement,
I will give you a home in My house and a place inside My walls. I will give you a name better than sons and daughters. Your name will last forever.
Foreigners who join the LORD to serve Him, to love His name, and to be His servants must keep the Sabbath and not ruin it. They must hold on to My agreement.

I will bring them to My holy hill. I will make them happy in My house of prayer. The gifts they burn on the altar and their other gifts will be accepted. My house will be called a house of prayer for all people."
The Lord, the LORD, says this. He gathers the people of Israel who were sent away. He says, "I will gather even more people to them."
Come, all you wild animals of the field. Come and eat. Come, all you wild animals of the forest. Come and eat.
Israel's guards are blind. They know nothing. They are like dogs that cannot bark. They lie down and dream. They like to sleep.
They are dogs with big appetites. They never have enough. They are shepherds who do not understand. They all go their own way. Each one wants more for himself.
They say, "Come, let us get wine. Let us drink strong drink. Tomorrow will be just like today, but even better."
Good people die, and no one cares. Good people are taken away, and no one knows this keeps them safe from bad times.
People who live right will have peace. They will rest when they lie down.
But you, who use magic, come here. You children of people who cheat in marriage and sell their bodies.
Who are you making fun of? Who do you open your mouth at and stick out your tongue at? Are you not children who do wrong? Are you not from a family of lies?
You burn with desire among the oak trees and under every green tree. You kill children in the valleys and in the cracks of the rocks.
Your share is with the smooth stones in the stream. They are your lot. You poured out drink offerings to them. You brought grain offerings to them. Should this make Me feel better?
You set up your bed on a high and tall mountain. You went up there to make sacrifices.
Behind your door and door frame you put your sign. You showed your bed to Me. You went up and made your bed wide. You made a deal with them. You loved their bed. You looked at their naked bodies.
You went to the king with oil. You made more perfumes. You sent your messengers far away. You lowered yourself down to the grave.
You got tired from going your many ways, but you did not say, "I give up." You found new strength, so you did not get weak.
Who did you worry about and fear, so you lied? You did not remember Me. You did not take it to heart. Have I not been quiet for a long time? And you do not fear Me.
I will tell about your right ways and your works, but they will not help you.
When you cry for help, let the things you gathered save you. The wind will carry them all away. A breath will take them. But the one who trusts in Me will get the land. He will own My holy mountain.
And it will be said, "Build up, build up. Make the road clear. Take the blocks out of the way of My people."

For this is what the One who is high and lifted up says. He lives forever. His name is Holy. He says, "I live in a high and holy place. I also live with the one who is sorry and humble in spirit. I give new life to humble people. I give new life to sorry people."
For I will not stay mad forever. I will not be angry all the time. A person's spirit would grow weak before Me. The breath of life I made would fail.
I was angry because of his sinful greed. I hit him and hid My face. I was angry, but he kept going his own way.
I have seen his ways, but I will heal him. I will guide him and bring comfort to him and to those who cry for him.
I will put praise on their lips: "Peace, peace to those far away and to those near," says the the LORD. "And I will heal them."
But bad people are like the sea that cannot rest. Its water keeps tossing. It throws up mud and dirt.
"There is no peace," says My God, "for bad people."
Shout out loud. Don't hold back. Lift your voice like a horn. Tell My people they have turned away. Tell Jacob's family they have done wrong.
They look for Me every day. They say they want to know My ways. They act like people who do what is right and do not leave God's rules. They ask Me for fair choices. They want to be close to God.
They say, "Why did we skip meals and You didn't see? Why did we go hungry and You didn't care?" But look! On your fast day, you do what you like. You make your workers work too hard.
Look, you skip meals so you can argue and fight. You even hit people with angry fists. That is not the kind of fasting that makes God hear you.
Is this the fast I want? A day when a person hurts himself? Should he bow his head like a bent reed and lie on rough cloth and ashes? Do you call that a fast, a day the LORD likes?
No, this is the fast I want: open the chains of wrong. Untie the heavy ropes. Set free people who are pushed down. Break every heavy load.
Share your bread with hungry people. Bring poor people with no home into your house. Give clothes to people with none. Don't turn away from your own family.
Then your light will shine like morning. You will get well fast. Doing right will lead you. The glory of the LORD will guard you.

Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and He will say, "Here I am." But you must stop putting heavy loads on people. Stop pointing fingers. Stop saying empty, mean things.
If you give food to hungry people and help those who are hurting, then your light will shine in the dark. Your darkest times will be like noon.
The LORD will always lead you. He will fill you up in dry places. He will make your bones strong. You will be like a garden with water. You will be like a spring whose water never stops.
Your people will rebuild old ruins. You will raise up old foundations. People will call you the one who fixes broken walls and the one who makes paths good to live on.

If you stop doing your own thing on the Sabbath, call the Sabbath a joy, honor the holy day of the LORD, and honor Him by not going your own way, not doing what you want, and not just talking your own words.
Then you will find joy in the LORD. I will make you ride high on the earth. I will feed you with the land your father Jacob was given. The LORD has spoken.
The LORD is strong enough to save us. He can hear us.
But your sins have put a wall between you and your God. Your wrongs have made Him turn away, so He will not hear you.
Your hands are stained with blood. Your fingers are stained with sin. Your lips tell lies. Your tongue speaks bad things.
No one asks for what is right. No one is fair and true. People trust in empty things and tell lies. They plan trouble and cause harm.
They hatch snake eggs and weave spider webs. If someone eats one of their eggs, he dies. If an egg is crushed, a snake comes out.
Their webs will not become clothes. They cannot cover themselves with what they do. What they do is wrong. They use their hands to hurt people.
Their feet run to do bad things. They hurry to kill innocent people. Their thoughts are full of wrong. They leave ruin and trouble behind them.
They do not know how to live in peace. What they do is not fair. They make twisted paths. No one who walks on them finds peace.
So what is fair is far from us. Right living does not reach us. We wait for light, but we see only dark. We look for bright light, but we walk in deep dark.
We feel along the wall like blind people. We feel around like we have no eyes. We trip at noon like it is night. We are like dead people in empty places.
We all growl like bears. We moan like doves. We look for what is fair, but there is none. We look for God to save us, but He is far away.
Our wrongs are many before you. Our sins speak against us. We know our wrongs. Our sins stay with us.
We turned against the LORD and lied. We turned away from our God. We talk about hurting people and turning away. We plan lies in our hearts and speak them.
So what is fair is pushed back. Right living stands far away. Truth has fallen in the street. What is right cannot get in.
Truth is gone. Anyone who stops doing wrong gets robbed. The LORD saw this. It was bad in His eyes, because nothing was fair.
He saw there was no one to help. He was amazed that no one stepped in. So His own power saved Him. His right living held Him up.
He put on right living like armor. He put a helmet of saving power on His head. He wore clothes of payback. He wrapped Himself in strong love for what is right.
He will pay back each person for what they do. He will be angry with those who fight Him. He will pay back His enemies, even faraway lands.
People in the west and east will fear the LORD's name. They will see His glory. When the enemy comes like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will stand against him.
The one who sets people free will come to Zion. He will come to those in Jacob who turn from sin, says the LORD.

The LORD says, "This is My promise to them. My Spirit is on you. My words are in your mouth. They will not leave your mouth, or your children's mouths, or your grandchildren's mouths, from now on and forever."
Get up and shine, because your light has come. The LORD's glory rises on you.
Darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness covers the nations. But the LORD will rise on you, and His glory will shine over you.
Nations will come to your light. Kings will come to the bright light of your new day.
Look up and see. People gather all around and come to you. Your sons come from far away, and your daughters are carried home.
Then you will see and shine with joy. Your heart will pound and grow big with happiness. The riches of the sea will come to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.
Camels in long lines will cover your land. Young camels from Midian and Ephah will come. All of them come from Sheba. They carry gold and sweet incense. They tell of the LORD's praise.
All the sheep of Kedar will gather to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will go up on My altar and be accepted. I will honor My beautiful house.
Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves flying home?

The far islands wait for Me. The ships of Tarshish come first. They bring your sons from far away. They bring silver and gold. They come for the name of the LORD your God and for the Holy One of Israel, because He has honored you.
People from other lands will build your walls. Their kings will serve you. I hit you in anger, but now I show you kindness.
Your gates will always be open. They will not close day or night. The wealth of the nations will come in. Their kings will be led to you.
Any nation or kingdom that will not serve you will be lost. It will be completely destroyed.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you. The cypress, elm, and boxwood trees will come together. They will make My holy place beautiful. I will honor the place where I rest My feet.
The sons of the people who hurt you will come and bow to you. All who looked down on you will fall facedown at your feet. They will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
Even though you were left alone and hated, with no one passing by, I will make you a lasting pride. You will be a joy for every generation.
You will be fed by the nations and their kings. Then you will know that I am the LORD your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

Instead of bronze, I will bring gold. Instead of iron, I will bring silver. Instead of wood, I will bring bronze. Instead of stones, I will bring iron. I will make your leaders bring peace. I will make your rulers do right.
No more will people hear about fighting or breaking in your land. No more will they hear about ruin inside your borders. You will call your walls Salvation. You will call your gates Praise.
The sun will not be your light by day. The moon will not shine on you by night. The LORD will be your light forever. Your God will be your beauty.
Your sun will not go down. Your moon will not fade away. The LORD will be your light forever. The days of your sadness will end.
Then all your people will do right. They will own the land forever. They are the branch I planted. They are the work of My hands, to show My glory.
The smallest one will become a thousand. The little one will become a strong nation. I am the LORD. I will make it happen fast when the time is right.

The Spirit of the Lord, the LORD, is on me. the LORD has chosen me to bring good news to poor people. He sent me to help people whose hearts are broken. He sent me to tell people in chains that they are free. He sent me to open the prison for people locked up.
He sent me to tell about the year of the LORD's favor. He sent me to tell about the day when our God will punish His enemies. He sent me to comfort everyone who is sad.

He sent me to help sad people in Zion. I will give them a beautiful crown instead of ashes. I will give them oil that brings joy instead of sadness. I will give them clothes of praise instead of a sad spirit. People will call them strong trees of what is right. They are plants the LORD grew to show His glory.
They will build up old ruins. They will make broken places new again. They will make cities new again that have been empty for many years.
Strangers will stand and take care of your sheep. People from other lands will work in your fields and grape fields.
People will call you priests of the LORD. People will say you serve our God. You will eat the riches of other nations. You will enjoy their wealth.

Instead of your shame, you will get twice as much. Instead of being disgraced, they will be happy with what they receive. So they will own twice as much in their land, and they will have joy that lasts forever.
For I, the LORD, love what is right. I hate stealing and wrong. I will be faithful to them. I will reward them for their work, and I will make a promise with them that lasts forever.
People in other nations will know their children. People everywhere will know their families. Everyone who sees them will know that they are people the LORD has blessed.

I am very happy in the LORD. My heart is glad in my God. He has dressed me in clothes of salvation. He has put a robe of what is right on me. He made me look like a groom with a priest's head covering. He made me look like a bride wearing her jewels.
Just as the ground grows plants, and a garden makes seeds grow, so the Lord, the LORD, will make what is right and praise grow in front of all nations.

For the good of Zion, I will not be quiet. For the good of Jerusalem, I will not rest. I will keep talking until her goodness shines like the morning. I will keep talking until her rescue burns like a bright torch.
Other nations will see your goodness. All kings will see your honor. You will get a new name. The LORD will give it to you.
You will be a beautiful crown in the LORD’s hand. You will be a royal crown in your God’s hand.

People will not call you Left Alone anymore. They will not call your land Empty anymore. Instead, they will call you My Delight. They will call your land Married. This is because the LORD is happy with you. He will take your land as His own.
A young man marries a young woman. In the same way, your sons will marry you. A groom is very happy with his bride. In the same way, your God will be very happy with you.
Jerusalem, I put guards on your walls. They watch day and night. They never stop. You people who pray to the LORD, do not rest.
Do not let Him rest until He makes Jerusalem strong. Do not let Him rest until He makes the whole world praise her.

The LORD made a strong promise by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “I will never again give your grain to your enemies for food. People from other lands will not drink the new wine you worked hard to make.
The people who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD. The people who gather it will drink it in My holy place.”
Go out! Go out through the gates! Make a road for the people! Build up the road! Build it up! Clear the stones away! Lift up a flag for all nations!
Look! The LORD has spoken to the whole world. He says, “Tell Daughter Zion: Your rescue is coming. His reward is with Him. His pay goes before Him.”
They will be called the Holy People. They are the ones the LORD set free. You will be called Looked For. You are a city that is not left alone.
Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with red-stained clothes? Who is this dressed in glory, walking in His great strength? “It is I. I speak what is right. I can save.”
Why are Your clothes red? Why do Your robes look like someone who stomped grapes in a wine press?
“I stomped the grapes alone. No one from the nations helped Me. I trampled them in My anger. I crushed them in My fierce anger. Their blood splashed on My clothes. I stained all My robes.
I had a day of punishment in My heart. The time to rescue had come.
I looked, and no one helped. I was shocked that no one stood by Me. So My own power saved Me. My anger held Me up.
I trampled the nations in My anger. In My wrath I made them stumble, and I spilled their blood on the ground.”
I will remember the LORD's faithful love. I will praise Him for all He has done for us. He has done many good things for Israel's family. He did them because of His mercy and His great love.
He said, “They are truly My people. They are children who will not lie.” So He became their Savior.
In all their trouble, He was troubled too. The Angel of His Presence saved them. Because of His love and mercy, He rescued them. He lifted them up and carried them through all the old days.
But they rebelled. They made His Holy Spirit sad. So He turned against them and became their enemy. He fought against them Himself.

Then His people remembered the old days, the days of Moses. They asked, “Where is the One who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who put His Holy Spirit among them, who sent His glorious power to lead them by Moses' right hand, who split the waters before them to make a name for Himself forever, who led them through the deep like a horse in the desert, so they did not stumble?”
Like cattle going down into a valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make a glorious name for Yourself.
Look down from heaven and see. Look from Your holy home, high and glorious. Where is Your strong love? Where is Your power? Why do You hold back Your mercy and kindness from me?
But You are our Father. Abraham does not know us. Israel does not recognize us. You, O the LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from long ago is Your name.
Why, O the LORD, do You let us wander from Your ways? Why do You make our hearts hard so we do not fear You? Come back for Your servants, the tribes You chose to be Yours.
For a little while Your people had Your holy place. But our enemies trampled Your holy place.
We have become like people You never ruled. We are like people not called by Your name.
If only You would tear open the sky and come down! Then the mountains would shake before You.
It would be like fire that burns dry wood. It would be like fire that makes water boil. You would make Your name known to Your enemies. People in other countries would be scared before You.
You did amazing things we did not expect. You came down, and the mountains shook before You.
No one has ever heard this. No ear has ever heard it. No eye has ever seen a God like You. You help those who wait for You.
You welcome people who are happy to do what is right. You welcome people who remember Your ways. You were angry, and we sinned. We have kept on sinning. Can we be saved?
We are all sinful. Even the good things we do are like dirty clothes. We all fade like a leaf. Our sins carry us away like the wind.
No one calls out to You. No one tries to hold on to You. You turned away from us. Our sins have worn us out.
But now, the LORD, You are our Father. We are the clay. You made us. We are all the work of Your hands.
Do not be too angry, the LORD. Do not remember our sins forever. Look at us. We are all Your people.
Your holy cities have become empty land. Zion is empty land. Jerusalem is ruined.
Our holy and lovely house has been burned by fire. Our fathers praised You there. All our nice things are ruined.
After all this, the LORD, will You hold back? Will You stay quiet and punish us so much?
I showed Myself to people who did not ask for Me. People who did not look for Me found Me. I said to a nation that did not call My name, "Here I am! Here I am!"
All day I held out My hands to stubborn people. They walked in bad ways. They followed their own bad plans.
These people always made Me angry right in front of Me. They killed animals in gardens. They burned sweet smoke on brick altars.
They sat among graves. They stayed in secret places at night. They ate pig meat. Their pots held soup made from bad meat.
They said, "Stay away! Do not come near me, because I am too holy for you!" These people are like smoke in My nose. They are like a fire that burns all day.
Look, it is written in front of Me. I will not be quiet. I will pay them back. I will pay them back in full.
You and your fathers have sinned together," says the the LORD. "They burned sweet smoke on mountains. They insulted Me on hills. So I will pay them back in full for their old bad deeds.

This is what the the LORD says: "When juice is still found in a bunch of grapes, people say not to destroy it, because there is still some good in it. In the same way, I will help My servants. I will not destroy them all."
I will bring children from Jacob. From Judah, I will bring people to take My mountains. My chosen people will take them. My servants will live there.
Sharon will become a place for sheep. The Valley of Achor will be a place for cows to rest. This is for My people who looked for Me.
But you who leave the the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for the god called Fortune and fill cups with wine for the god called Destiny,
I will let the sword get you. All of you will bow down to be killed. I called, but you did not answer. I spoke, but you did not listen. You did bad things in My eyes. You chose what I did not like.
So the Lord the LORD says: "My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. My servants will be happy, but you will be ashamed."
My servants will sing for joy from a glad heart. But you will cry from a sad heart. You will wail with a broken spirit.
You will leave your name behind as a curse for My chosen people. The Lord the LORD will put you to death. But He will give His servants a new name.

Anyone who asks for a blessing in the land will bless by the God of truth. Anyone who makes a promise in the land will promise by the God of truth. This is because the old troubles will be forgotten. They will be hidden from My eyes.
Look, I will make new heavens and a new earth. The old things will not be remembered. They will not come to mind.
But be glad and rejoice forever in what I make. I will make Jerusalem a joy. Its people will be a delight.
I will be glad over Jerusalem. I will rejoice over My people. No one will hear crying or loud sobbing there anymore.
No baby will live only a few days. No old person will die before a full life. A young person who dies will be one hundred years old. A bad person who lives to one hundred will be cursed.
They will build houses and live in them. They will plant grape gardens and eat their fruit.
They will not build for others to live in. They will not plant for others to eat. My people will live as long as a tree. My chosen people will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
They will not work for nothing. They will not have children doomed to trouble. They will be people blessed by the the LORD. Their children will be with them.
Before they call, I will answer. While they are still talking, I will hear.
"The wolf and the lamb will eat together. The lion will eat straw like the cow. The snake will eat dust. They will not hurt or destroy on all My holy mountain," says the the LORD.
The LORD says this: Heaven is My throne. The earth is where I rest My feet. What house will you build for Me? Where will I rest?
My hand made all these things. So they came to be, says the the LORD. But I look to the poor, to the one who is sad in spirit, and who shakes at My word.

A person who kills a bull is like one who kills a man. A person who gives a lamb is like one who breaks a dog's neck. A person who brings a grain gift is like one who brings pig's blood. A person who burns sweet smoke is like one who blesses a false god. They chose their own ways. Their hearts enjoy their bad things.
So I will choose their punishment. I will bring the things they fear. I called, but no one answered. I spoke, but they did not listen. They did evil in My eyes. They chose what I did not want.

Listen to the word of the the LORD, you who shake at His word. Your brothers hate you and push you away because of My name. They say, "Let the the LORD be honored, so we can see your joy." But they will be put to shame.
A loud noise comes from the city! A sound comes from the temple! It is the the LORD paying back His enemies.
Before she was in pain, she had a baby. Before the pain came, she gave birth to a boy.
Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Can a land be born in one day? Can a whole nation be born in one moment? Yet Zion had pain and gave birth to her children.
Would I bring pain and not let the baby come? says the the LORD. Would I, who helps birth, close the womb? says your God.
Be happy with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all who love her. Be very happy with her, all who cry for her.
So you may drink milk and be full from her comfort. So you may drink deeply and enjoy her glory.

For the the LORD says this: I will give her peace like a river. I will give her the glory of the nations like a flooding stream. You will drink milk. You will be carried on her hip and bounced on her knees.
As a man is comforted by his mother, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.
You will see this. Your heart will be glad. Your bones will grow strong like grass. The hand of the the LORD will be known to His servants. He will be angry with His enemies.
For the the LORD will come in fire. His war carts will come like a windstorm. He will pay back His anger with fury. He will speak strong words with flames of fire.
For the the LORD will judge all people with fire and with His sword. Many will be killed by the the LORD.
Those who make themselves holy and clean themselves to go into gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig meat, bad things, and mice, will end together, says the the LORD.
I know their works and their thoughts. It is time to gather all nations and all languages. They will come and see My glory.

I will put a sign among them. I will send some who are left to the nations: Tarshish, Pul, Lud (those who pull the bow), Tubal, Javan, and the far islands that have not heard of Me or seen My glory. They will tell My glory among the nations.

They will bring all your brothers from all nations as a gift to the the LORD. They will come on horses, in carts, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to My holy hill in Jerusalem, says the the LORD. It will be like when the people of Israel bring a clean gift to the the LORD's house.
And I will take some of them to be priests and Levites, says the the LORD.
For as the new heavens and the new earth that I make will stay before Me, says the the LORD, so your children and your name will stay.
From new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all people will come to bow down before Me, says the the LORD.
They will go out and see the dead bodies of the men who turned against Me. Their worms will not die. Their fire will not go out. They will be hated by all people.
These are the words of Jeremiah. He was the son of Hilkiah. He was one of the priests who lived in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin.
The word of the LORD came to him. This was in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah. It was in the thirteenth year of his rule.

It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah. It came until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah. That was when Jerusalem was taken away in the fifth month.
The word of the LORD came to me. He said, "
Before you were born, I knew you. Before you came into the world, I made you special. I chose you to be a prophet to the nations."
"Ah, Lord, the LORD!" I said. "I do not know how to speak. I am too young."
The LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am too young.' You must go to everyone I send you to. You must say everything I tell you.
Do not be afraid of them. I am with you, and I will rescue you," says the LORD.
Then the LORD stretched out His hand and touched my mouth. He said to me, "See, I have put My words in your mouth.
Today I put you in charge of nations and kingdoms. You will pull up and tear down. You will destroy and knock down. You will build and plant."
The word of the LORD came to me. He said, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "I see a branch from an almond tree," I said.
The LORD said to me, "You have seen right. I am watching to make sure My word comes true."
The word of the LORD came to me again. He said, "What do you see?" "I see a pot of boiling water," I said. "It is tilting away from the north."
The LORD said to me, "From the north, trouble will come to all who live in this land.
I am calling all the families and kingdoms of the north. Their kings will come and set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem. They will come against all its walls and all the cities of Judah."
The LORD said, "I will judge them for all their wrongs. They left Me and worshiped other gods. They bowed down to things their hands made."
The LORD said to me, "Get ready now. Stand up and tell them everything I tell you to do. Do not be afraid of them. If you are, I will make you afraid in front of them."

The LORD said, "Today I have made you a strong city, an iron pillar, and walls of bronze. You will stand against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, its leaders, its priests, and the people of the land."
"They will fight you, but they will not win. I am with you, and I will rescue you," says the LORD.
The word of the the LORD came to me. He said,

“Go and tell Jerusalem this: The LORD says, ‘I remember how kind you were when you were young. I remember how you loved Me when you were My bride. You followed Me into the desert, into a land where no one plants.’”
“Israel was special to the LORD. Israel was the first part of His harvest. Anyone who hurt Israel had to pay. Trouble came to them,” says the LORD.
Hear the word of the LORD, family of Jacob. Hear it, all the families of Israel.
The LORD says, “What wrong did your fathers find in Me? Why did they go far from Me? They followed worthless things and became worthless.”
They did not ask, “Where is the LORD? He brought us up from Egypt. He led us through the desert, through a dry and dark land, through a land where no one lives and no one walks.”
“I brought you into a good land to eat its fruit and its good things. But you came and made My land dirty. You made the gift I gave you into something awful.”
The priests did not ask, “Where is the LORD?” The men who knew God’s law did not know Me. The leaders turned against Me. The prophets spoke for Baal. They followed things that do not help.
“So I will still bring charges against you,” says the LORD. “I will bring charges against your children and your grandchildren.
Go across the sea to the lands of Kittim and look. Send to Kedar and look hard. See if anything like this has ever happened.”
Has a nation ever changed its gods? They are not even real gods. But My people traded the honor I gave them for something useless.
“Be shocked at this, you heavens. Be very afraid and be ruined,” says the LORD.
“My people did two bad things. They left Me, the source of living water. They dug broken wells that cannot hold water.”
Is Israel a slave? Was he born a slave? Why has he been robbed?
Young lions roar at him. They raise their voices. They make his land empty. His cities are burned. No one lives there.
The people of Noph and Tahpanhes will hurt you and shame you.
“Have you not brought this on yourself? You left the LORD your God when He led you in the way.”
“What do you gain by going to Egypt to drink the water of the Nile? What do you gain by going to Assyria to drink the water of the Euphrates?”
“Your own bad choices will punish you. Your turning away will correct you. Know and see that it is bad and bitter to leave the LORD your God. You do not fear Me,” says the Lord the LORD of armies.
“Long ago I took off your heavy load. I broke your chains. But you said, ‘I will not serve.’ On every high hill and under every green tree, you were not faithful to Me.”
“I planted you like a good grapevine. You were all true. How did you turn into a wild vine and become useless to Me?”
“Even if you wash with strong soap and use lots of cleaner, your guilt is still in front of Me,” says the Lord the LORD.
“How can you say, ‘I am not dirty. I did not follow the Baals’? Look at what you did in the valley. See what you have done. You are like a fast young camel running here and there.”
A wild donkey used to the desert sniffs the wind when she wants a mate. Who can turn her back? All who look for her will not get tired. They will find her when she is ready.
“Keep your feet from going bare. Keep your throat from getting dry. But you said, ‘It is no use. I love strangers, and I will follow them.’”
As a thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the family of Israel is ashamed. Their kings, leaders, priests, and prophets are ashamed too.
They say to a piece of wood, “You are my father.” They say to a stone, “You gave birth to me.” They turn their backs to Me, not their faces. But when trouble comes, they say, “Get up and save us!”
“Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them get up if they can save you when you are in trouble. You have as many gods as you have cities, Judah.”
“Why do you argue with Me? You have all turned against Me,” says the LORD.
“I hit your children for nothing. They did not learn. Your sword has eaten your prophets like a destroying lion.”
“You people, see the word of the LORD. Have I been a desert to Israel? Have I been a land of deep darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are free. We will not come to You anymore’?”
Does a young woman forget her jewelry? Does a bride forget her wedding clothes? But My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
“How well you get ready to look for love! Even bad women you have taught your ways.”
“On your clothes is found the blood of innocent poor people. You did not catch them breaking in. Yet you did all these things.”
“You say, ‘I am innocent. His anger has turned away from me.’ But I will judge you because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’”
“Why do you run around so much to change your way? You will be put to shame by Egypt, just as you were put to shame by Assyria.”
“You will also go out from there with your hands on your head. The LORD has turned away from those you trusted. You will not succeed with them.”

The LORD says, "If a man sends his wife away, and she leaves him and marries another man, would he take her back? Would that not make the land unclean? But you have been unfaithful with many lovers. Yet come back to Me.
Look up to the bare hills and see: where have you not been unfaithful? You sat by the roads waiting for lovers, like a traveler in the desert. You made the land dirty with your wrong ways.
So the rains did not come. But you have a stubborn, shameless face, like a woman who is not sorry. You refuse to feel ashamed.
Haven't you just called Me, 'my Father, You are the guide of my youth'?
Will He stay angry forever? Will He hold it against you always? You say things, but you keep doing wrong, and you get away with it."
In the days of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, "Have you seen what Israel, who left Me, has done? She went to every high hill and under every green tree, and she was unfaithful there.
I thought, 'After she does all this, she will come back to Me.' But she did not come back. Her sister Judah, who also broke faith, saw it.
I saw that Israel was unfaithful, so I sent her away and gave her a paper of divorce. But Judah, her sister, was not afraid. She also went and was unfaithful.
Because she treated it so lightly, she made the land dirty and worshiped stone and wood idols.
Even after all this, Judah did not come back to Me with all her heart. She only pretended, says the the LORD."
The LORD said to me, "Israel, who turned away, has been more right than Judah, who broke faith."
"Go and say these words to the north: 'Come back, Israel, who left Me, says the the LORD. I will not stay angry at you, because I am kind, says the the LORD. I will not be angry forever.
Just admit your guilt. You turned against the the LORD your God. You gave yourself to strangers under every green tree. You did not listen to Me, says the the LORD.'"
"Return, you children who turned away, says the the LORD, for I am your husband. I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and bring you to Zion.
I will give you leaders who care like I do. They will teach you what is right and help you understand.

When you grow and have many children in the land, in those days, says the the LORD, people will not talk about the box of the the LORD's promise anymore. They will not think about it or remember it or visit it. It will not be made again.
At that time, people will call Jerusalem the the LORD's throne. All nations will gather there to honor the the LORD's name. They will not follow their stubborn, evil hearts anymore.
In those days, Judah and Israel will walk together. They will come from the north to the land I gave your fathers."
"I thought, 'I want to treat you like sons and give you a beautiful land, the best land of all nations.' I thought, 'You will call Me, "my Father," and you will not turn away from Me.'
Just like a wife leaves her husband, you have left Me, Israel, says the the LORD."
A voice is heard on the hills. Israel's children are crying and begging, because they went the wrong way and forgot the the LORD their God.
"Come back, you children who turned away, and I will heal your turning away." "Here we are. We come to You, because You are the the LORD our God."
"It is no use to look to the hills for help. The The LORD our God is the one who saves Israel.
Shame has eaten up the things our fathers worked for since we were young: their sheep, cows, sons, and daughters.
We lie down in shame. Our shame covers us, because we and our fathers have sinned against the the LORD our God from our youth until today. We did not listen to the the LORD our God."
"If you come back, Israel, come back to Me," says the LORD. "If you take away your bad idols from My eyes and do not turn away.
If you promise that the LORD lives, with truth, fair choices, and right living, then other nations will be blessed by Him. They will praise Him."
This is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up your hard ground. Do not plant seeds among thorns.

Give yourselves to the LORD. Take away the stubborn part of your hearts, men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. If not, My anger will burst out like fire. It will burn, and no one will put it out. This is because of your bad deeds."
Tell Judah. Tell Jerusalem. Say, "Blow the horn in the land! Shout loud. Tell people to come together and run to the strong cities.
Lift a flag toward Zion. Find a safe place. Do not wait! I am bringing trouble from the north. It will be big trouble."
A lion has come up from his thick bushes. A destroyer of nations has left his home. He has left to ruin your land. Your cities will be broken. No one will live in them.
So put on rough cloth. Cry and wail. the LORD's hot anger has not turned away from us.
"On that day," says the LORD, "the king and leaders will lose heart. The priests will be shocked. The prophets will be amazed."
Then I said, "Oh, Lord, the LORD! You have tricked this people and Jerusalem. You said we would have peace, but we are in great danger."
At that time people will tell this people and Jerusalem that a hot wind from the bare hills in the desert blows toward My people. It is not to clean grain or make it ready.
A stronger wind than that comes from Me. Now I will also say how I will judge them.
Look! He comes up like clouds. His war carts are like a storm. His horses are faster than eagles. "Oh no! We are ruined!"
