They were afraid we might hit rocks. So they dropped four anchors from the back of the ship. They prayed for day to come.
Some sailors tried to escape from the ship. They pretended they were going to drop anchors from the front. They lowered the lifeboat into the sea.
Paul said to the officer and the soldiers, "If these men do not stay in the ship, you cannot be saved."
Then the soldiers cut the ropes of the lifeboat and let it fall.
Until day was about to come, Paul urged everyone to eat. He said, "Today is the fourteenth day you have waited and gone without food. You have eaten nothing.
So I urge you to eat. This will help save you. Not one hair from your head will be lost."
After he said this, he took bread. He gave thanks to God in front of everyone. He broke it and began to eat.
Then everyone felt better. They ate too.
There were 276 of us on the ship.
When they had eaten enough, they made the ship lighter. They threw the wheat into the sea.
When day came, they did not know the land. But they saw a bay with a beach. They planned to drive the ship onto it if they could.
They cut the anchors and left them in the sea. They untied the ropes of the rudders. They raised the front sail to the wind. They headed for the beach.
The ship hit a place where two seas meet. It ran aground. The front stuck fast and did not move. The back broke apart from the force of the waves.
The soldiers planned to kill the prisoners. They did not want anyone to swim away and escape.
But the officer wanted to save Paul. He stopped them. He told those who could swim to jump first and get to land.
The rest came on boards and pieces of the ship. In this way, everyone was saved and got to land.
After we were saved, we knew the island was called Malta.
The local people were very kind to us. They built a fire and welcomed all of us, because it was raining and cold.
Paul picked up a bundle of sticks and put them on the fire. A snake came out because of the heat and bit his hand.
When the local people saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, "This man must be a killer. He got out of the sea, but justice did not let him live."
But Paul shook the snake into the fire. He was not hurt.
They thought he would swell up or fall down dead. They waited and saw nothing bad happen to him. Then they changed their minds and said he was a god.
Near that place were fields owned by a man named Publius. He was the leader of the island. He welcomed us and took care of us for three days.
Publius's father was sick in bed with fever and stomach trouble. Paul went in, prayed, and put his hands on him. He healed him.
After that, the other sick people on the island came to Paul and were healed.
They honored us in many ways. When we were ready to sail, they gave us what we needed.
After three months, we sailed on a ship from Alexandria. It had stayed on the island for the winter. It had a picture of the twin gods on it.
We landed at Syracuse and stayed there three days.
From there we sailed along and came to Rhegium. The next day a south wind blew, and the second day we came to Puteoli.
There we found some Christian friends. They asked us to stay with them for seven days. After that we went to Rome.
The Christians in Rome heard about us. They came as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and felt brave.
When we got to Rome, Paul was allowed to live by himself, with a soldier to guard him.

Three days later, Paul called the Jewish leaders together. When they came, he said, "Brothers, I have done nothing against our people or our fathers' ways. But I was arrested in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
The Romans asked me questions. They wanted to let me go, because I had done nothing that deserved death.
But the Jewish leaders spoke against me. I had to ask to be tried by Caesar. I did not do this to accuse my own people.
That is why I asked to see you and talk with you. I am in chains because of the hope of Israel."
They said to him, "We have not received any letter about you from Judea. No Christian friend has come and said anything bad about you.
But we want to hear from you what you think. We know that everywhere people speak against this group."

They set a day. Many people came to Paul where he was staying. From morning until evening he told them about God's kingdom. He tried to convince them about Jesus, using the Law of Moses and the Prophets.
Some believed what he said. Others did not.
Paul said one thing: "The Holy Spirit spoke well to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet.
Isaiah said, 'Go to this people and say, You will hear but not understand. You will see but not know what you see.

For the hearts of these people are hard. They hear with difficulty. They have closed their eyes. This is so they will not see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, turn to God, and be healed.'
So let it be known to you that this salvation from God was sent to the people who are not Jews, and they will listen."
Paul stayed there two whole years in a house he rented. He welcomed everyone who came to him.
He preached God's kingdom with all boldness. No one stopped him. He taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
I am Paul. I serve Christ Jesus. God chose me to be His special messenger. He set me apart to share His good news.
God promised this good news long ago. He spoke through His prophets in the holy writings.
The good news is about His Son. He was born into David's family.
God showed that Jesus is His Son. He did this with power. Jesus rose from the dead. He is our Lord.
Through Jesus, God gave me His grace and this job. I help people in all nations obey God by trusting Him. This brings honor to Jesus' name.
You are among those people. God called you to belong to Jesus Christ.
I write to all of you in Rome. God loves you. He called you to be His holy people. May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you. People everywhere hear about your faith.
God knows I serve Him with my whole heart. I tell the good news about His Son. God is my witness. I pray for you all the time.
I always ask God to let me come to you. I want to come if it is God's will.
I really want to see you. I want to give you a gift from God's Spirit. It will make you strong.
Then we can help each other. Your faith and my faith can cheer us up.
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know something. I have wanted to come to you many times. But something stopped me. I wanted to help you grow, like I helped people in other nations.
I owe a debt to Greeks and to people who are not Greek. I owe it to wise people and to people who are not wise.
That is why I want to tell the good news to you in Rome.
I am not ashamed of the good news. It is God's power to save everyone who believes. He saves Jews first, and then Greeks.
The good news shows how God makes people right with Him. It starts with faith and grows into more faith. God's Word says, "The one who is right with God will live by faith."
God shows His anger from heaven. He is angry at all sin and wrong. People do wrong things. They hide the truth.
People can know about God. God showed it to them.
Since the world was made, people can see God's power. They can see that He is God. They see this in the things He made. So no one has an excuse.
They knew God. But they did not honor Him as God. They did not thank Him. Their thoughts became empty. Their foolish hearts became dark.
They said they were wise. But they became fools.
They traded the glory of the God who lives forever. They made fake gods that look like people, birds, animals, and small animals that crawl.
So God let them do what their hearts wanted. They did dirty things. They brought shame to their bodies.
They traded God's truth for a lie. They worshiped and served things God made. They did not worship the One who made everything. He is blessed forever! Amen.
So God let them follow bad desires. Even the women did things that are not natural.

The men did the same thing. They stopped being with women in the natural way. They burned with desire for other men. Men did shameful things with men. They got the punishment their wrong way deserved.
They did not want to know God. So God let them have a mind that does not work right. They did things they should not do.

They were full of all kinds of wrong. They were full of greed, hate, and mean ways. They wanted what others had. They killed. They fought. They lied. They were mean to people. They whispered bad things about others.
They talked bad about people. They hated God. They were rude and proud. They bragged. They made up new ways to do evil. They did not obey their parents.
They did not understand. They broke their promises. They had no love. They had no mercy.
They know God's rule. People who do these things deserve to die. But they still do them. They also cheer for others who do them.
You have no excuse, person. If you judge someone else, you judge yourself. You do the same things.
We know God's judgment is true for people who do these things.
So when you, a person, judge people who do these things but do them too, do you think you will get away from God's judgment? No.
Or do you look down on God's great kindness, patience, and waiting? Do you not know that His kindness leads you to change your heart?
But because of your hard heart that will not change, you are saving up anger for yourself. On the day God shows His fair judgment, His anger will come.
God will pay each person for what they do.
He will give life that never ends to people who keep doing good and want praise, respect, and a life that never ends.
But He will give anger and strong anger to people who only want their own way, who do not obey the truth, but obey what is wrong.
There will be trouble and pain for every person who does evil, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
But there will be praise, respect, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
All who sin without God's law will also be lost without the law. All who sin under God's law will be judged by the law.
It is not the people who hear the law who are right with God. The people who do the law will be called right.
When people who do not have God's law do by nature what the law says, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
They show that the work of the law is written in their hearts. Their inner voice also speaks up. Their thoughts either blame them or clear them.
This will happen on the day God judges the secret things of people through Jesus Christ. This is what my good news says.
Now you call yourself a Jew. You rest on the law. You brag about God.
You know what He wants. You can tell good from bad. You learn this from the law.
You think you are a guide for blind people, a light for people in the dark.
You think you are a teacher for foolish people and a teacher for little children. You have the law, which holds what is true and what to know.
So you teach other people, but do you teach yourself? You preach, "Do not steal," but do you steal?
You say, "Do not cheat with someone's wife or husband," but do you do it? You hate idols, but do you steal from temples?
You brag about the law, but do you shame God by breaking the law?
God's name is spoken badly among the nations because of you, just as it is written.
Being circumcised helps if you obey the law. But if you break the law, your circumcision becomes like not being circumcised.
If a person who is not circumcised keeps what the law says, will not his not being circumcised count as circumcision?
The person who is not circumcised in the body but obeys the law will judge you. You have the written law and circumcision, but you break the law.
A person is not a Jew just because he looks like one on the outside. True circumcision is not just on the skin.
A true Jew is one on the inside. True circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by written rules. That person's praise does not come from people. It comes from God.
What good is it to be a Jew? What good is being circumcised?
Much in every way! First, God gave the Jews His own words.
What if some Jews did not believe God? Does that make God not keep His promise?
No! God is always true, even if every person lies. The Bible says, “You are right when You speak. You win when You are judged.”
But if our bad ways show that God is good, what can we say? Is God wrong to be angry and punish? I am talking like a person.
No! If that were true, how could God judge the world?
But someone may say, “If my lie makes God's truth look great and brings Him praise, why am I still judged as a sinner?”
Why not say, as some people wrongly say we say, “Let us do bad so good can come”? They are wrong, and they deserve to be judged.
So what? Are we better than others? No! We already said that all people, Jews and non-Jews, are trapped by sin.
The Bible says, “No one is right with God, not even one.
No one understands. No one looks for God.
All have turned away. They have all become useless. No one does good, not even one.
Their throats are like open graves. Their tongues tell lies. Snake poison is on their lips.
Their mouths are full of curses and bitter words.
Their feet run fast to hurt people.
They leave ruin and pain wherever they go.
They do not know the way of peace.
We know that God's law speaks to those under the law. It stops every mouth. It shows that the whole world is guilty before God.
So no one will be made right with God by doing what the law says. The law shows us our sin.
But now God's way to be right with Him is shown without the law. The Law and the Prophets tell about it.
God makes people right with Him when they trust Jesus Christ. This is for everyone who believes. There is no difference between people.
For all people have sinned. All fall short of God's greatness.
But God makes them right with Him for free. He does this by His kindness. He sets them free through Christ Jesus.
God sent Jesus as the way to take away our sins. His blood paid for them. We receive this by faith. God did this to show He is right. In the past, God was patient and did not punish sins.
He did this to show He is right now. He is fair, and He makes right anyone who trusts Jesus.
So can anyone brag? No. Not because of a rule about doing good works. It is because of faith.
We believe that a person is made right with God by faith, not by doing what the law says.
Is God only the God of the Jews? Is He not also the God of other people? Yes, He is the God of other people too.
There is only one God. He will make Jews right with Him by faith. He will also make non-Jews right with Him by faith.
So do we throw away God's law because of faith? No! Instead, we show that the law matters.
So what can we say about Abraham, our father long ago? What did he find?
If Abraham was made right by the good things he did, he could brag. But he could not brag before God.
What does God's book say? It says, "Abraham trusted God. God counted that as being right with Him."
A worker gets pay. That pay is not a gift. It is owed.
But a person who does not work, and trusts God who makes bad people right, has faith. God counts that faith as being right with Him.
David says the same thing. He says God counts a person right without that person doing good works.
He said, "Happy are the people whose wrong ways are forgiven. Happy are the people whose sins are covered.
Happy is the man whose sin the LORD will never count against him."
Is this happy gift only for people who are circumcised? Or is it also for people who are not? We have been saying that Abraham's faith was counted as being right with God.
When was it counted? Was it after he was circumcised, or before? It was before he was circumcised, not after.

Abraham got the mark of circumcision. It was a sign that he was already right with God because of his faith. So he is the father of all who believe, even if they are not circumcised. God counts them right too.
He is also the father of people who are circumcised. But they must not only be circumcised. They must also follow the same faith our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.
God promised Abraham and his family that they would receive the world. This promise did not come through the law. It came through being right with God by faith.
If people who follow the law are the ones who get the promise, then faith means nothing. The promise would be empty.
The law brings God's anger. Where there is no law, there is no breaking of the law.

So the promise comes by faith. Then it is a free gift. It is sure for all of Abraham's family. It is not only for people who follow the law. It is also for people who have Abraham's faith. He is the father of us all.
It is written, "I have made you a father of many nations." Abraham is our father. He believed in God. God gives life to dead people. He calls things that are not here yet as if they are.
Abraham hoped when there was no hope. He believed God's words: "So shall your children be."
Abraham's faith did not get weak. He knew his body was almost dead. He was about one hundred years old. He knew Sarah could not have a baby.
But he did not doubt God's promise. His faith grew strong. He gave glory to God.
He was sure God could do what He promised.
That is why it was counted to him as being right with God.
The words "it was counted to him" were not written only for Abraham.
They were also written for us. God will count us right too, if we believe in Him. He raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
Jesus was handed over to die because of our sins. He was raised to life to make us right with God.
Since we are made right with God by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Through Him we can come to God by faith. We stand in His grace. We are glad because we hope to share God's glory.
We are glad in hard times too. We know hard times help us learn to wait and stay strong.
Staying strong builds good character. Good character gives us hope.
Hope does not let us down. God filled our hearts with His love by the Holy Spirit. God gave us that Spirit.
Christ died for people who do not follow God. He did this while we were still weak. He died at the right time.
It is hard for someone to die for a good person. Maybe someone would dare to die for a very good person.
But God shows His love for us. Christ died for us while we were still sinners.
Now we are made right by Christ's blood. So we will be saved from God's anger through Him.
We were God's enemies. But God brought us back to Him through His Son's death. Now we are friends with God. So we will be saved by Christ's life.
We are glad in God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Through Him we made friends with God.
Sin came into the world through one man. Death came because of sin. Death spread to all people because all people sinned.
Sin was in the world before the law came. But when there is no law, sin is not counted.
Still, death ruled from Adam to Moses. It ruled even over people whose sin was not like Adam's wrong choice. Adam points to the One who was coming.
God's free gift is not like Adam's wrong. Many died because of one man's wrong. But God's grace and free gift are much greater. They come through Jesus Christ. They help many people.
The free gift is not like the result of one sin. One sin brought God's judgment and punishment. But the free gift brings us right with God, even after many sins.
One man's wrong let death rule. But people who receive God's great grace and the free gift of being made right will rule in life. This is through Jesus Christ.
One wrong choice brought punishment to all people. One right choice brings life and makes all people right with God.
One man did not obey. So many people became sinners. One man obeyed. So many people will be made right.
The law came to show how much wrong there was. But where sin grew, God's grace grew even more.
Sin ruled and brought death. Now God's grace rules. It brings us right with God. It leads to life that never ends. This is through Jesus Christ our Lord.
What should we say? Should we keep on sinning so God's grace can grow?
No! We died to sin. How can we still live in it?
Don't you know this? All of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death.
So we were buried with Him through baptism into death. Christ was raised from the dead by the Father's glory. In the same way, we can live a new life.
If we have been joined to Him in His death, we will also be joined to Him when He rises.
We know our old self was nailed to the cross with Him. This was so the power of sin would be broken. Then we would not be slaves to sin.
Anyone who has died is free from sin.
If we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with Him.
We know Christ was raised from the dead. He will never die again. Death has no power over Him.
The death He died, He died to sin once for all. The life He lives, He lives to God.
In the same way, think of yourselves as dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
So don't let sin rule in your body that will die. Don't obey its wants.
Don't offer your body parts to sin as tools for wrong. Instead, offer yourselves to God as people alive from the dead. Offer your body parts to God as tools for right.
Sin will not rule you, because you are not under law but under grace.
What then? Should we sin because we are not under law but under grace? No!

Don't you know that when you offer yourselves to obey someone, you become slaves to the one you obey? You are slaves either to sin, which leads to death, or to obeying, which leads to being right with God.
Thank God! You used to be slaves to sin. But now you have obeyed from the heart the teaching you were given.
You were set free from sin and became slaves to doing right.
I am using human words because you are weak. Just as you once gave your body parts as slaves to dirty things and evil, now give your body parts as slaves to doing right. This leads to holy living.
When you were slaves to sin, you were free from doing right.
What good did you get then? You are now ashamed of those things, and they end in death.
But now you are free from sin and slaves to God. You get fruit that leads to holy living, and the end is life forever.
The pay of sin is death, but God's gift is life forever in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Don't you know, brothers? I talk to people who know the law. The law has power over a person only while that person is alive.
A married woman must obey the law about her husband while he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law.
So if her husband is still alive and she marries another man, people call her a cheater. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law. She is not a cheater if she marries another man.
My brothers, you also died to the law through Christ's body. Now you belong to another. You belong to Him who rose from the dead. This is so we can do good things for God.
When we lived for our own wants, our sinful wants worked in our bodies. The law made them grow. They led to death.
But now we died to what held us. We are free from the law. Now we serve God in a new way by the Spirit. We do not serve in the old way of written rules.

So what do we say? Is the law sin? No! But I would not have known sin without the law. I would not have known wanting what others have is wrong, if the law had not said, "Do not want what belongs to someone else."
But sin used the command to make me want all kinds of things. Without the law, sin is dead.
I once felt alive without the law. But when the command came, sin came alive, and I died.
So the command that was meant to give life brought death to me.
Sin used the command to trick me. It killed me through it.
So the law is holy. The command is holy, right, and good.
Did the good thing become death to me? No! Sin used what is good to bring death to me. This showed sin is truly sin. The command made sin very sinful.
We know the law is spiritual. But I am only human. I was sold to sin as a slave.
I do not understand what I do. I want to do good, but I do not do it. I do the thing I hate.
If I do what I do not want, I agree the law is good.
So now I am not the one doing it. Sin lives in me.
I know nothing good lives in me. I mean, nothing good lives in my sinful self. I want to do good, but I cannot do it.
I do not do the good I want. I keep doing the bad I do not want.
If I do what I do not want, it is not really me. Sin living in me does it.
So I find this rule: When I want to do good, bad is right there with me.
Deep inside, I am happy with God's law.
But I see another rule in my body. It fights the law in my mind. It makes me a prisoner to the rule of sin in my body.
What a sad man I am! Who will save me from this body that leads to death?
Thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So I serve God's law with my mind. But with my sinful self, I serve the law of sin.
So now there is no punishment for people who are in Christ Jesus.
The power of the Spirit, who gives life in Christ Jesus, has set you free from the power of sin and death.
The law could not save us because our human nature was too weak. So God sent His own Son in a body like ours. He came to take away sin, and God punished sin in His Son's body.
Now the good things the law wanted can happen in us. We do not live to please our sinful selves. We live to please the Spirit.
People who live to please their sinful nature think about sinful things. But people who live to please the Spirit think about what the Spirit wants.
Thinking only about sinful things leads to death. Thinking about what the Spirit wants gives life and peace.
A mind that thinks only about sin is against God. It does not obey God's law. It cannot obey it.
So people who live only for sinful things cannot please God.
But you are not like that. You live by the Spirit, if God's Spirit lives in you. If anyone does not have Christ's Spirit, that person does not belong to Him.
If Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, but your spirit is alive because God made you right.
If the Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from the dead, lives in you, then God, who raised Christ from the dead, will also give life to your bodies that die through His Spirit who lives in you.
So, brothers and sisters, we do not owe anything to our sinful nature. We do not have to live to please it.
If you live to please your sinful nature, you will die. But if you use the Spirit's power to stop doing wrong things with your body, you will live.
All who are led by God's Spirit are God's children.
You did not get a spirit that makes you a slave again and makes you afraid. You got the Spirit who makes you God's child. With that Spirit, we cry, "Abba, Father."
The Spirit Himself tells our spirit that we are God's children.
If we are God's children, then we will receive what God has promised. We will share it with Christ. But we must suffer with Him first, so we can share His glory.
I think the hard things we suffer now are nothing compared to the glory God will show us later.
All creation is waiting. It wants to see God's children shown for who they are.
God made the world broken and empty. The world did not choose it. But God did it with hope.
One day creation itself will be set free from decay and death. It will share the freedom and glory of God's children.
We know that all creation has been groaning like it is in pain giving birth until now.
We who have God's Spirit also groan inside. We wait for God to make us fully His children. We wait for our bodies to be set free.
We were saved because of this hope. But if we can see something, it is not hope. Who hopes for what they already see?
If we hope for what we cannot see, we wait for it with patience.
The Spirit also helps us when we are weak. We do not know how to pray the way we should. But the Spirit Himself prays for us with deep groans that words cannot say.
God, who looks at our hearts, knows what the Spirit is thinking. The Spirit prays for God's people the way God wants.
We know that God makes everything work for good for people who love Him. He does this for those He has called to follow His plan.
God knew His people before they were born. He chose them to become like His Son. Then His Son would be the first and most important among many brothers and sisters.
Those He chose, He also called. Those He called, He made right with Him. Those He made right, He also gave glory.
What can we say about all this? If God is for us, no one can stand against us.
God did not keep back His own Son. He gave Him up for all of us. So He will surely give us everything else we need, along with His Son.
Who can accuse the people God has chosen? God is the one who makes them right.
Who can condemn us? Christ Jesus died. He was raised to life. He sits at God's right side. He prays for us.
Who can separate us from Christ's love? Can trouble, or pain, or being chased for our faith, or hunger, or having no clothes, or danger, or a sword?
It is written, "For Your sake we face death all day. We are counted like sheep to be killed."
But in all these things we win completely through Him who loved us.
I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love. Not death or life. Not angels or rulers or powers. Not things now or things to come.
Not high or low. Not anything else in all creation. Nothing can separate us from God's love that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying. My heart and the Holy Spirit agree that this is true.
I am very sad. My heart hurts all the time.
I would even wish to be away from Christ for my brothers and sisters. They are my own people.

They are Israelites. God gave them many good things. He made them His children. He showed them His glory. He made agreements with them. He gave them His law. He told them how to worship Him. And He gave them His promises.
Their ancestors are great. Christ came from them as a man. He is God over all. Praise Him forever! Amen.
But God's word has not failed. Not everyone born in Israel is truly Israel.
Not all of Abraham's children are God's children. God said, "Your family will be named through Isaac."
This means God's children are not just children born in the usual way. God's children are the children He promised. They count as Abraham's family.
Here is God's promise: "At the right time I will come back, and Sarah will have a son."
Rebekah also had children. They had the same father, our father Isaac.
Before the twins were born, before they did good or bad, God chose. He did this so His plan would stand. God chooses by His own plan, not by what people do.
God told Rebekah, "The older son will serve the younger son."
The Bible says, "I loved Jacob, but I did not love Esau."
So what should we say? Is God unfair? No, never!
God said to Moses, "I will be kind to anyone I choose. I will care for anyone I choose."
So it does not depend on what we want or how hard we try. It depends on God, who is kind.
The Bible says to Pharaoh, "I made you important for this reason: I wanted to show My power in you. I wanted My name to be known all over the world."
So God is kind to anyone He wants. He also makes some people stubborn.
You might say to me, "Then why does God still blame people? No one can stop His plan."
But who are you, a person, to talk back to God? A pot does not say to the one who made it, "Why did You make me like this?"
The potter has the right to make pots from the same clay. He can make one pot for a special use and another for a plain use.
What if God wanted to show His anger and power? He waited with great patience. He let people who are ready for punishment stay for a while.
He did this to show how great His glory is. He is kind to people He made ready for glory.
He called us. He called us not only from the Jews but also from the other nations.
God said in Hosea, "I will call people who were not My people, 'My people.' I will call a woman who was not loved, 'My loved one.'"
"In the place where people said, 'You are not My people,' they will be called 'children of the living God.'"
Isaiah cried out about Israel: "Even if there are as many Israelites as sand by the sea, only a few will be saved."
The Lord will do what He said on the earth. He will finish it and cut it short.
Isaiah also said, "If the Lord of all had not left us some children, we would have been like Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah."
So what should we say? People who are not Jews did not try to be right with God. But they became right with God by faith.
But Israel tried to follow a law to be right with God. They did not reach it.
Why? Because they tried by doing things, not by faith. They tripped over the stone that makes people trip.
The Bible says, "Look, I put a stone in Zion that makes people trip. It is a rock that makes people fall. But anyone who trusts in Him will not be put to shame."
Brothers, I want Israel to be saved. That is my heart's wish and my prayer to God for them.
I can say this about them: They are very eager for God. But they do not know the right way.
They do not know God's way to be right with Him. They try to make their own way. So they do not obey God's way.
Christ is the end of the law. Now everyone who believes can be right with God.
Moses writes about being right by the law. He says, "The person who does these things will live by them."
But being right by trust says this: "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will go up to heaven?'" That means, "Bring Christ down."
"Or, 'Who will go down into the deep?'" That means, "Bring Christ up from the dead."
But what does it say? "The word is near you. It is in your mouth and in your heart." This is the word of trust that we preach.
If you say with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
For with the heart one believes and is right with God. And with the mouth one says it and is saved.
For the Bible says, "Everyone who trusts in Him will not be put to shame."
There is no difference between Jew and Greek. The same Lord is Lord of all. He is rich to all who call on Him.
For everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved.
But how can they call on Him if they have not believed in Him? And how can they believe if they have not heard about Him? And how can they hear without someone to tell them?
And how can anyone tell them unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!"
But not all of them obeyed the good news. For Isaiah says, "the LORD, who has believed our message?"
So faith comes from hearing. And hearing comes through the word of Christ.
But I ask, did they not hear? Yes, they did. Their voice went out to all the earth. Their words went to the ends of the world.
But I ask, did Israel not know? First Moses says, "I will make you jealous with a people who are not a nation. I will make you angry with a people who do not understand."
And Isaiah boldly says, "I was found by people who were not looking for Me. I showed Myself to people who were not asking for Me."
But to Israel He says, "All day long I have held out My hands to a people who do not obey and argue with Me."
So what do I say? Did God push His people away? No way! I am an Israelite too. I come from Abraham's family and from Benjamin's tribe.
God did not push away the people He knew before. Don't you know what the Bible says about Elijah? He prayed to God against Israel.
He said, "Lord, they killed Your prophets and tore down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they want to kill me."
But what did God say? He said, "I kept seven thousand men for Myself. They did not bow to Baal."
So it is now too. A small group is saved by grace.
If it is by grace, it is not by works. If it were by works, grace would not be grace.
What then? Israel did not find what it wanted. But the chosen ones did. The rest became stubborn.
The Bible says God gave them a spirit of deep sleep. Their eyes cannot see, and their ears cannot hear. This is still true today. David says:
"May their table be a trap and a snare. May it make them fall and pay them back.
May their eyes be dark so they cannot see. May their backs be bent forever."
Did they trip just to fall? No! Because they sinned, salvation came to people who are not Jews. This was to make Israel jealous.
If their sin brought riches to the world, and their loss brought riches to people who are not Jews, think how much more their full return will bring!
I am talking to you who are not Jews. I am an apostle to people who are not Jews. I honor this work.
I hope to make my own people jealous and save some of them.
If God turning them away made the world right with Him, what will bringing them back be? It will be life from the dead.
If the first part of the dough is holy, all of it is holy. If the root is holy, the branches are holy too.
Some branches were broken off. You are like a wild olive branch. You were joined to them. Now you share the rich root of the olive tree.
Don't brag about the branches. If you brag, remember this: you do not hold up the root. The root holds you up.
You may say, "Branches were broken off so I could be joined." That is true.
They were broken off because they did not believe. You stand because you believe. Don't be proud. Be afraid.
If God did not spare the natural branches, He may not spare you either.
See how kind and how strict God is. He is strict with those who fell. He is kind to you, if you keep in His kindness. If not, you too will be cut off.
And if they stop refusing to believe, they will be joined in again. God can join them in again.
If you were cut from a wild olive tree and joined to a good olive tree, even though that is not natural, how much more can these natural branches be joined to their own tree!
Brothers, I don't want you to miss this secret. Then you won't think you are so smart. Part of Israel has become stubborn until all the people who are not Jews have come to God.
And then all Israel will be saved. The Bible says, "The One who saves will come from Zion. He will turn Israel from sin.
This is My promise to them. I will take away their sins."
As far as the good news goes, they are enemies for your sake. But as far as God's choice goes, they are loved because of the fathers.
God does not take back His gifts or His call.
Just as you once disobeyed God but now have His mercy because they disobeyed,
so now they have disobeyed. This is so they can get mercy through the mercy shown to you.
God put everyone in the same place of not obeying, so He can have mercy on everyone.
Oh, how deep are God's riches, wisdom, and knowledge! No one can find out His choices. No one can trace His paths.
Who has known the Lord's mind? Who has been His helper?
Who gave Him something first, so He has to pay it back?
Everything comes from Him, through Him, and to Him. Glory to Him forever! Amen.
So, my brothers and sisters, I beg you to give your bodies to God. Because God is so kind, give yourselves as a living gift. Make it holy and pleasing to God. This is the right way to worship Him.
Do not be like the people of this world. Let God change you inside. He will make your mind new. Then you can know what God wants. You will know what is good and pleasing and perfect.
God has been kind to me. So I tell each of you: Do not think you are better than you really are. Think of yourselves in a wise and careful way. God has given each person a share of faith.
A body has many parts. Not all parts do the same job.
In the same way, we are one body in Christ. We are many people, but we belong to each other.
God has given us different gifts. Use them well. If you can tell God's message, speak with faith.
If you can serve, serve well. If you can teach, teach well.
If you can cheer people up, cheer them up. If you give, give freely. If you lead, lead with care. If you show kindness, be happy to do it.
Love must be real. Hate what is bad. Hold on to what is good.
Love each other like family. Try to honor each other more than yourselves.
Do not be lazy. Be excited in your spirit. Serve the Lord.
Be happy because you have hope. Keep going when life is hard. Keep praying.
Share with God's people when they need help. Try hard to welcome strangers.
Bless the people who hurt you. Bless them, and do not curse them.
Be happy with happy people. Cry with people who cry.
Think the same good thoughts toward each other. Do not be proud. Be friends with people who are not rich or important. Do not think you know everything.
Do not pay back evil with evil. Try to do what is right in front of everyone.
If you can, live in peace with all people.
My dear friends, do not try to get even. Let God be angry. He will punish. For the Bible says, "I will pay them back. I am the one who punishes," says the Lord.
But if your enemy is hungry, give him food. If he is thirsty, give him a drink. If you do this, you will make him feel ashamed.
Do not let evil win. Win over evil by doing good.
Everyone should obey the leaders who are over them.

God is the only one who gives power, and the leaders here were put there by God. So if you fight against them, you are fighting against God's plan. People who do that will bring punishment on themselves.
Leaders do not scare people who do good. They scare people who do bad. Do you want to not be scared? Do good, and they will praise you.
They are God's helpers to do good for you. But if you do bad, be afraid. They have the power to punish, and they do not use it for nothing. They are God's helpers who punish people who do bad.
So everyone must obey them. Do it not just because of fear of punishment, but because it is right.
That is why you pay taxes. The leaders work for God, and they keep doing this work.
Give everyone what you owe them. Pay taxes to the one who collects taxes. Pay what is due to the one who should get it. Respect the one who should be respected. Honor the one who should be honored.
Do not owe anyone anything, except to love each other. The one who loves others has done what God's rules ask.
God's rules say, do not cheat on your husband or wife, do not murder, do not steal, and do not want what is not yours. Any other rule is summed up in this: love your neighbor like you love yourself.
Love does not hurt a neighbor. So love does what God's rules ask.
You know what time it is. It is time to wake up from sleep. We are closer to being saved now than when we first believed.
The night is almost over. The day is near. So let us stop doing the things of the dark. Let us put on the things of the light.
Let us live good lives in the day. Do not have wild parties or drink too much. Do not do wrong sexual things or be out of control. Do not fight or be jealous.
Instead, live like the Lord Jesus Christ. Do not plan to do the wrong things your body wants.
Welcome the person who is weak in faith. Do not argue about what people think is right.
One person believes they can eat anything. But a weak person eats only vegetables.
The person who eats should not look down on the person who does not eat. And the person who does not eat should not judge the person who eats. God accepted that person.
Who are you to judge someone else's servant? He stands or falls to his own master. And he will stand, because the Lord can make him stand.
One person thinks one day is more special than another. Another person thinks every day is the same. Each person should be sure in his own mind.
The person who honors the day does it for the Lord. The person who eats eats for the Lord and gives thanks to God. The person who does not eat does not eat for the Lord and gives thanks to God.
None of us lives only for himself. And none of us dies only for himself.
If we live, we live for the Lord. If we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
Christ died and came back to life for this reason. He is Lord of both the dead and the living.
Why do you judge your brother? Or why do you look down on your brother? We will all stand before God to be judged.
It is written: "As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to Me, and every tongue will admit that God is right."
So each of us will answer to God for himself.
So let us stop judging each other. Instead, decide not to put anything in a brother's way that makes him fall.
I know and am sure in the Lord Jesus that nothing is wrong by itself. But if someone thinks it is wrong, then it is wrong for him.
If your brother is hurt because of food, you are not walking in love. Do not destroy the person Christ died for just because of food.
Do not let people speak badly about your good.
God's kingdom is not about eating and drinking. It is about doing what is right, having peace, and having joy in the Holy Spirit.
The person who serves Christ in this way pleases God and is approved by people.
So let us try to live in peace and build each other up.
Do not tear down God's work because of food. All food is okay. But it is wrong for a person to eat if it makes someone else fall.
It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that makes your brother fall.
Keep the faith you have between you and God. Happy is the person who does not judge himself by what he chooses.
But the person who is not sure is guilty if he eats. He does not eat from faith. And everything that is not from faith is sin.
We who are strong should help carry the weak. We should not just please ourselves.
Each of us should try to please the person next to us. We should do good and help them grow strong.
For even Christ did not please Himself. The Bible says, "The mean words of people who insult You fell on Me."
Everything written long ago was written to teach us. The Bible helps us keep going and gives us hope.
May God, who helps us keep going and comforts us, help you agree with each other, like Christ Jesus wants.
Then you can all praise God together. He is the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So welcome each other, just as Christ welcomed you. This brings praise to God.
I tell you, Christ came to serve the Jewish people. He showed God's truth. He made God's promises to their fathers come true.
He did this so people who are not Jews may praise God for His mercy. The Bible says, "So I will praise You among the nations. I will sing to Your name."
Again it says, "Be happy, you nations, with His people."
And again, "Praise the LORD, all you nations. Let all people praise Him."
And again, Isaiah says, "The family line of Jesse will grow. One will come to rule the nations. People from all nations will hope in Him."
May God, who gives hope, fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him. Then you will overflow with hope through the power of the Holy Spirit.
My brothers and sisters, I am sure you are full of goodness. You know a lot, and you can help each other learn.
I wrote to you boldly about some things. I did this to remind you. God gave me grace to do this.
I serve Christ Jesus by telling the good news to people who are not Jews. It is like a holy job. I want their lives to be a gift God accepts. The Holy Spirit makes them holy.
So I am proud of my work for God through Christ Jesus.
I will only talk about what Christ did through me. He helped people who are not Jews obey God. He did this by what I said and did.
God's Spirit gave me power to do signs and wonders. I told the good news about Christ everywhere from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
I always wanted to tell the good news where people did not know Christ. I did not want to build on another person's work.
The Bible says, "People who were not told about Him will see. People who have not heard will understand."
That is why I could not come to you sooner.
But now I have no more work here. I have wanted to visit you for many years.
I plan to visit you on my way to Spain. I hope to see you and enjoy time with you. Then you can help me on my trip.
But now I am going to Jerusalem. I am taking help to God's people there.
The churches in Macedonia and Achaia wanted to help. They gave money for poor believers in Jerusalem.
They were glad to do it. They owe them this help. If people who are not Jews received spiritual gifts from the Jews, they should help them with money and food.
So after I finish this job and make sure they get the gift, I will go to Spain. I will visit you on the way.
I know that when I come to you, Christ will bless us fully.
Brothers and sisters, I ask you to pray for me. Pray by the power of our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit. Help me in my struggle.
Pray that people in Judea who do not believe will not hurt me. Pray that God's people in Jerusalem will accept the gift.
Then I can come to you with joy, if God wants. We can rest together.
May the God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
I tell you about our sister Phoebe. She serves the church in Cenchreae.
Welcome her in the Lord in a way that is right for God's holy people. Help her with anything she needs from you, because she has helped many people, and me too.
Greet Priscilla and Aquila. They work with me for Christ Jesus.
They risked their lives for me. I am thankful for them, and so are all the churches of the people who are not Jews.
Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus. He was the first person in Asia to follow Christ.
Greet Mary. She worked very hard for you.
Greet Andronicus and Junia. They are my relatives and were in prison with me. They are well known among the apostles, and they followed Christ before I did.
Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.
Greet Urbanus, who works with us for Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.
Greet Apelles, who has shown he is true in Christ. Greet the people from Aristobulus's home.
Greet Herodion, my relative. Greet the people from Narcissus's home who belong to the Lord.
Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa. They work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She worked very hard for the Lord.
Greet Rufus, who is chosen in the Lord, and his mother. She has been like a mother to me too.
Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, Olympas, and all God's holy people with them.
Greet each other with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.
I beg you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for people who cause fights and lead others to sin. They go against the teaching you learned. Stay away from them.
These people do not serve our Lord Christ. They serve their own stomachs. They use smooth talk and kind words to trick the hearts of innocent people.
Everyone has heard that you obey. So I am glad about you. But I want you to be wise about what is good, and innocent about what is bad.
The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Timothy, who works with me, greets you. So do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
I am Tertius. I wrote this letter. I greet you in the Lord.
Gaius greets you. He has given me a place to stay, and he does the same for the whole church. Erastus, who keeps the city's money, greets you. So does Quartus, a brother.
Now to God, who can make you strong. He does this through my good news and through the message about Jesus Christ. This shows a secret plan that was hidden for a very long time.
But now it is shown. It is made known through the writings of the prophets. The God who lives forever gave the command. It is for all nations, so they will obey and have faith.
To the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ. Amen.
I am Paul. God chose me to be a messenger for Christ Jesus. This was God's plan. Our brother Sosthenes is with me.

I write to God's church in Corinth. God made you holy because of Christ Jesus. He called you to be His holy people. This letter is also for all people everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. He is their Lord and ours.
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
I always thank my God for you. I do this because of the grace God gave you in Christ Jesus.
In Him, you became rich in every way. You are rich in all you say and in all you know.
This shows that what Christ said is true among you.
You do not lack any gift. You wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to come again.
He will keep you strong to the end. Then you will be without blame on the day our Lord Jesus Christ comes.
God is faithful. He called you to share life with His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
Brothers, I ask you by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to agree with one another. Do not split into groups. Be joined together in the same mind and the same plan.
My brothers, some from Chloe's family told me about you. They said you are arguing.
I mean this: One of you says, "I follow Paul." Another says, "I follow Apollos." Another says, "I follow Peter." Another says, "I follow Christ."
Is Christ split into parts? Was Paul killed on a cross for you? Were you baptized in Paul's name?
I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius.
So no one can say you were baptized in my name.
I also baptized the family of Stephanas. I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.
Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news. I do not use fancy words. I do this so the cross of Christ will not lose its power.
The message about the cross is foolish to people who are dying. But to us who are being saved, it is God's power.
It is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will throw away the understanding of those who think they know."
Where is the wise person? Where is the teacher of the law? Where is the thinker of this age? Has not God made the world's wisdom look foolish?
The world did not know God through its own wisdom. So God was pleased to save those who believe through the foolish message we preach.
Jews ask for signs. Greeks look for wisdom.
But we preach Christ on the cross. This is a problem for Jews. It is foolish to people who are not Jews.
But to those God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is God's power and God's wisdom.
God's foolishness is wiser than people. God's weakness is stronger than people.
Brothers, look at your own calling. Not many of you were wise by human standards. Not many were powerful. Not many came from important families.
But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise. God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
God chose things that are low and looked down on. He chose things the world counts as nothing. He did this to bring down things the world counts as something.
So no person can brag before God.
God put you in Christ Jesus. Christ became our wisdom from God. He became our right living, our being made holy, and our being set free.
So, as it is written, "Let the one who brags brag about the Lord."
Brothers, when I came to you, I did not come with fancy words or human wisdom. I told you about God's truth.
I decided to know only one thing among you: Jesus Christ and His death on the cross.
I came to you weak, scared, and shaking a lot.
My words and my preaching were not with smart talk. They showed the Spirit's power.
I did this so your faith would not rest on people's wisdom, but on God's power.
We do speak wisdom to strong believers. But it is not the wisdom of this world. It is not the wisdom of the leaders of this world, who are fading away.
We speak God's secret wisdom. God hid it, but He planned it long ago for our honor.
None of the leaders of this world knew it. If they had known it, they would not have killed the Lord of glory.
But the Bible says, "No eye has seen it. No ear has heard it. No heart has dreamed it. God has made it ready for people who love Him."
But God showed these things to us through the Spirit. The Spirit looks into all things, even the deep things of God.
Who knows what a person thinks except that person's own spirit? In the same way, no one knows God's thoughts except God's Spirit.
We did not get the spirit of the world. We got the Spirit from God. So we can know the good things God gave us.
We talk about these things with words the Spirit teaches, not words from human wisdom. We match spiritual things with spiritual things.
A person without the Spirit does not accept the things of God's Spirit. To him they seem foolish. He cannot understand them, because they are understood in a spiritual way.
But a spiritual person can judge all things. Yet no one judges him.
The Bible asks, "Who has known the Lord's mind? Who can teach Him?" But we have the mind of Christ.
Brothers, I could not talk to you like people who follow God's Spirit. I had to talk to you like people who follow their own wants, like babies in Christ.
I gave you milk to drink, not solid food. You were not ready for it yet. Even now, you are still not ready.
You are still living by your own wants. When you are jealous and argue with each other, you are acting like people who do not know God. You are living like everyone else.
When one of you says, "I follow Paul," and another says, "I follow Apollos," you are acting like everyone else.
What is Apollos? What is Paul? They are servants. Through them, you believed. The Lord gave each one his job.
I planted the seed. Apollos watered it. But God made it grow.
So the one who plants is not important. The one who waters is not important. God is the one who makes things grow.
The one who plants and the one who waters work together. Each one will get his own pay for his own work.
We work together for God. You are God's field. You are God's house.
God was kind to me. He gave me this work. I laid the foundation like a wise builder. Now someone else builds on it. Each person must be careful how he builds.
No one can lay any other foundation. Jesus Christ is the only foundation.
If someone builds on this foundation with gold, silver, pretty stones, wood, grass, or straw,
his work will be shown for what it is. The day will show it. It will be shown in fire. The fire will test what kind of work each person did.
If the work stays, the person will get a reward.
If the work burns up, the person will lose it. But the person will be saved. He will be saved like someone going through fire.
Don't you know that you are God's temple? God's Spirit lives in you.
If anyone ruins God's temple, God will ruin that person. God's temple is holy. You are that temple.
Do not fool yourself. If anyone among you thinks he is wise in this world, he should become foolish. Then he can become wise.
The wisdom of this world is foolish to God. It is written, "God catches wise people in their own tricks."
And again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of wise people are useless."
So do not brag about people. All things are yours.
Paul, Apollos, Cephas, the world, life, death, things now, and things to come—all are yours.
You belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
People should think of us as helpers of Christ and as keepers of God's secrets.
Now those who keep things must be found faithful.
I care very little if you judge me, or if other people judge me. I do not even judge myself.
My own mind is clear, but that does not make me right. The Lord is the one who judges me.

So do not judge before the right time. Wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light the things hidden in darkness. He will show the reasons in people's hearts. Then each person will receive praise from God.
Brothers, I used myself and Apollos as an example for you. I did this so you can learn from us the words, "Do not go beyond what is written." Then you will not be proud of one leader against another.
Who made you different? What do you have that you did not receive? If you did receive it, why do you brag like you did not?
You already have all you want! You already have become rich! You have begun to rule without us! I wish you really had begun to rule, so we could rule with you!
It seems to me that God has shown us apostles last, like men sent to die. We have been made a show to the whole world, to angels, and to people.
We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, but we are not honored.
Even now we are hungry and thirsty. We are poorly dressed. We are beaten. We have no home.
We work hard with our own hands. When people say bad things about us, we bless them. When people hurt us, we put up with it.
When people speak badly of us, we answer kindly. Even now we have become like the trash of the world, like dirt that everyone wipes away.
I am not writing this to shame you. I am writing to warn you, because you are my dear children.
Even if you had ten thousand teachers in Christ, you do not have many fathers. In Christ Jesus, I became your father through the good news.
So I beg you to copy me.
That is why I sent Timothy to you. He is my dear and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus. I teach this same way in every church everywhere.
Some of you have become proud. You act as if I am not coming to you.
But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wants. Then I will find out not just the words of those proud people, but their power.
For God's kingdom is not about words. It is about power.
What do you want? Should I come to you with a stick, or with love and a gentle spirit?
People say there is sexual sin among you. A man is living with his father's wife. Even people who do not know God do not do that.
And you are proud! You should be sad instead. You should remove the man who did this wrong thing from among you.
Even though I am not with you in person, I am with you in spirit. I have already decided what should happen to the man who did this. It is as if I were there.
When you meet together in the name of our Lord Jesus, and my spirit is with you, and the power of our Lord Jesus is with you,
give this man to Satan, so his sinful self is destroyed, but his spirit is saved on the day of the Lord.
You are proud, and that is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast makes all the dough rise?
Get rid of the old yeast, so you can be new dough without yeast. Christ, our Passover lamb, was sacrificed.
So let us celebrate, not with old yeast or yeast of hate and evil, but with bread without yeast, with truth and honesty.
In my letter I told you not to spend time with people who sin sexually.
I did not mean all sinful people in this world, or greedy people, or thieves, or people who worship false gods. If you stayed away from all of them, you would have to leave the world.
But now I tell you: do not spend time with anyone who says he is a believer but is sexually sinful, greedy, worships false gods, mean, drunk, or a thief. Do not even eat with that person.
It is not my job to judge people outside the church. You should judge the people inside.
God judges people outside. Remove the evil person from among you.
If one of you has a problem with another person, do you dare take it to court before people who do wrong, instead of before God's holy people?
Don't you know that God's holy people will judge the world? If you will judge the world, aren't you good enough to judge small problems?
Don't you know we will judge angels? So we can surely judge everyday problems.
So if you have everyday problems to settle, why do you pick people the church looks down on to judge them?
I say this to make you feel ashamed. Isn't there even one wise person among you who can settle a problem between two believers?
Instead, one believer takes another believer to court, and people who do not believe in God watch.
So the fact that you have court cases against each other is already a loss for you. Why not let someone wrong you? Why not let someone cheat you?
But you are the ones who cheat and hurt people, even your own brothers in faith.

Don't you know that people who do wrong will not get God's kingdom? Don't be fooled. People who live in sexual sin, worship fake gods, cheat on their spouse, or have sex with people of the same gender will not get it.
Thieves, greedy people, drunkards, people who say mean things, and cheaters will not get God's kingdom either.
Some of you used to do these things. But you were washed clean. You were made holy. You were made right with God in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
I am allowed to do all things, but not all things help me. I am allowed to do all things, but I will not be controlled by anything.
Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food. But God will do away with both. The body is not for sexual sin. It is for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.
God raised the Lord by His power, and He will raise us too.
Don't you know your bodies are parts of Christ? Should I take what belongs to Christ and join it to a prostitute? No!
Don't you know that a man who joins himself to a prostitute becomes one body with her? The Bible says, "The two will become one flesh."
But anyone who joins himself to the Lord becomes one spirit with Him.
Run away from sexual sin. Every other sin a person does is outside the body. But sexual sin is a sin against his own body.
Don't you know your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you? You have Him from God, and you do not belong to yourselves.
God paid a high price to buy you. So honor God with your body.
Now about the things you wrote: "It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman."
But because there is so much sexual sin, each man should have his own wife, and each woman should have her own husband.
A husband should give his wife what she needs. A wife should do the same for her husband.
A wife does not have full power over her own body. Her husband does. A husband does not have full power over his own body. His wife does.
Do not keep away from each other. You may stop for a short time if you both agree, so you can pray. Then come together again. This way Satan will not tempt you, because you cannot control yourselves.
I say this as kind advice, not as a command.
I wish everyone were like me. But each person has his own gift from God. One has this gift, and another has that gift.
To people who are not married and to widows I say this: It is good for them to stay as I am.
But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry. It is better to marry than to burn with desire.
To married people I give this command. It is not from me, but from the Lord: A wife should not leave her husband.
If she does leave, she should stay unmarried, or she should go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
To the rest I say this. I say it, not the Lord: If a believer has a wife who does not believe, and she is willing to live with him, he should not leave her.
If a woman has a husband who does not believe, and he is willing to live with her, she should not leave her husband.
The husband who does not believe is made holy through his wife. The wife who does not believe is made holy through her husband. If not, your children would be unclean. But now they are holy.
If the one who does not believe wants to leave, let him go. The Christian brother or sister is not tied to them in such a case. God has called you to live in peace.
Wife, how do you know if you will save your husband? Husband, how do you know if you will save your wife?
Each person should live the life the Lord has given. This is what God called each person to do. I teach this in all the churches.
If a man was already circumcised when God called him, he should not try to undo it. If he was not circumcised, he should not get circumcised.
Circumcision means nothing. Not being circumcised means nothing. What matters is obeying God's commands.
Each person should stay in the situation he was in when God called him.
Were you a slave when God called you? Do not worry about it. But if you can become free, do that.
The slave who was called by the Lord is the Lord's free person. The free person who was called is Christ's slave.
You were bought with a price. Do not become slaves of people.
Brothers and sisters, each person should stay with God in the situation he was in when God called him.
About people who have never married, I do not have a command from the Lord. But I give my opinion, as one who has received the Lord's mercy and can be trusted.
Because of the hard times now, I think it is good for a person to stay as he is.
Are you married? Do not try to get free. Are you not married? Do not look for a wife.
If you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will have trouble in this life. I want to spare you that trouble.
Brothers and sisters, time is short. From now on, those who have wives should live as if they did not.
Those who cry should live as if they did not cry. Those who are happy should live as if they were not happy. Those who buy things should live as if they did not own them.
Those who use the things of this world should not use them too much. This world's shape is passing away.
I want you to be free from worry. A man who is not married cares about the Lord's things, how to please the Lord.
A married man cares about the things of this world, how to please his wife.
A woman who is not married, and a virgin, cares about the Lord's things, so she can be holy in body and spirit. A married woman cares about the things of this world, how to please her husband.
I say this to help you, not to trap you. I say it so you can live in a good and proper way, and serve the Lord without being pulled away.

If a man thinks he is not doing right by the virgin he is engaged to, and she is past the usual age to marry, and he feels he should marry her, he should do what he wants. He does not sin. Let them marry.
But a man who has decided firmly in his heart, and is not forced, but has control over his own will, and has decided not to marry her, does well.
So the man who marries her does well, and the man who does not marry her does even better.
A wife is tied to her husband as long as he lives. If her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wants, but only in the Lord.
In my opinion, she is happier if she stays as she is. And I think I too have God's Spirit.
Now about food given to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. But knowledge makes people proud, while love helps people grow.
If anyone thinks he knows a lot, he still does not know as he should.
But if anyone loves God, God knows him.
So about eating food offered to idols: We know an idol is not really anything in the world. And there is only one God.
Even if people call many things gods in heaven or on earth, there are many so-called gods and lords.
But for us there is one God, the Father. All things come from Him, and we live for Him. And there is one Lord, Jesus Christ. All things came through Him, and we live through Him.
But not everyone knows this. Some people are still used to idols. When they eat this food, they think it was offered to an idol. Their weak sense of right and wrong is made dirty.
Food does not bring us to God. We are not worse if we do not eat. We are not better if we do eat.
Be careful so that your freedom does not make weak people fall into sin.
If a person with a weak sense of right and wrong sees you eating in a temple for idols, won't he feel okay to eat food offered to idols?
So the weak brother, for whom Christ died, is ruined by your knowledge.
By sinning against your brothers and hurting their weak sense of right and wrong, you sin against Christ.
So if my food makes my brother fall into sin, I will never eat meat again. I do not want to make him fall.
Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Aren't you my work in the Lord?
Even if I am not an apostle to other people, I am to you. You are the proof that God sent me to do His work.
This is how I answer people who question me.
Don't we have the right to eat and drink?
Don't we have the right to take a wife who believes, like the other apostles, the Lord's brothers, and Peter?
Or are only Barnabas and I left without the right to stop working?
Who goes to war and pays his own way? Who plants a grape field and does not eat its fruit? Who takes care of sheep and does not drink their milk?
Am I saying this just from a human point of view? Doesn't God's law say the same thing?
For it is written in the Law of Moses, "Do not put a muzzle on an ox while it works." Is God really worried about oxen?
No, He says this for us. The farmer plows hoping to get a crop. The worker threshes hoping to share in the food.
If we planted spiritual seeds among you, is it too much to get food and help from you?
If other people have this right from you, shouldn't we have it even more? But we did not use this right. We put up with everything so we would not slow down the good news about Christ.
Don't you know that people who work in God's house eat from God's house? People who serve at the altar share in what is brought to the altar.
In the same way, the Lord said that people who tell the good news should live from the good news.
But I have not used any of these rights. I am not writing this to ask you to give me anything. I would rather die than let anyone take away my reason to be proud.
I cannot brag just because I tell the good news. I have to do it. I am in trouble if I do not tell the good news.
If I do it because I want to, I get a reward. If I do it because I must, God still gave me a job to do.
So what is my reward? It is that I can tell the good news for free, without using all my rights.
I am free from everyone, but I made myself a servant to everyone so I could win more people.
To Jewish people I became like a Jewish person, so I could win Jewish people. To people under the law I became like one under the law, even though I am not under the law, so I could win them.
To people without the law I became like one without the law. But I am not free from God's law. I am under Christ's law. I did this to win people without the law.
To weak people I became weak, so I could win weak people. I became all things to all people so I could save some.
I do all this for the good news, so I can share in its blessings.
Don't you know that in a race all runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run so you can win it.
Everyone who plays in the games trains hard. They do it to get a crown that fades away. We do it to get a crown that lasts forever.
So I do not run without knowing where I am going. I do not fight like I am hitting the air.
I keep my body under control and make it obey me. Then, after I preach to others, I will not fail the test.
I do not want you to miss this, brothers and sisters. Our people long ago were all under the cloud. They all went through the sea.
They all were joined to Moses in the cloud and the sea.
They all ate the same food from God.
They all drank the same drink from God. They drank from the spiritual rock that went with them. That rock was Christ.
But God was not happy with most of them. They died in the desert.
These things happened to teach us. We should not want bad things like they did.
Do not worship fake gods like some of them did. It is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to play."
Do not commit sexual sin like some of them did. In one day, 23,000 people died.
Do not test Christ like some of them did. They were killed by snakes.
Do not complain like some of them did. They were killed by the Destroyer.
These things happened to them to teach us. They were written for us who live now. The end of time has come to us.
So if you think you are strong, be careful. You might fall.
No test has come to you that is not common to people. God is faithful. He will not let you be tested more than you can handle. With the test, He will make a way out. Then you can stand it.
So, my dear friends, run away from worshiping fake gods.
I talk to you like smart people. Decide for yourselves if what I say is right.
The cup we bless, is it not sharing in Christ's blood? The bread we break, is it not sharing in Christ's body?
There is one bread. We are many, but we are one body. We all share that one bread.
Look at the people of Israel. Are not the people who eat the sacrifices sharing in the altar?
What am I saying then? Is food given to fake gods a big thing? Is a fake god a big thing?
No. I am saying that what people give to fake gods, they give to demons. They do not give it to God. I do not want you to share with demons.
You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You cannot share the table of the Lord and the table of demons.
Do we make the Lord jealous? Are we stronger than He is?
"All things are allowed," but not all things help. "All things are allowed," but not all things build us up.
No one should look out for only himself. Look out for what helps other people.
Eat any meat sold in the meat store. Do not ask questions about it. This is for your conscience.
For "the earth is the the LORD, and everything in it."
If someone who does not believe asks you to eat, and you want to go, eat what is put in front of you. Do not ask questions. This is for your conscience.
But if someone says to you, "This was given to a god," do not eat it. Do it for that person and for your conscience.
I do not mean your conscience. I mean his conscience. Why should my freedom be judged by someone else's conscience?
If I eat with thanks, why am I blamed for what I thank God for?
So if you eat, or drink, or do anything, do it all to give God glory.
Do not do things that make people fall. Do not make Jews, Greeks, or God's church fall.
I try to please all people in all things. I do not look for what helps me. I look for what helps many people. I want them to be saved.
Follow my example, like I follow Christ.
I praise you because you remember me in all things and keep the teachings I gave you.
But I want you to know this: Christ is the leader of every man. A man is the leader of a woman. And God is the leader of Christ.
Every man who prays or speaks God's message with his head covered brings shame on himself.
But every woman who prays or speaks God's message with her head uncovered shames herself. It is just as bad as if her hair were cut off.
If a woman will not cover her head, she should cut her hair short. But if it is shameful for a woman to cut her hair short or shave her head, then she should cover her head.
A man should not cover his head. He is made like God and shows God's glory. But a woman shows a man's glory.
Man did not come from woman. Woman came from man.
Man was not made for woman. Woman was made for man.
So a woman should have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
But with the Lord, men and women belong together. Neither can be without the other.
Just as woman came from man, man is born through woman. And all things come from God.
You decide for yourselves: Is it right for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
Does not nature itself teach you that long hair on a man is a shame to him?
But long hair on a woman is her glory. Her hair is given to her like a covering.
If anyone wants to argue about this, we have no such custom. The churches of God do not either.
Now when I give this command, I do not praise you. You come together, but it is for the worse, not for the better.
First, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are splits among you. I partly believe it.
There must be groups among you so that the ones who are true can be seen.
So when you come together, it is not really the Lord's Supper you eat.
When you eat, each one grabs his own supper first. One person is hungry, and another gets drunk.
Don't you have homes where you can eat and drink? Or do you look down on God's church and shame people who have nothing? What should I say to you? Should I praise you? In this I will not praise you.
