I got this from the Lord, and I gave it to you: On the night He was handed over, the Lord Jesus took bread.
He thanked God, broke it, and said, “This is My body, which is for you. Do this to remember Me.”
In the same way, after supper, He took the cup and said, “This cup is the new agreement in My blood. Do this, as often as you drink it, to remember Me.”
For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you tell about the Lord's death until He comes.
So anyone who eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in a wrong way will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
A person should look at himself first. Then he may eat the bread and drink the cup.
If he eats and drinks without thinking about what it means, he brings judgment on himself.
That is why many of you are weak and sick, and some have died.
If we looked at ourselves, we would not be judged.
When the Lord judges us, He trains us so we will not be punished with the world.
So, my brothers and sisters, when you come together to eat, wait for each other.
If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home. Then you will not come together for judgment. I will tell you the rest when I come.
Now, brothers and sisters, I want to talk about gifts from the Spirit. I don't want you to be confused.
You know that when you were not believers, you were led to worship fake gods that can't speak.
So I tell you: no one who speaks by God's Spirit says, "Jesus is cursed." And no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," unless the Holy Spirit helps them.
There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit gives them.
There are different kinds of work to do, but the same Lord gives them.
There are different kinds of power at work, but the same God works all of them in everyone.
The Spirit gives a gift to each person to help everyone.
To one person the Spirit gives wise words. To another, the Spirit gives knowledge.
To another, faith by the same Spirit. To another, gifts to heal people by the one Spirit.

To another, power to do miracles. To another, the gift to speak for God. To another, the gift to tell good spirits from bad ones. To another, the gift to speak in new languages. To another, the gift to explain those languages.
One and the same Spirit does all these things. He gives each gift to each person the way He wants.
A body is one, but it has many parts. Even with many parts, it is still one body. It is the same with Christ.
We were all baptized by one Spirit into one body. It doesn't matter if we are Jews or Greeks, slaves or free. We all received the one Spirit.
A body is not just one part. It has many parts.
If the foot says, "I am not a hand, so I am not part of the body," it is still part of the body.
If the ear says, "I am not an eye, so I am not part of the body," it is still part of the body.
If the whole body were an eye, where would hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would smell be?
But God put each part in the body just as He wanted.
If all were one part, where would the body be?
But now there are many parts, but one body.
The eye can't say to the hand, "I don't need you!" The head can't say to the feet, "I don't need you!"
In fact, the parts that seem weaker are needed.
We give more honor to parts we think are less important. The parts we keep covered get more respect.
The parts that look fine don't need this. But God put the body together. He gave more honor to the part that lacked it.
This is so the body does not break apart. Instead, the parts take care of each other.
If one part hurts, all the parts hurt. If one part is honored, all the parts are glad.
You are the body of Christ. You are parts of it.

In the church, God chose first apostles, second prophets, third teachers. Then He chose people who do miracles, people with gifts to heal, people who help others, people who lead, and people who speak in new languages.
Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all do miracles?
Do all have gifts to heal? Do all speak in new languages? Do all explain them?
But you should want the greater gifts. And I will show you a way that is even better.
If I speak every language that people and angels use, but I do not have love, I am just a loud, empty bell.
If I can tell what will happen, know every secret, and know everything, and if I have so much faith that I can move mountains, but I do not have love, I am nothing.
If I give away everything I own, and even give up my body, but I do not have love, it does not help me.
Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous. Love does not brag. Love is not proud.
Love is not rude. Love does not want only its own way. Love does not get angry easily. Love does not keep a list of wrongs.
Love is not glad when bad things happen. Love is glad when truth wins.
Love puts up with all things. Love believes all things. Love hopes all things. Love keeps going in all things.
Love never ends. But special messages will end. Speaking in new languages will end. What we know will end.
We know only a little now. We also tell what will happen only a little now.
When the perfect thing comes, these little things will end.
When I was a child, I talked like a child. I thought like a child. I understood like a child. When I became a man, I stopped doing child things.
Now we see things like a dark picture in a mirror. Then we will see face to face. Now I know only a little. Then I will know fully, just like I am known.
So these three things stay: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.
Follow love. But you should also want gifts from the Spirit. Most of all, you should want to speak God's message.
A person who speaks in an unknown language is not talking to people. He is talking to God. No one understands him. He speaks secret things by the Spirit.
But a person who speaks God's message talks to people. It helps them grow. It gives them courage. It gives them comfort.
A person who speaks in an unknown language helps himself grow. But a person who speaks God's message helps the whole church grow.

I want all of you to speak in unknown languages. But I want even more for you to speak God's message. The one who speaks God's message is greater than the one who speaks in an unknown language. That is true unless he explains what he said. Then the church can grow.

Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in an unknown language, how will that help you? It will not help unless I also speak to you. I could share a truth God showed me. I could share what I know. I could speak God's message. Or I could teach.
Even things without life make sounds. A flute or a harp makes a sound. But how will anyone know the tune if the notes are not clear?
If a horn makes a sound no one can tell, who will get ready for battle?
It is the same with you. If you do not speak clear words, how will anyone know what you said? You will just be talking to the air.
There are many kinds of languages in the world. All of them mean something.
If I do not know what the language means, I will seem like a foreigner to the speaker. And the speaker will seem like a foreigner to me.
It is the same with you. You want gifts from the Spirit so much. So try hard to help the church grow.
So a person who speaks in an unknown language should pray. He should pray that he can explain it.
If I pray in an unknown language, my spirit prays. But my mind is not helped.
So what should I do? I will pray with my spirit. I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit. I will also sing with my mind.
If you praise God only with your spirit, how can someone new say “Amen” to your thanks? He does not know what you are saying.
You may thank God well. But the other person is not helped.
I thank God that I speak in unknown languages more than all of you.
But in church I would rather say five words people can understand. Then I can teach others. I would rather do that than say ten thousand words in an unknown language.
Brothers and sisters, do not think like children. But be like babies when it comes to doing wrong. In your thinking, be grown up.
The Law says, “I will speak to these people with strange languages and foreign lips. But even then, they will not listen to Me,” says the Lord.

So unknown languages are a sign. They are for people who do not believe. They are not for believers. But speaking God's message is a sign. It is for believers. It is not for people who do not believe.
So if the whole church meets together and everyone speaks in unknown languages, what will happen? If new people or people who do not believe come in, won't they say you are crazy?
But if everyone speaks God's message and a person who does not believe or a new person comes in, he will be shown he is wrong. Everyone will show him.
The secrets of his heart will come to light. Then he will fall on his face and worship God. He will say, “God is really here with you.”

So what should we do, brothers and sisters? When you meet, each person has something. One has a song. One has a teaching. One has a truth God showed. One has an unknown language. One has an explanation. Do everything to help the church grow.
If anyone speaks in an unknown language, only two or three should speak. They should take turns. And one person should explain it.
If no one can explain it, the speaker should be quiet in church. He can speak to himself and to God.
Two or three prophets should speak. The others should decide if it is right.
But if God shows something to another person who is sitting there, the first speaker should stop.
All of you can speak God's message one by one. Then everyone can learn. Everyone can be encouraged.
The spirits of the prophets are under the prophets' control.
God is not a God of trouble. He is a God of peace. This is true in all the churches of God's people.
Women should be quiet in the churches. They are not allowed to speak. They should follow, just as the Law says.
If they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home. It is not right for a woman to speak in church.
Did God's word start with you? Or did it come only to you?
If anyone thinks he is a prophet or has a spiritual gift, he should know this. What I write to you is a command from the Lord.
If anyone does not accept this, he will not be accepted.
So, my brothers and sisters, want to speak God's message. And do not stop people from speaking in unknown languages.
But everything should be done in a good and orderly way.
Brothers and sisters, I want to tell you again about the good news I told you. You received it. You stay in it.
This good news saves you if you hold on to the words I told you. If not, you believed for nothing.
I gave you the most important thing first. Christ died for our sins, just like the Bible says.
He was buried. He rose again on the third day, just like the Bible says.
He appeared to Peter. Then He appeared to the twelve.
After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at one time. Most of them are still alive. Some have died.
Then He appeared to James. Then He appeared to all the apostles.
Last of all, He appeared to me too, like a baby born too soon.
I am the least of the apostles. I am not even good enough to be called an apostle. I made God's people suffer.
But God's grace made me what I am. His grace to me was not wasted. I worked harder than all of them. But it was not really me. It was God's grace working with me.
So whether it was I or they, we preach the same thing. And that is what you believed.
We preach that Christ rose from the dead. So why do some of you say there is no rising from the dead?
If there is no rising from the dead, then Christ did not rise.
If Christ did not rise, then our preaching is empty. And your faith is empty.
We would even be lying about God. We said God raised Christ. But if dead people do not rise, then God did not raise Him.
If dead people do not rise, then Christ did not rise.
If Christ did not rise, your faith is worth nothing. You are still in your sins.
Then people who died believing in Christ are lost.
If we hope in Christ only for this life, we are the saddest people of all.
But Christ did rise from the dead. He is the first of those who died to rise.
Death came through one man. So rising from the dead comes through one man too.
All people die because of Adam. So all people will be made alive because of Christ.
But each person rises in his own turn. Christ is first. Then, when He comes again, those who belong to Christ will rise.
Then the end will come. Christ will give the kingdom to God the Father. He will end all rule, all power, and all might.
Christ must rule until He defeats all His enemies.
The last enemy to be ended is death.
The Bible says, “God gave Christ power over all things.” But when it says “all things,” it does not mean God. God is the One who gave Christ that power.
When Christ has power over all things, then the Son Himself will be under God. God gave Christ power over all things. Then God will be everything to everyone.
What will people do who are baptized for those who died? If dead people do not rise, why are they baptized for them?
And why do we put ourselves in danger every hour?
Brothers and sisters, I face death every day. I am proud of you because of Christ Jesus our Lord.
If I fought wild animals in Ephesus for human reasons, what good is it to me? If dead people do not rise, then, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
Do not be fooled. Bad friends ruin good habits.
Think clearly and do what is right. Stop sinning. Some of you do not know God. I say this to shame you.
But someone will ask, “How are dead people raised? What kind of body will they have?”
You foolish person! What you plant does not live unless it dies first.
When you plant, you do not plant the full plant. You plant a bare seed. It may be wheat or something else.
But God gives it the body He wants. He gives each seed its own body.
Not all bodies are the same. People have one kind. Animals have another. Birds have another. Fish have another.
There are bodies in heaven and bodies on earth. The glory of the heavenly bodies is one kind. The glory of the earthly bodies is another kind.
The sun has one glory. The moon has another. The stars have another. Even stars are different in glory.
It is the same with rising from the dead. What is buried breaks down. What is raised will never break down.
It is planted in shame. It is raised in glory. It is planted in weakness. It is raised in power.
It is planted as a natural body. It is raised as a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
The Bible says, “The first man, Adam, became a living being.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
The spiritual did not come first. The natural came first. Then the spiritual came.
The first man was made from dust. The second man came from heaven.
People made from dust are like the man made from dust. People from heaven are like the man from heaven.
We were like the man made from dust. We will be like the man from heaven.
I tell you this, brothers and sisters: human bodies cannot take God's kingdom. What wears out cannot take what lasts forever.
Listen! I tell you a secret. Not all of us will die. But all of us will be changed.
It will happen in a flash. It will happen in the blink of an eye. The last trumpet will sound. The dead will rise and never die again. And we will be changed.
This dying body must receive life that never dies. This body that can die must receive life that lasts forever.
When this dying body receives life that never dies, then these words will come true: “Death has lost its power.”
“Death, where is your win? Death, where is your pain?”
The pain of death is sin. The power of sin is the law.
But thanks be to God! He gives us the win through our Lord Jesus Christ.
So, dear brothers and sisters, stand strong. Do not move away. Always do more and more in the Lord's work. You know that your work for the Lord is not wasted.
Now about the money you collect for God's people. Do what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
On the first day of each week, each of you should set aside some money. Save it up if things go well for you. Then I will not have to collect money when I come.
When I get there, I will send people you choose with letters. They will take your gift to Jerusalem.
If it is right for me to go too, they can go with me.
I will come to you after I travel through Macedonia. Yes, I am going through Macedonia.
Maybe I will stay with you for a while, or even spend the winter. Then you can help me on my way to where I go next.
I do not want to see you now for just a short time. I hope to stay with you longer, if the Lord lets me.
But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.
A great chance to do good work has opened up for me there, but many people are against me.
If Timothy comes, make sure he is not afraid with you. He does the Lord's work, just like I do.
No one should look down on him. Send him on his way in peace, so he can come to me. I am waiting for him with the brothers.
Now about our brother Apollos. I asked him many times to come to you with the brothers. He did not want to come now, but he will come when he has time.
Be on guard. Stand strong in your faith. Be brave. Be strong.
You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to believe. They gave themselves to serving God's people. I ask you, brothers and sisters,
to follow the lead of people like them, and of everyone who works hard to help.
I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus came. They made up for what you could not do.
They made my spirit and your spirit feel better. So respect people like them.
The churches in Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla send you many greetings in the Lord. So does the church that meets in their house.
All the brothers and sisters send you greetings. Greet each other with a holy kiss.
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand.
If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be cursed. Our Lord, come!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
My love is with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, sent by God's will, and Timothy our brother, write to God's church in Corinth. We also write to all God's people in Achaia.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Praise God! He is the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. He is the Father who shows mercy. He is the God who gives comfort.
He comforts us when we have trouble. Then we can comfort others in any trouble. We use the comfort God gave us.
Christ suffered, and His suffering comes to us. But through Christ, God's comfort comes to us too, and it is even more.
If we are in trouble, it is to help you. It brings you comfort and saves you. If God comforts us, it is also to help you. It helps you stay strong when you suffer the same things we suffer.
Our hope for you is strong. We know this: as you share our suffering, you also share God's comfort.
Brothers, we want you to know about the trouble we had in Asia. It was very hard. It was more than we could handle. We even thought we might die.
We thought we were going to die. This taught us not to trust ourselves. We trust God instead. He raises the dead.
He saved us from great danger of death. He will save us again. We put our hope in Him.
You help us by praying for us. Then many people will thank God for the gift He gave us. They will thank Him because many prayed.
We are proud of this. Our own hearts tell us it is true. We lived in this world in a holy and honest way before God. We did this even more with you. We did not use human wisdom. We used God's grace.
We write only what you can read and understand. I hope you will understand us fully.
You already understand us a little. We are proud of you, just as you will be proud of us on the day of our Lord Jesus.
Because I trusted this, I wanted to visit you first. Then you would have a second blessing.
I planned to go through you to Macedonia. Then I would come back to you from Macedonia. Then you would send me to Judea.
Did I make this plan lightly? Do I plan like people do in this world? Do I say yes and then no?
But God is faithful. Our message to you is not yes and no.
God's Son, Jesus Christ, was preached to you by us. Silvanus, Timothy, and I preached Him. He is not yes and no. In Him, the answer is always yes.
All of God's promises are yes in Him. So through Him we say Amen to God's glory.
God makes us strong with you in Christ. He chose us for His work.
He put His mark on us. He gave us the Holy Spirit in our hearts. The Spirit is our promise of more to come.
I ask God to be my witness. I did not come to Corinth again because I wanted to spare you.
We do not rule over your faith. We work with you for your joy. You stand strong by faith.
I decided not to come back to you in sadness.
If I make you sad, who can make me happy? Only the people I made sad.
I wrote so that when I came, I would not be sad because of the people who should make me happy. I trust all of you. I know my joy is your joy too.
I wrote with many tears. I was very sad and worried. I did not write to make you sad. I wrote so you would know how much I love you.
If someone made you sad, he did not make only me sad. He made all of you sad, at least a little. I am not saying this to be too hard on you.
The punishment that most of you gave him is enough.
Now you should forgive him and comfort him. Do not let too much sadness crush him.
So I ask you to show him love.
I wrote to see if you would obey in everything.
If you forgive someone, I forgive him too. What I forgive, I forgive for you, with Christ watching.
We do this so Satan will not trick us. We know his plans.
When I came to Troas to tell the good news about Christ, the Lord opened a door for me.
But I had no peace in my spirit. I did not find Titus, my brother. So I said goodbye and went to Macedonia.
Thanks be to God! He always leads us in victory in Christ. He uses us to spread the smell of knowing Him everywhere.
We are like a sweet smell of Christ to God. We are that smell to people who are being saved and to people who are lost.
To some, it smells like death leading to death. To others, it smells like life leading to life. Who is able to do this?
We are not like many who sell God's word for money. We speak in Christ. We speak honestly before God. We speak as people sent by God.
Are we starting to talk about how good we are again? Do we need letters that say we are good, like some people do? Do we need those letters to come to you or from you?
You are our letter. It is written in our hearts. Everyone knows it and reads it.

You show that you are a letter from Christ. We helped write it. It is not written with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God. It is not written on stone tablets, but on the soft hearts of people.
We have this kind of trust in God through Christ.
We are not able to do this by ourselves. We cannot take the credit. God gives us the power to do it.
God made us able to be helpers of a new agreement. It is not about written rules. It is about the Spirit. The written rules bring death, but the Spirit gives life.
The old way brought death. It was written on stone. It came with glory. The people of Israel could not look at Moses' face because it was so bright. That bright glory was fading away.
So the Spirit's way will have even greater glory.
If the old way that brought punishment had glory, then the new way that makes people right with God has much greater glory.
What had glory then does not seem great now. The new glory is so much greater.
If the old way that was fading had glory, then the new way that lasts has much greater glory.
We have this hope. So we speak with great courage.
We are not like Moses. He put a veil over his face. He did this so the people of Israel would not see the glory fade.
But their minds were closed. Even today, the same veil is there when people read the old agreement. It has not been taken away. It is taken away only in Christ.
Even today, when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
But when someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
The Lord is the Spirit. Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
We all have unveiled faces. We see the Lord's glory. We are being changed to look like Him. We go from glory to glory. This comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
God was kind to us. He gave us this work. So we do not give up.
We do not hide shameful things. We do not use tricks. We do not twist God's word. We show the truth clearly. We want all people to see that we are true. God sees us too.
If our good news is hidden, it is hidden from people who are lost.
The god of this world has blinded their minds. They cannot see the light of the good news. It shows the glory of Christ. Christ is the image of God.
We do not tell people about ourselves. We tell about Jesus Christ as Lord. We are your servants because of Jesus.
God said, "Let light shine out of darkness." He made His light shine in our hearts. This light helps us know God's glory. We see that glory in Jesus Christ.
We have this treasure in clay jars. God's great power is shown. It does not come from us.
We are pushed hard, but we are not crushed. We are confused, but we do not give up.
People chase us, but God does not leave us. We are knocked down, but we are not destroyed.
We carry Jesus' death in our bodies. We do this so Jesus' life can show in our bodies.
We who are alive are always handed over to death because of Jesus. This is so Jesus' life can show in our weak bodies.
So death works in us, but life works in you.
It is written, "I believed, so I spoke." We have the same spirit of faith. We believe too, so we speak.
We know God raised the Lord Jesus. He will raise us too. He will bring us to stand with you.
All this is for your sake. God's grace is growing. More and more people will thank Him. This brings glory to God.
So we do not give up. Our outer person is wearing away. But our inner person is made new day by day.
Our troubles are light and short. They make for us a glory that lasts forever. It is far greater than all our troubles.
We do not look at what we can see. We look at what we cannot see. What we see does not last. What we cannot see lasts forever.
We know this: If our body, like a tent on earth, is taken down, we have a home from God. It is a house in heaven that lasts forever. God made it. Human hands did not make it.
In this tent we groan. We want to put on our home from heaven.
When we put it on, we will not be found with no clothes.
While we are in this tent, we groan and feel heavy. We do not want to take off our clothes. We want to put on new clothes. Then our dying body will be filled with life.
God made us for this. He gave us His Spirit as a promise.
So we are always brave. We know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
We live by faith, not by what we see.
We are brave and would rather be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
So we try hard to please Him, whether we are at home or away.
We must all stand before Christ and be judged. Each of us will get what is right for what we did in the body, good or bad.
Because we know the Lord should be feared, we try to help people believe. God sees who we really are. I hope you see it in your hearts too.
We are not trying to make you praise us again. We are giving you a reason to be proud of us. Then you can answer people who brag about how they look, not about their hearts.
If we seem crazy, it is for God. If we are in our right mind, it is for you.
Christ's love pushes us to do this. We believe this: One died for all, so all died.
He died for all so that people who live will not live for themselves. They will live for Him who died for them and rose again.
So from now on we do not look at people just by what we see on the outside. Even if we once knew Christ in a human way, we do not know Him that way now.
So if anyone is in Christ, he is a new person. The old things are gone. Look, new things have come!
All this comes from God. He made us right with Himself through Christ. He gave us the job of helping others be made right with Him.
God was making the whole world right with Himself in Christ. He did not count people's wrongs against them. He gave us the message that brings people back to Him.
So we speak for Christ. It is like God is asking you through us. We ask you for Christ: “Be made right with God.”
God made Him, who never sinned, to take our sin for us. He did this so that in Him we might be right with God.
We work with God. We beg you not to take God's gift for nothing.
God says, "I heard you at the right time. I helped you on the day I saved you." Look, now is the right time. Look, now is the day God saves you.
We do not want to upset anyone, so no one can blame our work.
But as God's servants, we show who we are in every way: in great patience, in troubles, in hard times, and in worry.
We show it in beatings, in jail, in fights, in hard work, in sleepless nights, and in hunger.
We show it in pure living, in knowing what is true, in being patient, in being kind, in the Holy Spirit, and in true love.
We show it in true words, in God's power, and in the tools of right living for our right and left hands.
We are praised and shamed. People speak badly of us and speak well of us. They call us liars, but we tell the truth.
People do not know us, but God knows us. We seem to be dying, but look, we live. We are punished, but not killed.
We are sad, but always happy. We are poor, but we make many people rich. We have nothing, but we own everything.
Corinthians, we have spoken openly to you. Our heart is wide open to you.
You are not held back by us. You are held back by your own feelings.
I speak to you as to children. Open wide your hearts too.
Do not be tied to people who do not believe. What do right living and wrong living share? What do light and dark share?
What agreement can Christ have with Belial? What part does a believer have with an unbeliever?
What agreement can God's house have with false gods? We are the house of the living God. God said, "I will live in them. I will walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be My people."
So the Lord says, "Come out from among them and be separate. Do not touch anything that is not clean, and I will take you in."
He says, "I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters," says the Lord Almighty.
So, dear friends, since we have these promises, let us clean ourselves from every bad thing that hurts our bodies and spirits. Let us live holy lives because we respect God.
Open your hearts to us. We have not hurt anyone. We have not ruined anyone. We have not cheated anyone.
I do not say this to blame you. I already told you that you are in our hearts. We are ready to live and die with you.
I speak very freely to you. I am very proud of you. I am full of comfort. I am very happy even when we have troubles.
When we came to Macedonia, our bodies had no rest. We had troubles all around. People fought us from outside, and we were afraid inside.
But God, who comforts sad people, comforted us when Titus came.
God comforted us not just when Titus came. Titus also told us how you comforted him. He told us that you miss us, that you were sad, and that you care about me. This made me very happy.
Even if my letter made you sad, I do not regret it. For a little while I was sorry because my letter made you sad. But it was only for a short time.
Now I am happy. I am not happy because you were sad. I am happy because your sadness led you to change your hearts. You were sad in a way that pleases God. So you did not lose anything because of us.
Sadness that comes from God leads to a change of heart that helps you be saved. You will not be sorry for that. But sadness that comes from the world leads to death.

Look at what this sadness from God has done in you. It gave you a strong desire to do right. It made you want to clear your name. It made you angry at the wrong. It made you afraid. It made you miss us. It made you care about me. It made you want the wrong to be punished. In every way, you showed that you are clean in this matter.

So when I wrote to you, I did not write just for the person who did wrong. I did not write just for the person who was hurt. I wrote so that you could see how much you care about us, and God could see it too.
So we are comforted. We were also very happy to see Titus so happy, because all of you made his heart feel better.
I told Titus good things about you, and I was not ashamed. Everything we told you was true. So what we said about you to Titus was true too.
He loves you even more now. He remembers how all of you obeyed. You welcomed him with respect and fear.
I am happy that I can trust you completely.
Now we want you to know about the grace God gave to the churches in Macedonia.
Even in hard trouble, their great joy and deep poverty led to rich giving.
I can tell you they gave as much as they could, and even more. They chose to give on their own.
They begged us to let them share in this grace and help God's people.
They did more than we hoped. First they gave themselves to the Lord, and then to us, by God's will.
So we asked Titus to finish this grace among you too, since he started it.
You do well in everything: faith, speaking, knowledge, eagerness, and love. So do well in this grace too.
I am not giving an order. I am testing if your love is real by comparing it with how eager others are.
You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. He was rich, but He became poor for you, so that by His poverty you might become rich.
Here is my advice: it is good for you. Last year you were first not only to do this work but also to want to do it.
Now finish it, so that your eager desire to do it is matched by your finishing it, with what you have.
If the eagerness is there, the gift is accepted based on what you have, not on what you do not have.
I do not mean that others should have an easy time and you should have a hard time. I mean fairness.
Right now, your plenty can meet their need, so that later their plenty can meet your need. Then there will be fairness.
It is written, "The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little."
Thanks be to God, who put the same eagerness for you into Titus's heart.
He not only accepted our urging, but because he was very eager, he went to you on his own.
We sent with him the brother who is praised in all the churches for the gospel.
Not only that, but the churches chose him to travel with us with this grace we manage, to bring glory to the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness.
We are careful so that no one will blame us about this large gift we manage.
We want to do what is right not only before the Lord but also before people.
We sent with them our brother whom we have often tested and found eager in many things. Now he is even more eager because of his great trust in you.
As for Titus, he is my partner and helper for you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches and bring glory to Christ.
So show them, in front of the churches, proof of your love and of our praise for you.
I do not need to write much about helping God's people.
I know you are ready to give. I even brag about you to the people in Macedonia. I tell them that Achaia has been ready since last year. Your excitement made many others want to give too.
But I sent our friends ahead. I did not want our bragging to be empty. I want you to be ready, like I said.
What if people from Macedonia come with me and find you not ready? Then we would feel ashamed. You would too, because we trusted you.
So I asked our friends to go first. They will help get your promised gift ready. I want it to be a real blessing, not something from greed.
Remember this: A farmer who plants only a little will gather only a little. A farmer who plants a lot will gather a lot.
Each person should give what he chose in his heart. Do not give because you feel sad or because someone forces you. God loves a giver who is happy to give.
God can give you more than enough kindness. Then you will always have what you need. You will have plenty to do every good work.
The Bible says, "He gave freely to the poor. His good ways last forever."
God gives seed to the farmer and bread to eat. He will give you seed too. He will make it grow. He will make your good works grow.
God will make you rich in every way so you can share. Then many people will thank God because of us.
This gift helps God's people. It fills what they need. It also makes many people thank God.
This gift shows that you obey the good news about Christ. It also shows that you share with them and with everyone. People will praise God for this.
They will pray for you. They long to see you because God has given you so much kindness.
Thank God for His gift that is too great to tell!
I, Paul, ask you to be gentle and kind, like Christ. I am not proud when I am with you, but I am strong when I am away.
I pray that when I am with you, I will not have to be tough. I plan to be tough with people who think we live only for this world.
We live in human bodies, but we do not fight the way the world fights.
Our weapons are not human weapons. God's power makes them strong. They can break down strong walls.
We tear down wrong ideas and proud thoughts that stand against knowing God. We make every thought obey Christ.
We are ready to punish anyone who does not obey, once you fully obey.
You look at what is on the outside. If someone thinks he belongs to Christ, he should think again. We belong to Christ just as much.
Even if I talk more about the power the Lord gave us to build you up, not to tear you down, I will not be embarrassed.
I do not want you to think my letters are meant to scare you.
Some people say, "His letters are strong, but when he is with us, he is weak, and his words are not worth much."
People who say that should know this: when we are away, our words in letters are strong, and when we are with you, our actions are strong too.
We do not dare to put ourselves with people who praise themselves. They compare themselves only to themselves, and that shows they do not understand.
But we will not brag about things too big for us. We will stay in the work God gave us, and that work reaches to you.
We are not doing more than our work, as if we had not come to you. We were the first to bring the good news about Christ to you.
We do not brag about other people's work. We hope that as you trust God more, our work with you will grow because of you.
Then we can tell the good news in lands beyond you. We will not brag about work someone else already did.
But, "If someone brags, he should brag about the Lord."
It is not the person who praises himself who is accepted. It is the person the Lord praises.
I wish you would put up with a little of my foolish talk. You already do.
I care about you the way God cares. I promised to give you to Christ like a pure bride.
But I am afraid the snake tricked Eve, and your minds may be led away from true love for Christ.
If someone comes and tells about a different Jesus, or a different spirit, or a different good news, you put up with it too easily.
I do not think I am less than the best apostles.
I may not speak well, but I know a lot. We showed you this in every way.
Did I do wrong by lowering myself so you could be lifted up?
I took money from other churches to serve you.
When I was with you and needed things, I did not bother anyone. The brothers from Macedonia filled my need. I kept myself from being a burden to you in every way, and I will keep doing that.
As Christ's truth is in me, no one in Achaia will stop me from boasting about this.
Do I not love you? God knows I do.
I will keep doing what I do. I want to stop those who look for a chance to boast that they are like us.
They are false apostles. They trick people. They pretend to be Christ's apostles.
Even Satan pretends to be an angel of light.
So it is no surprise if his helpers pretend to be helpers of what is right. Their end will match their works.
I say again, do not think I am a fool. But if you do, accept me as a fool so I can boast a little.
What I say in this proud way is not how the Lord would speak, but like a fool.
Since many boast about human things, I will boast too.
You gladly put up with fools because you think you are wise!
You put up with anyone who makes you slaves, eats your food, takes your money, acts proud, or hits you in the face.
I say this to my shame: We were too weak to do that! But whatever anyone else dares to boast about, I dare to boast about too. (I am speaking like a fool.)
Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they from Abraham's family? So am I.
Are they Christ's servants? I am talking like a crazy person, but I am more. I have worked harder. I have been in jail more. I have been beaten more. I have faced death many times.
Five times I got 39 lashes from the Jews.
Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the sea.
I have traveled often. I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, Gentiles, cities, empty places, the sea, and false brothers.
I have worked hard and toiled. I have often gone without sleep. I have been hungry and thirsty. I have often gone without food. I have been cold and without clothes.
Besides all this, every day I feel pressure and worry about all the churches.
Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with anger?
If I must boast, I will boast about the things that show my weakness.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is praised forever, knows I am not lying.
In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the city to catch me.
But I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and I escaped his hands.
I must keep bragging, even though it does not help. I will tell about visions and things the Lord showed me.
I know a man who belongs to Christ. Fourteen years ago, he was taken up to the third heaven. I do not know if he was in his body or not. God knows.
I know that this man was taken up. I do not know if it was in his body or not. God knows.
He was taken to Paradise. He heard things that no one can say. People are not allowed to talk about them.
I will brag about that man. But I will not brag about myself, except about my weak times.
If I wanted to brag, I would not be foolish, because I would tell the truth. But I hold back, so no one thinks I am more than what they see in me or hear from me.
I saw very special things. So I was given a thorn in my body. It is like a messenger from Satan. It bothers me so I will not get proud.
Three times I asked the Lord to take it away.
But He said to me, "My grace is enough for you. My power works best when you are weak." So I will brag even more about my weak times. Then Christ's power can rest on me.
For Christ's sake, I am okay with weak times, insults, hard times, people chasing me, and trouble. When I am weak, then I am strong.
I have been a foolish man! You made me do it. You should have said good things about me. I was not less than those who say they are great apostles, even though I am nothing.
The signs of a true apostle were done among you. There were signs and wonders and strong works. I did them with great patience.
What did you have less than the other churches? Only this: I did not cost you money. Forgive me for that wrong.
Look, I am ready to come to you a third time. I will not be a trouble to you. I do not want what you have. I want you. Children do not save up for their parents. Parents save up for their children.
I will gladly spend my money and myself for your souls. If I love you more, will you love me less?
But even so, I did not cost you money. You say, "I was tricky, so I caught you by a trick."
Did I take advantage of you through anyone I sent to you?
I asked Titus to go, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not walk in the same Spirit? Did we not follow the same steps?
Have you thought all this time that we are defending ourselves to you? We speak in Christ, in front of God, and all of it is to help you grow.
I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I want. You may not find me as you want. I am afraid there may be fighting, jealousy, anger, selfish groups, mean talk, gossip, pride, and mess.

I am afraid that when I come again, my God may humble me in front of you. I may have to be sad for many who sinned before and did not say sorry. They did not turn away from their dirty sins, sexual sins, and wild living.
This is the third time I am coming to you. Every wrong thing must be proven by two or three people who saw it.
I already told you when I was there the second time. Now I tell you again while I am away. I warn the ones who sinned before and everyone else. If I come again, I will not be gentle with them.
Since you want proof that Christ speaks through me, know this. He is not weak with you. He is strong in you.
He was weak when He died on the cross. But He lives by God’s power. We are weak too. But we will live with Him by God’s power for you.
Look at yourselves. Are you still in the faith? Test yourselves. Do you not know that Jesus Christ is in you? Unless you fail the test.
I hope you know we have not failed the test.
I pray to God that you do no wrong. I do not pray this so we look good. I pray it so you do what is right. Even if we look like we failed.
We cannot work against the truth. We can only work for the truth.
We are glad when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray that you be made whole.
That is why I write this while I am away. I do not want to be hard on you when I am there. The Lord gave me power to build you up, not tear you down.
Finally, brothers and sisters, be happy. Fix what is wrong. Take heart. Think the same. Live in peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.
Greet each other with a holy kiss.
All of God’s holy people say hello to you.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the sharing of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
Paul is a special messenger. He did not get this job from people. He got it through Jesus Christ and God the Father. God raised Jesus from the dead.
All the brothers with me say hello to the churches in Galatia.
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
Jesus gave Himself for our sins. He did this to save us from this evil world. He did it because it was what God our Father wanted.
Give glory to God forever and ever. Amen.
I am amazed! You are turning away so fast from the God who called you by the grace of Christ. Now you follow a different good news.
It is not really another good news. Some people are troubling you. They want to change the good news about Christ.
But even if we or an angel from heaven tells you a different good news, let that one be cursed.
We said this before. I say it again now. If anyone tells you a different good news, let that one be cursed.
Am I now trying to please people or God? If I still tried to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.
I want you to know, brothers, that the good news I told you did not come from people.
No person gave it to me. No person taught it to me. Jesus Christ showed it to me.
You heard about my old life in the Jewish faith. I hurt God's church very much. I tried to destroy it.
I was doing better than many people my age in the Jewish faith. I worked very hard to follow the old ways of my people.
But God chose me before I was born. He called me by His grace.
God was happy to show His Son to me. He wanted me to tell people who are not Jews about Him. I did not go ask people what to do.
I did not go to Jerusalem to see the special messengers who were there before me. I went to Arabia. Then I went back to Damascus.
After three years, I went to Jerusalem. I visited Peter. I stayed with him for fifteen days.
I did not see any other special messengers. I only saw James, the Lord's brother.
I am writing this to you. God sees me. I am not lying.
Then I went to the areas of Syria and Cilicia.
The churches in Judea that belong to Christ did not know me in person yet.
They only heard people say, "The man who used to hurt us is now teaching the faith he once tried to destroy."
They praised God because of me.
Fourteen years later, I went up to Jerusalem again. Barnabas came with me. I took Titus too.
I went because God showed me to go. I told the leaders the good news I preach to non-Jews. I told it to the important men alone. I did not want my work to be for nothing.
Titus was with me. He was Greek. But no one made him get the Jewish mark.
Some false brothers sneaked in. They came to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus. They wanted to make us slaves.
We did not give in to them, not even for a minute. We did this so the true good news would stay with you.
The men who seemed important did not add anything to my message. It does not matter who they were. God does not play favorites.
Instead, they saw that God gave me the job of telling the good news to non-Jews. Peter had the same job for the Jews.
The same God who worked through Peter for the Jews also worked through me for other nations.
James, Peter, and John seemed like strong leaders. They saw the gift God gave me. They shook hands with Barnabas and me. They agreed we would go to non-Jews. They would go to the Jews.
They only asked us to remember poor people. I was already glad to do that.
Later, Peter came to Antioch. I stood up to him face to face. He was wrong.
Before some men came from James, Peter ate with non-Jews. But when those men came, he pulled back. He stayed away from them. He was afraid of the Jewish believers who wanted the Jewish mark.
The other Jewish believers followed him. Even Barnabas was led away by their fake acting.
I saw they were not living by the true good news. So I said to Peter in front of everyone, "If you are a Jew but live like a non-Jew, how can you make non-Jews live like Jews?"
We are Jews by birth. We are not sinners from other nations.

But we know that no one is made right with God by doing what the law says. We are made right by faith in Jesus Christ. So we believed in Christ Jesus. We did this so we could be made right by faith in Christ, not by doing what the law says. No one will be made right by doing what the law says.
We try to be made right in Christ. What if we still look like sinners? Does that mean Christ helps sin? No way!
If I put back what I took down, I show I break the rules.
The law killed my old way. Now I live for God.
I was nailed to the cross with Christ. I do not live anymore. Christ lives in me. The life I live now in my body, I live by faith in the Son of God. He loved me and gave Himself for me.
I do not throw away God's grace. If people could be made right by the law, then Christ died for nothing.
You silly Galatians! Who tricked you? You saw Jesus Christ shown as nailed to a cross right before your eyes.
I want to ask you one thing. Did you get God's Spirit by doing the law, or by hearing and trusting?
Are you that silly? You started with God's Spirit. Now are you trying to finish by your own strength?
Did you go through all that for nothing? I hope it was not for nothing.
Does God give you His Spirit and do great works among you because you do the law, or because you hear and trust?
Abraham trusted God. God counted that as right with Him.
So know this: people who trust are Abraham's children.
Long ago, God's Book showed that God would make all nations right with Him by trust. So it told Abraham the good news: "All nations will be blessed through you."
So people who trust are blessed with Abraham, the man who trusted.
But people who try to be right by doing the law are under a curse. God's Book says, "Cursed is everyone who does not keep doing all that is written in the law book."
It is clear that no one becomes right with God by the law. God's Book says, "The one who is right will live by trust."
The law is not based on trust. It says, "The one who does these things will live by them."
Christ set us free from the law's curse. He became a curse for us. God's Book says, "Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree."
He did this so Abraham's blessing could come to all nations through Christ Jesus. Then we could get the promised Spirit by trusting.
Brothers, here is a human example. Once a person's agreement is made strong, no one throws it out or adds to it.
God's promises were given to Abraham and to his family line. It does not say "and to families," like many. It says "and to your family line," like one. That one is Christ.
Here is what I mean. The law came 430 years later. It does not cancel the agreement God made before. So it cannot take away the promise.
If we get what God promised by the law, then it is not by promise anymore. But God gave it to Abraham as a gift through a promise.

Then why was the law given? It was added because people broke God's rules. It lasted until the family line came, the one the promise was about. The law was given through angels and put into effect by a middle man.
A middle man stands between two sides. But God is one.
So is the law against God's promises? No, not at all! If a law had been given that could give life, then we would become right with God by the law.
But God's Book put everyone under sin's power. It did this so the promise could be given to those who trust in Jesus Christ.
Before trust came, we were locked up by the law. We were held there until trust was shown.
So the law was our guide until Christ came. It helped us become right with God by trusting.
Now that trust has come, we are not under that guide anymore.
You are all God's children through trust in Christ Jesus.
All of you who were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
There is no Jew or Greek. There is no slave or free person. There is no male or female. You are all one in Christ Jesus.
If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's family line. You will get the promise.
I say this: While a child who will get everything is still young, he is like a slave. He owns it all, but he must obey the adults who care for him until his father says it is time.
He is under those adults until the time his father set.
In the same way, when we were young, we were slaves to the basic things of this world.
But when the right time came, God sent His Son. He was born from a woman. He was born under the law.
He did this to set free the people under the law. Then we could become God's children.
Because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into your hearts. The Spirit cries, "Abba, Father."
So you are not a slave anymore. You are a son. And if you are a son, you are also one who will get what God gives.
Before, you did not know God. You served things that are not really gods.
But now you know God. Even more, God knows you. So why do you turn back to weak and poor things? Do you want to be slaves to them again?
You watch days, months, times, and years.
I am afraid for you. I hope my work for you was not for nothing.
Brothers, I beg you, become like me. I became like you. You did not hurt me.
You know I first told you the good news because I was weak in my body.
You did not look down on my body's trouble. You did not spit at me. Instead, you welcomed me like an angel of God, like Christ Jesus.
Where is that happy feeling you had? I can say this: If you could, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
Have I become your enemy because I tell you the truth?
Those people want you, but not for a good reason. They want to shut you out so you will want them.
It is good to want good things always, not only when I am with you.
My children, I feel pain for you again. I will keep feeling pain until Christ shows in you.
I wish I could be with you now. I would talk in a different way. I do not know what to do about you.
Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not hear the law?
It is written that Abraham had two sons. One was from a slave woman. One was from a free woman.
The son from the slave woman was born in the normal way. The son from the free woman was born because of God's promise.
These things are a picture. The two women are like two special promises. One promise is from Mount Sinai. It gives birth to slaves. This is Hagar.
Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia. She is like the city of Jerusalem now. She and her children are slaves.
But the Jerusalem in heaven is free. She is our mother.
It is written, "Be happy, woman who has no children. Shout and cry out, woman who has never had pain. The children of the desert will be more than the children of the woman who has a husband."
Brothers, you are children of the promise, like Isaac.
Back then, the son born in the normal way hurt the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
But what does the writing say? "Send away the slave woman and her son. The slave woman's son will not share the family gift with the free woman's son."
So, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman. We are children of the free woman.
Christ set you free so you could be free. So stand strong. Do not let anyone put the heavy chain of slavery on you again.
Listen, I, Paul, tell you this: If you get circumcised, Christ will not help you at all.
I say again to every man who gets circumcised: You must obey the whole law.
You who try to be right with God by following the law have been cut off from Christ. You have fallen away from His grace.
But we wait with hope for God to make us right. We wait by faith and with the help of the Spirit.
In Christ Jesus, being circumcised or not does not matter. What matters is faith that works through love.
You were doing well. Who stopped you from obeying the truth?
That kind of talk does not come from God, who called you.
A little bad teaching can spread to many people.
I trust the Lord that you will not think differently. The person who is troubling you will be punished, no matter who it is.
Brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still being hurt for my faith? Then no one would be upset by the message of the cross.
I wish those troublemakers would leave you alone forever.
You were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to do wrong. Instead, serve each other with love.
The whole law is summed up in one command: "Love your neighbor as you love yourself."
If you fight and hurt each other, watch out, or you will destroy each other.
So I say, live by the Spirit, and you will not do what your sinful nature wants.
Your sinful nature wants what the Spirit does not want. The Spirit wants what your sinful nature does not want. They fight against each other, so you do not do what you want.
But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
The wrong things people do are clear: sexual sins, impure acts, and wild living.
They include worshiping false gods, witchcraft, hatred, fighting, jealousy, anger, selfish ambition, divisions, and groups that split people.
They also include envy, getting drunk, wild parties, and other things like these. I warn you, as I warned you before, that people who do these things will not be part of God's kingdom.
But the Spirit gives these good things: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, and faithfulness.
He also gives gentleness and self-control. There is no law against these things.
People who belong to Christ Jesus have put their sinful nature to death, along with its wrong wants and feelings.
If we live by the Spirit, let us also follow the Spirit.
Let us not become proud. Let us not provoke each other or envy each other.
Brothers, if someone is caught in a sin, you who follow the Spirit should help that person. Be gentle. Watch yourself so you won't be tempted too.
Carry each other's heavy loads. In this way you obey the law of Christ.
If someone thinks he is important but he is not, he tricks himself.
Each person should check his own work. Then he can be proud of himself. He should not compare himself to others.
Each person will carry his own load.
The one who learns God's word should share good things with the one who teaches.
Don't be fooled. God is not fooled. A person gets back what he plants.
If he plants for his sinful self, he will get ruin. If he plants for the Spirit, he will get life that lasts forever.
Let us not get tired of doing good. At the right time we will get a good crop if we don't give up.
So while we have time, let us do good to everyone. Let us do extra good to those who believe.
See how big my letters are. I write to you with my own hand.
Some people want to look good to others. They push you to be circumcised. They do this so they won't be hurt because of the cross of Christ.
Even those who are circumcised don't keep the law. They want you circumcised so they can brag about your body.
I don't want to brag about anything but the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of that cross, the world no longer matters to me, and I no longer matter to the world.
Being circumcised or not being circumcised doesn't matter. What matters is being made new.
Peace and mercy be on all who follow this rule. Peace and mercy be on God's people Israel too.
From now on, don't trouble me. I carry the marks of Jesus on my body.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
I am Paul. God made me an apostle of Christ Jesus. I write to God’s holy people in Ephesus. You believe in Christ Jesus.
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! He has blessed us with every good gift from heaven through Christ.
Before God made the world, He chose us in Christ. He chose us to be holy and without blame before Him. He did this because He loves us.
He planned ahead of time to make us His children through Jesus Christ. This was what He wanted to do.
So we praise His glorious grace. He gave us this grace freely in His loved Son.
Through Christ’s blood, we are set free. Our sins are forgiven. This is because God is so rich in grace.
He gave us so much grace, along with wisdom and understanding.
He let us know His secret plan. He was pleased to do this through Christ.
When the time is right, God will bring everything together under Christ. This includes things in heaven and things on earth.
In Christ, we were chosen. God planned this ahead of time. He works everything by His own plan.
We were the first to hope in Christ. We live to praise His glory.
You also heard the true message. It is the good news that saves you. You believed in Christ. Then God marked you with the Holy Spirit He promised.
The Holy Spirit is God’s promise that we will receive what He has saved for us. He will finish setting us free. This brings praise to His glory.
I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus. I heard about your love for all God’s people.
So I never stop thanking God for you. I always remember you when I pray.
I pray that God, the Father of glory, will give you wisdom. May He show you more about Himself. He is the God of our Lord Jesus Christ.
I pray that your hearts will be filled with light. Then you will know the hope He calls you to. You will know how rich and glorious His gift is to His people.
I pray you will know His great power for us who believe. It is the same power that works in us.
God used this power in Christ. He raised Christ from the dead. He seated Him at His right hand in heaven.
Christ is above all rulers and leaders. He is above every name. This is true now and in the future.
God put everything under Christ’s feet. He made Him head of the church.
The church is His body. It is filled with Him who fills everything.
And you were dead in your wrongs and sins.
You used to live in them, like the world around you. You followed the evil ruler of the air. His spirit works now in people who do not obey God.
We all lived like that once. We did what our bodies and minds wanted. Like everyone else, we were born under God's anger.
But God is full of mercy. He loved us with great love.
Even when we were dead in our sins, He made us alive with Christ. You are saved by grace.
He raised us up. He sat us with Christ in heaven.
He did this so that in the times to come, He could show how very rich His grace is. He shows kindness to us through Christ Jesus.
You are saved by grace through faith. This is not from yourselves. It is God's gift.
It is not from things you do. No one can brag.
We are God's work. He made us new in Christ Jesus to do good things. God planned these good things long ago for us to do.
So remember this: You were not Jews. People who are called "circumcised" called you "uncircumcised." That mark was made by hands.
At that time, you were without Christ. You were cut off from Israel. You did not share in God's promises. You had no hope. You were without God in the world.
But now, in Christ Jesus, you who were far away have been brought near by Christ's blood.
Christ Himself is our peace. He made both groups one. He broke down the wall that kept them apart.
In His body, He ended the law with its commands and rules. He did this to make one new person out of the two groups. He brought peace.
He joined both groups to God in one body through the cross. On the cross, He put their hate to death.
He came and told good news of peace to you who were far away and to those who were near.
Through Him, both of us can come to the Father by one Spirit.
So you are no longer strangers or guests. You are citizens with God's people. You belong to God's family.
You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets. Christ Jesus Himself is the most important stone.
In Him, the whole building fits together. It grows into a holy temple for the Lord.
In Him, you are being built together into a home for God by the Spirit.
Because of this, I, Paul, am in jail for following Christ Jesus. I am here for you people who are not Jews.
I hope you heard about the work God gave me. He gave me His kindness to share with you.
God showed me a secret plan. He let me know it. I wrote a little about it before.
When you read this, you can understand what I know about the secret plan of Christ.
People in other times did not know this secret. But now God has shown it to His holy apostles and prophets by the Holy Spirit.
Here is the secret: Through the good news, people who are not Jews can share the same blessings. They are part of the same body and share God's promise in Christ Jesus.
God made me a servant. He gave me this job by His kindness. His power worked in me.
I am the least important of all God's people. But God gave me this kindness. He let me tell people who are not Jews about the rich blessings of Christ. These blessings are too big to measure.
He also let me show everyone God's plan. This secret was hidden in God, who made everything.
Now God wants His many kinds of wisdom to be known. He shows it through the church. He shows it to rulers and powers in heaven.
This was God's plan from long ago. He carried it out through Christ Jesus our Lord.
Because of Him, we can come to God with courage. We can come with trust through faith in Him.
So I ask you not to lose heart because of my troubles. My troubles are for your good. They bring you honor.
Because of this, I bow my knees to the Father.
Every family in heaven and on earth gets its name from Him.
I pray that God will make you strong. He has great riches and glory. He will give you power through His Spirit in your inner self.
I pray that Christ will live in your hearts through faith. I pray that you will be rooted and built up in love.
Then you can understand, with all God's people, how wide and long and high and deep His love is.
You can know Christ's love. It is greater than all we can know. Then you will be filled with all that God has to give.
God can do much more than we ask or even think. His power works in us.
Give glory to God in the church and in Christ Jesus. Give glory to Him for all time, forever and ever. Amen.
I am in jail because I belong to the Lord. I ask you to live in a way that fits the call you got.
Be humble and gentle. Be patient. Put up with each other in love.
Work hard to keep the peace and stay together as one in the Spirit.
There is one body and one Spirit. God called you to share one hope.
There is one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
There is one God and Father of all. He is over all, through all, and in all.
But each of us got a gift of grace. Christ gave it in just the right amount.
It says, "When He went up high, He led captives away, and He gave gifts to people."
What does "He went up" mean? It means He also came down to the lower parts of the earth.
The One who came down is the same One who went up above all the heavens. He did this to fill everything.
He gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to tell the good news, and some to be pastors and teachers.
He did this to help God's people get ready to serve others and to build up Christ's body.
We keep going until we all believe the same and know God's Son. We want to grow up to be like Christ in every way.
Then we will not be little children anymore. We will not be tossed around like waves or blown by every new teaching. We will not be tricked by people who plan to fool us.
Instead, we speak the truth in love. We grow up in every way into Christ, who is the head.
The whole body is joined and held together by every part. Each part does its work. This makes the body grow and build itself up in love.
So I say this with the Lord's help: Do not live the way people who do not know God live. Their thoughts are empty.
Their minds are dark. They are cut off from God's life because they do not know Him. Their hearts are hard.
They stopped caring. They gave themselves up to doing bad things. They do every kind of wrong thing, and they always want more.
But that is not how you learned about Christ.
You heard Him. You were taught in Him. The truth is in Jesus.
You were taught to take off your old self. That old self was going bad because of wrong desires that trick you.
Let your thinking be made new.
Put on the new self. God made it to be like Him. It is right and holy and true.
So each of you must stop lying. Speak the truth to your neighbor. We are parts of the same body.
You may get angry, but do not sin. Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry.
Do not give the devil a chance.
Anyone who steals must stop stealing. He should work with his hands and do good. Then he can share with people who need help.
Do not let any bad words come out of your mouth. Say only what is good and helpful. Then your words will help the people who hear them.
Do not make God's Holy Spirit sad. He sealed you for the day you will be set free.
Get rid of all bitterness, anger, yelling, and mean talk. Put away all bad feelings.
Be kind and tender to each other. Forgive each other, just as God in Christ forgave you.
So be like God. You are His dear children.
Live with love, just as Christ loved us. He gave Himself for us. He was like a sweet-smelling gift and sacrifice to God.
Do not let sexual sin, dirty wrongs, or wanting too much even be talked about among you. God's holy people should not do these things.
Do not say dirty words. Do not talk in a silly or rude way. These things do not fit God's people. Say thanks to God instead.
Be sure of this: no one who does sexual sin, dirty wrongs, or wants too much will get a share in Christ's and God's kingdom. A greedy person worships things instead of God.
Do not let anyone trick you with words that mean nothing. God is angry at people who do not obey Him. These things bring His anger.
So do not join them in doing wrong.
You used to be in the dark. Now you are light in the Lord. Live like children of light.
Light brings all goodness, right living, and truth.
Find out what makes the Lord happy.
Do not join in the useless works of darkness. Instead, show that they are wrong.
It is shameful even to talk about what some people do in secret.
When light shines, it shows what is really there. Anything that shows the truth is like light.
That is why it says, "Wake up, you who are sleeping! Get up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
So be very careful how you live. Do not live like people who are not wise. Live like wise people.
Use your time well, because these days are bad.
So do not be foolish. Understand what the Lord wants.
Do not get drunk with wine. That leads to wild living. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
Speak to each other with psalms and songs of praise. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord.
Always give thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Be ready to serve each other out of respect for Christ.
Wives, obey your own husbands as you would obey the Lord.
The husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church. He is the Savior of the body.
Just as the church obeys Christ, wives should obey their husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her.
He did this to make her holy. He washed her with water and His word.
He did this so He could bring her to Himself as a beautiful church. She would have no spot or wrinkle or any other flaw. She would be holy and without blame.
In the same way, husbands should love their own wives as they love their own bodies. A man who loves his wife loves himself.
No one ever hated his own body. Instead, he feeds it and takes care of it. Christ does the same for the church.
We are parts of His body.
That is why it says, "A man leaves his father and mother and joins his wife. The two become one body."
This is a deep truth. I am talking about Christ and the church.
So each of you should love his wife as he loves himself. And the wife should respect her husband.
Kids, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
Honor your father and mother. This is the first command that comes with a promise.
Then things will go well for you, and you will live a long time on the earth.
Fathers, do not make your children angry. Instead, raise them with the Lord’s teaching and training.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear. Be honest in your heart, as if you were serving Christ.
Do not work only when people are watching, to make them happy. Work like servants of Christ. Do what God wants, from the heart.
Serve with a good attitude, as if you were serving the Lord, not people.
Know this: The Lord will reward each person for any good thing he does, whether he is a slave or free.
Masters, treat them the same way. Stop threatening them. Remember that both you and they have a Master in heaven. He does not play favorites.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His great power.
Put on all of God’s armor. Then you can stand against the devil’s tricks.

We are not fighting against people made of flesh and blood. We are fighting against rulers, authorities, and powers of this dark world. We are also fighting against evil spirits in the heavenly places.
So put on all of God’s armor. Then, when evil days come, you can stand your ground. After you have done all you can, keep standing.
Stand firm. Put truth around your waist like a belt. Put on the breastplate of right living.
Put shoes on your feet, ready to tell the good news of peace.
Also take the shield of faith. With it you can stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Take the helmet of salvation. Take the sword of the Spirit, which is God’s word.
Pray in the Spirit at all times. Use all kinds of prayers and requests. Stay awake and keep praying for all of God’s people.
Pray for me too. Ask that when I open my mouth, God will give me words. Then I can boldly tell the secret of the good news.
I am in chains because I tell this good news. Pray that I can speak boldly, the way I should.
Tychicus is a dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord. He will tell you everything, so you can know how I am and what I am doing.
I am sending him to you for this reason. He will tell you how we are, and he will cheer up your hearts.
Peace to all the brothers and sisters. May you have love and faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
May God’s grace be with everyone who loves our Lord Jesus Christ with a love that never ends.
Paul and Timothy, who serve Christ Jesus, send this to all of God's holy people in Christ Jesus in Philippi. We also send it to the leaders and helpers.
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
I thank my God every time I remember you.
In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy.
I thank God because you have helped spread the good news from the first day until now.
I am sure that God, who began a good work in you, will keep working in you until the day Christ Jesus comes back.

It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, because you are in my heart. You share God's grace with me. You share it while I am in chains and while I tell others about the good news and make it strong.
God knows how much I long for all of you with the love of Christ Jesus.
I pray that your love will grow more and more. I pray it will grow in knowing God and in good sense.
Then you can choose what is best. You will be pure and good until the day Christ comes.
You will be filled with the good fruit of right living. This comes through Jesus Christ and brings praise and glory to God.
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that what happened to me has helped spread the good news even more.
Everyone in the palace guard and all the others know that I am in chains for Christ.
Because of my chains, most of the brothers and sisters have become brave in the Lord. They speak God's word more bravely and without fear.
Some preach Christ because they are jealous and want to argue. But some preach Christ because they want to help.
The ones who love preach because they know I am here to tell others about the good news.
The others preach Christ to cause trouble. They are not pure. They think they can make things harder for me while I am in chains.
But what does it matter? Christ is preached in every way, whether for show or for truth. I am glad about that, and I will keep being glad.
I know this will turn out for my good. It will happen because you pray for me and because the Spirit of Jesus Christ helps me.
I hope and expect that I will not be ashamed. I hope I will be bold, as I always am, so Christ will be honored in my body. This is true whether I live or die.
For me, living is Christ, and dying is gain.
If I keep living in this body, I can do more good work. But I do not know which to choose.
I am pulled in two ways. I want to leave this life and be with Christ. That is much better.
But it is more needed for you that I stay in this body.
I am sure of this, so I know I will stay and keep helping you. I will help you grow in faith and joy.
Then, when I come to you again, you will have even more to be proud of in Christ Jesus because of me.

Live in a way that fits the good news of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you, I will know you stand strong. I will know you work together as one. You will have one spirit and one mind as you believe the good news.
Do not be afraid of those who are against you. This shows them they will be lost, but it shows you will be saved. And this comes from God.
God has given you a gift. He has given you the chance to believe in Christ and to suffer for Him.
You are fighting the same battle you saw me fight, and now you hear that I still fight.
If being in Christ helps you, if love comforts you, if you share the Spirit, if you have kind hearts and care,
then fill me with joy. Think the same way. Have the same love. Be one in heart and mind.
