Do not do things just to win or to look good. Be humble. Think others are more important than you.
Do not only look at your own needs. Look at other people's needs too.
Think the way Christ Jesus thought.
He was God, but He did not hold on to being equal with God.
Instead, He made Himself nothing. He became a servant. He became like a man.
He was found as a man. He humbled Himself. He obeyed even to death, even death on a cross.
So God lifted Him up very high. God gave Him the name above every name.
At the name of Jesus, every knee will bow. Knees in heaven, on earth, and under the earth will bow.
Every tongue will say that Jesus Christ is Lord. This brings glory to God the Father.
So, my dear friends, you obeyed when I was with you. Now obey even more when I am away. Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
For God is at work in you. He gives you the want to do good and the power to do it. This pleases Him.
Do everything without complaining or arguing.
Then you will be pure and good. You will be God's children without blame. You live among bad and crooked people. Shine like lights in the world.
Hold fast to the word of life. Then on the day of Christ, I can be proud. I will know I did not run for nothing. I did not work for nothing.
Even if my life is poured out like a drink offering on your faith, I am glad. I share joy with all of you.
You should be glad too. Share joy with me.
I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon. Then I can be cheered by news about you.
I have no one like him. He truly cares about you.
All the others look out for themselves. They do not care about Jesus Christ.
But you know Timothy. He served with me like a son with a father. He helped me share the good news.
So I hope to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.
I trust in the Lord that I will come soon too.
I think I need to send Epaphroditus to you. He is my brother, my helper, and my fellow soldier. He is also your messenger. He helped me when I needed it.
He longs to see all of you. He was upset because you heard he was sick.
He was sick, almost to death. But God had mercy on him. God had mercy on me too. I did not want more sorrow on top of sorrow.
So I am sending him even more. I want you to be glad to see him. I want to be less worried.
Welcome him in the Lord with all joy. Honor people like him.
He almost died for the work of Christ. He risked his life to make up for the help you could not give me.
Finally, my brothers and sisters, be glad in the Lord. It is not hard for me to write the same things to you again. It keeps you safe.
Watch out for those bad people. They are like dogs. They do evil work. They cut the body in a wrong way.
We are the true people who worship God by His Spirit. We are proud of Christ Jesus. We do not trust in our own bodies.
I could trust in my body too. If anyone thinks they can trust in their body, I can do it even more.
I was circumcised when I was eight days old. I am from Israel. I am from the tribe of Benjamin. I am a Hebrew, born from Hebrews. I was a Pharisee, a strict follower of the law.
I wanted so much to serve God that I hurt the church. I kept the law so well that no one could blame me.
But I used to think those things helped me. Now I see they hurt me, because of Christ.
Yes, I think everything is a loss. It is better to know Christ Jesus my Lord. Because of Him, I lost everything. I think of it like trash. I want to gain Christ.
I want to be found in Him. I do not want my own right way from the law. I want the right way that comes from God through faith in Christ.
I want to know Him. I want to know the power that raised Him from the dead. I want to share in His suffering. I want to be like Him in His death.
Then maybe I can rise from the dead too.
I have not gotten all of this yet. I am not perfect yet. But I keep going. I want to take hold of it, because Christ Jesus took hold of me.
Brothers and sisters, I do not think I have it all yet. But I do one thing. I forget what is behind me. I reach out to what is ahead.
I run toward the goal. The prize is God calling me up to heaven in Christ Jesus.
All of us who are grown up in faith should think this way. If you think something else, God will show you the truth.
But we must keep living by the truth we already have.
Brothers and sisters, follow my example. Keep your eyes on those who live like we do.
I told you many times, and now I say it with tears: many people live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
Their end is ruin. Their stomach is their god. They are proud of things they should be ashamed of. They think only about things on earth.
But we belong to heaven. We wait for a Savior from there. He is the Lord Jesus Christ.
He will change our weak bodies. They will be like His glorious body. He can do this by His power. He can put everything under His control.
So, my dear brothers and sisters, whom I love and miss, you are my joy and my crown. Stand firm in the Lord, my dear friends.
I ask Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
Yes, I ask you, my true friend, to help these women. They worked hard with me to share the good news. Clement and my other helpers worked too. Their names are in the book of life.
Always be joyful in the Lord. I say it again: Be joyful!
Let everyone see your gentle spirit. The Lord is near.
Don't worry about anything. Instead, pray about everything. Tell God your needs, and thank Him.
Then God's peace, which is greater than we can understand, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
Finally, my brothers and sisters, think about things that are true, good, right, pure, lovely, and kind. If something is excellent or worth praise, think about these things.
Do what you learned and received and heard and saw in me. Then the God of peace will be with you.
I was very happy in the Lord because you care about me again. You cared before, but you had no chance to help.
I am not saying this because I need something. I have learned to be happy with whatever I have.
I know how to live with little, and I know how to live with plenty. I have learned to be full or hungry, to have much or little.
I can do anything through Him who makes me strong.
But it was good of you to share my troubles.
And you Philippians know that when I first preached the good news and left Macedonia, only your church shared with me in giving and receiving.
Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent help for my needs more than once.
I am not asking for gifts. I want the good reward that comes to you from giving.
I have received full payment, and more. I have all I need. The gifts you sent by Epaphroditus are like a sweet smell to God. They are a sacrifice that pleases Him.
And my God will meet all your needs from His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Greet all God's people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters with me send you their greetings.
All God's people here send greetings to you, especially those in Caesar's house.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
Paul, a worker sent by Christ Jesus because God wanted it, and Timothy, our brother.
To God's holy and faithful people in Christ at Colossae: May God our Father give you grace and peace.
We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. We do this when we pray for you.
We heard about your faith in Christ Jesus. We heard about your love for all God's people.
You have this hope. It is saved for you in heaven. You heard about it before in the true message, the good news.

This good news is now with you. It is growing and bearing fruit all over the world. It is doing the same with you. It has done this since the day you heard it. It has done this since you truly knew God's grace.
You learned it from Epaphras, our dear fellow worker. He is a faithful helper of Christ for you.
He also told us about your love in the Spirit.

Because of this, since the day we heard, we have not stopped praying for you. We ask that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will. We ask that you may have spiritual wisdom and understanding.
Then you can live in a way that honors the Lord. You can please Him in every way. You can bear fruit in every good work. You can grow in knowing God.
You will be made strong with all power, by His glorious might. Then you can have great patience. You will not give up. Do this with joy.
Give thanks to the Father. He has made you able to share in the good things God gives His holy people in the light.
He has saved us from the power of darkness. He has brought us into the kingdom of His dear Son.
In Him we have freedom. Our sins are forgiven.
The Son is the image of the God we cannot see. He is first over all creation.
All things were made through Him and for Him. This includes things in heaven and on earth. It includes seen and unseen things. It includes thrones, powers, rulers, and authorities.
He is before all things. All things hold together in Him.
He is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning. He is first to rise from the dead. So He is first in everything.
God was pleased to have all of Himself live in Him.
Through Him God made peace. He brought all things back to Himself. This includes things on earth and in heaven. He did this by the blood of His cross.
Once you were far from God. You were enemies in your minds. This was because of your evil deeds.
But now God has brought you back to Himself. He did this through Christ's body and death. He wants you to be holy, without blame, and without fault before Him.

But you must keep going in your faith. Be strong and firm. Do not move away from the hope of the good news you heard. This good news was preached to all creation under heaven. I, Paul, became a helper of this good news.
Now I am glad to suffer for you. In my body, I am filling up what is still needed of Christ's sufferings. I do this for His body, the church.
I became a helper of this by God's plan. God gave me this work. I fully share God's word with you.
This secret was hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been shown to God's holy people.
God wanted to make known to the nations how great and rich this secret is. The secret is Christ in you. He is your hope of great honor.
We tell about Him. We warn every person. We teach every person with all wisdom. We want to present every person complete in Christ.
For this I work hard. I struggle with all the strength Christ gives me.
I want you to know how hard I work for you. I work for the people in Laodicea too. I work for all who have never met me face to face.
I want their hearts to be strong. I want them to love each other. I want them to understand God's big secret. That secret is Christ.
In Christ are all the hidden treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
I say this so no one tricks you with smooth words.
I am not there in body, but I am with you in spirit. I am glad to see your good order and your strong faith in Christ.
You received Christ Jesus as Lord. So walk with Him.
Grow deep roots in Him. Build your life on Him. Stay strong in what you were taught. Be full of thanks.
Watch out! Do not let anyone take you away with empty ideas. Do not follow human rules. Do not follow the world's basic ways. Follow Christ.
In Christ lives all of God's full power in a body.
You are full in Him. He is the head over all rulers and powers.
In Him, you had a circumcision not done by hands. It took away the old body of sin.
You were buried with Him in baptism. You were raised with Him through faith in God's power. God raised Christ from the dead.
You were dead in your sins. Your old life was far from God. But God made you alive with Christ. He forgave all our sins.
He erased the record of debt against us. He took it away and nailed it to the cross.
He took power from the rulers and powers. He made them look foolish. He beat them through Christ.
So do not let anyone judge you about food or drink. Do not let them judge you about a holiday, a new moon, or a Sabbath day.
These things are only a shadow of what was coming. The real thing is Christ.
Do not let anyone take your prize. Some people act humble and worship angels. They talk about what they have seen. They are proud for no reason. Their minds are weak.
They do not hold on to Christ, the Head. From Him, the whole body grows. God makes it grow through its joints and ties.
You died with Christ. You are free from the world's basic rules. So why do you act like you still live by them?
"Do not touch. Do not taste. Do not handle."
These things do not last. They are used up and gone. They come from human rules and teachings.
They look wise. They make people worship their own way. They make people be hard on their bodies. But they do not stop wrong desires.
If you have been raised with Christ, look for things above. Christ sits at God's right hand.
Think about things above. Do not think only about things on earth.
You died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, who is your life, shows Himself, you will show too. You will be with Him in glory.
So put to death the bad things in your life on earth. Stop sexual sin, dirty acts, bad feelings, wrong wants, and greed. Greed is like worshiping fake gods.
God's anger comes because of these things. It comes on people who do not obey.
You used to live this way. You did these things.
But now you must put away all these things: anger, hot temper, mean acts, bad talk, and dirty words from your mouth.
Do not lie to each other. You have taken off the old you with its bad acts.
Put on the new you. It is made new to know God. It is like the One who made you.
Here there is no Greek or Jew. There is no one who is marked or not marked. There is no person from a far place. There is no slave or free person. Christ is all, and He is in all.
You are God's chosen people. You are holy and loved. So put on kind hearts, good acts, humble thoughts, gentle ways, and patience.
Be patient with each other. Forgive each other. If someone has a problem with another person, forgive them. Forgive like the Lord forgave you.
Above all, put on love. Love holds everything together in a perfect way.
Let Christ's peace rule in your hearts. You were called to peace in one body. Be thankful.
Let Christ's word live richly in you. Teach and warn each other with wisdom. Sing Bible songs, hymns, and songs that praise God. Sing with grace in your hearts to God.
Whatever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus. Give thanks to God the Father through Him.
Wives, follow your husbands' lead. This fits in the Lord.
Husbands, love your wives. Do not be mean to them.
Children, obey your parents in all things. This pleases the Lord.
Fathers, do not make your children angry. Do not make them lose heart.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters in all things. Do not work only when they watch. Work with a true heart. Fear the Lord.
Whatever you do, work hard. Work as for the Lord, not for people.
Know that you will get your reward from the Lord. You serve Christ the Lord.
The one who does wrong will be paid back for the wrong. The Lord does not play favorites.
Masters, give your slaves what is right and fair. You know you also have a Master in heaven.
Keep praying. Stay awake and be thankful.
Pray for us too. Ask God to open a door for our message, so we can tell the secret plan of Christ. That is why I am in chains.
Pray that I can make it clear, as I should speak.
Walk with wisdom toward people outside the church. Make the most of every chance.
Let your words always be kind and helpful, so you know how to answer each person.
Tychicus will tell you everything about me. He is a loved brother, a faithful helper, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
I sent him to you for this: so you may know how we are, and so he may comfort your hearts.
With him is Onesimus, the faithful and loved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything here.
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you. Mark, Barnabas's cousin, greets you too. You got instructions about him. If he comes to you, welcome him.
Jesus, called Justus, also greets you. These are the only Jewish helpers I have for God's kingdom. They have been a comfort to me.
Epaphras, who is one of you, greets you. He is a servant of Christ Jesus. He always works hard in prayer for you, so you may stand mature and fully sure in all God's will.
I can say he works very hard for you and for the people in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Luke, the loved doctor, and Demas greet you.
Greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her house.
When this letter is read among you, make sure it is read in the church of the Laodiceans too. Also read the letter from Laodicea.
Tell Archippus, "See that you finish the work you got in the Lord."
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy send this letter to the church in Thessalonica. You belong to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace to you and peace.
We always thank God for all of you. We talk about you when we pray.
We remember, before God our Father, your work that shows your faith. We remember your hard work that shows your love. We remember how you do not give up, because you hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
Dear friends, God loves you. We know He chose you.
Our good news came to you not just with words. It came with power, with the Holy Spirit, and with strong belief. You know how we lived among you to help you.
You followed our example and the Lord's example. You received the word with joy from the Holy Spirit, even when you had much trouble.
So you became an example to all believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
The Lord's message spread from you in Macedonia and Achaia. Also, your faith in God has spread everywhere. So we do not need to say anything.
People tell us how you welcomed us. They tell how you turned to God from idols. Now you serve the living and true God.
They tell how you wait for His Son to come from heaven. God raised Him from the dead. His name is Jesus. He saves us from the punishment that is coming.
You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not a waste.
You know we had already been hurt and treated badly in Philippi. But even with much trouble, God gave us courage to tell you His good news.
Our message did not come from a mistake, or from bad thoughts, or from a trick.
We speak the way God wants. He tested us and trusted us with the good news. We do not try to please people. We try to please God, who checks our hearts.
You know we never used sweet talk. We did not make up a reason to get money. God is our witness.
We did not look for praise from people, from you or from others. As messengers of Christ, we could have been a heavy load to you, but we were not.
Instead, we were gentle with you, like a mother who takes care of her own children.
We loved you so much that we were glad to share God's good news with you. We even shared our own lives with you, because you became very dear to us.
Remember, brothers and sisters, how we worked hard day and night. We did not want to be a load to any of you. We told you God's good news.
You are witnesses, and God is too. We lived in a good, fair, and without fault way with you who believe.
You know we treated each one of you like a father treats his children.
We cheered you up, comforted you, and told you to live in a way that honors God. He calls you into His kingdom and His greatness.

We never stop thanking God. When you heard God's word from us, you accepted it. You did not treat it like human words. You treated it as God's word, which it really is. That word works in you who believe.
Brothers and sisters, you became like God's people in Judea who belong to Christ Jesus. You suffered the same things from your own people that they suffered from the Jews.
Those people killed the Lord Jesus and God's prophets. They drove us away. They do not please God. They work against all people.
They stop us from speaking to people from other nations so those people can be saved. In this way, they keep adding to their sins. But God's anger has finally come on them.
Brothers and sisters, we were taken away from you for a short time. We were not with you in person, but we were with you in heart. We wanted very much to see you again.
We wanted to come to you. I, Paul, tried again and again, but Satan stopped us.
What is our hope or joy or crown we are proud of? Is it not you? You will stand before our Lord Jesus when He comes.
You are our glory and our joy.
So, when we could not wait any longer, we decided to stay in Athens alone.
We sent Timothy, our brother and God's helper in sharing the good news about Christ. He came to make you strong and to cheer you up in your faith.
We did this so no one would be upset by these hard times. You know we are meant to have trouble.
When we were with you, we told you we would suffer. And it happened, just like you know.
So, when I could not wait any longer, I sent to learn about your faith. I did not want the devil to tempt you and make our work useless.
But Timothy came to us from you. He brought good news about your faith and love. He said you always think of us kindly and want to see us, just like we want to see you.
So, brothers and sisters, in all our trouble and hard times, we were cheered up by your faith.
Now we feel alive again, if you stay strong in the Lord.
How can we thank God enough for you? We are so happy about you before our God.
Night and day we pray hard that we can see you and help what is missing in your faith.
May God our Father and our Lord Jesus guide us to you.
May the Lord help you love each other more and more, and love everyone, just as we love you.
Then He can make your hearts strong and good, so you will be without blame in holy living before God our Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all His holy people. Amen.
Finally, friends, we ask you and beg you in the Lord Jesus to live the way we taught you. We want you to please God, and we want you to do this even more.
You know the rules we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
God wants you to live a holy life. So stay away from sexual sin.
Each of you should know how to use his own body in a clean and respectful way.
Do not let strong wrong desires control you, like people who do not know God.
Do not cheat or take advantage of another Christian in this. The Lord punishes people who do these things. We told you this before, and we warned you.
God did not call us to live dirty lives. He called us to live holy lives.
So anyone who ignores this rule is not ignoring people. He is ignoring God, who gives you His Holy Spirit.
You do not need us to write to you about loving each other like family. God has taught you how to love each other.
You already show love to all the Christians in Macedonia. But we ask you, friends, to love even more.
Try hard to live a quiet life. Take care of your own work. Work with your own hands, as we told you.
Then people outside the church will respect the way you live. You will not need to depend on anyone.
Friends, we do not want you to be sad about people who have died, like people who have no hope.
We believe Jesus died and rose again. So God will bring back with Jesus those who died believing in Him.
We tell you this by the Lord's word: We who are still alive when the Lord comes will not go before those who have died.
The Lord Himself will come down from heaven. He will shout a command. The voice of a chief angel will be heard. God's trumpet will sound. First, the dead who belong to Christ will rise.
Then we who are still alive will be taken up with them into the clouds. We will meet the Lord in the air. Then we will be with the Lord forever.
So cheer each other up with these words.
Now, brothers, we do not need to write to you about the times and seasons.
You know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
When people say, "Peace and safety," then sudden ruin will come on them, like pain comes on a woman having a baby. They will not escape.
But you, brothers, are not in the dark, so that day will not surprise you like a thief.
You are all children of light and children of the day. We are not children of the night or the dark.
So let's not sleep like the others. Let's stay awake and think clearly.
People who sleep, sleep at night. People who get drunk, get drunk at night.
But we belong to the day, so let's think clearly. Let's put on faith and love like a chest plate, and hope of being saved like a helmet.
God did not choose us to be punished. He chose us to be saved through our Lord Jesus Christ.
He died for us, so whether we are awake or asleep, we will live with Him.
So encourage one another and help each other grow, just as you are doing.
Brothers, we ask you to respect those who work hard among you, who lead you in the Lord and teach you.
Think very highly of them because of their work. Live in peace with each other.
We urge you, brothers, to warn those who are lazy, comfort those who feel sad, help those who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure no one pays back wrong for wrong. Always try to do good to each other and to all people.
Give thanks for everything, because this is what God wants for you in Christ Jesus.
Don't look down on God's messages.
Test everything. Hold on to what is good.
Stay away from every kind of evil.
May the God of peace make you completely holy. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be kept safe and without blame when our Lord Jesus Christ comes.
The One who called you is faithful. He will do it.
Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
I ask you by the Lord to read this letter to all the brothers.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Paul, Silas, and Timothy write to the church in Thessalonica. This church belongs to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
We must thank God for you, brothers. This is right. Your faith is growing a lot. The love that each of you has for the others is growing too.
So among God's churches, we tell about you. We are proud of how you keep going and keep trusting God while you face trouble and hard times.
This shows that God is fair when He judges. He counts you worthy of His kingdom. You suffer for it.
God will pay back trouble to those who trouble you.
He will give rest to you who are troubled, and to us too. This will happen when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with His mighty angels.
He will come in fire. He will punish people who do not know God and who do not obey the good news about our Lord Jesus.
They will be punished forever. They will be far from the Lord and from His great power.
This will happen on the day He comes. His holy people will praise Him. All who believed will be amazed at Him. You believed our message, so this includes you.
So we always pray for you. We ask God to count you worthy of His call. We ask Him to use His power to help you finish every good thing you want to do and every work that comes from faith.
Then the name of our Lord Jesus will be praised among you. You will be praised in Him too. This comes from the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Now, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to Him: we ask you, friends,
not to be quickly shaken in your mind or scared. Do not be fooled by a spirit, a word, or a letter that seems to come from us. It might say the day of the Lord has already come.
Do not let anyone trick you in any way. That day will not come until people turn away from God first. Then the man of lawlessness will be shown. He is the son of destruction.
He fights against God and puts himself above every god or thing people worship. He will even sit in God's temple and say he is God.
Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
And you know what is holding him back now. He will be shown when the time is right.
The secret power of lawlessness is already working. But the one who holds it back will keep doing so until he is taken out of the way.
Then the lawless one will be shown. The Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath of His mouth. He will destroy him when He comes.
The lawless one will come with Satan's power. He will do all kinds of power, signs, and false wonders.
He will trick people who are lost. They did not love the truth that could save them.
So God sends them a strong lie. They believe what is false.
Then all who did not believe the truth but liked doing wrong will be judged.
But we must always thank God for you, friends loved by the Lord. God chose you from the start to be saved. He makes you holy by the Spirit and helps you believe the truth.
He called you through the good news we told you. He did this so you can share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So, friends, stand firm. Hold on to the teachings we gave you, whether by word or by letter.
May our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father comfort you. They loved us and gave us lasting comfort and good hope by His grace.
May He make your hearts strong. May He help you do and say every good thing.
Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us. Pray that the Lord's word will spread fast and be praised, just as it was with you.
Pray that we will be saved from bad and evil people. Not everyone trusts in God.
But the Lord can be trusted. He will make you strong and keep you safe from the evil one.
We trust in the Lord that you are doing what we tell you. We also trust that you will keep doing it.
May the Lord help your hearts love God and wait with patience for Christ.
Brothers and sisters, we tell you this in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Stay away from any brother who lives in a wrong way and does not follow the teaching we gave you.
You know you should copy us. We did not live in a wrong way when we were with you.
We did not eat anyone's food for free. We worked hard day and night. We did this so we would not be a heavy load to any of you.
We had the right to ask for help. But we worked to give you a good example to follow. We did this so you would follow it.
When we were with you, we told you this: “If someone will not work, then he should not eat.”
We hear that some of you live in a wrong way. They do no work. They only get into other people's business.
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, we tell and ask those people to work quietly. Then they can eat their own food.
Brothers and sisters, do not get tired of doing good.
If someone does not obey what we say in this letter, mark that person. Do not spend time with him. Then he may feel ashamed.
Do not treat him like an enemy. Warn him like a brother.
May the Lord of peace give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. This is a sign in every letter. This is how I write.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
Paul is a worker sent by Christ Jesus. God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope told him to do this.
To Timothy, my true child in faith: May you have grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
When I went to Macedonia, I asked you to stay in Ephesus. There, you can tell some people not to teach wrong things.
They should not spend time on made-up stories or long family lists. Those things make people argue. They do not help God's work, which comes by faith.
The goal of this teaching is love. It comes from a clean heart, a good conscience, and real faith.
Some people have turned away from these things. They talk about empty things.
They want to be teachers of God's law. But they do not understand what they say or what they talk about.
We know God's law is good when people use it the right way.

The law is not for good people. It is for people who break rules and do not obey. It is for people who do not honor God and who sin. It is for people who are not holy and who treat holy things badly. It is for people who hurt their father or mother. It is for murderers.

It is for people who do wrong sex acts, men who have sex with men, people who capture and sell others, liars, and people who lie under oath. It is also for anything else that goes against true teaching.
This true teaching agrees with the good news. The good news shows the greatness of the blessed God. He trusted me with this good news.
I thank Christ Jesus our Lord. He gave me strength. He saw that I could be trusted. He put me in His work.
Before, I said bad things about God. I hurt His people. I was rude and mean. But God was kind to me. I did those things because I did not know better. I did not believe.
Our Lord's grace poured over me. It came with faith and love in Christ Jesus.
This is a true saying. People can fully trust it: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. I am the worst of them.
But God was kind to me for this reason. I was the worst sinner. Jesus Christ showed His great patience in me. He made me an example for people who would believe in Him and get life forever.
To the King who rules forever, who never dies, who cannot be seen, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
Timothy, my child, I give you this job. Prophets spoke about you before. Use their words so you can fight the good fight.
Hold on to faith and a good conscience. Some people have thrown these away. They have wrecked their faith.
Hymenaeus and Alexander are two of them. I gave them to Satan so they would learn not to say bad things about God.
First of all, I ask that prayers be made for everyone. Ask God to help them. Pray for them. Thank God for them.
Pray for kings and all leaders. Then we can live quiet and peaceful lives. We can live in a way that honors God and is good.
This is good. It pleases God, who saves us.
He wants all people to be saved. He wants them to know the truth.
There is only one God. There is only one person who brings God and people together. That person is Jesus Christ, who is a man.
He gave Himself to pay for all people. This is the message God gave at the right time.
God chose me to tell this message. I am a preacher and a messenger for God. I teach people who are not Jews to trust God and know the truth. I am telling the truth. I am not lying.
So I want men everywhere to pray. They should lift their hands to God. They should not be angry or argue.
In the same way, women should dress in a way that is modest. They should have self-control. They should not show off with fancy hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes.
Instead, they should do good things. That is what women who love God should do.
A woman should learn quietly and obey.
I do not let a woman teach a man or tell him what to do. She should be quiet.
Adam was made first. Then Eve was made.
Adam was not tricked. But Eve was tricked. She broke God's rule.
But women will be saved by having children, if they keep trusting God, loving others, and living holy lives with self-control.
This is a true saying: If anyone wants to be a church leader, he wants a good job.
A church leader must be a good man. He should have only one wife. He should stay calm and think clearly. He should act in a nice way. He should welcome guests. He should be able to teach.
He should not drink too much. He should not hit people. He should be gentle and not fight. He should not love money.
He should lead his own family well. His children should obey him, and they should be respectful.
If a man does not know how to lead his own family, how can he take care of God's church?
He should not be a new believer. Then he will not become proud and fall into the devil's trap.
He must also have a good name with people outside the church. Then he will not fall into shame and the devil's trap.
Helpers in the church should also be respected. They should not lie or say two different things. They should not drink too much wine. They should not be greedy for money.
They should hold on to the secret truth of faith with a clean heart.
First, they should be tested. Then, if no one can blame them, they may serve.
Women should be respected too. They should not talk mean about others. They should stay calm and be faithful in everything.
Helpers should have only one wife. They should lead their children and homes well.
Those who serve well gain a good place and strong courage in their faith in Christ Jesus.
I hope to come to you soon. But I am writing these things to you now.
If I am slow to come, you will know how people should act in God's house. That house is the church of the living God. It is the strong support and base of the truth.

The secret of living for God is very great: He was shown in a body. He was made right by the Spirit. Angels saw Him. He was preached to all nations. People believed in Him all over the world. He was taken up into glory.
The Spirit says clearly that in later times some people will leave the faith. They will listen to lying spirits and demon teachings.
These teachers act like they are good, but their own hearts are hard.
They tell people not to marry. They tell people not to eat some foods. But God made those foods for people to eat with thanks. God made them for people who believe and know the truth.
Everything God made is good. Nothing should be thrown away if it is taken with thanks.
It is made clean by God's word and by prayer.
If you tell the brothers these things, you will be a good helper of Christ Jesus. You grow strong from the words of faith and good teaching that you have followed.
Stay away from bad, silly stories. Train yourself to follow God.
Body training helps a little. But following God helps in every way. It has a promise for this life and the life to come.
This is a true word. It should be accepted by all.
We work hard for this. We hope in the living God. He is the Savior of all people. He is the Savior most of all for people who believe.
Tell people these things. Teach them.
Do not let anyone look down on you because of your youth. Be an example to believers in what you say, how you live, in love, in faith, and in clean living.
Until I come, give yourself to reading the Bible, to encouraging people, and to teaching.
Do not forget the gift given to you. It was given to you through prophecy when the leaders put their hands on you.
Think about these things. Live in them. Then everyone will see your progress.
Watch yourself and your teaching. Keep doing these things. If you do, you will save yourself and the people who hear you.
Do not speak harshly to an older man. Talk to him like a father. Treat younger men like brothers.
Treat older women like mothers. Treat younger women like sisters. Stay pure in every way.
Help widows who are truly widows.
But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should first learn to be good to their own family. They should pay back their parents and grandparents. This pleases God.
A widow who is truly alone puts her hope in God. She prays day and night.
But a widow who lives only for fun is dead while she lives.
Tell people these things. Then no one can blame them.
If anyone does not take care of his own family, he has turned away from the faith. He is worse than someone who does not believe.
A widow should be put on the list only if she is at least 60 years old. She should have been married to one husband.
People should say good things about her. She raised children. She welcomed strangers. She washed the feet of God's people. She helped people in trouble. She did every kind of good work.
But do not put younger widows on the list. When they feel strong desires, they want to marry, and that can pull them away from Christ.
They will be judged because they broke their first promise.
Also, they learn to be lazy. They go from house to house. They are not just lazy. They also talk too much. They poke into other people's business. They say things they should not say.
So I want younger widows to marry. They should have children. They should take care of their homes. Then no enemy will have a reason to say bad things.
Some have already turned away to follow Satan.
If a woman who believes has widows in her family, she should help them. Then the church will not have to carry the load. The church can help the widows who are truly alone.
Church leaders who lead well should get twice as much honor. This is even more true for those who work hard at speaking and teaching.
The Bible says, "Do not stop an ox from eating while it works." It also says, "A worker should get his pay."
Do not listen to a charge against a church leader unless two or three people say it is true.
Tell people who keep sinning to stop. Do this in front of everyone. Then the others will be afraid to sin.
I ask you to do this before God, Christ Jesus, and the angels He chose. Keep these rules without favoring anyone. Do not be unfair.
Do not be too quick to choose someone for church work. Do not share in other people's sins. Keep yourself pure.
Stop drinking only water. Drink a little wine. It can help your stomach and your many sicknesses.
Some people's sins are easy to see. They lead the way to judgment. Other sins show up later.
Good works are easy to see too. Even the ones that are not easy to see cannot stay hidden.
Slaves should think their own masters are worth full respect. This is so God's name and teaching won't be spoken against.

Slaves who have masters who believe should not look down on them, because they are brothers. They should serve them even more, because the masters who get the help are believers and loved. Teach and urge these things.
If anyone teaches something different and does not agree with the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that goes with living for God,
he is proud and knows nothing. He is sick with questions and fights about words. These bring envy, fighting, bad words, and evil guesses.
People with ruined minds who have lost the truth keep causing trouble. They think living for God is a way to get money.
But living for God and being happy with what we have is great gain.
We brought nothing into the world. We can take nothing out.
If we have food and clothes, we should be happy with that.
People who want to be rich fall into a trap. They fall into many silly and harmful wants. These wants pull people down into ruin and loss.
Loving money is the root of all kinds of evil. Some people who wanted it left the faith. They hurt themselves with many sorrows.
But you, man of God, run from these things. Chase after doing right, living for God, faith, love, patience, and a gentle spirit.
Keep fighting the good fight of faith. Hold on to life that lasts forever. God called you to it. You said the good words about it in front of many people.
I charge you before God, who gives life to all, and before Christ Jesus, who spoke the good words before Pontius Pilate.
Keep this command clean and without fault until our Lord Jesus Christ shows Himself.
God will show it at the right time. He is the happy and only Ruler. He is King of kings and Lord of lords.
He alone never dies. He lives in light no one can go near. No person has seen Him. No person can see Him. Honor and power belong to Him forever. Amen.
Tell rich people in this world not to be proud. They should not trust in money that can go away. They should trust in God, who richly gives us all things to enjoy.
They should do good. They should be rich in good works. They should be ready to give and share.
They will save up a good base for the future. Then they can hold on to real life.
Timothy, guard what was given to you. Stay away from empty talk that is not holy. Stay away from false ideas that are called knowledge.
Some people say they have it. They missed the faith. Grace be with you.
Paul is an apostle of Christ Jesus. God chose this by His will. It is about the promise of life in Christ Jesus.
To Timothy, my dear child: grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
I thank God. I serve Him with a clean heart, like my family before me. I remember you day and night in my prayers.
I remember your tears. I want to see you. Then I will be full of joy.
I remember your true faith. It lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice. I am sure it lives in you too.
That is why I remind you to stir up God's gift in you. God gave it to you when I put my hands on you.
God did not give us a spirit of fear. He gave us power, love, and self-control.
So do not be ashamed of the story of our Lord. Do not be ashamed of me, His prisoner. Share the hard times for the good news. God gives you power to do it.
God saved us. He called us with a holy call. He did not do it because of our works. He did it because of His own plan and grace. He gave this grace to us in Christ Jesus before time began.
Now it is shown to us. Jesus Christ our Savior came and made it clear. He ended death. He brought life and life that never ends. He did this through the good news.
I was chosen to tell this good news. I am a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
That is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed. I know whom I have trusted. I am sure He can keep what I trusted to Him until that day.
Hold on to the true words you heard from me. Hold them with faith and love in Christ Jesus.
Guard the good gift. The Holy Spirit lives in us. He will help you.
You know that everyone in Asia turned away from me. Phygelus and Hermogenes are two of them.
May the Lord show mercy to Onesiphorus's family. He cheered me up many times. He was not ashamed of my chains.
When he was in Rome, he looked hard for me. He found me.
May the Lord let him find mercy from the Lord on that day. You know better than I do how much he helped in Ephesus.
So, my child, be strong in the kindness that is in Christ Jesus.
Also, tell faithful people what you heard me say with many people watching. They must be able to teach others.
Suffer with me, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
A soldier does not get busy with everyday work. He wants to please the leader who picked him.
Also, an athlete does not win a prize unless he follows the rules.
The farmer who works hard should get some of the crop first.
Think about what I say. The Lord will help you understand all of this.
Remember Jesus Christ. He rose from the dead. He came from David's family. This is the good news I tell.
I suffer for it. I am in chains like a bad person. But God's word is not chained.
So I keep going for God's chosen people. I want them to be saved in Christ Jesus and have glory that lasts forever.
This is a true saying: "If we died with Him, we will live with Him.
If we keep going, we will rule with Him. If we turn away from Him, He will turn away from us.
If we are not faithful, He stays faithful. He cannot turn away from Himself."
Remind people of these things. Tell them before God not to fight about words. It does no good. It only hurts the people who listen.
Try hard to show God you are a good worker. Then you will not be ashamed. You will teach the true message the right way.
Stay away from empty talk that does not honor God. People who talk like that will become worse and worse.
Their talk will spread like a sickness. Hymenaeus and Philetus are two of them.
They missed the truth. They say people already rose from the dead. They are turning some people away from faith.
But God's strong base stands firm. It has this seal: "The Lord knows who belongs to Him," and, "Everyone who says the Lord's name must turn away from wrong."
In a big house, there are gold and silver things. There are also wood and clay things. Some are for special use. Some are for everyday use.
So if a person makes himself clean from these wrong things, he will be a special tool. He will be holy and useful to the Master. He will be ready for every good work.
Run from the wrong wants of youth. Run after right living, faith, love, and peace. Do this with people who call on the Lord with a clean heart.
Stay away from foolish and silly questions. You know they start fights.
The Lord's servant must not fight. He must be kind to everyone. He must be able to teach. He must not get angry fast.
He must teach those who are against him in a gentle way. Maybe God will help them change their hearts. Then they will know the truth.
Then they may wake up and get free from the devil's trap. The devil has caught them to do what he wants.
But know this: In the last days, hard times will come.
People will love only themselves and money. They will brag and be proud. They will say mean things and not obey their parents. They will be unthankful and not holy.
They will not love others or forgive. They will tell lies and not control themselves. They will be mean and hate what is good.
They will turn on friends, act without thinking, and be full of pride. They will love fun more than God.
They will look like they love God, but they will say no to God's power. Stay away from people like that.
Some of them sneak into homes and lead weak women away. These women are full of sin. They follow many wrong wants.
They always learn, but they never learn the truth.
Just like Jannes and Jambres stood against Moses, these people stand against the truth. Their minds are ruined. They fail the test of faith.
But they will not get far. Everyone will see how foolish they are, just like people saw those men's foolishness.
But you followed my teaching, my way of life, my plan, my faith, my patience, my love, and my staying power.
You also saw my troubles and pain. You saw what happened to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. You saw how I was treated. The Lord rescued me from all of them.
Yes, everyone who wants to live for God in Christ Jesus will be treated badly.
But bad people and fakes will get worse and worse. They will trick others, and they will be tricked too.
But you must stay in what you learned and trusted. You know who taught you.
You have known the holy writings since you were a baby. They can make you wise so you can be saved. This comes through faith in Christ Jesus.
All Scripture is from God. It is useful for teaching, for showing what is wrong, for fixing mistakes, and for training people to do right.
This helps God's person be ready and able to do every good work.
I speak strongly before God and Christ Jesus. He will judge people who are alive and people who have died. I also speak by His coming and His kingdom.
Preach God's word. Be ready to speak at any time. Correct people. Warn them. Ask them to do right. Do this with patience and teaching.
A time will come when people will not listen to true teaching. Instead, they will want teachers who say what they like to hear. They will gather many teachers to please themselves.
They will stop listening to the truth. They will turn to made-up stories.
But you must stay calm and clear in all things. You must face hard times. Do the work of one who tells the good news. Finish the work God gave you.
I am already being poured out like an offering to God. The time for me to leave is here.
I have fought well. I have finished the race. I have kept believing.
Now a prize for doing right is waiting for me. The Lord, who judges fairly, will give it to me on that day. He will give it not only to me, but also to all who have loved His coming.
Try hard to come to me soon.
Demas left me because he loved this world. He went to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia. Titus went to Dalmatia.
Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you. He helps me a lot in my work.
When you come, bring the coat I left with Carpus at Troas. Also bring the books, and especially the papers.
Alexander the metal worker hurt me very much. The Lord will pay him back for what he did.
You should also watch out for him. He fought hard against our words.
The first time I spoke for myself, no one came to help me. Everyone left me. May God not blame them.
But the Lord stood by me and made me strong. He did this so I could tell the good news fully. All people could hear it. I was saved from great danger.
The Lord will save me from every evil work. He will bring me safely into His kingdom in heaven. Glory belongs to Him forever and ever. Amen.
Say hello to Prisca and Aquila and the family of Onesiphorus.
Erastus stayed in Corinth. I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
Try hard to come before winter. Eubulus says hello to you. Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers say hello too.
The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
I am Paul. I serve God. Jesus Christ sent me to tell His message. I help God’s chosen people believe. I help them know the truth. This truth helps us live for God.
We hope to live forever. God never lies. He promised this life long ago.
Now, at the right time, He has shown His word. I preach it because God our Savior told me to.
To Titus, my true child in our shared faith: May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior give you grace and peace.
I left you in Crete for a reason. You need to fix what is missing. You also need to choose church leaders in each town. Do it the way I told you.

A church leader must be a good man. No one should be able to blame him. He should have only one wife. His children should believe. They should not be known for wild living. They should not refuse to obey.
A leader cares for God’s people. So he must be blameless. He must not be proud. He must not get angry fast. He must not drink too much. He must not hit people. He must not love money in a wrong way.
He must welcome guests. He must love good things. He must control himself. He must do what is right. He must live for God. He must stay in control.
He must hold tight to the true message we teach. Then he can encourage people with good teaching. He can also show why some people are wrong.
Many people do not obey. They say empty things. They trick people. This is true of many who follow Jewish rules.
You must stop them from talking. They ruin whole families. They teach things they should not teach. They do it to get money in a bad way.
One of their own writers said, “People from Crete always lie. They act like wild animals. They are lazy and only want food.”
This is true. So correct them firmly. Help them have a strong faith.
They should not listen to Jewish stories. They should not follow rules made by people. Those rules turn people away from the truth.
To people who are pure, everything is pure. But to people who are dirty inside and do not believe, nothing is pure. Even their minds and hearts are dirty.
They say they know God. But their actions say no. They are awful. They do not obey. They are useless for any good work.
But you should talk about things that fit good teaching.
Older men should be sober, respected, sensible, and strong in faith, love, and patience.
Older women should act in a holy way. They should not say bad things about others. They should not drink too much wine. They should teach what is good.
Then they can teach younger women to love their husbands and children.
They should be sensible, pure, and good at home. They should obey their own husbands. Then people will not say bad things about God's message.
In the same way, tell young men to control themselves.
Show yourself as a good example in everything. Teach with honesty and respect.
Use words that are healthy and cannot be blamed. Then people who are against us will be ashamed. They will have nothing bad to say about us.
Slaves should obey their own masters in everything. They should try to please them. They should not talk back.
They should not steal. They should show they can be trusted. Then they make God's teaching look good. God is our Savior.
God's grace has come to save all people.
It teaches us to say no to sin and to want things of this world. It teaches us to live with self-control, to do right, and to honor God now.
We wait for the happy hope and for our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, to come in glory.
He gave Himself for us. He did this to set us free from all sin. He made us clean. He made us His own people. He wants us to be eager to do good.
Talk about these things. Encourage people. Correct people with full authority. Do not let anyone look down on you.
Remind them to obey leaders and people in charge, and to be ready to do every good thing.
They should not say bad things about anyone. They should be peaceful and kind, and show true gentleness to everyone.
We were once like that too. We were foolish. We did not obey. We were tricked. We served many wrong wants and pleasures. We lived in badness and jealousy. People hated us, and we hated each other.
But then God our Savior showed His kindness and love to people.
He saved us. He did not save us because of good things we did. He saved us because of His mercy. He washed us and made us new through the Holy Spirit.
He poured out the Holy Spirit on us in a big way through Jesus Christ our Savior.
So now, by His grace, we are right with God. We can hope to live forever.
This is a true saying. I want you to be sure about these things. Then people who believe in God will be careful to do good works. These things are good and help people.
But stay away from foolish questions, family histories, fights, and arguments about the law. They do not help. They are useless.
Warn a person who causes trouble once or twice. Then stay away from him.
Know that this kind of person is turned away from truth and keeps sinning. He brings judgment on himself.
When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, try hard to come to me at Nicopolis. I have decided to stay there for the winter.
Help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their trip. Make sure they have what they need.
Our people should also learn to do good works and help people in real need. Then they will not be useless.
Everyone with me says hello to you. Say hello to those who love us because of faith. May grace be with all of you.
Paul, a prisoner for Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, write to Philemon. Philemon is our dear friend and helper.
We also write to Apphia our sister, Archippus our fellow soldier, and the church that meets in your house.
I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give you grace and peace.
I thank my God all the time. I remember you when I pray.
I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus. I hear about your love for all God's people.
I pray that your sharing of faith will help you know all the good things we have in Christ.
Your love has given me much joy and comfort. You have made God's people feel rested.
In Christ, I could tell you what to do. That would be the right thing.
But I would rather ask you because of love. I am Paul, an old man. Now I am also a prisoner for Christ Jesus.
I ask you to care for my child Onesimus. I became his father in the faith while I was in chains.
He was not useful to you before. But now he is useful to you and to me.
I am sending him back to you. He is very dear to me.
I wanted to keep him with me. Then he could help me while I am in chains for the good news.
But I did not want to do anything without your permission. I want your good deed to be by choice, not by force.
Maybe he was away from you for a little while so you could have him back forever.
He is not just a slave now. He is more than a slave. He is a dear brother. He is very dear to me. He should be even more dear to you, both in this life and in the Lord.
So if you think of me as a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
If he has wronged you in any way, or if he owes you anything, charge it to me.
I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will pay it back. I will not even mention that you owe me your own self.
Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Make my heart feel rested in Christ.
I write to you because I trust you will obey. I know you will do even more than I ask.
Also, get a room ready for me. I hope that through your prayers I will be set free and come to you.
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, says hello to you.
Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my helpers, say hello to you.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
Long ago, God spoke to our fathers in many ways through His prophets.
But in these last days, He has spoken to us through His Son. God made His Son the one who will get all things. He also made the world through His Son.
The Son shines with God's bright light. He is just like God. He holds everything together by His strong word. After He took away our sins, He sat down next to God in heaven.
So the Son became much greater than the angels. The name He received is much better than their names.
God never said to any angel, "You are My Son. Today I have become Your Father." He also said, "I will be His Father, and He will be My Son."
And when God brings His first Son into the world, He says, "Let all of God's angels bow down to Him."
About the angels, God says, "He makes His angels like the wind and His servants like fire."
But about the Son, God says, "Your throne, O God, will last forever. Your kingdom will be ruled the right way.
You have loved what is right and hated what is wrong. So God, Your God, has poured oil of joy on You more than on anyone else."
He also says, "Lord, in the beginning You made the earth. The heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will end, but You will stay. They will all grow old like clothes.
You will roll them up like a coat. They will be changed like clothes. But You are the same, and Your years will never end."
God never said to any angel, "Sit in the place of honor next to Me until I make Your enemies bow down to You."
Angels are spirits who serve God. He sends them to help those who will be saved.
So we must listen very closely to what we have heard. We must not lose it.
The message that angels gave was true. Every sin and every time people did not listen got a fair punishment.
How can we escape if we do not care about this great rescue? The Lord first told about it. People who heard it told us it was true.
God also showed it was true. He used signs and wonders. He used many kinds of power. He gave gifts from the Holy Spirit, just as He wanted.
God did not put the coming world under angels. That is the world we are talking about.
Someone said, "What is a man? Why do You remember him? What is a son of man? Why do You care for him?
You made him a little lower than angels for a short time. You gave him glory and honor.
You put everything under his feet." When God put everything under him, nothing was left out. But now we do not yet see everything under his rule.
But we see Jesus. He was made a little lower than angels for a short time. Now He is crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death. By God's kindness, He died for all people.
All things are for Him, and all things come from Him. He is bringing many sons to glory. So it was right for Him to make Jesus, the leader of their rescue, complete through suffering.
Jesus makes people holy. He and the people He makes holy come from one family. So He is not ashamed to call them His brothers.
He says, "I will tell Your name to My brothers. I will sing praise to You among the people."
He also says, "I will trust in Him." And again, "Here I am, with the children God gave Me."
The children have bodies and blood. So Jesus became like them. He did this so that by dying He could destroy the devil, who had the power of death.
He did this to free all people who were slaves their whole lives because they feared death.
He does not help angels. He helps the family of Abraham.
So He had to be like His brothers in every way. Then He could be a kind and faithful high priest for God. He could pay for the sins of the people.
He suffered when He was tested. So He can help people who are tested.
So, holy brothers, you share in a call from heaven. Think about Jesus. He is the One God sent, and He is our High Priest.
He was faithful to God, who made Him. Moses was faithful too, in all of God's house.
Jesus has more honor than Moses. The one who builds a house has more honor than the house.
Every house is built by someone. But God made everything.
Moses was faithful like a servant in all of God's house. He told about things God would say later.
But Christ is faithful like a Son over God's house. We are His house if we keep our hope strong and do not give up.
So the Holy Spirit says, "Today, if you hear His voice,
do not make your hearts hard. Do not be like the people who turned against God in the desert.
There, your fathers tested Me. They saw My works for forty years.
So I was angry with that group of people. I said, 'They always go the wrong way in their hearts. They do not know My ways.'
I said with anger, 'They will not enter My rest.'"
Brothers, be careful. Do not let any of you have an evil heart that does not trust God. Do not turn away from the living God.
But help each other every day, while it is still called Today. Then none of you will get a hard heart because sin tricks you.
We share in Christ if we keep our hope strong from the start to the end.
It says, "Today, if you hear His voice, do not make your hearts hard like the people who turned against God."
Who heard God and still turned against Him? Was it not all the people who left Egypt with Moses?
Who made God angry for forty years? Was it not the people who sinned? Their bodies fell in the desert.
Who did God say would not enter His rest? Was it not the people who did not obey?
So we see they could not go in because they did not trust God.
The promise to enter God's rest is still here. So we should be careful. None of you should miss it.
We heard the good news too, like those people long ago. But the message did not help them. They did not mix it with faith.
We who believe are going into that rest. God said, "I swore in My anger, 'They will never enter My rest.'" But God's work was finished when the world began.
In one place God said about the seventh day, "God rested on the seventh day from all His work."
And again He said, "They will never enter My rest."
So some people can still enter God's rest. The people who heard the good news first did not enter. They did not obey.
So God sets another day. He calls it "Today." Much later, He spoke through David. He said, "Today, if you hear His voice, do not be stubborn."
If Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken about another day.
So God's people still have a Sabbath rest.
Anyone who enters God's rest also rests from his own works. He rests just like God did from His works.
So let us try hard to enter that rest. Then no one will fall by following the same bad example of not obeying.

God's word is alive and powerful. It is sharper than any sword. It cuts deep. It goes all the way to the soul and spirit. It cuts between joints and marrow. It judges what we think and want in our hearts.
Nothing God made is hidden from Him. Everything is open before His eyes. We must answer to Him.
We have a great high priest. He went through the heavens. He is Jesus, the Son of God. So let us hold on to what we say we believe.
We do not have a high priest who cannot feel our weaknesses. He was tested in every way, just like us, but He did not sin.
So let us come to God's throne of grace with courage. Then we will receive mercy. We will find grace to help us when we need it.
Every high priest is chosen from among people. He is chosen to work for people with God. He offers gifts and sacrifices for sins.
He can be gentle with people who do not know and who go wrong, because he is weak too.
Because of this, he must offer a gift for his own sins, just like he does for the people.
No one takes this honor for himself. He must be called by God, like Aaron was.
In the same way, Christ did not make Himself high priest. God said to Him, "You are My Son. Today I have become Your Father."
And in another place He says, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
While He lived on earth, Jesus prayed to God with a loud voice and tears. God could save Him from death. God heard Him because Jesus respected God.
Even though He was the Son, He learned to obey by what He suffered.
After He was made perfect, He became the way for all who obey Him to be saved forever.
God called Him high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
We have much to say about this. It is hard to explain because you are slow to listen.
By now you should be teachers. But you need someone to teach you again the first lessons of God's word. You need milk, not solid food.
Anyone who lives on milk is still a baby. He does not know much about right living.
Solid food is for grown people. They have learned to tell good from bad.
So let's move past the first lessons about Christ. Let's grow up and be strong in faith.
We do not need to start over with the first steps: turning from the wrong things we do, trusting God, lessons about baptism, laying hands on people, rising from the dead, and God's final judgment.
We will do this if God allows.
It is impossible to make people turn back to God again if they once saw God's light, tasted His gift from heaven, shared in the Holy Spirit,
tasted God's good word, and felt the power of the future world,
and then turned away. They would be like putting the Son of God on a cross again and shaming Him.
Land that drinks the rain that falls on it and grows good plants for the people who work it gets God's blessing.
But land that grows thorns and weeds is no good. It is close to being cursed, and its end is to be burned.
Dear friends, even when we talk like this, we are sure you will do better things, things that go with being saved.
God is not unfair. He will not forget your work and your love. You showed your love by helping God's people, and you still do.
We want each of you to keep working hard until the end, so you can be very sure of your hope.
Then you will not be lazy. You will copy those who trusted God and waited patiently, and they received what God promised.
When God made a promise to Abraham, He had no one greater to swear by, so He swore by Himself.
He said, "I will surely bless you, and I will make your family very large."
Abraham waited patiently, and then he received what God promised.
People swear by someone greater than them. An oath makes a promise strong and ends arguments.
God wanted to show the people who receive His promise that His plan will not change. So He used an oath.
God cannot lie. So we have two things that will not change. This gives strong comfort to us who run to God for safety. We can hold tight to the hope God gives us.
We have this hope like a strong anchor for our soul. It is safe and sure. It goes into the place behind the curtain.
Jesus went there first for us. He became our high priest forever, like Melchizedek.
This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham when Abraham came back from winning a battle against kings. He blessed Abraham.
Abraham gave him one tenth of everything. First, Melchizedek's name means "king of right living." Then it also means "king of Salem," which means "king of peace."
He had no father or mother listed. He had no family tree. He had no beginning of days and no end of life. He is like God's Son. He stays a priest forever.
Think about how great this man was. Even Abraham, the great father, gave him one tenth of the best things he won.
The law says priests from Levi's family must take one tenth from the people. That means from their own brothers, even though they also come from Abraham.
But Melchizedek did not come from Levi's family. He took one tenth from Abraham. He blessed the man who had God's promises.
Everyone knows the greater person blesses the lesser person.
Here, people who will die collect the tenth. But there, he is said to live.
In a way, Levi, who collects the tenth, also paid the tenth through Abraham.
When Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in his father's body.
If the priests from Levi's family could make people perfect, why would we need another priest like Melchizedek, not like Aaron? The people got the law through those priests.
When the work of the priests changes, the law must change too.
The one these words are about came from a different tribe. No one from that tribe served at the altar.
It is clear our Lord came from Judah. Moses said nothing about priests from that tribe.
This becomes even clearer if another priest like Melchizedek comes.
He became a priest not because of a family rule about birth, but because of the power of a life that cannot end.
For it is said, "You are a priest forever, in the way of Melchizedek."
So the old command is set aside because it was weak and useless.
The law made nothing perfect. But a better hope is brought in. Through it we come near to God.
This did not happen without a serious promise. Other priests became priests without such a promise.
But Jesus became a priest with a serious promise. God said to Him, "The LORD has made a serious promise and will not change His mind: 'You are a priest forever.'"
Because of this promise, Jesus makes a better agreement sure.
There have been many priests, because death stopped them from staying in office.
But Jesus lives forever, so His work as a priest never ends.
So He can save completely those who come to God through Him. He always lives to pray for them.
This is the kind of high priest we need. He is holy. He does no wrong. He is pure. He is set apart from sinners. He is higher than the heavens.
Unlike other high priests, He does not need to offer gifts every day. First for their own sins, then for the people's sins. He offered Himself one time for all.
The law makes weak men high priests. But the word of the serious promise, which came after the law, makes the Son perfect forever.
The main thing is this: We have a high priest like that. He sat down on the right side of the throne of the Majesty in heaven.
He serves in the holy place and in the true tent. The Lord set up that tent, not people.
Every high priest is chosen to give gifts and offerings. So this Priest must have something to give too.
If He were on earth, He would not be a priest, because other priests already give gifts the way the law says.

They serve in a place that is only a copy and shadow of the things in heaven. That is why God told Moses, when he was about to build the tent, "Be careful to make everything just like the pattern I showed you on the mountain."
But now Jesus has a much better work. He is the go-between for a better agreement. That agreement is based on better promises.
If the first agreement had been perfect, there would be no need for a second one.
But God found fault with the people. He said, "Look, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.
It will not be like the agreement I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt. They did not keep My agreement, so I did not care for them, says the Lord.

"This is the agreement I will make with the people of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people.
"No one will need to teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' because everyone will know Me, from the least to the greatest.
"For I will forgive their wrongs and not remember their sins anymore."
By calling this one "new," God has made the first agreement old. And what is old and wearing out will soon be gone.
The first agreement had rules for worship. It also had a holy place on earth.
A tent was set up. The first room had a lamp, a table, and special bread. People called this room the Holy Place.
Behind the second curtain was another room. People called it the Most Holy Place.

It had a gold altar for incense. It also had the wooden box of the agreement, covered with gold on every side. Inside were a gold jar with manna, Aaron's stick that grew buds, and the stone tablets of the agreement.
Above it stood angels of glory. They covered the lid of mercy. We will not talk about all these things now.
The priests went into the first room again and again. They did their work there.
But only the high priest went into the second room. He went only once a year. He always brought blood. He gave it for his own sins and for the sins the people did without knowing.
The Holy Spirit shows this: the way into the Most Holy Place was not open yet. The first tent was still standing.
This is a picture for now. The gifts and sacrifices they bring cannot make a worshiper feel fully clean inside.
They are only about food, drink, washings, and body rules. They last until God makes a better way.
But Christ came. He is the high priest of the good things that have come. He went through a bigger and better tent. Hands did not make it. It is not part of this world.
He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves. He entered the Most Holy Place once and for all time. He used His own blood. He bought freedom that lasts forever.
The blood of goats and bulls was sprinkled on people who were not clean. The ashes of a young cow also helped. These things made the body clean.

So Christ's blood can do much more. He offered Himself to God without fault. He did this through the Spirit that never ends. His blood will clean our hearts from bad deeds. Then we can serve the living God.

So Christ is the helper for a new agreement. He did this so the people God called can receive the promised gift that lasts forever. His death set them free from the wrongs they did under the first agreement.
When there is an agreement, the one who made it must die.
An agreement starts to work only after the person dies. It means nothing while that person is alive.
So the first agreement was not started without blood.
Moses told the people every command in the law. Then he took the blood of calves and goats. He mixed it with water, red wool, and a plant called hyssop. He sprinkled the book and all the people.
He said, “This is the blood of the agreement God commanded you to keep.”
He also sprinkled the tent and all the things used to serve God.
The law says almost everything is made clean with blood. Without blood being poured out, there is no forgiveness.
So the copies of things in heaven had to be cleaned with these gifts. But the real things in heaven need better gifts.
Christ did not go into a man-made copy of the true holy place. He went into heaven itself. Now He stands before God for us.
He does not offer Himself again and again, like the high priest who goes into the holy place every year with someone else's blood.
If He did, He would have suffered many times since the world began. But now He has come once. It is near the end of time. He came to take away sin by giving Himself.
People die only once. After that, they are judged.
In the same way, Christ was offered once to take away the sins of many. He will come a second time. He will not come to deal with sin. He will come to save the people who are waiting for Him.
The law is only a shadow of the good things coming. It is not the real thing. So it can never make people perfect by offering the same sacrifices every year.
If it could, they would have stopped. The people who worship would have had no more guilt from sin.
But those sacrifices remind people of their sins every year.
It is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
So when He came into the world, He said, “You did not want sacrifices and offerings. But You made a body for Me.
You did not like burnt offerings and sin offerings.
Then I said, ‘Look, I have come. It is written about Me in the book. I come to do Your will, O God.’”
He said this first: “You did not want sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings. You were not pleased with them, even though people offer them by the law.”
Then He said, “Look, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first way to set up the second way.
And by that will, we are made holy through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
