Priests stand and serve every day. They offer the same sacrifices again and again. But those sacrifices can never take away sins.
But Christ offered one sacrifice for sins for all time. Then He sat down at the right hand of God.
Now He waits until His enemies are put under His feet.
By one offering He made perfect forever the people God is making holy.
The Holy Spirit also tells us this. He said before,
“This is the promise I will make with them after those days, says the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts. I will write them on their minds.
I will not remember their sins and wrongs anymore.”
Where there is forgiveness of these things, there is no more offering for sin.
So, brothers and sisters, we have courage to go into the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus.
He made a new and living way for us through the curtain. That curtain is His body.
We have a great priest over God's house.
So let us come near to God with a true heart and full trust. Our hearts are sprinkled clean from guilt. Our bodies are washed with clean water.
Let us hold tightly to the hope we say we have. We must not turn from it. The One who promised is faithful.
Let us think about how to help each other love and do good.
Do not stay away from meeting together, as some do. But cheer each other up. Do this even more as you see the Day coming.
If we choose to keep sinning after we know the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left.
There is only a scary waiting for judgment and fire that will burn God's enemies.
Anyone who broke the law of Moses died without mercy when two or three people saw it.
How much worse do you think it will be for someone who walks on the Son of God, treats the blood of the promise like it is nothing, and insults the Spirit of grace?
We know the One who said, “I will punish. I will pay them back.” And again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
It is a scary thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
Remember the early days. After you received the light, you stayed strong through many hard times.
Sometimes you were laughed at in front of others and had hard times. Sometimes you stood by people who were treated the same way.
You felt sorry for people in jail. You were happy even when people took your things. You knew you had something better in heaven that lasts.
So do not throw away your courage. It will bring a big reward.
You need to be patient. Then, after you do God's will, you will receive what He promised.
In a very short time, the One who is coming will come. He will not be late.
But the one who is right with God will live by faith. If anyone turns back, I will not be pleased with them.
But we are not people who turn back and are lost. We are people who believe and are saved.
Faith means being sure of what we hope for. It means knowing that things we cannot see are real.
Long ago, people were praised for trusting God.
By faith we know that God made the world by His word. What we see was not made from things we can see.
By faith Abel gave God a better gift than Cain. God said Abel was right, because God accepted his gift. Abel still speaks, even though he died.
By faith Enoch was taken away so he did not die. No one could find him, because God took him. Before that, he was known for pleasing God.
Without faith, no one can please God. Anyone who comes to God must believe that He is real. They must also believe that He rewards people who look for Him.

By faith Noah was warned about things he had not yet seen. He was careful and built a big boat to save his family. By doing this, he showed the world was wrong. He became right with God because of his faith.
By faith Abraham obeyed when God called him to go to a place he would receive. He left, even though he did not know where he was going.
By faith he lived in the land God promised, like a stranger. He lived in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who would share the same promise.
He was waiting for a city with strong walls, made by God.
By faith Sarah, even though she could not have children and was too old, got power to have a baby. She trusted God, who had promised.
So from one man, almost as good as dead, came many people. They were as many as the stars in the sky and the sand by the sea.
All these people died still trusting. They did not get what was promised yet. But they saw it far away and welcomed it. They said they were strangers and travelers on earth.
People who say such things show they are looking for a home country.
If they had kept thinking about the country they left, they could have gone back.
But they want a better country, a heavenly one. So God is not ashamed to be called their God. He has made a city for them.
By faith Abraham, when tested, offered Isaac. The man who had received the promises offered his only son.
God had said, "Through Isaac your children will be called."
Abraham thought God could raise the dead. So he got Isaac back, like a picture of rising from the dead.
By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau about the future.
By faith Jacob, when dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons. He worshiped, leaning on his staff.
By faith Joseph, near the end of his life, spoke about the Israelites leaving Egypt. He gave orders about his bones.
By faith Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born. They saw he was a beautiful child. They were not afraid of the king's rule.
By faith Moses, when grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.
He chose to suffer with God's people instead of enjoying sin for a short time.
He thought being made fun of for Christ was worth more than Egypt's treasures. He looked ahead to the reward.
By faith he left Egypt and was not afraid of the king's anger. He kept going because he saw the One who cannot be seen.
By faith he kept the Passover and put blood on the doors. Then the one who killed the firstborn would not touch them.
By faith the people crossed the Red Sea on dry ground. The Egyptians tried it and were drowned.
By faith the walls of Jericho fell after the people marched around them for seven days.
By faith Rahab the prostitute welcomed the spies in peace. She did not die with those who did not obey.
What more can I say? Time would run out if I told about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
Through faith they won kingdoms, did right, got promises, and stopped lions from hurting them.
They put out fire, escaped swords, became strong from weakness, were strong in war, and turned back enemy armies.
Women got their loved ones back when God raised them from the dead. Others were hurt badly and did not accept freedom, so they could have a better rising from the dead.
Others were laughed at, beaten, chained, and put in prison.
They were hit with stones, cut in two, and killed with swords. They wore sheepskins and goatskins. They were poor, hurt, and treated badly.
The world was not good enough for them. They wandered in deserts, mountains, caves, and holes in the ground.
All these people were praised for their faith, but they did not get what was promised.
God had planned something better for us, so they would not be made complete without us.

So, since many people who believed in God are watching us like a big cloud, let's put away everything that slows us down. Let's also put away sin that holds on to us. Then let's run the race God set for us, and keep going even when it is hard.
Look at Jesus. He started our faith and makes it complete. He saw the joy ahead. So He stayed on the cross and did not care about the shame. Now He sits at God's right side.
Think about Jesus. Bad people fought against Him. He stayed strong. Think about Him so you do not get tired or give up in your hearts.
In your fight against sin, you have not bled yet.
Have you forgotten the words that speak to you like sons? They say, "My son, do not think lightly of the the LORD's training. Do not give up when He corrects you.
For the the LORD trains the one He loves. He punishes every son He accepts."
You must keep going through hard training. God is treating you like His sons. What father does not train his son?
If you get no training, then you are not true sons. All true sons get training.
We had fathers on earth who trained us, and we listened to them. So we should obey the Father of our spirits even more. Then we will live.
They trained us for a short time, the way they thought best. But God trains us for our good. He wants us to share His holy life.
Right now, training feels hard, not fun. But later it gives good fruit. It gives peace and right living to people who learn from it.
So lift up your tired hands. Make your weak knees strong.
Make straight paths for your feet. Then the weak part will not get worse. It will get better.
Try to live in peace with all people. Try to be holy. No one will see the the LORD without holiness.
Watch out. Do not let anyone miss God's grace. Do not let a bitter root grow. It can trouble people and make many dirty.
Do not let anyone be like Esau. He was not holy. He sold his right as firstborn son for one meal.
You know what happened later. He wanted the blessing, but he was turned away. He could not get it back, even when he cried.
You did not come to a mountain you can touch. It had fire, darkness, gloom, and a storm.
You did not hear a trumpet and a voice. The people who heard it begged for no more words.
They could not stand the command: "Even if an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned."
The sight was so scary that Moses said, "I am terrified and shaking."
But you have come to Mount Zion. You have come to the city of the living God. You have come to heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to thousands and thousands of angels.
You have come to God's people, the firstborn whose names are in heaven. You have come to God, who judges all. You have come to the spirits of good people made perfect.
You have come to Jesus. He makes peace in a new agreement. His blood speaks a better word than Abel's blood.
Be careful. Do not say no to the One who speaks. The people long ago did not escape when they said no to God's warning on earth. We will not escape if we turn away from God's warning from heaven.
Back then, His voice shook the earth. Now He has promised, "I will shake the earth one more time. I will shake heaven too."
The words "one more time" mean the things that can be shaken will be taken away. These are things God made. The things that cannot be shaken will stay.
So let's be thankful. We are getting a kingdom that cannot be shaken. Let's worship God in a way that pleases Him. Let's do it with respect and fear.
Our God is a fire that burns everything up.
Keep loving your brothers and sisters.
Do not forget to be kind to guests. Some people welcomed strangers and did not know they were angels.
Remember people who are in prison. Think of them as if you were locked up with them. Remember people who are hurt, as if you were hurt too, since you have bodies too.
Marriage is good for everyone. Keep the marriage bed pure. God will judge people who do sexual wrong and people who cheat in marriage.
Do not love money. Be happy with what you have. God has said, "I will never leave you. I will never abandon you."
So we can say with confidence, "The LORD is my helper. I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?"
Remember your leaders. They taught you God's word. Think about how they lived and how they finished life. Follow their faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Do not let strange and different teachings pull you away. It is good for your heart to be made strong by grace, not by food rules. Food rules did not help the people who followed them.
We have an altar. The people who serve at the holy tent are not allowed to eat from it.
The high priest brings animal blood into the holy place to pay for sin. But the animals' bodies are burned outside the camp.
So Jesus suffered outside the city gate. He made the people holy by His own blood.
So let us go to Him outside the camp. Let us share His shame.
We do not have a city that lasts here. We are looking for the city that is coming.
Through Jesus, let us always give God a sacrifice of praise. That means we praise Him with our words.
Do not forget to do good and share with others. God is pleased with gifts like these.
Obey your leaders and listen to them. They watch over you, and they will have to answer to God for you. Let them do this with joy, not with sadness. Sadness would not help you.
Pray for us. We believe we have a clear heart, and we want to live the right way in everything.
I ask you even more to pray, so I can come back to you soon.

May the God of peace make you ready to do every good thing, so you can do His will. He brought back our Lord Jesus from the dead through the blood of the forever promise. Jesus is the great Shepherd of the sheep.
May God do in us what pleases Him through Jesus Christ. Give Him glory forever and ever. Amen.
Brothers, please listen to my encouraging words. I wrote only a short letter.
Know that our brother Timothy has been set free. If he comes soon, I will come with him to see you.
Greet all your leaders and all God's people. The people from Italy send greetings to you.
May grace be with all of you.
James is a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. He writes to the twelve tribes scattered among the nations. Greetings.
My brothers, be very happy when you face all kinds of troubles.
You know that when your faith is tested, it helps you learn to keep going.
Let that help you keep going until it is finished. Then you will be grown up and whole. You will not lack anything.
If any of you needs wisdom, ask God. He gives to everyone freely and does not scold. He will give it to him.
But ask with faith. Do not doubt. A person who doubts is like a wave of the sea blown and tossed by the wind.
That person should not think he will get anything from the Lord.
He cannot make up his mind. He is not steady in anything he does.
A brother who is poor should be glad that God lifts him up.
A rich person should be glad that God humbles him. He will pass away like a wildflower.
The sun rises hot and dries up the grass. The flower falls off. Its beauty is gone. In the same way, rich people will fade away while they are busy.
Happy is the person who keeps going when tested. After he passes the test, he will get the crown of life. God promised it to those who love Him.
No one should say when tempted, "God is tempting me." God is not tempted by evil. He does not tempt anyone.
Each person is tempted when his own desire pulls him away and traps him.
Then desire grows and gives birth to sin. When sin is finished, it brings death.
Do not be fooled, my dear brothers.
Every good gift and every perfect gift comes from above. It comes from the Father who made the lights. He does not change like shifting shadows.
He chose to give us new life through the true word. He made us the first and best of all He made.
My dear brothers, know this: Everyone should listen quickly, speak slowly, and be slow to get angry.
A person's anger does not make things right with God.
So throw away all dirty and evil things. Humbly accept the word planted in you. It can save your souls.
Do what the word says. Do not just listen. If you only listen, you fool yourselves.
If someone listens to the word but does not do it, he is like a man looking at his face in a mirror.
He looks at himself, goes away, and right away forgets what he looked like.
But the person who looks into the perfect law that gives freedom and keeps at it is not a forgetful listener. He does what it says. He will be blessed in what he does.
If someone thinks he is religious but cannot control his tongue, he tricks his own heart. His religion is useless.
Pure and clean religion before God the Father is this: Help orphans and widows in their trouble. Keep yourselves clean from the world.
My brothers and sisters, you believe in our great Lord Jesus Christ. Do not treat some people better than others.
Imagine a man comes to your meeting. He wears a gold ring and nice clothes. A poor man comes in too. His clothes are dirty.
If you give the rich man a good seat and say, “Sit here, please,” but you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my feet,”
then you have treated people unfairly. You have become judges with bad thoughts.
Listen, my dear brothers and sisters. Hasn't God chosen poor people in this world? He makes them rich in faith. He gives them the kingdom He promised to people who love Him.
But you shame poor people. Aren't rich people the ones who treat you badly? They take you to court.
They say bad things about the good name you were given.
If you follow the great rule in the Bible, “Love your neighbor as you love yourself,” you do well.
But if you treat some people better than others, you sin. The law says you broke its rules.
A person who keeps all of God's law but breaks one small part is guilty of breaking all of it.
God said, “Do not be unfaithful in marriage.” He also said, “Do not kill.” If you do not cheat in marriage but you kill someone, you have broken God's law.
Talk and act like people who will be judged by the law that gives freedom.
God will judge without mercy people who did not show mercy. But mercy is stronger than judgment.
My brothers and sisters, what good is it if someone says he has faith but does no good works? Can that faith save him?
Suppose a brother or sister has no clothes and not enough food for the day.
If one of you says, “Go in peace. Stay warm and eat well,” but you do not give them what they need, what good is that?
So faith alone, with no good works, is dead.
But someone may say, “You have faith, and I have good works.” Show me your faith with no good works. I will show you my faith by my good works.
You believe God is one. Good! Even the demons believe that, and they shake with fear.
You foolish person, do you want proof that faith with no good works is useless?
Wasn't our father Abraham made right with God by what he did? He offered his son Isaac on the altar.
You see that his faith worked with his actions. His faith was made complete by what he did.
The Bible came true. It says, “Abraham believed God, and God counted it as right.” Abraham was called God's friend.
So you see that a person is made right with God by good works, not by faith alone.
In the same way, wasn't Rahab the prostitute made right with God by her actions? She welcomed the spies and sent them out another way.
Just as a body with no life is dead, faith with no good works is dead.
My brothers, not many of you should be teachers. We know we will be judged more strictly.
We all make many mistakes. If someone does not make mistakes with words, that person is good. That person can keep the whole body under control.
We put bits in horses' mouths. Then they obey us. We can turn their whole body.
Look at ships. They are big. Strong winds push them. But a small rudder turns them where the driver wants.
The tongue is small too. But it says big things. Look how a little fire can burn a big forest.
The tongue is a fire. It is a world of wrong. It is among the parts of our body. It makes the whole body dirty. It sets the whole life on fire. It is set on fire by hell.
People have tamed all kinds of animals, birds, snakes, and sea creatures.
But no person can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil. It is full of deadly poison.
With it we praise the Lord and Father. With it we curse people made in God's likeness.
Praise and cursing come from the same mouth. My brothers, this should not be.
Can sweet water and bitter water come from the same spring?
My brothers, can a fig tree make olives? Can a grapevine make figs? No. Salt water cannot make fresh water.
Who is wise and knows things among you? Show it by a good life and by works done with gentle wisdom.
If you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not brag and lie against the truth.
This wisdom is not from heaven. It is earthly, natural, and demonic.
Where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is disorder and every evil thing.
But wisdom from above is first pure. Then it is peace-loving, gentle, willing to listen, full of mercy and good fruit. It is fair and not fake.
People who make peace plant peace. The fruit of right living grows.
Where do fights and wars come from among you? Don't they come from the bad wants inside you?
You want things and don't have them. You kill and are jealous, but you still can't get them. You fight and make war. You don't have things because you don't ask God.
When you do ask, you don't get them, because you ask for bad reasons. You want to use them for your own fun.
You are not faithful to God! Don't you know that being friends with the world makes you an enemy of God? Anyone who wants to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.
Do you think the Bible says this for no reason? The Spirit that God put in us wants us for Himself. He is jealous for us.
But God gives even more grace. That is why it says, "God stands against proud people, but He gives grace to humble people."
So give yourselves to God. Stand against the devil, and he will run away from you.
Come close to God, and He will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners. Make your hearts clean, you people who can't decide.
Be sad and cry. Let your laughing turn to crying, and your joy turn to sadness.
Be humble before the Lord, and He will lift you up.

Brothers, don't say bad things about each other. Anyone who says bad things about a brother or judges that brother says bad things about God's law and judges it. But if you judge God's law, you are not following it. You are acting like its judge.
There is only One who made the law and who judges. He can save people or destroy them. So who are you to judge your neighbor?
Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this city. We will stay there a year and buy and sell and make money."
You don't even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? It is like a fog that shows up for a little while and then is gone.
Instead, you should say, "If the Lord wants us to, we will live and do this or that."
But now you brag with pride. All that kind of bragging is bad.
So if someone knows the right thing to do and doesn't do it, that is sin.
Come now, you rich people. Cry and wail, because hard times are coming to you.
Your money has gone bad. Moths have eaten your clothes.
Your gold and silver have rusted. Their rust will show you are wrong. It will eat your bodies like fire. You saved up money for the last days.
Look, the pay you kept from the workers who cut your fields is crying out against you. The harvesters' cries have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
You lived for fun and comfort. You fed your hearts for the day of slaughter.
You judged and killed the good man. He does not fight back against you.
So be patient, brothers. Wait until the Lord comes. Look at the farmer. He waits for the good crop from the land. He is patient until it gets the early and late rain.
You be patient too. Make your hearts strong, because the Lord is coming soon.
Do not groan against each other, brothers, so you will not be judged. Look, the Judge stands at the door.
Brothers, look at the prophets. They suffered and were patient. They spoke in the name of the Lord. Take them as an example.
We think people who keep going are blessed. You have heard about Job. He kept going. You saw what the Lord did at the end. The Lord is full of kindness and mercy.
Above all, my brothers, do not swear. Do not swear by heaven, earth, or anything else. Let your yes be yes, and your no be no. Then you will not fall under judgment.
Is anyone among you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone happy? He should sing.
Is anyone among you sick? He should call the church leaders. They should pray over him and rub oil on him in the name of the Lord.
The prayer of faith will save the sick person. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
So tell each other your sins. Pray for each other, so you may be healed. The prayer of a good person is powerful and it works.
Elijah was a man like us. He prayed hard that it would not rain. It did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
He prayed again. The sky gave rain. The land grew its crop.
My brothers, if one of you wanders from the truth, and someone brings him back,
know this: The one who turns a sinner from his wrong way will save his soul from death. He will cover a lot of sins.
Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, writes to God's chosen people. You live as strangers in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
God the Father chose you by His plan. The Spirit makes you holy. You obey Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with His blood. Grace and peace be yours in full.
Praise God! He is the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. He has great mercy. He gave us new life. Now we hope for good things because Jesus rose from the dead.
We will receive a gift that never breaks, never gets dirty, and never fades. It is kept in heaven for you.
God's power keeps you safe through faith. You will be saved. This will be shown at the last time.
You are glad now. Even if for a little while you must be sad in many hard tests, you can still be glad.
Your faith is worth more than gold that burns up. Tested by fire, it will bring praise, glory, and honor when Jesus Christ is shown.
You love Him even though you have not seen Him. You do not see Him now, but you trust Him. You are filled with joy too great for words.
You are getting the goal of your faith: saving your souls.
The prophets searched and studied about this saving grace for you.
They tried to learn when and how it would happen. Christ's Spirit in them told about Christ's suffering and the glory that would come after.
They learned they served you, not just themselves. Now the good news is told to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Angels want to look into these things.
So get your minds ready. Be calm and clear. Put all your hope in the grace that will come to you when Jesus Christ is shown.
Be like children who obey. Do not go back to old desires from when you did not know better.
The One who called you is holy. You be holy in all you do.
It is written, "Be holy, because I am holy."
If you call on the Father who judges each person's work fairly, live with fear during your time here.
You know you were not bought back with things that pass away, like silver or gold.
You were bought with Christ's precious blood, like a lamb with no spot or stain.
He was chosen before the world began. He was shown in these last times for you.
Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory. So your faith and hope are in God.
You cleaned your souls by obeying the truth. Love each other deeply from a pure heart.
You were born again, not from seed that dies, but from the living, lasting word of God.
"All people are like grass. All their glory is like a flower of grass. The grass dries up. The flower falls."
"But the word of the the LORD lasts forever." This word is the good news told to you.
So, put away all badness, tricking, pretending, being jealous, and talking bad about people.
Like new babies, want pure milk from God's word. Then you can grow up and be saved.
You have tasted that the Lord is good.
Come to Him. He is the living stone. People did not want Him. But God chose Him. He is very special to God.
You are like living stones too. You are being built into a spiritual house. You are a holy group of priests. You offer spiritual gifts that God accepts through Jesus Christ.
It says in the Bible, "Look! I put a stone in Zion. It is chosen and very special. It is the most important stone. Anyone who trusts in Him will not be put to shame."
So to you who believe, He is very special. But to those who do not believe, "The stone the builders did not want became the most important stone."
And, "A stone that makes people trip, and a rock that makes them fall." They trip because they do not obey the word. That is what they were made for.
But you are a chosen family. You are royal priests. You are a holy nation. You are God's own people. You tell about the good things of the One who called you out of darkness into His amazing light.
Once you were not a people. Now you are God's people. Once you had not received mercy. Now you have received mercy.
Dear friends, I ask you, as strangers and visitors in this world, to stay away from wrong wants of the body. They fight against your soul.
Live good lives among other people. Then, when they say bad things about you as if you were bad people, they will see your good works. They will praise God on the day He comes to judge.
For the Lord's sake, obey every human rule. Obey the king, because he is the top ruler.
Obey the leaders, because they are sent by him to punish bad people and praise good people.
God wants you to do good. Then you will stop foolish people from saying bad things, because they do not know.
Live like free people. But do not use your freedom to cover up bad things. Live like servants of God.
Honor all people. Love the family of believers. Fear God. Honor the king.
Servants, obey your masters with all respect. Obey not only the good and kind ones, but also the mean ones.
It is a good thing if someone suffers pain for doing right, because he wants to please God.
What good is it if you are hit for doing wrong and you take it? But if you suffer for doing good and take it, that is a good thing in God's eyes.
You were called to this. Christ suffered for you. He left you an example to follow in His steps.
He did no wrong. No lie was found in His mouth.
When people said bad things to Him, He did not say bad things back. When He suffered, He did not threaten. He gave Himself to the One who judges fairly.
He carried our sins in His body on the cross. He did this so we could stop living for sin and live for what is right. By His wounds, you are healed.
You were like sheep that went the wrong way. But now you have turned back to the Shepherd and Guardian of your souls.
Wives, in the same way, obey your own husbands. Then even if some do not obey God's word, they can be won over without talking.
They will see your clean and respectful lives.
Your beauty should not come from outside things, like fancy hair, gold jewelry, or fine clothes.
It should come from who you are inside. That beauty lasts forever. It is a gentle and calm spirit. That is very special to God.
For this is how good women long ago made themselves beautiful. They trusted God and obeyed their own husbands.
Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her daughters if you do good and are not scared of anything frightening.
Husbands, in the same way, live with your wives and understand them. They are more delicate. Honor them because they share God's gift of life with you. Then nothing will block your prayers.
Last of all, everyone should think the same way. Care about each other's feelings. Love each other like family. Be kind. Do not be proud.
Do not pay back bad for bad or mean words for mean words. Instead, bless them. God called you to do this so you can receive a blessing.
"For anyone who wants to love life and see good days should keep their tongue from evil and not tell lies.
They should turn away from evil and do good. They should look for peace and go after it.
The eyes of the LORD are on good people. He hears their prayers. But the face of the LORD is against people who do bad things."
Who can hurt you if you try hard to do good?
But even if you suffer for doing right, you are blessed. Do not be afraid of their threats. Do not be upset.
But in your hearts, make Christ your Lord. Always be ready to tell anyone who asks you why you have hope. Do it gently and with respect.
Keep a clean heart. Then people who say bad things about you will be ashamed when they see your good life in Christ.
It is better to suffer for doing good than for doing bad, if that is what God wants.
Christ suffered for sins one time. He was good, but He suffered for bad people, to bring you to God. He died in His body, but He was made alive in the Spirit.
In the Spirit, He went and preached to spirits in prison.
These spirits disobeyed long ago, when God waited patiently while Noah built the ark. Only eight people were saved by water.
This water is like baptism, which now saves you. It is not washing dirt from the body. It is asking God for a clean heart. It saves you because Jesus Christ rose from the dead.
He has gone to heaven. He sits at God's right hand. Angels, rulers, and powers obey Him.
Christ suffered in His body. So you should think the same way. Anyone who suffers in the body has stopped living for sin.
Live the rest of your time in the body not for what people want, but for what God wants.
You already had enough time to do what people who do not know God want. You lived in sexual sin, bad desires, drinking too much, wild parties, and worship of false gods.
Now they are shocked that you do not join them in the same wild life of sin. So they say bad things about you.
But they will have to answer to God. He is ready to judge the living and the dead.
This is why the good news was told even to people who have died. They were judged in the body like all people. But they can live in the spirit like God.
The end of all things is near. So be wise and stay awake so you can pray.
Most of all, love each other deeply. Love covers many sins.
Welcome guests with love. Do not complain.
Each of you has received a gift. Use it to help each other. Be good workers with God's many gifts.
If you speak, speak God's words. If you serve, serve with the strength God gives. Then God will be praised in everything through Jesus Christ. He has glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
Dear friends, do not be surprised by the hard test that comes to you. Do not think it is strange, as if something strange is happening to you.
But be glad that you share in Christ's sufferings. Then you will be very glad and happy when His glory is shown.
If you are made fun of for Christ's name, you are blessed. The Spirit of glory and God rests on you.
But none of you should suffer because you are a murderer, a thief, a bad person, or a busybody.
But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed. Praise God because of that name.
It is time for God to judge. It starts with God's family. If it starts with us, what will happen to people who do not obey God's good news?
And, "If it is hard for a good person to be saved, what will happen to people who do not know God and who sin?"
So those who suffer because it is God's will should give their souls to God, who made everything. He is faithful. Keep doing good.
I am an elder too. I saw Christ suffer. I will share in the glory that will be shown. I ask the elders among you to listen.
Take care of God's people near you. Watch over them. Do it because you want to, not because you have to. Do it with a ready heart, not to make money.
Do not boss the people God gave you. Be a good example to them.
When the Chief Shepherd comes, you will get a crown of glory that never fades.
Younger people, obey your elders. All of you should wear humility like clothes when you are with each other. God fights against proud people, but He gives grace to humble people.
So be humble under God's strong hand. Then He will lift you up at the right time.
Give all your worries to Him, because He cares about you.
Stay alert and be careful. The devil is your enemy. He walks around like a roaring lion. He wants to eat someone up.
Stand up to him. Stay strong in your faith. Remember that your brothers and sisters all over the world are going through the same hard times.

After you suffer for a little while, God will make you whole again. He is the God who gives all grace. He called you to share His glory that lasts forever in Christ. He will make you steady, make you strong, and give you a firm base.
All power belongs to Him forever. Amen.
I wrote this short letter through Silvanus. I think he is a faithful brother. I am asking you and telling you that this is God's true grace. Stay in it.
The church in Babylon, chosen with you, says hello. So does my son Mark.
Say hello to each other with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
Simon Peter, a servant and messenger of Jesus Christ. To those who got a faith as special as ours. It came through the right way of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ.
May God give you more and more grace and peace as you know God and Jesus our Lord.
His power has given us everything we need for life and living for God. We get it through knowing Him who called us by His own glory and goodness.
Through these, He gave us great and very special promises. Through them, you can share in God's own life. You can also get away from the bad wants in the world that ruin people.
So do your best to add goodness to your faith. Then add knowing to your goodness.
Add self-control to your knowing. Add patience to your self-control. Add living for God to your patience.
Add love for brothers and sisters to your living for God. Add love to that love.
If you have these things and they grow, you will not be lazy or useless in knowing our Lord Jesus Christ.
But anyone who does not have them is blind. He can see only what is close. He forgot that God washed away his old sins.
So, brothers and sisters, work hard to make sure God called you and chose you. If you do these things, you will never fall.
Then God will richly welcome you into the kingdom that lasts forever. That is the kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
So I will always remind you about these things. You already know them. You are strong in the truth you have.
I think it is right to wake you up with this reminder while I am still in this body.
I know I will soon leave this body behind. Our Lord Jesus Christ showed me this.
I will work hard so that after I leave, you will always remember these things.
We did not follow made-up stories when we told you about the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We saw His glory with our own eyes.
God the Father gave Him honor and glory. A voice came to Him from the great and glorious God. "This is My Son, whom I love. I am very pleased with Him."
We heard this voice from heaven. We were with Him on the holy mountain.

We also have the prophets' words. They are even more sure. You are right to pay attention to them. They are like a lamp shining in a dark place. They shine until the day comes and light shines in your hearts.
First, know this: no message from God in the Bible came from a person's own idea.
For no message from God ever came by a person's want. Instead, people spoke from God as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

But in the past there were also false prophets among the people. In the same way, there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly bring in wrong ideas that destroy people. They will even turn their backs on the Master who bought them. They will bring quick ruin on themselves.
Many people will follow their bad ways. Because of them, people will say bad things about the true way.
They will cheat you with fake words because they want money. Their punishment was decided long ago. It is real, and their ruin is coming.
God did not spare the angels who sinned. He sent them to a dark place and tied them with chains. They are kept there until they are judged.
God did not spare the old world either. He brought a flood on the world of people who did not obey Him. But He kept Noah safe. Noah told people to do right. Noah and seven others were saved.
God also punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. He burned them to ashes. He made them a warning for people who will not obey God later.
But God saved Lot. Lot was a good man. He was upset by the dirty lives of the lawless people around him.
That good man lived among them day after day. What he saw and heard hurt his good heart.
So the Lord knows how to save good people from trouble. He also knows how to keep bad people for punishment until the day they are judged.
This is very true for people who follow their bad body wants and hate anyone telling them what to do. They are bold and stubborn. They are not afraid to say mean things about great beings.
Even angels are stronger and have more power than they do. But angels do not say mean things about them to the Lord.

But these people are like animals that do not think. They live by instinct. They are born to be caught and destroyed. They say mean things about things they do not understand. They will be destroyed like animals.
They will be paid back with hurt for the hurt they caused. They think having fun means partying in the daytime. They are spots and stains. They enjoy fooling people while they eat with you.

Their eyes are full of wrong desire for other people's wives. They never stop sinning. They trick people who are not strong in faith. They have hearts that practice wanting more and more. They are children under a curse.
They left the straight road and went the wrong way. They followed the way of Balaam son of Beor. He loved getting paid to do wrong.
But a donkey scolded him for his wrong. The donkey could not talk, but it spoke with a man's voice. It stopped the prophet from acting crazy.
These people are like wells with no water. They are like clouds blown by a storm. The darkest dark is saved for them.
They say proud and empty things. They use body wants to trick people who are just getting away from those who live in error.
They promise freedom, but they are slaves to ruin. A person is a slave to whatever controls them.
If people escape the bad things of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, and then get trapped in them again and lose, their last state is worse than the first.
It would have been better for them not to know the right way than to know it and turn away from the holy rule given to them.
This old saying is true for them: "A dog goes back to its own throw-up, and a washed pig goes back to roll in the mud."
Dear friends, this is the second letter I write to you. I write to wake up your true thinking. I want you to remember.
Remember the words the holy prophets said. Remember the command from our Lord and Savior. His apostles gave that command to you.
First, know this. In the last days, people who make fun will come. They will follow their own bad wants.
They will say, "Where is the promise that He will come? Our fathers died long ago. But everything is the same as it was from the start of the world."
They choose not to see this. Long ago, God's word made the heavens. He made the earth too. The earth came from water and was made with water.
Water also destroyed the world back then. It was a great flood.
God's same word keeps the heavens and earth we have now. They are kept for fire. They are kept for the day God judges people. That day will destroy people who do not follow God.
Dear friends, do not forget this. To the Lord, one day is like a thousand years. A thousand years are like one day.
The Lord is not slow to keep His promise. Some people think He is slow. But He is patient with you. He does not want anyone to die in sin. He wants everyone to turn from sin.

But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will pass away with a loud noise. The parts of the world will burn up and be destroyed. The earth and what people have done on it will not be found.
Since all these things will be destroyed, what kind of people should you be? You should live holy lives. You should live for God.
Look for the day of God. Want it to come soon. On that day, the heavens will burn and be destroyed. The parts of the world will melt in the heat.
But God promised something new. We look for new heavens and a new earth. Only right living will be there.
So, dear friends, since you look for these things, try hard. Be found by Him in peace. Be clean from sin. Be without blame.
Think of our Lord's patience as a chance to be saved. Our dear brother Paul wrote to you about this. God gave him wisdom to write it.

He writes about these things in all his letters. Some parts are hard to understand. People who do not know much and people who are not strong twist those parts. They also twist the other holy writings. They do this to destroy themselves.
Dear friends, you already know this. Be careful. Do not be led away by the wrong teaching of people who break God's rules. Do not fall from your strong faith.
Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. May He have glory now and forever. Amen.
We tell about the Word that gives life. He was there from the start. We heard Him. We saw Him with our own eyes. We looked at Him, and our hands touched Him.
This life was shown to us. We saw it, and we tell you about it. We tell you about life that lasts forever. It was with the Father, and it was shown to us.
We tell you what we saw and heard. We do this so you can share life with us. We share life with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
We write these things so our joy will be full.
Here is the message we heard from Him and tell you: God is light. There is no darkness in Him at all.
If we say, "We share life with Him," but we live in darkness, we lie. We do not do what is true.
But if we live in the light, like He is in the light, we share life with each other. The blood of Jesus, His Son, makes us clean from all sin.
If we say, "We have no sin," we fool ourselves. The truth is not in us.
If we tell God our sins, He is faithful and fair. He will forgive our sins and make us clean from all wrong.
If we say, "We have not sinned," we make Him a liar. His word is not in us.
My dear children, I write this to you so you won't sin. But if anyone does sin, we have Someone who speaks for us to the Father. He is Jesus Christ, and He is always right.
He is the one who paid for our sins. He did not pay for only our sins. He paid for the sins of the whole world.
We know we know Him when we obey His commands.
If someone says, "I know Him," but does not obey His commands, that person is a liar. The truth is not in that person.
But if someone keeps His word, God's love is truly made complete in that person. This is how we know we are in Him.
If someone says they stay in Him, they should live like He lived.
Dear friends, I am not giving you a new rule. I am giving you an old rule you have had since the start. The old rule is the message you heard.
But I am also giving you a new rule. It is true in Him and in you. The dark is going away, and the true light is already shining.
If someone says they are in the light but hates their brother, they are still in the dark.
Anyone who loves their brother stays in the light. There is nothing in them that makes them fall.
But if someone hates their brother, they are in the dark. They walk in the dark. They do not know where they are going, because the dark has blinded their eyes.
Dear children, I write to you because your sins are forgiven because of His name.
Fathers, I write to you because you know Him who has been there from the start. Young men, I write to you because you have beaten the evil one. Children, I write to you because you know the Father.
Fathers, I wrote to you because you know Him who has been there from the start. Young men, I wrote to you because you are strong. God's word stays in you. You have beaten the evil one.
Do not love the world or the things in it. If anyone loves the world, the Father's love is not in them.

All that is in the world is not from the Father. It is wanting things for our bodies, wanting what we see, and being proud of what we have. These do not come from the Father. They come from the world.
The world and its wants are passing away. But anyone who does what God wants will live forever.
Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ is coming. Now many enemies of Christ have come. So we know this is the last hour.
They left us. But they were not really with us. If they had been with us, they would have stayed with us. They left so it would be clear that not all of them were with us.
But you have a special gift from the Holy One. You know these things.
I write to you, not because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it. No lie comes from the truth.
Who is the liar? It is the one who says Jesus is not the Christ. That person is the enemy of Christ. They say no to the Father and the Son.
Anyone who rejects the Son does not have the Father. Anyone who accepts the Son has the Father too.
Keep in your hearts what you heard from the start. If you keep it in your hearts, you will stay in the Son and in the Father.
He promised us life that never ends.
I write this to you about people who try to trick you.
But the gift you got from Him stays in you. You do not need anyone to teach you. His gift teaches you about everything. It is true and not a lie. Stay in Him, just as it taught you.
Now, dear children, stay in Him. Then, when He comes, we can be brave. We will not be ashamed when He comes.
If you know He is good, then you know this: anyone who does what is right has been born from Him.
Look at how much love the Father has given us. He calls us God's children, and we are. That is why the world does not know us. It did not know Him.
Dear friends, we are God's children now. We do not yet know what we will be. But we know this: when He shows Himself, we will be like Him. We will see Him just as He is.
Everyone who has this hope in Him keeps himself pure, just as He is pure.
Everyone who sins breaks God's law. Sin is breaking God's law.
And you know that He came to take away sins. There is no sin in Him.
No one who stays in Him keeps sinning. No one who keeps sinning has seen Him or known Him.
Dear children, do not let anyone trick you. The person who does what is right is right, just as He is right.
The person who keeps sinning belongs to the devil. The devil has been sinning since the beginning. The Son of God came to destroy the devil's work.
No one born of God keeps sinning. God's seed stays in him. He cannot keep sinning because he is born of God.
This shows who God's children are and who the devil's children are. Anyone who does not do what is right is not from God. Neither is anyone who does not love his brother.
This is the message you heard from the start: we should love one another.
Do not be like Cain. He belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his own deeds were evil, but his brother's deeds were good.
Do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
We know we have moved from death to life because we love our brothers. Anyone who does not love stays in death.
Anyone who hates his brother is a murderer. And you know that no murderer has life that lasts forever living in him.
We know what love is by this: He gave His life for us. So we should give our lives for our brothers.
If someone has things of this world and sees his brother in need, but closes his heart to him, how can God's love stay in him?
Dear children, let us not just say we love with words. Let us love by what we do and by being true.
By this we will know we belong to the truth. We will feel sure in our hearts before Him.
If our hearts say we are wrong, God is greater than our hearts. He knows everything.
Dear friends, if our hearts do not say we are wrong, we can be bold with God.
We get what we ask from Him because we obey His commands and do what pleases Him.
His command is this: believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as He told us.
The person who obeys His commands stays in Him, and He stays in that person. By this we know He stays in us: He gave us His Spirit.
Dear friends, do not believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see if they come from God. Many fake prophets have gone out into the world.
This is how you know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that says Jesus Christ came in the flesh is from God.
Every spirit that does not say this about Jesus is not from God. That is the spirit of the antichrist. You have heard it is coming, and it is already in the world.
You are from God, dear children. You have won over them, because the One in you is greater than the one in the world.
They are from the world. So they speak like the world, and the world listens to them.
We are from God. The person who knows God listens to us. The person who is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of lies.
Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
The person who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
God showed His love to us this way: He sent His only Son into the world so that we may live through Him.
This is love: not that we loved God, but that He loved us. He sent His Son to take away our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us so much, we should love one another.
No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us, and His love is made complete in us.
This is how we know we live in Him and He lives in us: He has given us His Spirit.
We have seen and tell others that the Father sent His Son to save the world.
If anyone says Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him, and he lives in God.
We have known and believed the love God has for us. God is love. The person who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in him.
Love is made complete in us this way: We can be brave on judgment day. We are like Him in this world.
There is no fear in love. Perfect love pushes fear away. Fear brings punishment. A person who is afraid has not been made perfect in love.
We love because He first loved us.
If someone says, "I love God," but hates his brother, he is a liar. A person who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
We have this command from Him: The person who loves God must also love his brother.
Everyone who believes Jesus is the Christ is born of God.
Everyone who loves the Father loves His child too. We know we love God's children when we love God and keep His commands.
Loving God means keeping His commands. And His commands are not hard.
Everything born of God wins over the world. Our faith is the win that wins over the world.
Who wins over the world? The one who believes Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ is the One who came by water and blood. He came not by water only, but by water and blood. The Spirit tells the truth, because the Spirit is the truth.
There are three who tell about it.
They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood. The three agree as one.
We take people's words. But God's word is greater. God has told about His Son.
The one who believes in the Son of God has this word in him. The one who does not believe God calls God a liar, because he did not believe God's word about His Son.
This is God's word: God gave us life that lasts forever. This life is in His Son.
The one who has the Son has life. The one who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I wrote these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God. I want you to know you have life that lasts forever.
We can come to God with courage. If we ask for anything that fits His will, He hears us.
If we know He hears us, we know we have what we asked from Him.

If anyone sees his brother sin in a way that does not lead to death, he should ask God. God will give life to those who sin in a way that does not lead to death. There is sin that leads to death. I am not saying to pray about that.
All wrong is sin. But there is sin that does not lead to death.
We know everyone born of God does not keep sinning. The One born of God keeps him safe. The evil one does not touch him.
We know we are from God. The whole world lies in the evil one.
We know the Son of God has come. He helped us understand so we may know Him who is true. We are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and life that lasts forever.
Dear children, keep yourselves away from false gods.
The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children. I love them in the truth. All who know the truth love them too.
The truth stays in us, and it will be with us forever.
Grace, mercy, and peace come from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father. They will be with us in truth and love.
I was very happy. I found that some of your children are walking in the truth. This is what the Father told us to do.
Now I ask you, lady, not for a new rule. I write this rule we have had from the start: We should love each other.
This is love: We follow His rules. This is the rule you heard from the start. You should walk in it.
Many liars have gone into the world. They do not say that Jesus Christ came as a real person. Such a person is a liar and against Christ.
Watch yourselves, so you do not lose what we worked for. Then you can get the full reward.
Anyone who goes too far and does not stay in Christ's teaching does not have God. The one who stays in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If someone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not let him in. Do not even say hello to him.
Anyone who says hello to him shares in his bad work.
I have much more to write to you. I do not want to use paper and ink. I hope to come and talk with you face to face. Then our joy will be full.
The children of your chosen sister greet you.
The older church leader writes to Gaius, whom he loves truly.
Dear friend, I pray that you do well in all things and stay healthy, just as your soul does well.
I was very happy when brothers came and said you live in the truth, just as you really do.
I have no greater joy than this: I hear that my children live in the truth.
Dear friend, you are faithful in all you do for the brothers, even for strangers.
They told the church about your love. You will do well to help them on their way in a way that honors God.
They went out to work for God’s Name. They took no help from people who are not believers.
So we should help people like them. Then we work together for the truth.
I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who likes to be first, will not welcome us.

So if I come, I will talk about what he does. He says bad things about us. He is not satisfied with that. He will not welcome the brothers either. He stops anyone who wants to welcome them. He throws them out of the church.
Dear friend, do not copy what is bad. Copy what is good. The person who does good belongs to God. The person who does bad has not seen God.
Everyone says good things about Demetrius. The truth itself says so too. We also say he is good. You know that what we say is true.
I had many things to write to you. But I do not want to write with pen and ink.
I hope to see you soon. Then we can talk face to face. Peace to you. The friends say hello to you. Say hello to the friends by name.
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, writes to the people God called. God the Father loves you. Jesus Christ keeps you safe.
May you have lots of mercy, peace, and love.
Dear friends, I wanted to write to you about how God saves us all. But I felt I had to write to you. I want you to fight for the faith God gave His holy people.
Some bad men have slipped in among you. Long ago God said they would be judged. They change God's grace into an excuse to do wrong. They also say no to our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
You already know this, but I want to remind you. Jesus saved His people out of Egypt. Later He destroyed those who did not believe.
Some angels did not stay in their high place. They left their own home. He keeps them in dark chains forever. They will be judged on the great day.
Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them did the same kind of wrong. They are an example of people who suffer forever in fire.
These men also have dreams. They make their bodies dirty. They do not obey leaders. They speak bad words against glorious beings.
But even Michael, the top angel, did not dare to say a bad judgment when he argued with the devil about Moses' body. He said, "The The LORD rebuke you!"
But these men say bad things about what they do not know. They act like animals. They know some things by instinct, but those things destroy them.
How sad for them! They follow Cain's bad way. They run after money like Balaam did wrong. They are destroyed like Korah's people.

These men are spots in your love feasts. They eat with you and do not care. They only feed themselves. They are clouds with no rain, blown by wind. They are fall trees with no fruit, pulled up by roots. They died twice.
They are wild sea waves that foam up their shame. They are wandering stars. Dark, dark night is kept for them forever.
Enoch was the seventh man after Adam. He said this about them:

"See, the the LORD is coming with thousands and thousands of His holy ones. He will judge all people. He will show all ungodly people they are wrong for all the bad things they did. He will show them they are wrong for all the hard words they said against Him."
These men complain and find fault. They follow their own wrong wants. They brag with big words. They praise people only to get something.
But, dear friends, remember the words the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said before.
They told you, "In the last days, people will make fun of God. They will follow their own bad wants."
These men split you up. They follow only what feels natural. They do not have the Spirit.
But you, dear friends, build each other up in your most holy faith. Pray with the help of the Holy Spirit.
Keep in God's love. Wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that gives life forever.
Be kind to people who doubt.
Save some people by pulling them out of the fire. Be kind to others, but be afraid. Hate even clothes made dirty by sin.
God can keep you from falling. He can bring you to His glory with no blame and with great joy.
To the only God who saves us, give glory, greatness, power, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord. This was true before time, now, and forever. Amen.
This book is about Jesus Christ. God gave it to Him to show His servants what must happen soon. He sent His angel to His servant John to make it known.
John told about everything he saw. He saw God's word and the truth about Jesus Christ.
God blesses the person who reads these words out loud. God blesses the people who hear them and obey them. The time is near.
I, John, write to the seven churches in Asia. May grace and peace be with you. They come from the One who is, who was, and who is coming. They also come from the seven Spirits in front of His throne.
They come from Jesus Christ too. He is the true witness. He is the first to rise from the dead. He rules over the kings of the earth. Jesus loves us. He set us free from our sins with His blood.
He made us a kingdom of priests for His God and Father. Glory and power belong to Him forever and ever. Amen.
"Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see Him. Even the people who hurt Him will see Him. All the people on earth will cry because of Him." Yes, it will happen. Amen.
The Lord God says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega. I am the One who is, who was, and who is coming. I am the All-Powerful One."

I, John, am your brother. I share with you in the hard times, the kingdom, and the patient waiting that we have in Jesus. I was on the island of Patmos. I was there because of God's word and the truth about Jesus.
On the Lord's Day, the Spirit came on me. I heard a loud voice behind me. It sounded like a trumpet.
The voice said, "Write in a book what you see. Send it to the seven churches. Send it to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
I turned to see who was talking to me. When I turned, I saw seven gold lampstands.
In the middle of them stood someone like the Son of Man. He wore a long robe down to His feet. He had a gold belt around His chest.
His head and hair were white like wool, as white as snow. His eyes were like fire.
His feet were like shiny bronze in a hot fire. His voice was like the sound of rushing water.
He held seven stars in His right hand. A sharp sword with two edges came out of His mouth. His face shone like the bright sun.
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. He put His right hand on me. He said, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.
I am the One who lives. I was dead, but now I am alive forever and ever. I hold the keys to death and the place of the dead.
"Write what you have seen, what is happening now, and what will happen later.
Here is the secret meaning of the seven stars in My right hand and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches. The seven lampstands are the seven churches."
To the angel of the church in Ephesus, write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven gold lampstands.
I know your deeds, your hard work, and your staying strong. I know you cannot stand bad people. You tested those who say they are apostles but are not, and you found them to be liars.
You have kept going and have endured hard things for My name, and you have not grown tired.
But I have this against you: You have left the love you had at first. “
Think about how far you have fallen! Turn from your sin and do the things you did at first. If you do not turn, I will come to you and take your lampstand out of its place.
But you have this good thing: You hate what the Nicolaitans do, and I hate it too. “
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life in God's paradise.” “
To the angel of the church in Smyrna, write: These are the words of the One who is the First and the Last, who died and came back to life.
I know your trouble and your poverty, but you are rich! I know the bad things said by those who say they are Jews but are not. They are really a meeting place of Satan. “

Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will put some of you in jail to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful even if it costs you your life, and I will give you the crown of life.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who wins will not be hurt by the second death.” “
To the angel of the church in Pergamum, write: These are the words of the One who has the sharp sword with two edges.

I know where you live, where Satan has his throne. Yet you hold on to My name. You did not turn away from your faith in Me, even when Antipas, My faithful witness, was killed among you, where Satan lives. “
But I have a few things against you: Some of you follow the teaching of Balaam. He taught Balak to lead the people of Israel into sin, so they ate food offered to idols and did sexual wrong.
In the same way, some of you follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans. “
So turn from your sin! If you do not, I will come to you soon and fight against them with the sword from My mouth.

Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, a name only the one who gets it knows.” “
To the angel of the church in Thyatira, write: These are the words of the Son of God. His eyes are like fire, and His feet are like shiny bronze.
I know your deeds, your love, your faith, your service, and your staying strong. Your last deeds are more than your first. “
But I have this against you: You let that woman Jezebel stay. She calls herself a prophet, and she teaches and leads My servants into sexual wrong and eating food offered to idols.
I gave her time to turn from her sexual wrong, but she does not want to.
So I will throw her on a bed of suffering. I will make those who sin with her suffer very much, unless they turn from what she does. “
I will kill her children. Then all the churches will know that I am the One who looks into hearts and minds. I will pay each of you back for what you have done.
Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to those who do not follow her teaching and have not learned Satan's so-called deep secrets: I will not put any other heavy load on you.
Just hold on to what you have until I come. “
To the one who wins and does My work to the end, I will give power over the nations.
That person will rule them with an iron rod and break them like clay pots, just as I received power from My Father.
I will also give that person the morning star.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.”

"To the angel of the church in Sardis, write this: These are the words of the One who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know what you have done. People think you are alive, but you are really dead.
Wake up! Make strong what is left. It is about to die. I have not found your good works finished before My God.
"Remember what you received and heard. Keep it, and turn back to God. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief. You will not know what time I will come to you.
"But a few people in Sardis have not made their clothes dirty. They are worthy, and they will walk with Me in white clothes.
The one who stays strong will wear white clothes. I will not erase his name from the book of life. I will say his name before My Father and before His angels.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
"To the angel of the church in Philadelphia, write this: These are the words of the Holy One, the True One. He has the key of David. He opens, and no one shuts. He shuts, and no one opens.
I know what you have done. Look, I have put an open door before you. No one can shut it. You have a little strength. You kept My word. You did not deny My name.
"Look, some people say they are Jews, but they are not. They belong to Satan's meeting place. I will make them come and bow down at your feet. Then they will know that I loved you.
You kept My word and stayed strong. So I will keep you safe from the time of trouble that is coming to the whole world. It will test the people who live on earth.
"I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so no one takes your crown.

The one who stays strong, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God. He will never leave again. I will write on him the name of My God. I will write the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem. It comes down from heaven from My God. I will also write My new name.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
"To the angel of the church in Laodicea, write this: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness. He is the beginning of God's creation.
I know what you have done. You are not cold, and you are not hot. I wish you were one or the other.
"So, because you are lukewarm—not hot and not cold—I am about to spit you out of My mouth.
You say, 'I am rich. I have gotten rich. I need nothing.' But you do not know that you are in trouble, poor, blind, and naked.

"I tell you to buy from Me gold that fire has cleaned, so you can be rich. Buy white clothes, so you can cover yourself. Then your shame will not show. Buy eye medicine, so you can put it on your eyes and see.
I correct and train the people I love. So be eager, and turn back to God.
"Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in. I will eat with him, and he will eat with Me.
The one who stays strong, I will let him sit with Me on My throne. I won the victory too, and I sat down with My Father on His throne.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."
After these things, I saw a door open in heaven. The first voice I heard sounded like a trumpet. It spoke to me and said, "Come up here. I will show you what must happen after this."
Right away I was in the Spirit. I saw a throne in heaven, and One was sitting on it.
The One on the throne looked like jasper and a red stone. A rainbow shone around the throne. It looked like an emerald.
Around the throne were twenty-four seats. On them sat twenty-four elders. They wore white clothes. They had gold crowns on their heads.
Lightning, thunder, and voices came from the throne. Seven lamps of fire burned in front of the throne. They are the seven Spirits of God.
In front of the throne was a sea of glass like crystal. In the middle and around the throne were four living creatures. They were full of eyes in front and behind.
The first creature looked like a lion. The second looked like a calf. The third had a face like a man. The fourth looked like a flying eagle.

Each of the four creatures had six wings. They were full of eyes all around and inside. Day and night they do not stop saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, and is, and is to come."
When the creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One sitting on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down before Him. They worship the One who lives forever and ever. They throw their crowns in front of the throne. They say,
"You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory, honor, and power. You made all things. They are here because You wanted them to be."
Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne. It had writing inside and out. It was sealed with seven seals.
I also saw a strong angel shouting loudly, "Who is good enough to open the scroll and break its seals?"
But no one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open the scroll or look inside it.
I cried and cried because no one was good enough to open the scroll or look inside it.
Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not cry. Look! The Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won. He can open the scroll and its seven seals."

Then I saw a Lamb that looked like it had been killed. It stood in the middle of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. It had seven horns and seven eyes. The eyes are the seven Spirits of God sent out to all the earth.
The Lamb came and took the scroll from the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.

When He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and gold bowls full of sweet smoke. The smoke means the prayers of God's holy people.

They sang a new song. They said, "You are good enough to take the scroll and open its seals. You were killed, and with Your blood You bought people for God from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
You made them a kingdom and priests to serve our God. They will rule on the earth."
Then I looked and heard the voices of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. Their number was millions and millions, and thousands and thousands.
They said in a loud voice, "The Lamb that was killed is good enough to receive power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise!"

Then I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and on the sea. Everything in them said, "Praise, honor, glory, and power belong forever and ever to Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!"
The four living creatures said, "Amen!" Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
I saw the Lamb open one of the seven seals. I heard one of the four living things say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"
I looked, and there was a white horse. The rider had a bow. He was given a crown. He went out to win, and to keep on winning.
When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living thing say, "Come!"
Another horse came out. It was red. The rider was given power to take peace from the earth, so people would kill each other. He was given a big sword.
When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living thing say, "Come!" I looked, and there was a black horse. The rider held a scale in his hand.
I heard a voice among the four living things say, "A quart of wheat costs a whole day's pay. Three quarts of barley cost a whole day's pay. Do not hurt the oil or the wine."
When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living thing say, "Come!"

I looked, and there was a pale horse. The rider's name was Death. Death was followed by the grave. They were given power over one fourth of the earth. They could kill with a sword, with hunger, with sickness, and with wild animals.
When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of people who were killed for God's word and for the truth they told.
They cried out in a loud voice, "How long, holy and true Lord, until you judge the people on earth and pay them back for killing us?"
Each one was given a white robe. They were told to rest a little longer. More servants and brothers who would be killed like them still had to come.
I saw when the Lamb opened the sixth seal. There was a big earthquake. The sun turned black like rough cloth. The whole moon turned like blood.
The stars in the sky fell to earth, like figs that fall from a tree when a strong wind shakes it.
The sky was rolled up like a scroll. Every mountain and island moved from its place.
The kings of the earth, the rulers, the army leaders, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
They said to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb."
For the great day of their anger has come, and who can stand?
After this, I saw four angels. They stood at the four corners of the earth. They held back the four winds. No wind blew on the earth, the sea, or any tree.
Then I saw another angel. He came from the east. He had the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels. God had given them power to hurt the earth and the sea.
He said, "Do not hurt the earth, the sea, or the trees. Wait until we put God's mark on the foreheads of His servants."
Then I heard how many people were marked. There were 144,000. They came from all the tribes of Israel.
From Judah: 12,000. From Reuben: 12,000. From Gad: 12,000.
From Asher: 12,000. From Naphtali: 12,000. From Manasseh: 12,000.
From Simeon: 12,000. From Levi: 12,000. From Issachar: 12,000.
From Zebulun: 12,000. From Joseph: 12,000. From Benjamin: 12,000.

After this, I saw a huge crowd. No one could count them. They came from every nation, tribe, people, and language. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb. They wore white robes. They held palm branches in their hands.
They shouted in a loud voice, "Our God saves us! He sits on the throne. The Lamb saves us too!"
All the angels stood around the throne. The leaders and the four living beings were there too. They fell on their faces before the throne. They worshiped God.
They said, "Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen!"
One of the leaders spoke to me. He said, "Who are these people in white robes? Where did they come from?"
I said, "Sir, you know." Then he said, "These are the people who came out of the great trouble. They washed their robes. They made them white in the blood of the Lamb."
So they stand before God's throne. They serve Him day and night in His temple. The One who sits on the throne will live with them.
They will never be hungry again. They will never be thirsty again. The sun will not burn them. No heat will hurt them.
The Lamb is in the middle of the throne. He will be their shepherd. He will lead them to springs of living water. God will wipe every tear from their eyes.
When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was quiet in heaven for about half an hour.
I saw seven angels standing before God. They were given seven trumpets.
