Another angel came and stood at the altar. He had a gold bowl for burning incense. He was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of all God's people. He offered it on the gold altar before the throne.
The smoke from the incense went up with the prayers of God's people. It went up to God from the angel's hand.
The angel took the bowl and filled it with fire from the altar. Then he threw it on the earth. There were thunder, loud noises, lightning, and an earthquake.
The seven angels with the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.
The first angel blew his trumpet. Hail and fire mixed with blood came down on the earth. A third of the earth burned up. A third of the trees burned up. All the green grass burned up.
The second angel blew his trumpet. Something like a huge mountain on fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood.
A third of the living things in the sea died. A third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet. A great star, burning like a lamp, fell from the sky. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The star's name is Wormwood. A third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was bitter.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet. A third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were hit. So a third of them became dark. A third of the day had no light, and a third of the night too.

I looked and heard an eagle flying high in the sky. It called out in a loud voice, "Woe! Woe! Woe to the people who live on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts that the last three angels are about to blow!"
The fifth angel blew his trumpet. I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. He was given the key to the deep hole.
He opened the deep hole. Smoke rose up like smoke from a big oven. The sun and the air became dark because of the smoke.
From the smoke came locusts on the earth. They were given power like scorpions on the earth.
They were told not to hurt the grass, the green plants, or the trees. They could hurt only people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
They were not to kill people. They were to hurt them for five months. The hurt felt like a scorpion sting.
In those days people looked for death but could not find it. They wanted to die, but death ran away from them.
The locusts looked like horses ready for war. They had crowns like gold on their heads. Their faces looked like people's faces.
They had hair like a woman's hair. Their teeth were like lions' teeth.
They had chest plates like iron. The sound of their wings sounded like many horses and wagons running to war.
They had tails and stings like scorpions. Their tails had power to hurt people for five months.
Their king was the angel of the deep hole. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon. In Greek it is Apollyon.
The first terrible thing was over. Two more terrible things were coming.
The sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice from the four horns of the gold altar in front of God.
The voice said to the sixth angel with the trumpet, "Let the four angels go. They are tied up at the big river Euphrates."
The four angels were ready for that hour, day, month, and year. They were set free to kill a third of the people.
I heard the number of the horse soldiers. It was two hundred million.
In the vision, I saw the horses and the riders. They had chest plates of fire, blue, and sulfur. The horses' heads were like lions' heads. Fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
A third of the people died from these three plagues: fire, smoke, and sulfur that came from their mouths.
The horses' power was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes with heads. They hurt people with them.

The rest of the people did not die from these plagues. They still did not turn from their sins. They kept worshiping evil spirits and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Those idols cannot see, hear, or walk.
They did not turn from their murders, evil magic, sexual sins, or stealing.
I saw another strong angel coming down from heaven. He was wrapped in a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun. His feet were like pillars of fire.
He had a small open scroll in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
He cried out with a loud voice, like a lion roars. When he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice from heaven. It said, "Seal what the seven thunders said. Do not write them down."
The angel I saw was standing on the sea and on the land. He raised his right hand to heaven.

The angel swore by the One who lives forever and ever. He made heaven and everything in it. He made the earth and everything in it. He made the sea and everything in it. He said, "There will be no more waiting!"
But in the days when the seventh angel is about to blow his trumpet, God's secret plan will be finished. God told this to His servants, the prophets.
I heard the voice from heaven again. It spoke to me. It said, "Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land."
So I went to the angel. I said, "Give me the little scroll." The angel said, "Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter. But in your mouth it will be sweet like honey."
I took the little scroll from the angel's hand. I ate it. It was sweet like honey in my mouth. But after I ate it, my stomach became bitter.
Then they said to me, "You must tell God's message again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."
I was given a measuring stick like a rod. A voice said, "Get up and measure God's temple and the altar, and count the people worshiping there."
But do not measure the outer courtyard. Leave it out, because it was given to the nations. They will walk all over the holy city for 42 months.
I will give power to my two witnesses. They will speak God's message for 1,260 days. They will wear rough cloth.
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
If anyone tries to hurt them, fire comes from their mouths and eats up their enemies. Anyone who tries to hurt them must be killed.
They have power to shut the sky so rain does not fall while they speak God's message. They have power to turn water into blood. They can hit the earth with any plague whenever they want.
When they finish speaking, the beast that comes up from the deep pit will fight them. It will beat them and kill them.
Their bodies will lie in the street of the big city. That city is called Sodom and Egypt in a spiritual way. It is where their Lord was nailed to a cross.
People from many nations, tribes, languages, and groups will look at their bodies for three and a half days. They will not let the bodies be buried.
The people who live on earth will be happy about this. They will celebrate and send gifts to each other, because these two prophets made life hard for them.
But after three and a half days, God's breath of life went into them. They stood up. The people watching them were very afraid.
Then they heard a loud voice from heaven say, "Come up here!" They went up to heaven in a cloud. Their enemies watched them.
At that same hour there was a big earthquake. A tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed. The rest were afraid and gave praise to God in heaven.
The second disaster is over. Look, the third disaster is coming soon.
The seventh angel blew his horn. Loud voices in heaven said, "The world's kingdom now belongs to our Lord and His Christ. He will rule forever and ever."
The 24 elders who sit on thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God.
They said, "We thank You, Lord God Almighty. You are the One who is and who was. You have taken Your great power and now You rule.

The nations were angry. Your anger came. It is time to judge the dead, to give Your reward to Your servants, the prophets and the holy people, and to all who fear Your name, small and great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth."
Then God's temple in heaven opened. People could see the box of His agreement in His temple. There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake, and big hail.
A big sign appeared in heaven. A woman was dressed in the sun. The moon was under her feet. She wore a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was about to have a baby. She cried out in pain.
Another sign appeared in heaven. It was a big red dragon. It had seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

Its tail pulled down one third of the stars in the sky. It threw them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman. She was about to have her baby. The dragon wanted to eat her baby as soon as it was born.
She had a baby boy. He will rule all nations with an iron rod. Her baby was taken up to God, to His throne.
The woman went to the desert. God had a safe place ready for her there. She was fed there for 1,260 days.
Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought the dragon. The dragon and his angels fought back.
But the dragon was not strong enough. He and his angels could not stay in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down to earth. He is the old snake. People call him the Devil and Satan. He tricks the whole world. He and his angels were thrown down too.

Then I heard a loud voice in heaven. It said, “Now God has saved us! Now He has power and a kingdom! Now Christ has the right to rule! The one who blamed our brothers has been thrown down. He blamed them day and night before our God.
They won over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the things they said about Jesus. They did not love their own lives, even when it meant death.
So be happy, you heavens and everyone who lives there! But trouble is coming for the earth and the sea! The devil came down to you with great anger. He knows his time is short.”
When the dragon saw he was thrown to earth, he chased the woman who had the baby boy.
The woman was given two wings like a big eagle’s wings. She could fly away from the snake to her place in the desert. There she was fed for three and a half years.
The snake poured water like a river out of his mouth after the woman. He wanted to wash her away.
But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river the dragon poured out.
The dragon was angry at the woman. He went to fight the rest of her children. They obey God’s rules and tell about Jesus. Then the dragon stood on the sand by the sea.
Then I saw a beast come up from the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads. It had ten crowns on its horns. It had names that spoke against God on its heads.
The beast looked like a leopard. Its feet were like a bear's feet. Its mouth was like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave the beast its power, its throne, and great power to rule.
One of the beast's heads looked like it had been killed. But the deadly wound healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
People worshiped the dragon because he gave power to the beast. They also worshiped the beast. They said, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?"
The beast was given a mouth to speak proud words against God. It was allowed to use its power for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to speak against God. It spoke against God's name. It spoke against God's home and the people who live in heaven.
It was allowed to fight God's holy people and beat them. It was given power over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
All people on earth will worship it. But those whose names are in the Lamb's book of life will not. The Lamb was killed. Their names were written before the world began.
If someone is to be taken prisoner, they will be taken prisoner. If someone is to be killed with a sword, they will be killed with a sword. This is where God's people need patience and faith.
Then I saw another beast come up from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb's horns. But it spoke like a dragon.
It used all the power of the first beast right in front of it. It made the earth and everyone living on it worship the first beast. That beast's deadly wound had healed.
It did great miracles. It even made fire come down from heaven to earth while people watched.
It tricked the people living on earth. It told them, "Make a statue of the beast that was hurt by a sword but lived."
It was allowed to give life to the statue. Then the statue could speak. It made people who did not worship the statue be killed.
It made everyone get a mark. Small and great people, rich and poor, free and slave, all got it. The mark was on the right hand or on the forehead.
No one could buy or sell unless they had the mark. The mark was the beast's name or the number of its name.
This needs wisdom. Anyone who understands should figure out the beast's number. It is a man's number. His number is 666.
Then I looked, and there was the Lamb standing on Mount Zion. With Him were 144,000 people. They had His name and His Father's name written on their foreheads.
I heard a sound from heaven. It was like the sound of many waters. It was like loud thunder. The sound I heard was like people playing harps.
They sang a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures, and before the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who were bought from the earth.

These people kept themselves clean. They did not sin with women. They are pure. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They were bought from among people. They are the first gift to God and to the Lamb.
No lie was found in their mouths. They are without blame.
Then I saw another angel flying high in the sky. He had the good news that lasts forever. He was to share it with everyone on earth. He was to share it with every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give Him praise. The time has come for Him to judge. Worship the One who made heaven, earth, the sea, and the springs of water."
Another angel followed and said, "Fallen! Fallen is great Babylon! She made all the nations drink the wine of her angry sin."
A third angel followed them. He said in a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and its image, and gets its mark on his forehead or hand,
he will drink the wine of God's anger. It is poured full strength into the cup of His wrath. He will be hurt in fire and burning sulfur. This will happen before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
The smoke of their pain goes up forever and ever. Those who worship the beast and its image have no rest day or night. The same is true for anyone who gets the mark of its name."
Here is where God's people need to be patient. They keep God's commands and trust in Jesus.
Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Happy are those who die in the Lord from now on.""Yes," says the Spirit. "They will rest from their hard work. Their good works will follow them."
Then I looked, and I saw a white cloud. Someone sat on the cloud. He looked like the Son of Man. He had a gold crown on His head. He had a sharp sickle in His hand.
Another angel came out of the temple. He called in a loud voice to the One on the cloud, "Send your sickle and reap. The time has come to reap. The harvest of the earth is ripe."
The One on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth. The earth was harvested.
Another angel came out of the temple in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

Another angel came out from the altar. He had power over fire. He called in a loud voice to the one with the sharp sickle, "Send your sharp sickle. Gather the clusters of grapes from the earth's vine. The grapes are ripe."
The angel swung his sickle on the earth. He gathered the grapes. He threw them into God's great winepress of anger.
The winepress was trampled outside the city. Blood came out of it. It reached up to the horses' mouths. It went for about 180 miles.
I saw another big and amazing sign in heaven. Seven angels had the seven last troubles. God's anger was finished in them.
I saw something like a sea made of glass mixed with fire. People who had won against the beast, his statue, and the number of his name stood on the glassy sea. They had God's harps.
They sang the song of Moses, God's servant, and the song of the Lamb. They said, "Your works are great and amazing, Lord God Almighty. Your ways are right and true, King of all nations.
Who will not be afraid of You, Lord, and praise Your name? You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship You, because Your right acts have been shown."
After this I looked, and the temple of the tent of witness in heaven opened.
Seven angels came out of the temple. They had the seven troubles. They wore clean, bright linen and gold belts around their chests.
One of the four living beings gave the seven angels seven gold bowls. The bowls were full of God's anger. God lives forever and ever.
The temple filled with smoke from God's glory and His power. No one could go in until the seven troubles of the seven angels were done.
I heard a loud voice from the temple. It said to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth."
The first angel went and poured his bowl on the earth. Painful, bad sores came on the people who had the beast's mark and who worshiped its picture.
The second angel poured his bowl into the sea. The sea turned to blood, like the blood of a dead person. Every living thing in the sea died.
The third angel poured his bowl into the rivers and springs. They turned to blood.
I heard the angel of the waters say, "You are right, O Holy One, who is and who was, because You judged these things.
They poured out the blood of Your holy people and Your prophets. So You gave them blood to drink. They deserve it."
I heard the altar say, "Yes, Lord God Almighty, Your judgments are true and right."
The fourth angel poured his bowl on the sun. The sun was given power to burn people with fire.
The people were burned with great heat. They said bad things about God's name, the God who has power over these troubles. But they did not turn from their wrong ways to give Him glory.
The fifth angel poured his bowl on the throne of the beast. The beast's kingdom became dark. People bit their tongues because of the pain.
They said bad things about the God of heaven because of their pain and sores. But they did not turn from their wrong ways.
The sixth angel poured his bowl on the great river Euphrates. Its water dried up to make a way for the kings from the east.
I saw three bad spirits that looked like frogs. They came from the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast, and the mouth of the false prophet.
They are spirits of demons. They do amazing signs. They go out to the kings of the whole world to gather them for the war on the great day of God Almighty.
"Look, I am coming like a thief! Happy is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes, so he will not walk around naked and have people see his shame."
They gathered them together in the place called Armageddon in Hebrew.
The seventh angel poured his bowl into the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple. It said, "It is done!"
Then there were lightning flashes, sounds, and thunder. There was a great earthquake. It was bigger than any earthquake since people have been on earth.
The great city split into three parts. The cities of the nations fell. God remembered great Babylon. He gave her a cup of wine filled with His fierce anger.
Every island disappeared, and the mountains could not be found.
Huge hail, as heavy as a large rock, fell from the sky on the people. The people said bad things about God because of the hail. The punishment was very, very bad.
One of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and talked with me. He said, "Come. I will show you how God will judge the great prostitute. She sits on many waters."
The kings of the earth did bad things with her. The people who live on earth got drunk on her evil way.
The Spirit carried me into a desert. I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was full of evil names. It had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman wore purple and red clothes. She was covered with gold, jewels, and pearls. She held a gold cup full of dirty and evil things from her bad life.
On her forehead was a secret name: "BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE EVIL THINGS OF THE EARTH."
I saw the woman drunk with the blood of God's people. She was drunk with the blood of those who told about Jesus. I was very amazed when I saw her.
The angel said, "Why are you amazed? I will tell you the secret about the woman and the beast that carries her. The beast has seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw was alive. It is not alive now. It will come up from the deep hole and go to be destroyed. People on earth whose names are not written in the book of life from the start of the world will be amazed when they see the beast. It was alive, it is not alive now, and it will come again. "
This needs a wise mind: The seven heads are seven mountains. The woman sits on them.
They are also seven kings. Five have already fallen. One is ruling now. The other has not come yet. When he comes, he must stay for a short time.
The beast that was alive and is not alive now is also an eighth king. He belongs to the seven, and he goes to be destroyed. "
The ten horns you saw are ten kings. They have not yet received a kingdom. But they will receive power as kings for one hour with the beast.
They all agree. They give their power and authority to the beast.
They will fight against the Lamb. But the Lamb will win, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings. The people with Him are called, chosen, and faithful."
The angel said, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The ten horns and the beast you saw will hate the prostitute. They will ruin her and leave her naked. They will destroy her and burn her with fire.
God put it in their hearts to do what He wants. He made them agree. He made them give their kingdom to the beast until God's words come true.
The woman you saw is the great city. It rules over the kings of the earth."
After these things, I saw another angel come down from heaven. He had great power. The earth shone with his glory.

He cried out in a loud voice, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She is now a home for demons. She is a prison for every bad spirit. She is a prison for every dirty bird. She is a prison for every dirty and hated beast."
She led all nations to sin. The kings of the earth did wrong with her. The sellers of the earth got rich from her fancy life.
Then I heard another voice from heaven. It said, "Come out of her, my people, so you do not share in her sins or get her troubles."
Her sins piled up to heaven. God remembers her bad deeds.
Pay her back for what she did. Give her twice as much trouble for her bad work. Mix her a double cup of what she mixed.
She gave herself glory and lived in luxury. Give her that much pain and sadness. She says in her heart, "I sit as queen. I am not a widow. I will not be sad."
So her troubles will come in one day: death, sadness, and hunger. She will be burned with fire. The Lord God is strong, and He judges her.
The kings of the earth did wrong and lived fancy with her. They will cry and be sad when they see her smoke.
They stand far away because they are afraid of her pain. They say, "Oh no! Oh no! The great city! The strong city Babylon! In one hour, your punishment has come."
The sellers of the earth cry and are sad. No one buys their goods anymore.

Their goods are gold, silver, pretty stones, pearls, fine cloth, purple cloth, silk, red cloth, all kinds of special wood, things made of ivory, things made of the best wood, bronze, iron, and marble.
They also sell cinnamon, spice, sweet smells, perfume, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, wagons, and even people's lives.
The things you wanted most are gone from you. All the rich and bright things are lost from you. They will never be found again.
The sellers who got rich from her stand far away. They are afraid of her pain. They cry and are sad.
They say, "Oh no! Oh no! The great city! She wore fine cloth, purple, and red. She was covered with gold, pretty stones, and pearls."
In one hour, all that wealth was ruined. Every ship captain, every sailor, and everyone who works on the sea stood far away.
They cried out when they saw her smoke. They said, "Who is like the great city?"
They threw dust on their heads. They cried and were sad. They said, "Oh no! Oh no! The great city! In her, all who had ships on the sea got rich from her costly things. In one hour, she was ruined."
Rejoice over her, heaven! Rejoice, saints, apostles, and prophets! God has judged your case against her.

Then a strong angel picked up a stone. It was as big as a heavy grinding stone. He threw it into the sea. He said, "So Babylon the great city will be thrown down with force. She will not be found anymore."
No one will hear music, flutes, or trumpets in you anymore. No worker of any kind will be found in you anymore. No mill sound will be heard in you anymore.
No lamp light will shine in you anymore. No bride or groom will be heard in you anymore. Your sellers were the great men of the earth. All nations were led astray by your magic.
In her, blood of prophets and saints was found, and blood of all who were killed on the earth.
After these things I heard a loud voice like a great crowd in heaven. They said, "Praise the Lord! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God.
His decisions are true and fair. He judged the great evil woman who ruined the earth with her sexual sin. He punished her for killing His servants."
Again they said, "Praise the Lord! The smoke from her rises forever and ever."
The 24 leaders and the four living beings fell down and worshiped God, who sits on the throne. They said, "Amen. Praise the Lord!"
A voice came from the throne. It said, "Praise our God, all you His servants, and you who respect Him, both small and great."
I heard something like a great crowd, like the roar of many waters, and like strong thunder. They said, "Praise the Lord! The Lord our God, the All-Powerful One, is King.
Let us be glad and rejoice. Let us give Him glory. The wedding of the Lamb has come, and His bride has gotten ready."
She was given fine white clothes, bright and clean. The fine clothes mean the good things God's holy people have done.
The angel said to me, "Write this: Happy are those invited to the wedding dinner of the Lamb." Then he said, "These are the true words from God."

I fell down at his feet to worship him. But he said, "Don't worship me! I am a servant like you and your brothers who tell about Jesus. Worship God. The message about Jesus is what prophecy is all about."
I saw heaven open. There was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True. He judges and fights fairly.
His eyes were like flames of fire. He wore many crowns on His head. He has a name written that only He knows.
He wore a robe dipped in blood. His name is called the Word of God.
Heaven's armies followed Him. They rode white horses and wore clean white clothes.
A sharp sword came from His mouth. With it He will hit the nations. He will rule them with an iron stick. He will carry out God's fierce anger, the anger of the All-Powerful God.
On His robe and on His thigh He has a name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried in a loud voice to all the birds flying in the sky, "Come! Gather for God's great dinner.
Eat the flesh of kings, army leaders, strong men, horses and riders, and all people, slaves and free, small and great."
I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to fight the rider on the horse and His army.

The beast was caught. The false prophet was with him. He had done amazing signs that tricked the people who got the beast's mark and worshiped his statue. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
The rest were killed by the sword from the rider's mouth. All the birds ate until they were full.
I saw an angel come down from heaven. He had the key to the deep pit. He also had a big chain in his hand.
He grabbed the dragon. The dragon is the old snake. He is the Devil and Satan. The angel tied him up for a thousand years.

He threw him into the deep pit. He shut it and locked it. This was so Satan could not trick the nations anymore. It would last until the thousand years were over. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

I saw thrones. People sat on them. They were given the power to judge. I also saw the souls of people who were killed. They died because they told about Jesus. They died because they obeyed God's word. They had not bowed down to the beast. They had not bowed down to its statue. They had not taken its mark on their forehead or hand. They came to life. They ruled with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come to life. This was until the thousand years were over. This is the first rising from the dead.

Happy and holy are the people who take part in the first rising from the dead. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and for Christ. They will rule with Him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are over, Satan will be set free from his prison.
He will go out and trick the nations all over the world. These are Gog and Magog. He will gather them for war. There will be as many of them as grains of sand by the sea.
They marched across the wide land. They surrounded the camp of God's holy people. They surrounded the city He loves. But fire came down from heaven. It burned them up.
The devil who tricked them was thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. The beast and the false prophet are there too. They will suffer day and night forever and ever.
I saw a great white throne. I saw the One sitting on it. Earth and sky ran away from His face. There was no place left for them.

I saw the dead. Some were great. Some were small. They stood before the throne. Books were opened. Another book was opened too. It is the book of life. The dead were judged by what they had done. It was written in the books.
The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and the grave gave up the dead who were in them. Each person was judged by what they had done.
Then death and the grave were thrown into the lake of fire. This lake of fire is the second death.
Anyone whose name was not in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth were gone. The sea was gone too.
I saw the holy city. It was the new Jerusalem. It came down from heaven from God. It was ready like a bride dressed for her husband.
I heard a loud voice from the throne. It said, "Look! God's home is with people. He will live with them. They will be His people. God Himself will be with them. He will be their God.
He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death. There will be no more sadness, crying, or pain. The old things are gone."
He who sat on the throne said, "Look! I am making all things new." He also said, "Write this down. These words are true and can be trusted."
He said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega. I am the Beginning and the End. I will give free water from the spring of the water of life to anyone who is thirsty.
The one who wins will get all these things. I will be his God, and he will be My son.

But cowards, people who do not believe, people who do things God hates, murderers, people who do wrong sexual things, people who do magic, people who worship false gods, and all liars will have their place in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death."
One of the seven angels came to me. He had the seven bowls full of the last seven troubles. He said, "Come. I will show you the bride. She is the wife of the Lamb."
He carried me in the Spirit to a very high mountain. He showed me the holy city, Jerusalem. It came down from heaven from God.
The city had God's glory. It shone like a very precious stone. It was like a jasper stone, clear like crystal.
It had a great, high wall. It had twelve gates. Twelve angels stood at the gates. The names of the twelve tribes of Israel's sons were written on the gates.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The city wall had twelve foundations. On them were the twelve names of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
The angel who talked with me had a gold measuring stick. He used it to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
The city was square. It was as wide as it was long. He measured the city with the stick. It was 12,000 stadia long, wide, and high.
He also measured the wall. It was 144 cubits. This was a person's measure, and it is also an angel's measure.
The wall was made of jasper. The city was made of pure gold. It was like clear glass.
The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper. The second was sapphire. The third was agate. The fourth was emerald.
The fifth was onyx. The sixth was carnelian. The seventh was chrysolite. The eighth was beryl. The ninth was topaz. The tenth was chrysoprase. The eleventh was jacinth. The twelfth was amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each gate was made from one pearl. The city's main street was pure gold. It was like see-through glass.
I did not see a temple in the city. The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it. God's glory gives it light. The Lamb is its lamp.
People from all countries will walk by its light. The kings of the earth will bring their honor into it.
Its gates will never be shut during the day. There will be no night there.
They will bring the honor and respect of all countries into it.
Nothing dirty will ever go into it. No one who does things God hates or tells lies will go in. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will go in.
Then the angel showed me a river of water that gives life. It was clear like glass. It flowed from the throne of God and the Lamb.
The river ran down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river grew the tree of life. It had twelve kinds of fruit. It gave fruit every month. Its leaves healed the countries.
Nothing will be cursed anymore. The throne of God and the Lamb will be there. His servants will worship Him.
They will see His face. His name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night. They will not need light from a lamp or from the sun. The Lord God will give them light. They will rule forever and ever.
Then the angel said to me, "These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God, who is over the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His servants what must soon happen."
"Look! I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who obeys the words of this prophecy."
I, John, heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down. I worshiped at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
But he said to me, "Don't do that! I am a servant just like you, your brothers who are prophets, and everyone who obeys this book. Worship God!"
Then he said to me, "Do not keep these words secret. The time is near.
Let the one who does wrong keep doing wrong. Let the one who is dirty keep being dirty. Let the one who does right keep doing right. Let the one who is holy keep being holy."
"Look! I am coming soon. I will bring My reward with Me. I will pay each person for what they have done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega. I am the First and the Last. I am the Beginning and the End."
"Blessed are those who wash their robes. They will have the right to eat from the tree of life. They will go through the gates into the city.
But outside are unclean people, those who use magic, those who are immoral, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves and tells lies."
"I, Jesus, sent My angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the Root and the descendant of David. I am the bright Morning Star."
The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Let the one who hears say, "Come!" Let the thirsty one come. Let anyone who wants it take the water of life for free.
I warn everyone who hears the words of this prophecy: If anyone adds to them, God will add to that person the troubles written in this book.
If anyone takes away from the words of this prophecy, God will take away that person's share in the tree of life and in the holy city. This is written in this book.
The One who says these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
May the kindness of the Lord Jesus be with all God's holy people. Amen.
